p-001.title: Fudumeza i-Thermos Yakho Ngaphambili
p-001.summary: Ukugxaza i-thermos ngamanzi ashisayo kuqala kugcina isiphuzo sakho sifudumele isikhathi eside kakhulu.
p-001.principle: Ukushisa kuphuma ngokuhamba (conduction), ngokugingqika komoya (convection) nangemisebe (radiation); ungqimba lwe-vacuum luvimba lokhu kokuqala okubili kanti udonga olunombala osiliva lunciphisa imisebe. Amandla $Q = mc\Delta T$ asetshenziswa kuqala ekufudumezeni udonga lwebhodlela.
p-001.example: Ukufudumeza udonga lwensimbi engenasici (stainless steel) olungama-200 g ($c\approx0.5\ \mathrm{J/g\cdot K}$) lusuka ku-20°C luya ku-90°C kuthatha cishe ama-7 kJ. Ngaphandle kokufudumeza ngaphambili, isiphuzo sakho sinikeza lokho kushisa futhi sehle cishe ngo-3-4°C ngokushesha.
p-001.actionItem: Namhlanje ekuseni, gcwalisa i-thermos yakho ngamanzi abilayo imizuzu emi-3, uwachithe, bese ufaka isiphuzo sakho.

p-002.title: Pholisa Ukudla Okushisayo Ngaphambi Kokukufaka Esiqandisini
p-002.summary: Ukufaka isobho elishisayo ngqo esiqandisini kufudumeza okunye ukudla futhi kudla ugesi owengeziwe.
p-002.principle: Isiqandisi kufanele sikhiphe ukushisa $Q = mc\Delta T$ nge-compressor yaso. Isitsha esingajulile, esibanzi sinendawo engaphezulu enkulu, ngakho-ke siphora ngokushesha nge-$P = hA\Delta T$.
p-002.example: Ukupholisa amalitha ama-3 esobho kusuka ku-80°C kuya ku-5°C kususa cishe $3000\times4.18\times75\approx940\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Ukukuyeka kufinyelele ku-40°C etafuleni kuqala kususa cishe ingxenye yalowo mthwalo esiqandisini.
p-002.actionItem: Namuhla hlukanisa ukudla okushisayo ezitsheni ezingajulile, kupholise kuze kufike ku-30-40°C, bese ukufaka esiqandisini emahoreni ama-2.

p-003.title: Ukuvikela Ukubanda Kwefasitela Nge-Bubble Wrap
p-003.summary: Ukunamathisela i-bubble wrap efasiteleni kubamba umoya ongahambi onqamula kakhulu ukulahleka kokushisa.
p-003.principle: Umoya ongahambi uhambisa kuphela cishe $0.026\ \mathrm{W/m\cdot K}$, okungu-1/40 wengilazi ($1.0$). Ku-$Q = UA\Delta T$ i-coefficient engu-$U$ iyawa.
p-003.example: Iwindi elilodwa elingama-2 $\mathrm{m^2}$ elinegebe elingu-20°C phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle kanye ne-$U\approx5.8$ lilahlekelwa ngama-232 W. I-bubble wrap eyehlisa u-$U$ ibe cishe ku-3.5 inikeza ama-140 W, yonge cishe ama-90 W.
p-003.actionItem: Namuhla fafaza amanzi efasiteleni bese ucindezela i-bubble wrap, uhlangothi oluyisicaba lubheke engilazini.

p-004.title: Ingubo Kagesi vs Ukufudumeza Indlu Yonke
p-004.summary: Uma uwedwa, ukufudumeza umzimba wakho kuphela ngengubo kagesi kungcono kakhulu kunokufudumeza igumbi lonke.
p-004.principle: Amandla okufudumeza $E = Pt$ akhula ngokuya ngobukhulu bendawo oyifudumezayo. Ukufudumeza kuphela indawo encane ngaphansi kwezingubo kudinga ukushisa okuncane kakhulu.
p-004.example: Ingubo kagesi engama-50 W yamahora ayi-8 isebenzisa i-0.4 kWh. Ukufudumeza igumbi nge-heater engama-4 kW amahora ayi-8 kungasebenzisa kufika ku-32 kWh, ngokuphindwe izikhathi eziningi.
p-004.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku yehlisa i-thermostat ngo-1-2°C bese usebenzisa ingubo kagesi ezingeni eliphansi.

p-005.title: Ukugcina Ilayisi Lifudumele vs Ukufriza Izingxenye Zalo
p-005.summary: Ukufriza ilayisi elisele linezingxenye ezincane kusebenzisa amandla kagesi amancane kunokuliyeka embizeni kagesi lifudumala.
p-005.principle: Ukugcina kufudumele kumele kuqhubeke nokunxephezela ukulahleka kodonga $P = UA\Delta T$. Ukushisisa kabusha nge-microwave kusebenzisa i-$E = Pt$ kuphela lapho kudingeka.
p-005.example: Ukugcina kufudumele cishe ngama-60 W amahora angama-24 kungu-1.44 kWh. Ukushisisa kabusha isitsha esisodwa esingu-200 g ku-700 W imizuzu emi-2 kuthatha cishe u-0.023 kWh.
p-005.actionItem: Namuhla songa ilayisi elisele libe izingxenye ezanele ukudliwa kanye, lifrize, bese ucisha imodi yokufudumeza.

p-006.title: Ibhethri Yefoni Ebandeni
p-006.summary: Ifoni ecimayo esimweni sezulu esiqandayo kungenxa yokuthi amakhemikhali ebhethri ahamba kancane.
p-006.principle: Ukuhamba kwama-ion kulandela i-Arrhenius $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, kwehla kakhulu njengoba izinga lokushisa lehla kuyilapho ukumelana kwangaphakathi (internal resistance) kukhuphuka kanti i-voltage iyehla.
p-006.example: Iseli le-lithium-ion linganikeza kuphela cishe u-70-80% wamandla alo ku-0°C futhi kube kuncane kakhulu ku--10°C, ngakho-ke ifoni ebonisa u-30% ngaphandle ingacima kungazelelwe.
p-006.actionItem: Uma uphuma, gcina ifoni yakho ephaketheni elingaphakathi; uma icima, yifudumeze ngomzimba wakho ngaphambi kokuyivula kabusha.

p-007.title: Ukuhlolwa Kwebhethri Lemoto Ebusika
p-007.summary: Imoto yehluleka ukuqubuka emakhazeni amakhulu ngoba amandla aphumayo ebhethri ayehlika kanti nowoyela uyajiya.
p-007.principle: Amandla atholakala ngokuthi $P = VI$; emakhazeni ukumelana kwangaphakathi $r$ kuyakhuphuka, ngakho-ke i-terminal voltage $V = \varepsilon - Ir$ iyehla.
p-007.example: Emsakazweni wokuqubuka ongu-400 A, ukumelana okukhuphuka kusuka ku-0.01 Ω kuya ku-0.02 Ω kukhulisa ukwehla kusuka ku-4 V kuya ku-8 V, okushiya okuncane kakhulu ebhethrini elingu-12 V.
p-007.actionItem: Namuhla cisha izibani nesifudumezi ngaphambi kokuqubula imoto, futhi uhlole ibhethri elineminyaka engaphezu kwemithathu ubudala.

p-008.title: Ukuhamba Phezu Kweqhwa
p-008.summary: Phezu kweqhwa, izinyathelo ezimfushane unyathela phansi ngezinyawo zonke zisebenzisa kahle ukungqubuzana.
p-008.principle: Ukuze ungashibiliki kudingeka $F \le \mu N$. Eqhweni $\mu\approx0.05\text{-}0.1$, cishe ingxenye eyodwa kweyishumi yetiyela elomile ($\approx0.7$).
p-008.example: Unyawo luyashelela uma isilinganiso samandla athe mpo kwaya phansi, $\tan\theta$, sedlula $\mu$. Ukunciphisa ububanzi besinyathelo sakho phakathi kunciphisa u-$\theta$ abuyele ebangeni eliphephile.
p-008.actionItem: Ngosuku olulandelayo olunomqhele weqhwa nciphisa isinyathelo sakho phakathi futhi ungawafaki amandla akho emaphaketheni.

p-009.title: Shiya Isizinda Se-Microwave Singenalutho
p-009.summary: Ukuhlela ukudla kube yindilinga epuletini kwenza i-microwave ifudumale ngokulinganayo.
p-009.principle: Ama-microwave aku-2.45 GHz akha amagagasi amile anobude begagasi obungu-$\lambda = c/f \approx 12.2\ \mathrm{cm}$, okudala izindawo ezishisayo nezibandayo.
p-009.example: Isizinda sepuleti sivame ukuthola amandla amancane futhi sihlale sibanda. Isakhiwo esiyindilinga kanye nokunyakazisa kanye phakathi nendawo kunganciphisa umehluko wokushisa ngo-20°C noma ngaphezulu.
p-009.actionItem: Namuhla hlela ukudla kube yindilinga bese ushiya maphakathi kungenalutho, uphinde ukugoqoze phakathi nendawo lapho kufudumala.

p-010.title: Vala Isivalo Lapho Ubilisa
p-010.summary: Ukusibekela ibhodwe nje kuphela kunciphisa kakhulu isikweletu sakho segesi.
p-010.principle: Amanzi ahwamukayo amuka nokushisa okufihliwe $L \approx 2260\ \mathrm{J/g}$. Isivalo sivimba umhwamuko nokulahleka kokushisa, ngakho ukushisa okufanayo kubilisa ngokushesha okukhulu.
p-010.example: Ukufudumeza u-1 L kusuka ku-20°C kuya ku-100°C kudinga $Q = 1000\times4.18\times80\approx334\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Isivalo sivame ukunciphisa isikhathi negesi cishe ngo-20-30%.
p-010.actionItem: Namuhla beka isivalo kusukela ekuqaleni lapho ubilisa ama-noodle noma isobho.

p-011.title: I-Freezer Egcwele, Isiqandisi Esivulekile
p-011.summary: I-freezer egcwele igcina izinga lokushisa layo lapho ivulwa, kanti isiqandisi sidinga indawo yokuba umoya uhambe.
p-011.principle: Umthamo omkhulu wokumelana nokushisa $C = mc$ weqhwa nokudla ugcina amakhaza, okunciphisa $\Delta T = Q/C$. Ingxenye yesiqandisi idinga ukuhamba komoya.
p-011.example: Ukuvula umnyango imizuzwana engu-10 kushintshanisa cishe u-100 L womoya we-freezer, ngakho-ke i-freezer engenalutho ifudumala cishe ngo-5°C, kanti egcwele ivikelwa okuqukethwe kuyo futhi ibuyela esimweni ngokushesha kakhulu.
p-011.actionItem: Namuhla qandisa amabhodlela ambalwa amanzi bese ugcwalisa izindawo ezingenalutho ku-freezer yakho.

p-012.title: Isibuko Esingemuva Kwe-Radiator
p-012.summary: I-foil esodongeni ngemuva kwe-radiator ibuyisela ukushisa ekamelweni.
p-012.principle: Amandla emisebe atholakala ngokuthi $P = \varepsilon\sigma A T^4$; i-aluminium ecwebezelayo inokukhishwa okuphansi nokukhanya okuphezulu, okuphindisela imisebe ye-infrared ekamelweni.
p-012.example: Ingxenye yokushisa kwe-radiator esodongeni lwangaphandle imuncwa udonga. Isibuko siyayibuyisela, ngakho ukufudumeza okufanayo kufudumeza igumbi ngokushesha nokulahleka okuncane odongeni.
p-012.actionItem: Namuhla namathisela i-foil eqinile ebonisayo ngemuva kwe-radiator esodongeni olubheke ngaphandle.

p-013.title: Zingela Amandla we-Standby
p-013.summary: Izinto zikagesi ezibukeka zicishiwe zisadonsa ugesi ngenkathi zisaxhunyiwe.
p-013.principle: Amandla atholakala nge-$E = Pt$. Ukudonsa amandla okungu-5 W e-standby kubukeka kukuncane kodwa kusebenza amahora angama-24 ngosuku, amahora angama-8760 ngonyaka.
p-013.example: Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-standby engu-20 W kusebenzisa u-$0.02\times8760 \approx 175\ \mathrm{kWh}$, cishe ama-KRW angama-35,000 ngonyaka ngamanani angama-200 KRW nge-kWh ngayinye.
p-013.actionItem: Namuhla hlanganisa i-TV, i-set-top box kanye namashaja kusokhethi enokhiye bese uyicisha ngesikhathi sokulala.

p-014.title: Yehlisa I-thermostat Ngo-1°C
p-014.summary: Ukwehlisa izinga lokushisa legumbi ngo-1°C nje kuphela kunciphisa kakhulu amandla okushisa.
p-014.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa $Q = UA\Delta T$ kuhambisana ngqo nomehluko ophakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle $\Delta T$.
p-014.example: Ngo-0°C ngaphandle, ukusuka ku-22°C kuye ku-21°C kunciphisa u-$\Delta T$ kusuka ku-22 kuye ku-21, cishe ngo-4.5%, futhi amandla okushisa ehla cishe ngesilinganiso esifanayo.
p-014.actionItem: Namuhla yehlisa i-thermostat ngo-1°C bese ugqoka ijezi.

p-015.title: Ubude Bamakhethini Nokulahleka Kokushisa Efasiteleni
p-015.summary: Amakhethini aminyene afika phansi avimba umoya obandayo ukuthi ungangeni efasiteleni.
p-015.principle: Umoya oseduze nengilazi ebandayo uyaminyana kakhulu bese uyehla, okudala i-convection. Ku-$Q = hA\Delta T$ ikhethini lehlisa i-convection coefficient $h$.
p-015.example: Ukuvala amakhethini aminyene kusuka kufremu kuye phansi kuvame ukunciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa efasiteleni ngo-10-25%. Isikhala sivumela umoya obandayo ukuba uphume njengoshimula.
p-015.actionItem: Ngemuva kokushona kwelanga namhlanje donsa amakhethini avaleke ngokuphelele futhi uhlole ukuthi umphetho uthinta phansi.

p-016.title: Vala Izikhala Zomoya Emnyango
p-016.summary: Isikhala esingu-1 mm eduze komnyango sidla buthule imali yakho yokufudumeza yasebusika.
p-016.principle: Umoya ongenayo ngenxa yokuvuza kufanele ufudunyezwe: $P = \rho c \dot V \Delta T$, lapho umoya ungu-$\rho c \approx 1.2\ \mathrm{kJ/m^3 K}$.
p-016.example: Ukuvuza okungu-20 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ ngo-$\Delta T=20$°C kubiza u-$P \approx 1.2\times20\times20/3.6\approx133\ \mathrm{W}$. Ukuvala ingxenye konga cishe ama-66 W.
p-016.actionItem: Namuhla namathisela i-weatherstrip tape phansi emnyango nasemaphethelweni ewindo.

p-017.title: Umfutho Wamathayiasebusika
p-017.summary: Umfutho wamathayi uyehlela phansi kanye nezinga lokushisa.
p-017.principle: Kwigesi ekahle esilinganisweni esingaguquki $P/T = \text{const}$. Njengoba izinga lokushisa eliphelele $T$ lehla, umfutho $P$ nawo wehla ngendlela efanayo.
p-017.example: Ithayi eliku-35 psi ku-20°C (293 K) lifundeka njengo-$35\times263/293\approx31.4\ \mathrm{psi}$ ku--10°C (263 K), cishe ngaphansi ngo-3.6 psi.
p-017.actionItem: Namhlanje ekuseni hlola umfutho emathayini abandayo bese uwafaka umoya ufike ezingeni elinconyiwe.

p-018.title: Kungani Ama-mittens Ekugcina Ufudumele Kakhulu
p-018.summary: Ama-mittens aneminwe ehlangene afudumele kakhulu kunezinsimbi zezandla ezijwayelekile.
p-018.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa $Q = hA\Delta T$ kuhambisana ngqo nobubanzi bendawo engaphandle $A$. Iminwe ehlanganisiwe inciphisa indawo evezwayo futhi yabelane ngokushisa.
p-018.example: Uma kuqhathaniswa namagilavu asonga iminwe emihlanu ngokuhlukana, ama-mittens aveza cishe u-20-30% ngaphansi wendawo, ngakho-ke i-insulation efanayo ilahlekelwa ukushisa okuncane ngaleyo ndlela.
p-018.actionItem: Ngosuku olubanda kakhulu gqoka ama-mittens phezu kwamagilavu amancane.

p-019.title: Izingqimba Zibamba Umoya
p-019.summary: Izingqimba eziningana ezincanyana zingafudumala kakhulu kunengubo eyodwa ewugqinsi.
p-019.principle: Umoya onganyakazi phakathi kwezingqimba uvimbela ukulahleka kokushisa. Isamba sokumelana nokushisa $R = \sum d_i/k_i$ siyakhula ngengqimba ngayinye.
p-019.example: Ingqimba engu-5 mm yomoya onganyakazi yengeza u-$R = 0.005/0.026\approx0.19\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Uma ushisa, khipha ingqimba eyodwa ukugwema ukubandiswa umjuluko.
p-019.actionItem: Namuhla phuma ugqoke izingqimba ezintathu: ingaphansi ye-fleece, ihembe, kanye ne-windbreaker.

p-020.title: Ukwomisa Impahla Ngaphakathi Endlini
p-020.summary: Ukushiya izikhala phakathi kwezingubo nokungenisa umoya kwenza izingubo ezingaphakathi zome ngokushesha kakhulu.
p-020.principle: Izinga lokuhwamuka $\dot m \propto A(p_s - p_a)$ likhula ngobukhulu bendawo engaphezulu kanye nomehluko wokucindezela komhwamuko.
p-020.example: Uma u-500 g wamanzi uhwamuka ku-1 kg wempahla emanzi, umunca cishe u-$500\times2.26\approx1130\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Ukushiya izikhala phakathi kwezinto kunganciphisa isikhathi sokoma cishe ngesigamu.
p-020.actionItem: Namuhla lengisa impahla enezikhala bese uvula ifeni ngejubane eliphansi.

p-021.title: Gwema Ukwephuka Kwengilazi Eshisayo
p-021.summary: Ukuthela amanzi abilayo engilazini ebandayo kungayiqhekeza.
p-021.principle: Ukwanda okungalingani kudala ukucindezeleka kokushisa $\sigma = E\alpha\Delta T$. Ingilazi evamile ye-soda-lime ayikubekezeleli kahle lokhu.
p-021.example: Ngo-$E\approx70\ \mathrm{GPa}$, $\alpha\approx9\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{K^{-1}}$ kanye no-$\Delta T=70$°C, $\sigma\approx44\ \mathrm{MPa}$, okwanele ukudala ukwephuka kwendawo engaphandle.
p-021.actionItem: Namuhla fudumeza ingilazi ebandayo ngamanzi afudumele kuqala, bese uthela isiphuzo esishisayo.

p-022.title: Qondanisa Ibhodwe Nesitofu Se-Induction
p-022.summary: Isitofu se-induction sisebenza kangcono kakhulu ngebhodwe elinesinqe esiyisicaba nesisayizi efanele.
p-022.principle: I-induction idala amagagasi kagesi (eddy currents) ukuze ukushisa $P = I^2R$ kuvele khona kanye esinqeni sebhodwe. Ibhodwe kufanele lihehe uzibuthe futhi lithintane kahle nesitofu.
p-022.example: Ibhodwe elincane kakhulu kune-coil lithola amandla amancane futhi lithatha isikhathi eside. Ukusebenza kahle cishe kungu-85-90% uma kuqhathaniswa cishe no-40-50% kwegesi.
p-022.actionItem: Namuhla beka uzibuthe phansi emabhodweni akho ukuze uhlole ukuthi uyanamathela yini.

p-023.title: Sebenzisa I-Convection Ye-Air-Fryer
p-023.summary: Shiya izikhala phakathi kokudla ku-air fryer ukuze kuphume ku-crispy.
p-023.principle: Ukuhamba ngokushesha komoya oshisayo kuyi-convection ephoqelelwe, lapho u-$Q = hA\Delta T$ eno-$h$ omkhulu. Ukumbondelana kunciphisa indawo eveziwe engu-$A$.
p-023.example: I-convection ye-ovini icishe ibe ngu-$h\approx10\ \mathrm{W/m^2K}$, i-convection yefeni icishe ibe ngu-$30\text{-}50$, eshesha ngokuphindwe ka-3 kuya ku-5. Ingqimba eyodwa ingonga cishe imizuzu engu-10.
p-023.actionItem: Namuhla dlalisa ukudla kube yingqimba eyodwa kubhasikidi we-air-fryer ngaphandle kokumbondelana.

p-024.title: Hlanza Isisefo Se-Lint Somshini Wokomisa
p-024.summary: Ukuthulula isisefo se-lint kunciphisa isikhathi sokoma.
p-024.principle: Isisefo esivalekile sinciphisa ukugeleza komoya $\dot V$ kanye nokukhishwa komswakama $\dot m = \dot V\Delta\omega\rho$.
p-024.example: Isisefo esivalekile singandisa isikhathi sokoma ngo-20-30%. Umjikelezo osuka emizuzwini engu-80 uya kwengu-100 usebenzisa amanye amandla engeziwe angu-0.4 kWh ku-2 kW.
p-024.actionItem: Namuhla vula umshini wokomisa bese uhlanza isisefo se-lint.

p-025.title: Nciphisa Ugesi Omi Wasebusika
p-025.summary: Ukuthuthumela kukagesi ezibambini zeminyango ebusika kwenzeka ngoba umoya owomile uvumela amashaji ukuthi ahlale kuwe.
p-025.principle: Ishaji yokungqubuzana $Q$ inyusa i-voltage njenge-capacitor $V = Q/C$; umoya owomile ubambezela ukukhishwa kwamashaji ukuze ifinyelele ezinkulungwaneni zama-volt.
p-025.example: Umzimba one-$C\approx100\ \mathrm{pF}$ ophethe $Q=0.3\ \mu\mathrm{C}$ ufinyelela ku-$V = 3000\ \mathrm{V}$. Ukwenyusa umswakama ube ngaphezu kuka-40% kuvumela amashaji ukuthi aphume kancane kancane.
p-025.actionItem: Namuhla thinta ukhiye noma udonga ngaphambi kokubamba isibambo somnyango ukuze ukhiphe amashaji.

p-026.title: Gwema Ukulayisha Kakhulu I-Power Strip
p-026.summary: Ukuxhuma izifudumezi ezinkulu ezimbalwa ku-power strip eyodwa kufaka engcupheni yokushisa ngokweqile kanye nomlilo.
p-026.principle: Amandla atholakala nge-$P = VI$, ngakho-ke ku-220 V $I = P/V$, futhi ukushisa kungu-$P_\text{heat} = I^2R$, okulingana nesikwele samanje kagesi (current).
p-026.example: Isifudumezi sika-1500 W kanye neketela lika-1000 W kuthatha $2500/220\approx11.4\ \mathrm{A}$, okungaphezu kwe-strip evamile engu-10 A. Ukukhuphuka ngo-10% kagesi kukhulisa ukushisa ngo-21%.
p-026.actionItem: Namuhla hlola izinga le-strip yakho (isibonelo 10 A) bese uxhuma izifudumezi ngqo odongeni.

p-027.title: Shaja Phakathi kuka-20 no-80%
p-027.summary: Ukugcina ifoni phakathi kuka-20% no-80% kwandisa impilo yebhethri.
p-027.principle: I-voltage ephezulu yokushaja isheshisa ukuwohloka kwe-electrolyte, futhi ukuguga kuncike emazingeni okushisa njengokuthi $k\propto e^{-E_a/RT}$.
p-027.example: Ukugwema ukushaja ngokugcwele kanye nokushisa kungangeza amakhulu emijikelezo ngale kuka-500 evamile ngaphambi kokuba umthamo wehlele ku-80%.
p-027.actionItem: Namuhla vula ukushaja okwenziwe ngcono (optimized charging) noma umkhawulo ka-80% efonini yakho.

p-028.title: Kungakanani Okongiweni Ngokushintshela ku-LED
p-028.summary: Ekukhanyeni okufanayo, i-LED isebenzisa ugesi omncane kakhulu.
p-028.principle: Qhathanisa ukusebenza kokukhanya $\eta = \Phi/P$ (lm/W): i-incandescent icishe ibe ngu-13 lm/W, i-LED ingu-100 lm/W noma ngaphezulu.
p-028.example: Ibhalbhu elingu-800 lm lithatha u-60 W njenge-incandescent kanti lithatha u-8 W njenge-LED. Emahoreni angu-5 ngosuku longa $0.052\times5\times365\approx95\ \mathrm{kWh}$ ngonyaka.
p-028.actionItem: Namuhla shintsha ibhalbhu elilodwa egumbini olisebenzisa kakhulu ufake i-LED.

p-029.title: Kungani Izibambo Zensimbi Zizizwa Zibanda Kakhulu
p-029.summary: Emazingeni afanayo okushisa, insimbi izizwa ibanda kakhulu kunokhuni.
p-029.principle: Ukudluliswa kokushisa ngokuthintana kuncike ku-thermal effusivity $e = \sqrt{k\rho c}$; ukudonswa kokushisa okusheshayo kuzizwa kubanda kakhulu.
p-029.example: Izinsimbi zine-$e\approx10{,}000\text{-}20{,}000$ kanti ukhuni lune-$e\approx400$ (SI), okungukwehlukana ngamashumi ezikhathi. Ku-0°C insimbi izizwa ibanda kakhulu.
p-029.actionItem: Lapho uphuma ebusika namuhla bamba izibambo zensimbi usebenzisa amagilavu noma indwangu.

p-030.title: Ukuvimbela Amapayipi Abandayo
p-030.summary: Ngezansi kwezinga lokuqandisa, amanzi asepayipini aphenduka iqhwa, ayanwebeka futhi angaphahlaza ipayipi.
p-030.principle: Amanzi anwebeka cishe ngo-9% lapho eba yiqhwa. Epayipini elivaliwe umfutho ukhuphuka ngo-$\Delta P = K\Delta V/V$ bese ipayipi liyabhoboza.
p-030.example: Nge-bulk modulus engu-$K\approx2\ \mathrm{GPa}$, umfutho wethiyori ufinyelela kumakhulu e-MPa. Ukuconsa kancane kwenza ukuthi amanzi angabi yiqhwa kalula.
p-030.actionItem: Uma kubikezelwa izinga lokushisa elingaphansi kuka-zero namuhla, shiya umpompi uconsa kancane bese usonga imitha ngento evikela amakhaza.

p-031.title: Ukucisha noma Ukushiya Ivuliwe Isfudumezi Uma Ungaphandle
p-031.summary: Shiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ohambweni olufushane bese uyasehlisa kolude.
p-031.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa kungu-$P = UA(T_\text{in}-T_\text{out})$, okuncane kakhulu ezingeni lokushisa eliphansi lasendlini. Ukushisa kabusha kubiza u-$C\Delta T$.
p-031.example: Emahoreni ayi-12, ukwehlisa ukusuka ku-22°C kuye ku-17°C kunciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa cishe ngama-25%, okungaphezulu kwezindleko zokushisa kabusha, okuyinzuzo ephelele. Emahoreni ayi-2-3 inzuzo iba ncinane.
p-031.actionItem: Namuhla sebenzisa imodi yokungabi bikho endlini uma uphandle amahora ayi-6 noma ngaphezulu, futhi uyiyeke isifudumezi sinjalo ohambweni olufushane.

p-032.title: Ibanga Lokuma Eqhweni
p-032.summary: Eqhweni, ibanga lokuma landa ngokuphindwe kaningi kunenani lasemgwaqweni owomile.
p-032.principle: Ibanga lokuma lithi $d = v^2/(2\mu g)$: lilingana nesivinini esiyisikwele, liphinde lincike ngokuphambene nokungqubuzana (friction).
p-032.example: Ku-50 km/h (13.9 m/s) emgwaqweni owomile $\mu=0.7$ kunikeza u-$d\approx14\ \mathrm{m}$, eqhweni $\mu=0.2$ kunikeza u-$d\approx49\ \mathrm{m}$. Ukwehlisa iye ku-30 km/h kunikeza cishe i-18 m.
p-032.actionItem: Emigwaqweni eneqhwa namuhla shayela ngesigamu sesivinini sakho esijwayelekile futhi ushiye igebe elikhulu.

p-033.title: Vikela Iqolo Lakho Lapho Ufosholoza
p-033.summary: Ukugcina umthwalo useduze nokusebenzisa imilenze yakho kusiza iqolo lakho.
p-033.principle: I-torque yesigwedlo ithi $\tau = Fd$; lapho umthwalo ukude kakhulu nomgogodla wakho, isikhashana samandla siba sikhulu ngokwengeziwe.
p-033.example: Ukubamba u-5 kg weqhwa ngobude bengalo (0.6 m) kunikeza u-$\tau\approx5\times9.8\times0.6\approx29\ \mathrm{N\cdot m}$; eduze ku-0.2 m cishe kuba yi-10 N·m, ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu.
p-033.actionItem: Namuhla fosholoza imithwalo elula kaningi, eyibambe eduze komzimba wakho, usebenzisa imilenze esikhundleni seqolo.

p-034.title: Vula Izivalo Zejeke Eziqinile Kalula
p-034.summary: Isivalo esinenkani siyavuleka lapho irediyasi enkulu iphindaphinda i-torque yakho.
p-034.principle: I-torque ithi $\tau = Fr$; emandleni afanayo irediyasi $r$ enkulu inikeza i-torque eningi ngokulinganayo.
p-034.example: Isivalo esingu-3 cm ($r=1.5\ \mathrm{cm}$) esidinga i-3 N·m kuthatha u-$F=200\ \mathrm{N}$. Isivuli esingu-$r=6\ \mathrm{cm}$ sidinga kuphela u-$F=50\ \mathrm{N}$, ingxenye eyodwa kwezine.
p-034.actionItem: Namuhla bopha iglavu yenjoloba noma ithawula esivalweni, noma sebenzisa isivuli samajekhi.

p-035.title: Ngaphambi Kokuma Esitulweni
p-035.summary: Esitulweni, isikhungo sakho sesisindo (center of mass) kumele sihlale ngaphezu kwesisekelo ukugwema ukuwa.
p-035.principle: Umzimba uzinza ngenkathi umugqa oqondile phakathi nendawo yesisindo sawo uhlala ngaphakathi kwesisekelo sawo. Umkhawulo wokutsheka ngu-$\tan\theta = b/h$.
p-035.example: Ngesigamu sobubanzi besisekelo esingu-$b=20\ \mathrm{cm}$ nokuphakama kwesikhungo sesisindo esingu-$h=100\ \mathrm{cm}$, ukutsheka okungu-$\theta=\arctan0.2\approx11^\circ$ kuphela kuyakugumbuqela.
p-035.actionItem: Namuhla sebenzisa isitulo sokunyathela esizinzile esikhundleni sesitulo esijwayelekile ezindaweni eziphakeme.

p-036.title: Beka Amacala Eilala (Ladder) Kumadigri Angama-75
p-036.summary: Uma liqonde kakhulu liyawela emuva; uma litsheke kakhulu liyashelela.
p-036.principle: Ngaphandle kokungqubuzana kodonga, ilala ngeke lishelele uma $\tan\theta \ge 1/(2\mu)$.
p-036.example: Ngephansi elingu-$\mu=0.4$, $\tan\theta \ge 1.25$, ngakho $\theta\ge51^\circ$. Cishe amadigri angama-75 (isisekelo esiyingxenye eyodwa kwezine yobude belala ukusuka odongeni) ukubekwa okuphephile okunconyiwe.
p-036.actionItem: Namuhla beka isisekelo selala kude nodonga ngekota yobude balo.

p-037.title: Inkungu Yesibuko Sasegunjini Lokugezela
p-037.summary: Isibuko siba nenkungu ngemva kokugeza ngoba umhwamuko uba ngamaconsi lapho izinga lokushisa lehlela ngaphansi kwe-dew point.
p-037.principle: Ukuba yizithukuthuku noma ukujiya (condensation) kwenzeka lapho izinga lokushisa lebuso behlela ngaphansi kwe-dew point $T_d$. Cishe $T_d \approx T - (100-RH)/5$.
p-037.example: Ku-30°C nomswakama ongu-90% $T_d\approx28$°C, ngakho-ke isibuko esingu-25°C siba nenkungu. Isiphephetha-moya esehlisa umswakama sibe ku-60% sinikeza $T_d\approx14$°C.
p-037.actionItem: Namuhla vula isiphephetha-moya sasegunjini lokugezela ngenkathi ugeza nasemizuzwini eyi-10 ngemva kwalokho.

p-038.title: Ungahuduli Ifenisha Esindayo
p-038.summary: Faka indwangu ngaphansi kwefenisha esindayo esikhundleni sokuyihudula phansi ingena lutho.
p-038.principle: Ukungqubuzana okumile (static friction) kungu-$f = \mu_s N$. Indwangu yehlisa i-$\mu$ futhi ivikela nephansi.
p-038.example: Iwodilobhu engu-50 kg ene-$\mu=0.5$ idinga $f=0.5\times50\times9.8\approx245\ \mathrm{N}$. Izisheleli zefenisha ezinikeza i-$\mu=0.2$ ziyehlisa ibe ngu-98 N, okungaphansi ngo-60%.
p-038.actionItem: Namuhla beka amaphedi e-felt noma ithawula ngaphansi kwezinyawo zefenisha ngaphambi kokuyishelela.

p-039.title: Bilisa Amanzi Owawo Kuphela
p-039.summary: Ukubilisa kuphela lokho ozokuphuza konga ugesi nesikhathi.
p-039.principle: Ukushisa okudingekayo kungu-$Q = mc\Delta T$, okulingana ngqo nesisindo samanzi $m$.
p-039.example: Ukushisa u-1 L usuka ku-20°C uya ku-100°C kuthatha u-334 kJ, cishe u-0.093 kWh. Inkomishi eyodwa (250 mL) ithatha u-0.023 kWh, okuyikota.
p-039.actionItem: Namuhla gcwalisa igedlela ngenani ozolisebenzisa kuphela, ubheke izimpawu zezinkomishi.

p-040.title: Shiya Isikhala Ngemuva Kwefriji
p-040.summary: Ifriji ecindezelwe odongeni ayikwazi ukukhipha ukushisa futhi isebenzisa ugesi omningi.
p-040.principle: Ukushisa kwe-compressor kuphuma ngekhoyili yangemuva ngokuhamba komoya okungokwemvelo (natural convection); ku-$Q = hA\Delta T$ ukuvaleka kokuhamba komoya kunciphisa u-$h$.
p-040.example: Uma ukungena komoya okuvinjiwe kukhuphula izinga lokushisa le-condenser ngo-10°C, i-COP iyehla futhi ukusetshenziswa kukagesi kungakhuphuka cishe ngo-10-15%. Ku-400 kWh ngonyaka lokho kungu-40-60 kWh.
p-040.actionItem: Namuhla donsa ifriji ibe ngu-5-10 cm ukusuka odongeni bese wesula uthuli kukhoyili yangemuva.

p-041.title: Nciphisa Ukudlidliza Komshini Wokuwasha Lapho Uphehla
p-041.summary: Izingubo zokuwasha ezingalingani zenza umshini wokuhlanza udlidlize kakhulu lapho usonta/uphehla.
p-041.principle: Isisindo $m$ esingekho phakathi nendawo ku-radius $r$ sidala amandla e-centrifugal $F = m\omega^2 r$, alingana ngqo nesivinini se-angular siphindwe kabili.
p-041.example: Ku-1000 rpm ($\omega\approx105\ \mathrm{rad/s}$) no-1 kg ongalingani ku-$r=0.2\ \mathrm{m}$, $F\approx2200\ \mathrm{N}$. Ukulinganisa kususa cishe konke lokhu.
p-041.actionItem: Namuhla lapho uwasha into enkulu njengengubo yokulala (duvet), engeza izinto ezincane futhi usabalalise umthwalo ngokulinganayo.

p-042.title: Buyisela Amandla Okumunca E-Vacuum
p-042.summary: Ukuthulula umgqomo nokuhlanza isihlungi kubuyisela amandla okumunca cishe abe mansha.
p-042.principle: Amandla okumunca angumphumela $P = \Delta P\cdot Q$ womehluko wokucindezela nokuhamba komoya. Ukuvaleka kunciphisa kakhulu ukuhamba komoya.
p-042.example: Isihlungi esivaleke kancane singanciphisa ukuhamba komoya ngo-30-50%. Imotho efanayo iletha amandla aphansi kakhulu okususa uthuli futhi ukuhlanza kuthatha isikhathi eside.
p-042.actionItem: Namuhla thulula umgqomo we-vacuum bese uthinta kancane noma uwashe futhi womise isihlungi.

p-043.title: Ukushisa Okucashile (Latent Heat) kuma-Ice Pack
p-043.summary: Indlela engcono kakhulu yokugcina izinto zibanda ukushisa okucashile kokuncibilika kweqhwa.
p-043.principle: Iqhwa elincibilikayo limunca u-$Q = mL$ lapho u-$L=334\ \mathrm{J/g}$ kuyilapho lihlala ku-0°C.
p-043.example: Ukuncibilikisa i-ice pack engu-500 g kumunca u-$500\times334\approx167\ \mathrm{kJ}$, okuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-16 kune-10 kJ edingekayo ukufudumeza inani elifanayo lamanzi aku-0°C ngo-5°C.
p-043.actionItem: Namuhla phatha i-ice pack uma uyothenga igilosa futhi ucoshe izinto eziqandisiwe ekugcineni.

p-044.title: Isisindo Seqhwa Phezu Kophahla
p-044.summary: Iqhwa elinomswakama linesisindo esiphindwe kaningi kuneqhwa elomile futhi lingabhidliza ophahla nezindlu zokutshala izitshalo (ama-greenhouse).
p-044.principle: Isisindo ngu-$P = \rho g h$; iqhwa elomile $\rho\approx100\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, iqhwa elinomswakama $\rho\approx400\text{-}500$.
p-044.example: U-30 cm weqhwa elinomswakama ($\rho=400$) unikeza u-$400\times9.8\times0.3\approx1180\ \mathrm{Pa}$, okuphindwe kane kuneqhwa elomile (cishe 300 Pa).
p-044.actionItem: Uma likhithika kakhulu namuhla, susa iqhwa ngokuphepha ezindlini zokutshala nasezivikweni zelanga.

p-045.title: I-Heat Pump Uma Iqhathaniswa Nesifudumezi Sikagesi
p-045.summary: Ukusebenzisa i-air conditioner ukushisa kunikeza ukushisa okuningi ngogesi ofanayo.
p-045.principle: I-heat pump ihambisa ukushisa, ngakho-ke u-$\mathrm{COP} = Q_h/W$ ungaphezulu kuka-1. Isifudumezi sikagesi sino-$\mathrm{COP}=1$.
p-045.example: Ku-COP 3, i-1 kWh ikhiqiza i-3 kWh yokushisa. Ukuletha i-3 kW amahora angu-5 kuthatha i-15 kWh ngesifudumezi sokumelana kagesi (resistance heater) kodwa kuthatha i-5 kWh nge-heat pump, konga i-10 kWh.
p-045.actionItem: Namuhla sebenzisa indlela yokufudumeza ye-air conditioner yakho ku-20°C esikhundleni sesifudumezi sikagesi.

p-046.title: Kungani Amagilavu Amanzi Ezizwa Ebanda Kakhulu
p-046.summary: Amagilavu amantombazane antshontsha ukushisa ngokushesha kakhulu kunawomile.
p-046.principle: Amanzi adlulisa ukushisa cishe ngo-$0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\cdot K}$, cishe izikhathi ezingu-23 kunomoya ($0.026$), futhi ukuhwamuka kwengeza ukulahleka okwengeziwe, kukhulise u-$Q = kA\Delta T/d$.
p-046.example: Ebudilini obufanayo, igilavu elimanziswe kakhulu lilahlekelwa ukushisa okuphindwe kaningi. Igremu ngalinye elihwamukile lithatha enye i-2.26 kJ.
p-046.actionItem: Namuhla omisa noma yimaphi amagilavu asetshenziswe eqhweni ngokushesha futhi uphathe amanye ayisipele.

p-047.title: Izingcwecwe zeqhwa ezilengayo ophahleni zibonisa ukuvuza kokushisa ngophahla
p-047.summary: Lapho iqhwa lincibilika ngaphansi bese liphinde liqina ezinsikeni zophahla, ukushisa kwangaphakathi kungenzeka kuyaphuma ngophahla.
p-047.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa ngu-$\dot Q=UA\,\Delta T$. Ukufakwa kwe-insulation okungenele kwenyusa u-$U$, ngakho ingaphandle lophahla likhuphukela ngaphezu kuka-0 °C bese lincibilikisa iqhwa.
p-047.example: Ophahleni olungu-100 m², ukunciphisa u-$U$ usuke ku-0.5 uye ku-0.25 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\,K)}$ ku-$\Delta T=20$ K kuhlisa ukulahleka kusuka ku-$0.5\times100\times20=1{,}000$ W kuye ku-500 W, okuwuhhafu walokho.
p-047.actionItem: Namuhla, bheka izingcwecwe zeqhwa ezilengayo ezinsikeni zophahla noma kusilingi kavulandi (ungami ngaphansi kwazo) futhi, uma ziziningi, hlola i-insulation yesilingi noma yophahla.

p-048.title: Ulwembe Lwensipho Olunqanda Ukufiphala Kwezibuko
p-048.summary: Izibuko ziba nenkungu ngoba ilensi ibanda kunephuzu lokubopha amazolo (dew point) lomoya owukhipha ngomlomo. Ulwembe oluncane lwensipho lwenza amanzi asakazeke abe ungqimba olusobala esikhundleni sokwakha amaconsi.
p-048.principle: Umhwamuko uyajiya lapho izinga lokushisa lendawo $T_s$ lingaphansi kwephuzu lokubopha amazolo $T_d$. I-surfactant yehlisa i-contact angle ukuze amaconsi amancane asakazeke abe ulwembe olusobala.
p-048.example: Umoya okhishiwe ku-34 C nomswakama ongu-100% unephuzu lokubopha amazolo eliseduze no-34 C, kuyilapho ilensi ihlezi cishe ku-20 C, ngakho ifiphala ngokushesha. Ukugcoba iconsi elilodwa lensipho yezitsha ethambile kancane phezu kwelensi bese uyivumela yome kwenza amanzi asakazeke ebusweni futhi kunciphisa kakhulu ukufiphala.
p-048.actionItem: Namuhla, gcoba iconsi elilodwa lensipho ethambile yezitsha nhlangothi zombili zamalensi, ayeke ome emoyeni ngaphandle kokuwesula, bese ucindezela ucingo lwekhala lwesifonyo ukuze umoya ungavuzi uye phezulu.

p-049.title: Ukubona Izibuko Zangempela Ze-Polarized
p-049.summary: Ukubaneka okuvela emanzini nasemigwaqweni emanzi kuvame ukuba yi-polarization evundlile, ngakho-ke amalensi e-polarized ayakuhlunga lokho futhi anciphise ukukhathala kwamehlo. Ezinye izibuko zimnyama nje kuphela, ngakho-ke zihlole ngokwakho.
p-049.principle: Ukukhanya okudlula ku-polarizer kulandela umthetho ka-Malus othi $I=I_0\cos^2\theta$, futhi ukukhanya okubonakala kusuka emanzini kucishe kube ne-polarization ephelele eduze kwe-engeli ka-Brewster ethi $\theta_B=\arctan(n)\approx 53^\circ$.
p-049.example: Lapho i-polarization yokubaneka iku-$90^\circ$ ku-eksisi yelensi, $\cos^2 90^\circ=0$ futhi ukubaneka kuvimbeleka ngokuphelele. Ungaqinisekisa ilensi ngoba amalensi amabili e-polarized abekwe phezu komunye ngo-$90^\circ$ aphenduka abe mnyama. I-polarization yehlukile ekuvikelweni emisebeni ye-UV, ngakho-ke bheka futhi ilebula le-UV400.
p-049.actionItem: Bheka isikrini sefoni usebenzisa ilensi bese uyiphendula ngo-$90^\circ$ ukuze ubone ukuthi isikrini siba mnyama yini, futhi uhlole uphawu lwe-UV400.

p-050.title: Kungani Imigwaqo Yamabhuloho Iqala Ngokuqina Ngeqhwa
p-050.summary: Amabhuloho alahlekelwa ukushisa kusuka phezulu nangaphansi, ngakho-ke aqina ngeqhwa ngaphambi kwemigwaqo evamile futhi ngokuvamile afihla iqhwa elimnyama (black ice).
p-050.principle: Imigwaqo esemhlabathini ithola ukushisa okuvela enhlabathini, kanti ibhuloho linomoya ngaphansi kwalo. Ibanga lokubhuleka lithi $d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$.
p-050.example: Ku-50 km/h ($v\approx13.9$ m/s), itiyela elomile ($\mu\approx0.7$) lidinga cishe amamitha ayi-14, kodwa iqhwa ($\mu\approx0.1$) lidinga cishe amamitha angama-99, okucishe kube ngokuphindwe kasikhombisa ngaphezulu.
p-050.actionItem: Ebusuku nasekuseni lapho izinga lokushisa lingaphansi kuka-3 °C, yehlisa isivinini ngaphambi kwamabhuloho, izimbobo zamathaneli nezindawo ezinomthunzi.

p-051.title: Kungani Isibuko Sokuzicwala Esikhulisa Ngo-2-3x Sinele
p-051.summary: Ukukhulisa okukhulu kakhulu akusho ukuthi kungcono. Ibanga elifushane lokugxila (focal length) likuphoqa ukuba usondeze ubuso kakhulu futhi libonisa indawo encane kakhulu kuphela.
p-051.principle: Isibuko esigobele ngaphakathi (concave mirror) $\dfrac1f=\dfrac1{d_o}+\dfrac1{d_i}$ esinokukhulisa okungu-$m=-\dfrac{d_i}{d_o}$. Ngaphakathi kwephuzu lokugxila uthola isithombe esibonakalayo esime mpo futhi esikhulisiwe.
p-051.example: Uma $f=20$ cm nobuso bakho buku-$d_o=10$ cm, $d_i=-20$ cm no-$m=2\times$. Isibuko esingu-10x sine-$f\approx5$ cm, ngakho-ke kufanele uhlale ngaphakathi kuka-5 cm futhi ubone iso elilodwa kuphela ngesikhathi. Ngale kwephuzu lokugxila isithombe siphenduka sibheke phansi.
p-051.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuthenga, linganisa ukuthi ubuso bakho buvamise ukuhlala buqhele ngakanani esibukweni bese ukhetha imodeli enebanga lokugxila elicwile ngokuphindwe kabili kwalelo banga (2-3x).

p-052.title: Nciphisa Isikhathi Sokupheka Namandla Ngembiza Yokupheka Ngomfutho (Pressure Cooker)
p-052.summary: Imbiza yomfutho inyusa izinga lokubila kwamanzi lifinyelele cishe ku-120 °C, okunciphisa isikhathi sokupheka sibe yingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu noma ngaphansi.
p-052.principle: Izinga lokubila lenyuka nomfutho (Clausius-Clapeyron), futhi isivinini sokwenzeka kokupheka sicishe siphindaphindeke kabili njalo ngo-$10^\circ$C, ngakho-ke kushesha ngokuphindwe $2^{(120-100)/10}=4$.
p-052.example: Ku-1 atm gauge (cishe i-2 atm absolute) amanzi abila eduze kuka-120 °C. Izimbambo ezithosiwe ezidinga imizuzu engama-60 ebhodweni elivulekile ziqeda cishe ngemizuzu engama-20, okonga cishe i-1 kWh esitofini se-induction esingu-1.5 kW. Ungalokothi uvule isivalo kuze kube yilapho umfutho usuphele ngokuphelele.
p-052.actionItem: Pheka ukudla okuthatha isikhathi eside ukubila namuhla ebusuku (inyama yengulube ebilisiwe, ubhontshisi, izitshulu) embizeni yomfutho bese ucisha isitofu kusenesikhathi ukuze umfutho osele uqedele umsebenzi.

p-053.title: Igebe Lomnyango Elingamaphesenti Ayingxenye engu-1% Lehla Ukuvikela Umsindo Kusuka ku-30 dB Kuya ku-20 dB
p-053.summary: Umnyango owugqinsi ulahlekelwa amandla amaningi okuvikela umsindo uma unomgudu omncane nje. I-weatherstrip ebiza imali encane inciphisa kokubili umsindo nomoya obandayo ongenayo.
p-053.principle: Ukudluliselwa okuhlanganisiwe $\tau=\dfrac{\sum S_i\tau_i}{\sum S_i}$ nokulahlekelwa kokudlulisela (transmission loss) $TL=-10\log_{10}\tau$.
p-053.example: Umnyango olinganiselwe ku-30 dB ($\tau=0.001$) onegebe elilingana no-1% wendawo yawo ($\tau\approx1$) unikeza $\tau=0.99\times0.001+0.01=0.011$, ngakho-ke i-TL yehla ize ifinyelele cishe ku-19.6 dB. Ukuvala igebe nge-weatherstrip (cishe ngamadola ama-3) kunciphisa nemimoya ebandayo yasebusika nezindleko zokufudumeza.
p-053.actionItem: Vala umnyango bese ubheka ukukhanya okuphuma ngaphansi naseduze kwawo, bese ufaka i-silicone weatherstrip noma umshanelo wokuvikela umnyango (door sweep).

p-054.title: Ukuhambisa I-Wi-Fi Router Kushintsha Isivinini Sakho
p-054.summary: Njalo uma uqinisa ibanga libe kabili, isignali iba buthaka ngokuphindwe kane (6 dB), kanti udonga ngalunye luthatha amanye ama-3-10 dB. I-router esendaweni evulekile emaphakathi nendlu ithuthukisa isivinini.
p-054.principle: Ukulahleka kwendlela endaweni evulekile (Free-space path loss) $FSPL(\mathrm{dB})=20\log_{10}d+20\log_{10}f+32.44$ ($d$ nge-km, $f$ nge-MHz).
p-054.example: Ku-2.4 GHz, amamitha ayi-10 abiza cishe i-60.0 dB namamitha angama-20 cishe i-66.0 dB, ngakho-ke ukuphinda kabili ibanga kunezezela i-6 dB. Udonga lukakhonkolo lususa amanye ama-5-10 dB, okuyingakho igumbi elikude lihamba kancane.
p-054.actionItem: Khipha i-router ngemuva kwe-TV noma ekhabetheni bese uyibeka eshalofini elivulekile eliphakeme ngamamitha ayi-1-1.5 eduze nendawo emaphakathi yekhaya, bese uqhathanisa isivinini egumbini elikude.

p-055.title: Njalo Ngama-3 dB Okukhula Komsindo Kunciphisa Isikhathi Esiphephile Sokusebenzisa Ama-Earphone Ngengxenye
p-055.summary: Ukwenyuka ngakunye ngama-3 dB kuphinda kabili amandla omsindo futhi kunciphisa ngengxenye isikhathi izindlebe zakho ezingakwazi ukusibekezelela ngokuphepha. Ukwehlisa ivolumu kancane kwandisa kakhulu isikhathi sokulalela ngokuphepha.
p-055.principle: Izinga lomsindo $L=10\log_{10}\dfrac{I}{I_0}$ ($I_0=10^{-12}$ W/m²). Isiqondiso sokuchayeka: amahora angu-8 ku-85 dB, kuncipha isikhathi ngengxenye njalo ngama-3 dB.
p-055.example: I-85 dB inika amahora angu-8, i-88 dB amahora angu-4, i-91 dB amahora angu-2, i-94 dB ihora eli-1, kanti i-100 dB yimizuzu engu-15 kuphela. Ukukhuphula ivolumu ukuze unqobe umsindo wesitimela sangaphansi komhlaba ngaphezu kwe-95 dB kwenza ngisho nemizuzu engu-30 ibe yingozi.
p-055.actionItem: Vula izilungiselelo zokuphepha kwama-headphone noma umkhawulo wevolumu ocingweni lwakho namuhla bese umisa umkhawulo omkhulu cishe kuma-60%.

p-056.title: Ukushushuluza Emvuleni Yasentwasahlobo (Hydroplaning): Yehlisa Ijubane Ngo-20% Kuphela
p-056.summary: Ngejubane emgwaqweni omanzi, amanzi aphambi kwesondo awakwazi ukubaleka futhi akha iweji ephakamisa isondo. Uma selishushuluza phezu kwamanzi, ukulawula isiteringi nokubhuleka cishe kuyanyamalala.
p-056.principle: Umfutho onamandla wamanzi $q=\tfrac12\rho v^2$ osondela kumfutho wokuthintana $p$ uvumela ulwelwesi lwamanzi luphakamise isondo. Ijubane elibucayi $v\approx\sqrt{2p/\rho}$ (isilinganiso esilula).
p-056.example: Ngomfutho wokuthintana ongaba ngu-220 kPa, $v\approx\sqrt{2\times220000/1000}\approx21$ m/s, noma cishe ama-76 km/h. Imisele egugile ayikhiphi amanzi kahle futhi ingalahlekelwa ukubamba ngejubane eliphansi, ngakho-ke emgwaqweni wama-100 km/h shayela cishe kuma-80 km/h emvuleni.
p-056.actionItem: Bheka ukuthi izinkomba zokuguga kwesondo (TWI) sezilingana yini nobuso bomsele, futhi ushayele ngama-80% ejubane elijwayelekile emvuleni.

p-057.title: Ungayethembi Inombolo Ye-NRR Emakhoneni Ezindlebe
p-057.summary: I-NRR ephrintiwe ephaketheni iyisimo esihle kakhulu saselebhu, ngakho-ke ukuvikeleka kwangempela kuphansi kakhulu. Qhathanisa amakhoni ezindlebe usebenzisa inani elehlisiwe lezindawo zamakhonsathi nezokusebenzela.
p-057.principle: Isilinganiso sangempela sokwehliswa komsindo $\mathrm{NRR}_{\text{real}}\approx\dfrac{\mathrm{NRR}-7}{2}$ dB (ukulungiswa kwe-A-weighting, bese kuncishiswa ngo-50%).
p-057.example: Ikhoni legwebu elibhalwe ukuthi NRR 33 linikeza $(33-7)/2=13$ dB kuphela. Ekhonsathini engu-100 dB lokho kuhlala ku-87 dB, okusekude kancane nesiqondiso se-85 dB. Ukulifaka ngendlela efanele kubaluleke kakhulu kunelebula.
p-057.actionItem: Gingqa ikhoni legwebu libe lincane, donsela indlebe yakho phezulu nasemuva, lifake, bese ulibamba ngomunwe imizuzwana engu-30 ngenkathi livuvuka.

p-058.title: Ukushaja Okungenantambo: Ukuqondana Kwekhoyili Kunquma Ukusebenza Kahle
p-058.summary: Ukushaja okungenantambo kulahlekelwa amandla amaningi kunekhebula, futhi ukuqondana okungekuhle kwengeza ukushisa namandla amoshiwe. Ukuqondana okuhle kunciphisa kokubili ukulahleka kwamandla nokuguga kwebhethri.
p-058.principle: Ukusebenza kahle kokuxhumana kokungeniswa kuncike kusici sokuhlanganisa $k$: $\eta=\dfrac{k^2Q_1Q_2}{\left(1+\sqrt{1+k^2Q_1Q_2}\right)^2}$. Ukungaqondani kahle kuhlisa u-$k$ ngokushesha okukhulu.
p-058.example: Ukushaja ucingo lwe-5000 mAh, 3.85 V (cishe 19.3 Wh) kudinga 21.4 Wh ngekhebula ku-90%, 27.5 Wh ngaphandle kwentambo ku-70%, kanye no-38.5 Wh uma kungaqondile kahle ku-50%. Ngokushaja kanye ngosuku, lokho cishe kwengeza i-2 kWh/ngonyaka uma kuqondile kanye cishe ne-6 kWh/ngonyaka uma kungaqondile.
p-058.actionItem: Beka ifoni ngqo lapho kuphawulwe khona ikhoyili yephedi, futhi ususe amakhava awugqinsi, amakhadi namapuleti ensimbi ngaphambi kokushaja.

p-059.title: Susa Unyawo Ku-petroli Kusenesikhathi Ngaphambi Kwelambu Elibomvu
p-059.summary: Ukubhuleka elambini elibomvu kuguqula amandla okuhamba emoto abe ukushisa okumoshekile. Ukususa unyawo kusenesikhathi kuvumela imoto ukuba ihambe ngomfutho wayo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa uphethiloli futhi konge uphethiloli.
p-059.principle: Amandla okuhamba $E_k=\tfrac12mv^2$, ngakho-ke amandla alahleka lapho kubhulekwa alingana nesikwele sejubane.
p-059.example: Imoto enesisindo esingu-1,500 kg ku-60 km/h (16.7 m/s) inamandla $E_k\approx208$ kJ. Ngokuthatha cishe i-8.5 MJ yamandla awusizo ngelitha likaphethiloli ngalinye, ukuma ngakunye kumelela cishe ama-25 mL. Ukulindela amarobhothi ayi-10 konga amashumi kuya kumakhulu amamililitha ngosuku.
p-059.actionItem: Ohambweni lwanamuhla, susa unyawo ku-gesi cishe amamitha ayi-150 ngaphambi kwelambu elibomvu bese uvumela imoto izihambele, usebenzise ibhuleki kancane kuphela lapho kudingeka.

p-060.title: Ukuhambisa Amanzi Ngaphandle Kwephampu: I-Siphon
p-060.summary: Ukushintsha amanzi e-aquarium noma ukukhipha amanzi emgqonyeni wemvula kudinga kuphela ipayipi nomehluko wokuphakama. Uma ipayipi seligcwele, amanzi aqhubeka nokugeleza ebheke ezansi.
p-060.principle: Uma indawo yokuphuma ingaphansi kobuso bamanzi ngo-$\Delta h$, umehluko womfutho $\Delta P=\rho g\Delta h$ uqhuba ukugeleza, ngejubane elifanele $v=\sqrt{2g\Delta h}$.
p-060.example: Ekwehleni ngo-0.5 m ijubane elifanele lingu-3.1 m/s, kodwa ukungqubuzana kwepayipi kulinciphisa libe cishe ngu-1 m/s. Ngepayipi elingu-10 mm lokho kungu-$Q\approx0.08$ L/s, okuhambisa ama-20 L cishe ngemizuzu emi-4.
p-060.actionItem: Faka ipayipi emanzini ukuze ligcwale, vala isiphetho esisodwa, bese usibeka ebhakedeni elibekwe phansi kakhulu. Ungalokothi umunce ipayipi ngomlomo uma usebenzisa uketshezi olunamakhemikhali.

p-061.title: Ezinsukwini zeqhwa, imisebe ye-UV ivela phezulu naphansi
p-061.summary: Iqhwa elisha libonisa imisebe eminingi ye-ultraviolet, ngakho-ke amehlo nobuso basha kalula ezindaweni ezinwebezekile zeqhwa kunalokho obukulindele.
p-061.principle: I-Albedo ngu-$\alpha=I_r/I_0$, futhi ukuchayeka kwe-UV sekukonke kucishe kube ngu-$I_0(1+\alpha)$. Iqhwa elisha line-albedo ye-UV ecishe ibe ngu-0.8-0.9, utshani bucishe bube ngu-0.03.
p-061.example: Uma i-UV eqondile ingu-1, uthola cishe u-1.03 phezu kotshani kodwa cishe u-1.8-1.9 phezu kweqhwa elisha, cishe ngokuphindwe kabili.
p-061.actionItem: Lapho uya eqhweni, phatha izibuko zelanga noma izibuko zokuzivikela ezivimba i-UV kanye neshumi lokuvikela elangeni (sunscreen).

p-062.title: Kungani Izindlebe Zakho Zivaleka Uma Indiza Yehla
p-062.summary: Umfutho wekhabhin ufana nokuphakama okungaba ngu-2,400 m, ngakho umoya osendlebeni yakho ephakathi uyakhula ngemva kokusuka bese ucindezelwa lapho yehla. Ukuvula izindlebe zakho kusenesikhathi lapho yehla kuvimbela ubuhlungu.
p-062.example: Ukusuka ku-101 kPa phansi uye cishe ku-75 kPa lapho indiza ihamba phezulu, umoya osendlebeni yakho uyakhula ngo-$101/75\approx1.35$, okungukuthi ngo-35%. Lapho yehla uyancipha bese udonsela ingaphakathi lesigubhu sendlebe ngaphakathi. Ikhala elivalekile ngenxa yomkhuhlane lenza kube nzima ukuthi i-eustachian tube ivuleke.
p-062.actionItem: Lapho kumenyezelwa ukuthi indiza iyahlala, hlafuna ushingamu noma zambula ngokuphindaphindiwe bese uginqa amathe, futhi uhlale uphapheme.

p-063.title: Ukufunda Izinombolo Ze-Binocular Njengo-8x42 Ngokukhanya
p-063.summary: Izinombolo ze-binocular zikhombisa ukukhulisa kuphindwe ngobubanzi be-lens yangaphambili. Ekuseni kakhulu nantambama udinga i-exit pupil enkulu, kanti encane nelula ilungele emini.
p-063.example: I-8x42 inikeza $42/8=5.25$ mm ngokukhanya okuhlobene okungaba ngu-27.6, kanti i-10x25 inikeza 2.5 mm kanye cishe no-6.3, ngakho i-8x42 ikhanya kakhulu ngokuphindwe kane ekukhanyeni okuphansi. Inhlavu yeso lakho ingu-5-7 mm ebumnyameni, ngakho ngokubuka izinyoni ekuseni kakhulu k تصویbheke i-exit pupil engu-4 mm noma ngaphezulu.
p-063.actionItem: Uma uzoyisebenzisa ekuseni kakhulu noma kusihlwa, khetha i-$D/M\ge4$ mm; ohambweni lwasemini khetha ehlanganayo nelula, bese uyizama mathupha.

p-064.title: Bopha Amapayipi Amanzi Ashisayo Ukuze Uvimbe Ukulahleka Kokushisa
p-064.summary: Amapayipi angenalutho amanzi ashisayo phakathi kwe-boiler nompompi alahlekelwa ukushisa njalo. Imikhono yokufaka i-insulation iyanciphisa kakhulu lokho kulahleka.
p-064.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa kwepayipi kubalwa njengo-$\dot Q\propto \Delta T/R$, kanti i-insulation inyusa ukumelana nokushisa $R$. Ukukhulisa i-$R$ kabili kunciphisa ukulahleka phakathi ku-$\Delta T$ efanayo.
p-064.example: Ake sithi amamitha ayi-10 epayipi elingenalutho elingu-25 K ngaphezu kwezinga lokushisa legumbi lilahlekelwa cishe ngu-25 W ngemitha ngalinye: 250 W. Ngemva kwe-insulation, kusala cishe u-60 W, konga cishe u-1.9 kWh emahoreni ayi-10.
p-064.actionItem: Linganisa ipayipi elingenalutho lamanzi ashisayo egumbini le-boiler noma ngaphansi kukasinki bese uhlela ukulimboza nge-foam insulation.

p-065.title: Susa Ibhokisi Lophahla Kule Nentwasahlobo
p-065.summary: Ukushiya ibhokisi le-ski lophahla lasebusika kwandisa ukudonsa komoya emgwaqweni omkhulu futhi kumoshe uphethiloli.
p-065.example: Imoto ene-$C_dA=0.69\,\mathrm{m^2}$ ku-100 km/h (27.8 m/s) idinga cishe u-8.9 kW. Ibhokisi lophahla elenezela u-20% ku-$C_dA$ liyikhuphulela cishe ku-10.7 kW, okungu-1.8 kW ngaphezulu, noma cishe u-0.8 L owengeziwe ku-100 km.
p-065.actionItem: Uma ibhokisi lakho lophahla nezinsimbi eziwela ngaphesheya kungenalutho, kususe namuhla ukugcine egalaji.

p-066.title: Cwecwa, Ungaphumi Ngamandla: Ukususa Izinsimbi Zokuxhoma Ezinamathelayo
p-066.summary: Izinsimbi zokuxhoma ezinamathelayo zimelana kahle nokudonselwa phansi (shear) kodwa ziyadedela lapho zidonswa ziqonde ngqo kude nodonga (peel).
p-066.principle: Ku-shear yonke indawo enamathelisiwe ihlanganyela umthwalo, kanti ekucwecweni amandla agxila emugqeni owodwa onqenqemeni, ngakho $F_{\text{peel}}\ll F_{\text{shear}}$.
p-066.example: Ngokwesibonelo, insimbi yokuxhoma ebamba 2 kgf ku-shear ingadedela ku-0.2-0.5 kgf lapho icwecwa. Kungakho insimbi yokuxhoma ithwala umthwalo obheke phansi kodwa iphume lapho iphakamiselwa ngaphandle.
p-066.actionItem: Sula uthuli nomswakama endaweni bese ucindezela insimbi yokuxhoma umzuzu o-1 noma ngaphezulu. Ukuze uyisuse, nweba umucu kancane futhi ubheke ngasohlangothini olufana nolwodonga.

p-067.title: Sebenzisa I-Noise Cancelling Ukuze Wehlise Ivolumu Ngo-6 dB
p-067.summary: I-noise cancelling ikhiqiza umsindo ophambene ngenkathi ukuze kucinywe umsindo wangaphandle. Udinga ivolumu encane esitimeleni esingaphansi komhlaba, okuvikela izindlebe zakho.
p-067.principle: Ukuphazamiseka okubhubhisayo (destructive interference): $A\sin\omega t+A\sin(\omega t+\pi)=0$. Isebenza kahle kakhulu emsindweni ozinzile wamaza aphansi (ngaphansi kuka-1 kHz).
p-067.example: Esitimeleni esinomsindo ongu-80 dB, uma ukucisha komsindo kususa cishe u-20 dB wokubhonga okuphansi ungalalela ngevolumu ephansi ngo-6 dB (isb., kusuka ku-91 dB kuye ku-85 dB), okukhuphula isikhathi sokulalela ngokuphepha sisuke emahoreni ama-2 siye emahoreni ayi-8, ngokuphindwe kane ubude.
p-067.actionItem: Esitimeleni esingaphansi komhlaba noma ebhasini, vula i-noise cancelling bese wehlisa ivolumu yakho ngezinyathelo ezimbili noma ezintathu.

p-068.title: Ukujika Ekhoneni Emvuleni Yasentwasahlobo: Umkhawulo Wakho Wejubane Wangempela
p-068.summary: Ijubane elikhulu eliphephile ekhoneni linqunywa ukubambelela kwesondo kanye neringi yejika. Umgwaqo omanzi wehlisa lowo mkhawulo kakhulu.
p-068.principle: Umkhawulo wejubane $v=\sqrt{\mu g r}$ (amandla adonsela phakathi alingana nokungqubuzana kokubambelela).
p-068.example: Ekhoneni elinerediyasi engu-50 m, umgwaqo owomile ($\mu=0.7$) uvumela cishe u-67 km/h, umgwaqo omanzi (0.4) cishe u-50 km/h kanti iqhwa (0.2) cishe u-36 km/h. Amabhodi abonisa amjubane anconyiwe acabangela umgwaqo owomile, ngakho-ke yehlisa kakhulu ijubane emvuleni.
p-068.actionItem: Yehlisa ijubane endleleni eqondile ngaphambi kokungena ekhoneni, futhi ugweme ukubhuleka kakhulu noma ukujika isiteringi ngamandla ungaphakathi kulo.

p-069.title: Usayizi We-TV: Ibanga Lokubuka Libaluleke Ukwedlula Ukulungiswa Kwezithombe (Resolution)
p-069.summary: Iso lomuntu libona ngokucacile cishe i-arcminute eyodwa. Uma ukude awukwazi ukuhlukanisa i-4K ne-Full HD, ngakho-ke sebenzisa imali kusayizi wesikrini kunasesinqumweni sezithombe.
p-069.principle: Ukunemba kweso $\theta\approx1'\approx2.9\times10^{-4}$ rad; kububanzi be-pixel $p$ ibanga elikude kakhulu lapho ama-pixel ehlukaniseka khona litholakala ngo-$d=\dfrac{p}{\theta}$.
p-069.example: I-TV ye-55-intshi ye-4K ine-pixel pitch ecishe ibe ngu-0.32 mm, ngakho-ke ama-pixel abonakala kuphela ngaphakathi kwebanga elingaba ngu-1.1 m. Uma usofa wakho uqhele ngamamitha angu-3, ngisho ne-Full HD iyawafihla ama-pixel ayo kuze kufike kuma-intshi angu-75, ngakho-ke bhekisisa usayizi nekhwalithi yesithombe (contrast, HDR) kunokukhokhela i-4K ebizayo.
p-069.actionItem: Kala ibanga ukusuka kusofa wakho ukuya lapho kuhlala khona i-TV usebenzisa itheyiphu yokukala bese ukhetha usayizi wesikrini ngokuya ngalo.

p-070.title: Ungqimba Olukhulu Lweqhwa Esitsheni Esiqandisayo Lwenza Sisebenzise Ugesi Omningi
p-070.summary: Ungqimba lweqhwa lubamba umoya phakathi kwamakristalu alo, lwakhe ungqimba oluvimba amakhaza futhi lwenza isicindezeli (compressor) sisebenze isikhathi eside.
p-070.principle: Ukuphikisa ukushisa (thermal resistance) kungu-$R=d/k$, okuhambisana ngqo nogqinsi $d$. Ungqimba lweqhwa luno-$k\approx0.2$-$0.5\ \mathrm{W/(m\,K)}$, okuphansi kakhulu kuneqhwa eliqinile (cishe 2.2).
p-070.example: Ngo-$k=0.3$, ungqimba lweqhwa olungu-5 mm luno-$R=0.005/0.3\approx0.017\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$, okuphindwe kahlanu kune-1 mm, kanti ukusebenza kokupholisa kwehla ngokufanayo.
p-070.actionItem: Uma iqhwa lidlula u-3-5 mm, cisha umshini bese uwuyeka uncibilike ngokwemvelo. Ungalokothi uhlinze ngommese noma ngethuluzi elicijile.

p-071.title: Amalitha Angu-200 Emvula: Amanzi Amahhala Engadini Yasentwasahlobo
p-071.summary: Imvula yasentwasahlobo eqoqwe ophahleni inganisela ingadi ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amanzi ompompi. Ukuphakamisa umgqomo kunikeza umfutho owanele wokusebenzisa ipayipi.
p-071.principle: Umfutho wamanzi $P=\rho g h$, ukuqoqwa kwamanzi $V=A\times R$ (indawo ephahleni iphindwe ngomthamo wemvula).
p-071.example: Imvula engu-20 mm ophahleni olungama-10 m2 iqoqa u-$10\times20=200$ L. Ukuphakamisa umgqomo ngo-1 m kunikeza u-9.8 kPa (cishe u-0.1 bar) womfutho, owanele ukuhambisa amanzi ngamandla adonsela phansi epayipini eliya ezingadini eziphansi.
p-071.actionItem: Beka umgqomo wemvula endaweni ephakeme okungenani ngo-50 cm futhi uwumboze ngesivalo nangesihlungi ukuze omiyane bangazaleli kuwo.

p-072.title: Umsindo Obuyayo Wombhobho (Feedback): Yehlisa Umsindo (Gain) ngo-3 dB
p-072.summary: Uma umbhobho uphinda ukhulisa umsindo wesipikha uthola umsindo ohlabayo owevayo. Ukulungisa ibanga nevolumu kukunqanda kalula lokhu.
p-072.principle: Inzuzo yomjikelezo (loop gain) $G=g_{amp}\cdot g_{path}\ge1$ enezigaba ezihambisanayo ibangela ukudlidliza okungumsindo.
p-072.example: Ukuphinda kabili ibanga phakathi kombhobho nesipikha kwengeza u-6 dB wokulahleka kwendlela, okuvumela ivolumu eyengeziwe. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukwehlisa inzuzo ngo-3 dB nje kuphela kunciphisa inzuzo yomjikelezo phakathi futhi umsindo ohlabayo uyanyamalala.
p-072.actionItem: Ungawabeki amaspika phambi kombhobho, waqondise ezilalelini, bese wehlisa umsindo wombhobho (gain) ngo-3 dB (isinyathelo esisodwa noma ezimbili).

p-073.title: Ukuhlola Amandla Emisebe Ye-UV Ngesithunzi Sakho
p-073.summary: Uma isithunzi sakho sifushane kunawe, ilanga liphezulu kuneziqu ezingu-45 kanti i-UV inamandla. Ngasekupheleni kukaNdasa isithunzi sakho sasemini sase sishoda kakhulu kunobude bakho.
p-073.principle: Isilinganiso se-UV sandiswa ngo-$\sin\alpha$ wokuphakama kwelanga $\alpha$, kanti ubude besithunzi ngu-$L=\dfrac{h}{\tan\alpha}$.
p-073.example: Emazingeni angama-37 enyakatho nge-equinox (cishe ngo-20 kuNdasa), ukuphakama kwasemini kungu-$90^\circ-37^\circ=53^\circ$ futhi isithunzi singu-$1/\tan53^\circ=0.75$ wobude bakho. Ekuqaleni kukaNhlolanja (ukuphakama cishe ngama-degrees angama-38) sasingu-1.28 izikhathi zobude bakho.
p-073.actionItem: Hlola isithunzi sakho cishe emini namuhla; uma sifushane kunawe, gcoba okokuvikela elangeni kwe-SPF 30+ futhi ugqoke nesigqoko.

p-074.title: Amakhamera e-Speed Section: Ukugijima Kakhulu Konga Imizuzu Engu-2 Kuphela
p-074.summary: Ukuqapha kwesigaba kuhlola isivinini sakho esiyisilinganiso. Isikhathi ositholayo ngokugijima kakhulu sincane kakhulu kuyilapho ukusetshenziswa kwamandla nengozi kukhuphuka kakhulu.
p-074.principle: Isivinini esiyisilinganiso $\bar v=\dfrac{\Delta s}{\Delta t}$, amandla okudonsa komoya (drag power) $\propto v^3$.
p-074.example: Isigaba esingamakhilomitha angu-20 sithatha imizuzu engu-12 ngo-100 km/h kanye nemizuzu engu-10 ngo-120 km/h, okuwukonga imizuzu engu-2, kodwa amandla okudonsa komoya akhuphuka ngo-$1.2^3=1.73$ (+73%) namandla e-kinetic ngo-44%. Ukugijima ekuqaleni kukuphoqa ukuthi wehlise ijubane kamuva, ngakho-ke ayikho inzuzo yangempela.
p-074.actionItem: Endaweni elawulwa yisivinini sesigaba (section control), setha i-cruise control emkhawulweni bese ugcina isivinini esingaguquki.

p-075.title: Ahlulela Izipikha Ngokuzwela (dB), Hhayi Ngama-Watts
p-075.summary: Umehluko wokuzwela ongu-3 dB ulingana nokuphindaphindeka kabili kwamandla e-amplifier ukuze uthole ubukhulu bomsindo obufanayo. Inombolo enkulu ye-wattage ayiqinisekisi isipikha esinomsindo omkhulu.
p-075.principle: Ukucindezela komsindo $\mathrm{SPL}=S+10\log_{10}P-20\log_{10}d$ ($S$: 1 W/1 m ukuzwela nge-dB).
p-075.example: Ukuze ufinyelele ku-85 dB kumamitha angu-3 udinga cishe u-94.5 dB kumitha elingu-1. Isipikha esinokuzwela okungu-90 dB sidinga cishe u-2.8 W kuyilapho esingu-84 dB sidinga cishe u-11.2 W, okuwumehluko ophindwe kane.
p-075.actionItem: Hlola ukuzwela (dB ku-1 W/1 m) eshidini lemininingwane yesipikha ohlela ukusithenga bese ukhetha leso esiphezulu.

p-076.title: Nciphisa Isivinini Sefeni Ngo-20% Bese Amandla Ehla Ngengxenye
p-076.summary: Ukusetshenziswa kwamandla efeni kukhuphuka nge-cube yesivinini sayo. Uma umoya ophansi kancane wamukelekile, ungonga ugesi omningi.
p-076.principle: Imithetho yokuhlobana kwefeni (affinity laws): ukugeleza komoya $Q\propto N$, amandla $P\propto N^3$.
p-076.example: Kusivinini esingu-80%, ukugeleza komoya kungu-80% kodwa amandla aba ngu-$0.8^3=0.51$, cishe ingxenye. Ifeni engu-40 W yehlela cishe ku-20 W, okonga cishe u-4.7 kWh ngenyanga ngamahora angu-8 ngosuku.
p-076.actionItem: Namuhla, setha ifeni yakho noma i-ventilator ku-medium esikhundleni sika-high bese uhlola ukuthi kusenethezekile yini.

p-077.title: I-Nozzle Eyodwa Inganga U-40% Wamanzi Engadi
p-077.summary: Ukunciphisa imbobo yesiphetho sepayipi kusheshisa umfudlana wamanzi ukuze ufike kude, kanti i-nozzle evalelekayo ivimbela ukumosheka lapho uhamba.
p-077.example: Ipayipi elingu-15 mm elithwala u-10 L/min (0.167 L/s) linesivinini esingaba ngu-0.94 m/s. I-nozzle engu-5 mm ikhuphula isivinini sifike cishe ku-8.5 m/s, ngokushesha ngokuphindwe kasishiyagalolunye, futhi idinga cishe u-36 kPa. Ukuvala ukugeleza ngenkathi uhamba kungenza ukuchelela kwemizuzu engu-5, okungu-50 L, kwehle kuye cishe ku-30 L.
p-077.actionItem: Faka i-nozzle yenhlamvu (trigger shut-off) esiphethweni sepayipi bese uchelela ezimpandeni zezitshalo kuphela.

p-078.title: I-Water Hammer: Umsindo Wokuqhuma Lapho Uvala Impompi
p-078.summary: Ukuvala ngokushesha kumisa amanzi ahambayo kungazelelwe futhi kuthumela igagasi lokushaqeka emapayipini, okubangela ukuqhuma nokonakala okungenzeka.
p-078.principle: I-Joukowsky equation $\Delta p=\rho c\,\Delta v$ ($c$: isivinini somsindo epayipini).
p-078.example: Ngamanzi ahamba ngo-2 m/s epayipini lethusi elino-$c\approx1200$ m/s, ukumisa ngokushesha kunikeza u-$\Delta p\approx2.4$ MPa (24 bar), okuphindwe kasithupha kunesivamile esingu-3-4 bar. Uma ukuvala kuthatha isikhathi eside kuno-$2L/c$ (cishe u-17 ms ngepayipi elingu-10 m) ukushaqeka kwehla kakhulu.
p-078.actionItem: Vala amaphampu e-lever namavalvu omshini wokuwasha kancane, bese ubuza nge-water hammer arrestor uma lowo msindo uqhubeka nokwenzeka.

p-079.title: Isikhathi Sokushintsha Izicathulo Zokugijima: Ngokombono Wamandla Omthelela
p-079.summary: Njengoba impahla enciphisa umthelela (cushioning) iguga, unyawo lwakho luma ngokushesha kakhulu futhi amadolo namaqakala athwala amandla amakhulu. Zihlole njalo ngemva kwamakhilomitha angu-500-800.
p-079.principle: I-Impulse $F\,\Delta t=\Delta p$, ngakho amandla ayisilinganiso $F=\dfrac{m\Delta v}{\Delta t}$.
p-079.example: Ukwenza lula ngomgijimi ongu-70 kg odedela u-70 N·s lapho efika phansi, ukuma ngo-0.035 s kunikeza u-2,000 N, kuyilapho i-cushioning egugile emisa ngo-0.02 s inikeza u-3,500 N (cishe izikhathi ezingu-5 zesisindo somzimba), okuwukukhuphuka ngo-75%.
p-079.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ukuthi ingxenye ephakathi nendawo yesicathulo sakho sokugijima (midsole) icindezelekile futhi inemibimbi yini, bese ubhala phansi ibanga osuligijimile kusukela wagcina ukuzishintsha.

p-080.title: Ukushayela Ebusuku: Ungashayeli Ngokushesha Okudlula Izibani Zakho Eziphansi
p-080.summary: Izibani eziphansi zikhanyisa cishe amamitha angama-40, kodwa ukuma usuka ku-80 km/h kuthatha ibanga elide, ngakho-ke ushayela endleleni ongayiboni.
p-080.example: Ku-80 km/h (22.2 m/s) enomzuzwana o-1 wokusabela kanye no-$\mu=0.7$, udinga $22.2+36=58$ m, okungaphezu kwama-40 m. Ku-60 km/h kungama-$16.7+20=37$ m, okuphephile. Ungqimba olungcolile noma inkungu ngaphakathi kwewindi langaphambili kuhlakaza ukukhanya futhi kunciphise umbono wakho kakhulu.
p-080.actionItem: Sula ingaphakathi lewindi lakho langaphambili nezibani zangaphambili ngaphambi kokuhamba, futhi uhlale ku-60 km/h noma ngaphansi emigwaqweni emnyama eseceleni.

p-081.title: Isigqoko Sebhayisikili: Ukushona Kokucindezeleka Kungukhiye
p-081.summary: Isigqoko sandisa ibanga elithathwa yikhanda lakho ukuma, sinciphise amandla omthelela. Isitifiketi nokulingana kubaluleke kakhulu kunentengo noma ukubukeka.
p-081.example: Ikhanda elingama-5 kg elishaya ngejubane elingu-6 m/s lithwala $E_k=90$ J. Ngaphandle kwesigqoko nokuma ngo-2 mm, amandla acishe abe ngama-45 kN; ngamagwebu e-EPS angu-20 mm cishe angama-4.5 kN, okuyingxenye eyodwa kweshumi. I-EPS ilahlekelwa ukusebenza kwayo uma isicindezelwe umthelela.
p-081.actionItem: Bheka isitifiketi sokuphepha se-CPSC, EN 1078 noma esinye, silinganise ngeminwe emibili ngenhla kwamashiya, bese ulungisa amabhande abe sesimweni esingu-Y ngaphansi kwezindlebe.

p-082.title: Izibani Zensimu Zelanga: Tshekisa Ngama-degrees angama-35 Eningizimu Ukuze Uthole Okungaphezulu Ngo-25%
p-082.summary: Ipaneli yelanga iqoqa kakhulu uma ibheke ngqo elangeni. Ukutshekisa isibani sensimu ukuze silingane ne-latitude yakho kukhulisa ukushajeka.
p-082.principle: Amandla atholakele $\propto\cos\theta$ ($\theta$: i-incidence angle). Ukutsheka okungcono kakhulu $\approx$ i-latitude.
p-082.example: Ku-37 degrees enyakatho, nelanga lasemini le-equinox ku-53 degrees, ipaneli eyisicaba ithola $\sin53^\circ=0.80$, ipaneli eqondile esodongeni $\cos53^\circ=0.60$, kanti ipaneli etshekiswe ngama-degrees angama-37 ithola u-1.0. Lokho kungaphezulu cishe ngo-25% kunesicaba futhi kungaphezulu ngo-67% kuneqondile.
p-082.actionItem: Bhekisa ipaneli yesibani sensimu eningizimu, yitshekise ngama-degree angama-35-40, bese ususa umthunzi nothuli.

p-083.title: Isibani Setafula Esiqhele Ngama-cm angama-30 Eduzane, Ingxenye Yesine Yamandla
p-083.summary: Ukuqina kokukhanya kuyehla ngokuphindaphindwe kwebanga. Ukubeka isibani eduze kwenza ibhalbhu elibuthakathaka likwazi ukunikeza ukukhanya okufanayo.
p-083.example: Ukususa isibani kusuka ku-60 cm kuye ku-30 cm kwenza ukukhanya kuphakame ngokuphindwe ka-4. Ukuthola ama-lux angama-500 ku-60 cm kudinga i-LED engu-12 W, kodwa ku-30 cm u-3 W wanele, okonga cishe ama-13 kWh ngonyaka emahoreni ama-4 ngosuku.
p-083.actionItem: Beka isibani cishe ngama-30 cm ukusuka ekhasini lakho, ubhekane nesandla sakho sokubhala, bese ufaka ibhalbhu elinamandla aphansi e-wattage.

p-084.title: Kungani Izingcingo Zinqamuka Ku-elevator
p-084.summary: Ibhokisi lensimbi liyi-Faraday cage evimba amagagasi kagesi kazibuthe ukuba angangeni. Ukulungiselela ngaphambi kokuba isignali inqamuke kuvikela izingcingo ezibalulekile.
p-084.principle: Ukushona kwesikhumba $\delta=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{\pi f\mu\sigma}}$ (ukushona lapho igagasi libola khona ngaphakathi komqhubi kagesi).
p-084.example: Ku-aluminum ($\sigma=3.8\times10^7$ S/m) igagasi elingu-1.8 GHz linokushona kwesikhumba okungaba ama-micrometer angu-1.9 kuphela, ngakho-ke ngisho namashidi ensimbi azacile ayalivimba. Utotoba ngesignali evuza ngezikhala zeminyango nezimbobo zomoya.
p-084.actionItem: Qedela izingcingo ezibalulekile ngaphambi kokungena ngaphakathi, vula ukushaya nge-Wi-Fi, bese ulanda amafayela adingekayo ngaphambi kokungena egalaji elingaphansi komhlaba.

p-085.title: Ukuhlanza Kwasentwasahlobo: Sula Uthuli, Ungalushaneli
p-085.summary: Isikhathi uthuli oluhlala ngaso emoyeni siyehluka kakhulu ngobukhulu balo. Ukushanela kuphakamisela uthuli oseluhlale phansi lubuyele emoyeni owuphefumulayo.
p-085.example: Inhlayiya yothuli engama-micrometer ayi-10 ihlala phansi cishe ngo-6 mm/s, iwa ngo-1 m cishe ngemizuzu emi-3, kanti eyi-2.5 micrometer iwa ngejubane elingu-$1/16$ lalelo, okungu-0.38 mm/s, ithathe cishe imizuzu engama-44. Izinhlayiya ezincane zilenga emoyeni isikhathi eside ngemva kokuhlanza.
p-085.actionItem: Hlanza namuhla usebenzisa imophu emanzi noma indwangu emanzi esikhundleni sokushanela, bese ungenisa umoya ngokuvula amawindi ihora lonke ngemva kwalokho.

p-086.title: Umthetho Wokushiya Imizuzwana Emibili Ibanga Lokulandela
p-086.summary: Uma zombili izimoto zibhuleka ngokulinganayo, igebe olidingayo yibanga lakho lokusabela kuphela. Imizuzwana emibili inika cishe amamitha angama-56 ku-100 km/h.
p-086.example: Ku-100 km/h (27.8 m/s) ukusabela kwemizuzwana engu-1.5 kudinga u-41.7 m, kanti umthetho wemizuzwana emibili unika u-55.6 m, okuyisikhala esiphephile. Emvuleni, yelule ibe yimizuzwana emi-3 kuya kwemi-4.
p-086.actionItem: Lapho imoto ephambi kwakho idlula uphawu noma ipali yokukhanya, bala uthi 'kunye, kubili' bese uqinisekisa ukuthi awufiki kuleyo ndawo ngaphambi kokuba uqede ukubala.

p-087.title: Amasondo Amakhulu Aginqika Phezu Kwamajika Omgwaqo Kalula Kakhulu
p-087.summary: Isondo elikhudlwana likhuphuka isitebhisi esifanayo nge-engeli ethambile, ngakho kudingeka amandla amancane.
p-087.principle: Esondweni eline-radius engu-$R$ phezu kwesitebhisi esinokuphakama okungu-$h$, amandla avundlile ku-ekseli atholakala ngokuthi $F=mg\,\dfrac{\sqrt{2Rh-h^2}}{R-h}$.
p-087.example: Ngo-$mg=100$ N esondweni kanye no-$h=1$ cm, isondo elingu-6 cm lidinga cishe u-112 N, isondo elingu-10 cm lidinge cishe u-75 N bese kuthi isondo elingu-16 cm lidinge cishe u-55 N.
p-087.actionItem: Lapho uthenga umthwalo wokuhamba noma inqola yengane, hlola ububanzi besondo nempahla eyakhiwe ngayo (iraba noma i-polyurethane), bese uphakamisa amasondo angaphambili lapho ufinyelela emphethweni womgwaqo.

p-088.title: Ukushaja Ngokushesha: I-Voltage Ephezulu Isha kusho Ukulahlekelwa Okuncane
p-088.summary: Ukushisa okulahleka ocingweni kukhula nesikwele samandla kagesi (current). Ukuletha amandla afanayo nge-voltage ephezulu kanye ne-current ephansi kunciphisa ukulahleka.
p-088.example: Ukuletha u-18 W ku-5 V kuthatha u-3.6 A, kumoshe u-2.6 W (14%) entanjeni engu-0.2 ohm, kanti ku-9 V kuthatha u-2 A bese kumosha u-0.8 W (4.4%) kuphela. Izintambo ezincane nezinde zilahlekelwa kakhulu nakakhulu.
p-088.actionItem: Sebenzisa intambo ewugqinsi, emfushane esekela izinga elifanayo neleshaja yakho (njenge-PD), bese ushintsha izintambo ezindala ezigugile.

p-089.title: Yomisa Izimpahla Ngelanga Lomthombo Nomoya Ohelezayo
p-089.summary: Ukuhwamukisa amanzi ezimpahleni ezimanzi kuthatha amandla amaningi, kanti ilanga nomoya kukulethela lokho mahhala.
p-089.principle: Ukushisa okucashile $Q=mL$ ($L=2.26\times10^6$ J/kg), izinga lokuhwamuka $E\propto(a+bu)(e_s-e_a)$ (likhula ngomoya $u$).
p-089.example: Ukuhwamukisa u-1 kg wamanzi kuthatha u-$2.26$ MJ $\approx0.63$ kWh. Ukusonta ngo-1,000 rpm noma ngaphezulu nokweneka emoyeni obandayo ongu-2 m/s komisa ngokushesha okukhulu kunaphakathi endlini futhi konge cishe u-2-3 kWh womjikelezo owodwa womshini wokomisa. Ngezinsuku ezinempova eningi, omisela ngaphakathi endlini esikhundleni salokho.
p-089.actionItem: Vuthulula izingubo eziphume emshinini wokukaza, ziqhelelanise ukuze umoya udlule, bese uzengoma endaweni enelanga nomoya ohelezayo.

p-090.title: Amantongomane Esondo Abambekile Lapho Kushintshwa Amathayi Wentwasahlobo
p-090.summary: Lapho ushintsha amathayi ebusika uwenza awavamile, amantongomane ngeke anyakaze ngoba i-torque iphezulu. Isikrufu eside sinciphisa amandla owadingayo.
p-090.example: Ukuthukulula inathi lesondo elingu-110 N·m ngesikrufu esingu-0.3 m kudinga cishe u-370 N, kanti ngesikrufu esingu-0.6 m kudingeka cishe u-183 N, okuyingxenye kuphela. Ungafaki ipayipi lapho uqinisa; sebenzisa i-torque wrench ukuze ufinyelele inani elicacisiwe.
p-090.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuba uphakamise imoto ngejekhi, thukulula inathi ngalinye ngohhafu wokujika ngenkathi ithayi lisephansi, futhi ngaso sonke isikhathi sebenza endaweni esezingeni elilinganayo.

p-091.title: Isikhwama Sokugibela Izintaba: Gcina Izinto Ezisindayo Ziseduze Nomhlane Wakho
p-091.summary: Lapho umthwalo wesikhwama ukude nomzimba wakho, kulapho umhlane namahlombe akho kuthwala khona amandla amaningi okuzungeza. Gcina izinto ezisindayo zibheke emhlane wakho bese udlulisela umthwalo ebhandeni lenyonga.
p-091.principle: I-Torque $\tau=mgd$ ($d$: ibanga ukusuka ku-ekseli yomzimba kuya maphakathi nesisindo somthwalo).
p-091.example: Umthwalo ongu-6 kg oqhele ngo-25 cm unikeza $\tau=6\times9.8\times0.25=14.7$ N·m, kanti u-10 cm unikeza u-5.9 N·m, okungaphansi cishe ngo-60%. Vumela ibhande lenyonga lithwale cishe u-70% wesisindo ezinqulwini zakho.
p-091.actionItem: Pakisha izinto ezisindayo njengebhodlela lamanzi nokudla kwasemini zibheke emhlane wakho phakathi nendawo ngenhla, bese uqinisa ibhande lenyonga ngaphambi kokuhamba.

p-092.title: Ukungena komoya nhlangothi zombili ngemizuzu eyi-10
p-092.summary: Ukuvula amawindi amabili abhekeneyo kuvuselela umoya egumbini ngokushesha okukhulu kunokuvula elilodwa kuphela.
p-092.principle: Ukugeleza komoya kulandela isibalo sika-Bernoulli $p+\tfrac{1}{2}\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$ kanye nezinga lokugeleza $Q=Av$. Uma kunendawo yokungena nephumelo, umoya uyadlula futhi izinga lokungena komoya liyenyuka.
p-092.example: Egumbini elingama-75 m³, umoya ohelezayo ongu-1 m/s embotsheni engu-0.5 m² unikeza $Q=0.5\times1=0.5\ \mathrm{m^3/s}$ (1,800 m³/h). Ekusebenzeni lokhu kusho ukushintshwa komoya izikhathi ezi-5 kuya kwezi-10 ngehora, ngakho imizuzu eyi-10 yanele, uma kuqhathaniswa nokushintshwa oku-1 kuya koku-2 kuphela ngefasitela elilodwa.
p-092.actionItem: Namuhla, vula amawindi amabili (noma umnyango nefasitela) abhekeneyo imizuzu eyi-10.

p-093.title: Umfutho wesondo lebhayisikili nokumelana nokugingqika
p-093.summary: Isondo elithambile lenza ukugibela okufanayo kube nzima kakhulu ngejubane elifanayo.
p-093.principle: Ukumelana nokugingqika kungu-$F_\mathrm{rr}=C_\mathrm{rr}\,mg$. Umfutho ophansi wandisa indawo ethinta phansi, ukhulise ukulahleka kokuma kwebhayisikili, futhi ukhuphule i-$C_\mathrm{rr}$.
p-093.example: Kusisindo esihlanganisiwe esingama-80 kg, ukukhuphula i-$C_\mathrm{rr}$ isuke ku-0.005 iye ku-0.010 kuphinda kabili i-$F_\mathrm{rr}$ isuke cishe ku-3.9 N iye ku-7.8 N, kanti ngejubane elingu-20 km/h (5.6 m/s) amandla asuka cishe ku-22 W aye ku-44 W.
p-093.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokugibela, futha amathayi akho afinyelele ebangeni lomfutho elibhalwe eceleni kwesondo (psi/bar).

p-094.title: Izifonyo zothuli zisebenza ngogesi omile (static electricity)
p-094.summary: Isifonyo sohlobo lwe-KF/N95 sibamba uthuli oluncane kakhulu ngamandla kagesi omile, hhayi nje ngezimbobo ezincane, ngakho amanzi noma utshwala buyasenza buthaka.
p-094.principle: Imicu yesisefo inogesi omile ohlala njalo futhi idonsa izinhlayiya ngamandla e-Coulomb $F=k\dfrac{q_1q_2}{r^2}$. Amanzi, utshwala noma umjuluko kususa lawo mandla kagesi.
p-094.example: Isifonyo se-KF94 sihlunga okungenani ama-94% ezinhlayiya ezingama-0.4 μm, kodwa ngemva kokufafazwa ngotshwala ukusebenza kahle kungase kwehle ngaphansi kwama-80%. Isifonyo esisodwa ngokuvamile silungele ukusetshenziswa cishe usuku olulodwa (cishe amahora ayi-8).
p-094.actionItem: Ungasihlanzi noma usifafaze isifonyo sakho; faka esisha namuhla uma sesimanzi noma sesiphelelwe yisimo.

p-095.title: Ikhofi eliconsayo namandla okugeleza komsinga wamanzi
p-095.summary: Ukuthela kancane futhi ngomucu omncane kukhipha ukunambitheka ngokulinganayo, okunikeza inkomishi enambitheka kakhulu emantini afanayo ekhofi.
p-095.principle: Umlomo omncane wethala ukhuphula isivinini $v=Q/A$ futhi udala ukunyakaza okuxuba ikhofi ngokulinganayo. Ukukhishwa kokunambitheka kuncike esikhathini sokuthintana kanye nezinga lokushisa.
p-095.example: Izinga elijwayelekile ngamagremu ayi-15 ekhofi anama-250 mL amanzi ashisa ngo-92-96 °C, athelwa ngezigaba phakathi kwemizuzu engu-2.5-3. Ukukuthulula konke ngemizuzwana engama-30 kunciphisa isikhathi sokuthintana ngengxenye yesihlanu, okunikeza inkomishi ebuthaka nemuncu.
p-095.actionItem: Phaqa ikhofi lanamuhla ekuseni ngokuthela kathathu kancane ngomucu omncane wamanzi.

p-096.title: Ukukhanya okuphansi kwesikrini, amandla aphansi kagesi
p-096.summary: Amandla okukhanyisa kwangemuva kwe-LCD acishe alingane nokukhanya kwayo, ngakho-ke ukunciphisa ukukhanya konga ugesi nokuphazamiseka kwamehlo.
p-096.principle: Amandla okukhanyisa kwangemuva alingana no-$P\approx kB$ ngokukhanya okungu-$B$, ngakho ingqikithi yamandla ithi $P=P_0+kB$.
p-096.example: Uma isikrini esisebenzisa ama-40 W sisebenzisa ama-25 W ekukhanyeni kwangemuva ku-100%, ukukwehlisa kuye ku-50% konga ama-12.5 W, cishe ama-31%. Ema-horeni ayi-8 ngosuku lokho kungu-$0.0125\times8\times30\approx3$ kWh ngenyanga.
p-096.actionItem: Namuhla, misa ukukhanya kwesikrini sekhompuyutha noma i-TV yakho eduze kwama-50%, kuhambisane nokukhanya kwegumbi.

p-097.title: Izitsha zokupheka ze-induction zidinga isinqe esiyisicaba
p-097.summary: I-Induction ishisa ngokusebenzisa amagagasi kagesi ngaphakathi ebhodweni ngokwalo, ngakho isinqe esigobile simosha amandla.
p-097.principle: Inkundla kazibuthe eguqukayo idala imisinga ye-eddy phansi ebhodweni, eyishisisa ngokushisa kuka-Joule $P=I^2R$. Igebe elikhudlwana phakathi kwebhodwe nesitofu lenza ukuxhumana kube buthaka.
p-097.example: I-Induction inokusebenza kahle okucishe kube ngama-85-90% uma kuqhathaniswa nokungaba ngama-40-50% kwegesi. Uma isinqe siphakama ngo-2 mm noma ngaphezulu, ukusebenza kahle kwehla ngokusobala kanti ukubila kuthatha imizuzu eminingana eyengeziwe.
p-097.actionItem: Namuhla, beka ibhodwe lakho endaweni eyisicaba bese uhlola ukuthi alixegi noma aliphakathi yini emaphethelweni.

p-098.title: Gcina izincwadi ezisindayo eduze kwesisekelo seshalofu
p-098.summary: Isisindo esifanayo uma siqhelelene nesisekelo sinikeza ishalofu amandla amakhulu okuphenduka (turning moment), ngakho liyagoba noma liphume odongeni.
p-098.principle: I-moment esisekelweni ingu-$M=Fd$, elingana ngqo nebanga elingu-$d$.
p-098.example: Inqwaba engu-5 kg (cishe engu-49 N) eqhele ngama-5 cm ukusuka esisekelweni inikeza u-$M\approx2.5\ \mathrm{N\,m}$, kodwa eqhele ngama-25 cm inikeza cishe u-$12\ \mathrm{N\,m}$, okuphindaphindwe kahlanu.
p-098.actionItem: Lapho uhlela amashalofu namuhla, beka izinto ezisindayo eduze kodonga noma kwesisekelo kanti ezilula uzibeke ngaphandle.

p-099.title: Ungashiyi umnyango wesiqandisi uvulekile
p-099.summary: Ukuvula umnyango kwenza umoya obandayo uphume bese kungena ofudumele, ngakho i-compressor kumele isebenze futhi.
p-099.principle: Umoya uhamba ngokushintshana kokushisa okuqhutshwa ukuminyana (density-driven convection) kanti ukutholakala kokushisa kungu-$Q=mc\Delta T$. Umoya osesiqandisini esingu-300 L unesisindo esingaba ngu-0.36 kg.
p-099.example: Ukugcina umnyango uvulekile imizuzwana engu-30 kungakhuphula izinga lokushisa langaphakathi lisuke ku-4 °C liye ku-10 °C, futhi ukubandisa kabusha kuthatha imizuzu engu-10-20 yokusebenza kwe-compressor. Ukuvula ngokungadingekile izikhathi ezingu-20 ngosuku kungengeza cishe u-2-4% ekusebenziseni amandla kwanyanga zonke.
p-099.actionItem: Namuhla, nquma ukuthi yini oyidingayo ngaphambi kokuvula isiqandisi bese usivala phakathi kwemizuzwana engu-10.

p-100.title: Umsindo wehla ngo-6 dB lapho ibanga liphindaphindeka kabili
p-100.summary: Ukusuka nje kude nomthombo womsindo kunciphisa kakhulu izinga lawo, okuyindlela elula kakhulu yokuvikela ukuzwa ekhona.
p-100.principle: Amandla omsindo omthombo oyiphuzu alandela u-$I\propto1/r^2$ kanti izinga lomsindo lingu-$L=10\log_{10}(I/I_0)$. Ukuphinda kabili ibanga kunikeza u-$\Delta L=-20\log_{10}2\approx-6\ \mathrm{dB}$.
p-100.example: Isipikha esingu-90 dB ku-1 m sifundeka njengo-84 dB ku-2 m kanye no-78 dB ku-4 m. Imikhombandlela ivumela cishe amahora angu-8 ku-85 dB namahora angu-2 ku-91 dB, ngakho ibanga lenza isikhathi sakho sokulalela ngokuphepha sibe side.
p-100.actionItem: Namuhla, ekhonsathini noma endaweni yokwakha, yima kude ngokuphindwe kabili ukusuka kusipikha noma emthonjeni womsindo.

p-101.title: Phinda ijubane kabili, ibanga lokubhuleka liphindaphindeka kane
p-101.summary: Ukwehlisa ijubane kancane kunciphisa kakhulu ibanga lokuma futhi kunciphisa ingozi yokushayisana.
p-101.principle: Ibanga lokubhuleka livela ku-$\tfrac{1}{2}mv^2=\mu mg\,d$, ngakho $d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$, elilingana nesikwele sejubane.
p-101.example: Emgwaqweni owomile ($\mu\approx0.7$), u-50 km/h (13.9 m/s) udinga cishe ama-14 m kanti u-100 km/h (27.8 m/s) udinga cishe ama-56 m, okuphindaphindwe kane. Emgwaqweni omanzi ($\mu\approx0.4$), u-100 km/h udinga cishe ama-98 m.
p-101.actionItem: Ngosuku olunamatshe noma olunemvula, shayela ngo-20% ngaphansi komkhawulo wejubane namuhla futhi ugcine igebe eliphindwe kabili kunokujwayelekile emotweni ephambi kwakho.

p-102.title: Zilinganise isisindo phansi endaweni eqinile, eyisicaba
p-102.summary: Kukhaphethi othambile noma phansi lapho kutshekile umthwalo awuhlukaniswa ngokulinganayo yizinzwa zesikali, ngakho izilinganiso ziyaphambuka.
p-102.principle: Isikali sihlanganisa izinzwa zaso ezine zamakhona, $W=\sum F_i$. Indawo etshekile noma ethambile iguqula indlela umthwalo ohlukaniseka ngayo phakathi kwazo.
p-102.example: Umuntu ongu-70 kg unikeza u-$mg\approx686$ N, cishe u-171 N inzwa ngayinye. Uma unyawo olulodwa lucwila endaweni ethambile, inzwa eyodwa ithwala kakhulu bese yengeza iphutha.
p-102.actionItem: Khetha indawo eqinile, eyisicaba njengamathayela asendlini yokugezela lapho ubeka khona isikali futhi uzilinganise endaweni efanayo ngaso sonke isikhathi.

p-103.title: Izinsimbi zokulenga zokudonsa (suction hooks) zinamathela kuphela ngemuva kokuthi umoya uphushelwe ngaphandle
p-103.summary: Ingwegwe yokudonsa yasegunjini lokugezela ibanjwa umfutho womoya wangaphandle, hhayi iglue.
p-103.principle: Amandla okubamba angu-$F=\Delta P\cdot A$. Uma umoya wangaphakathi uphushelwe ngaphandle, umehluko womfutho nomoya wangaphandle ocishe ube ngu-101 kPa ucindezela inkomishi.
p-103.example: Inkomishi engu-5 cm ine-$A=\pi(0.025)^2\approx1.96\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, ngakho umkhawulo wethiyori ungu-$101{,}000\times1.96\times10^{-3}\approx198$ N. Izingwegwe zangempela zibamba okuncane kakhulu ngoba umoya uyangena kancane.
p-103.actionItem: Sula amanzi nothuli ethayeleni noma engilazini, cindezela ngokuqinile ukuze ukhiphe umoya, futhi ungalokothi weqe umthwalo olinganiselwe obhalwe engwegweni.

p-104.title: Cisha izibani usebenzise ukukhanya kwasemini okuvela efasiteleni
p-104.summary: Ngosuku olucwathile lwasentwasahlobo, ukukhanya eduze kwefasitela kukhanya kakhulu ngokuphindaphindiwe kunezibani zegumbi, ngakho-ke izibani zasemini ngokuvamile azidingeki.
p-104.principle: Ukukhanya okukhanyisayo kungu-$E=\Phi/A$ (ngama-lux). Eduze kwefasitela ngosuku olucwathile ngokuvamile kungaphezu kuka-1,000 lx, kuyilapho u-300-500 lx wanele ehhovisi noma emsebenzini wokufunda.
p-104.example: Ukucisha ama-bulb e-LED amathathu angu-8 W (24 W) amahora angu-6 ngosuku konga u-$0.024\times6\times30\approx4.3$ kWh ngenyanga.
p-104.actionItem: Namuhla, vula amakhethini, sondeza ideskhi yakho noma indawo yokufundela efasiteleni bese ucisha izibani.

p-105.title: Qhathanisa umoya ophephulwa ufeni (CMM), hhayi umsindo wawo kuphela
p-105.summary: Amafeni amabili anobukhulu obufanayo angahambisa inani lomoya elihluke kakhulu, elinqunywa ubukhulu bamaphiko kanye nesivinini somoya.
p-105.principle: Ukugeleza komoya kungu-$Q=Av$ (nge-$\mathrm{m^3/min}$), futhi ufeni onobubanzi obungu-$D$ unendawo engu-$A=\pi D^2/4$.
p-105.example: Ufeni ongu-0.3 m ($A\approx0.071\ \mathrm{m^2}$) ophephetha ngo-3 m/s ngokwesilinganiso uhambisa u-$Q\approx0.21\ \mathrm{m^3/s}\approx12.8\ \mathrm{m^3/min}$, ehlanganisa umoya wegumbi elingu-30 $\mathrm{m^3}$ ngemizuzu engaba ngu-2 nemizuzwana engu-20.
p-105.actionItem: Lapho uthenga ufeni noma into ezungezisa umoya, qhathanisa ukugeleza komoya (CMM), umsindo (dB) namandla kagesi (W) ephepheni lemininingwane ndawonye.

p-106.title: Isefo yefasitela ecwebile ivimba izinambuzane kodwa ivimba nomoya
p-106.summary: Isibalo esiphezulu se-mesh senza izimbobo ezincane ezivimba izinambuzane ezincanyana, kodwa futhi sinciphisa nendawo evulekile yokungena komoya.
p-106.principle: Usayizi wembobo ungemingaba ngu-$25.4/N-d$ mm ($N$: izintambo nge-intshi ngayinye, $d$: ubukhulu bentambo) kanti indawo evulekile ingu-$\varphi=\left(\dfrac{p-d}{p}\right)^2$ lapho u-$p=25.4/N$.
p-106.example: Ngocingo olungu-0.25 mm, isefo ye-mesh engu-18 inezimbobo ezingaba ngu-1.16 mm nendawo evulekile engaba ngu-68%, kuyilapho i-mesh engu-24 inezimbobo ezingaba ngu-0.81 mm nendawo evulekile engaba ngu-58%.
p-106.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokushintsha isefo, nquma ukuthi usayizi wezinambuzane ongakanani odinga ukuwuvimba nokuthi udinga umoya ongakanani, bese ukhetha isibalo se-mesh efanele.

p-107.title: Ukushaja kamosha ugesi othile ube ukushisa
p-107.summary: Isokhethi lodonga linikeza amandla amaningi kunalawo agcinwa ibhethri yefoni. Umehluko ulahleka njengokushisa kushaja nakwibhethri.
p-107.example: Ibhethri engu-5,000 mAh, 3.85 V igcina cishe u-19.3 Wh. Ekusebenzeni kokushaja okungu-85% udonsa u-$19.3/0.85\approx22.7$ Wh, noma cishe u-6.8 kWh ngezikhathi zokushaja ezingu-300 ngonyaka.
