p-107.actionItem: Namuhla, shaja nge-adaptha eqinisekisiwe esezingeni eliphezulu futhi ukwenze endaweni engenisa umoya esikhundleni sokushaja ngaphansi kwengubo.

p-108.title: Lapho utshekisa ikhanda lakho kakhulu, intamo yakho ithwala umthwalo omkhulu
p-108.summary: Lapho ikhanda lakho liqhubekela phambili kakhulu, kulapho kukhula khona amandla okutsheka futhi imisipha yentamo yakho kudingeka isebenze kanzima.
p-108.principle: Isisindo sekhanda u-$W$ esibekwe ebangeni elingu-$d$ phambi kwendawo yokuphenduka yentamo sidala amandla okujika (moment) angu-$M=Wd$ okumele imisipha iwenqabe.
p-108.example: Ikhanda linesisindo esingaba ngu-5 kgf, futhi imodeli eyodwa ilinganisela ukuthi umthwalo wentamo ungaba ngu-12 kgf lapho litshekele phambili ngo-15° kanti uba cishe ngu-27 kgf lapho litsheke ngo-60°.
p-108.actionItem: Namuhla, phakamisela ilaptop noma ifoni yakho ezingeni lamehlo bese uphakamisa ikhanda lakho ukuze welule intamo njalo ngemva kwemizuzu engu-30.

p-109.title: Itafula elinemilenze emine liyaxhuga ngoba kuthinta imilenze emithathu kuphela
p-109.summary: Amaphuzu amathathu achaza indawo eyisicaba (plane), ngakho uma umlenze wesine ungekho kuleyo ndawo eyisicaba umlenze owodwa uhlala untanta futhi itafula liyaxhuga.
p-109.principle: Ukulingana kudinga ukuthi $\sum F=W$ kanye no-$\sum M=0$. Ukwesekwa kwamaphuzu amathathu kuhlala kuqinile ngaso sonke isikhathi, kodwa amaphuzu amane athintana ndawonye kuphela uma esendaweni eyodwa eyisicaba.
p-109.example: Uma umlenze owodwa umfushane ngo-1 mm, lowo mlenze uyantanta kanti eminye emithathu yabelana ngomthwalo. Iphepha elisongwe ngokuvamile linobukhulu obungu-0.1-0.2 mm, ngakho-ke udinga izingqimba ezimbalwa.
p-109.actionItem: Faka iphepha elisongwe noma i-pad elungisekayo ngaphansi komlenze oxhugayo, bese ucindezela etafuleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi alisaxhugi.

p-110.title: Lapho ukuphuma kwamanzi eshaweni kuncipha
p-110.summary: Umlotha wensimbi noma itshwayo livala izimbobo zeshawa, bese ukuphuma kwamanzi kwehla kakhulu.
p-110.principle: Ukuphuma kwamanzi epayipini elincane kulandela umthetho ka-Poiseuille $Q=\dfrac{\pi r^4\Delta P}{8\eta L}$, okuya ngamandla amane e-radius.
p-110.example: Uma i-radius yembobo incipha ngo-20%, ukuphuma kwehla kufike ku-$0.8^4\approx0.41$, okuwukwehla ngo-59%. Ukucwilisa ikhanda leshawa kuviniga oxutshwe namanzi ngokulingana (1:1) imizuzu engama-30 kuyalincibilikisa itshwayo.
p-110.actionItem: Namuhla, khumula ikhanda lakho leshawa, ulicwilise kuviniga oxutshwe namanzi imizuzu engama-30, bese uyalikhuhla uphinde ulihlambulule.

p-111.title: I-hydrostatic head yetende nge-mm iwukuphakama kwekholomu yamanzi
p-111.summary: Isilinganiso sokuvikela amanzi setende lokukhempa ngenkathi yezimvula siwukuphakama kwekholomu yamanzi (nge-mm) indwangu yalo engayimisa ingangenisi manzi.
p-111.principle: Ingcindezi ye-hydrostatic ngu-$P=\rho g h$. Ikholomu yamanzi engu-1,000 mm ilingana cishe ne-9.8 kPa.
p-111.example: Isilinganiso esingu-1,500 mm sisho ukuthi indwangu imelana ne-$1000\times9.8\times1.5=14.7$ kPa. Imvula enamandla naphansi lapho kuhlezi khona abantu kudinga amanani aphakeme kakhulu.
p-111.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokukhempa ngenkathi yezimvula, hlola isilinganiso esiselebula yetende (i-1,500 mm noma ngaphezulu ivame ukunconywa endwangwini engaphandle) kanye nokunamatheliswa kwemithungo.

p-112.title: Hlola iraba lomnyango wesiqandisi ngephepha
p-112.summary: Iraba elixegayo livumela umoya ofudumele ukuba ungene, ngakho-ke i-compressor isebenza isikhathi eside.
p-112.principle: Ukushisa okungena embotsheni ngu-$\dot Q=\dot m c_p\Delta T$. Indawo enkulu yembobo yandisa kokubili ukugeleza komoya nokungena kokushisa.
p-112.example: Ngesikhala esimaphakathi esingu-1 mm emaphethelweni omnyango angu-3 m, indawo yembobo iba ngu-$0.001\times3=3\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, noma 30 cm², okufana nembobo elingana nesandla esivulekile.
p-112.actionItem: Vala umnyango ucindezele iphepha bese uyalidonsa. Uma liphuma kalula noma kuphi, hlanza noma shintsha iraba lomnyango.

p-113.title: Ugesi osetshenziswa izinto zikagesi ugcina usungukushisa ekamelweni
p-113.summary: Cishe wonke amandla kagesi agcina esengukushisa, okufudumeza ikamelo futhi kwandise umthwalo wokulipholisa.
p-113.principle: Ukongiwa kwamandla kunikeza i-$Q=Pt$. Amandla kagesi $P$ ento kagesi aguquka abe ukushisa kwegumbi cishe ngokuphelele.
p-113.example: Ikhompyutha engu-100 W esetshenziswe amahora angu-4 ikhipha u-$0.1\times4=0.4$ kWh, cishe u-1.44 MJ, ekamelweni, njenge-heater encane engu-100 W.
p-113.actionItem: Namuhla, cima amakhompyutha, izibani, namashaja ongawasebenzisi ukuze unciphise imithombo yokushisa ekamelweni.

p-114.title: Qhathanisa amalebula kagesi nge-kWh yonyaka
p-114.summary: Ungagcini nje ebangeni lokusebenza: i-kWh yonyaka (noma yenyanga) eselebula ikutshela ukusetshenziswa kukagesi kwangempela.
p-114.principle: Ukusetshenziswa kwamandla ngu-$E=Pt$ nge-kWh. Umehluko wonyaka ophindwe ngeminyaka yokusetshenziswa unikeza umehluko ophelele.
p-114.example: Isiqandisi esisebenzisa i-300 kWh/ngonyaka uma siqhathaniswa nesisebenzisa i-450 kWh/ngonyaka sinomehluko we-150 kWh ngonyaka, okuyi-1,500 kWh eminyakeni eyi-10.
p-114.actionItem: Lapho uthenga into kagesi, qhathanisa ibanga lokonga amandla laselebula kanye ne-kWh yayo yonyaka.

p-115.title: Khetha isihlanzi-moya nge-CADR kanye nomthamo wegumbi
p-115.summary: Ngenkathi yothuli oluphuzi isihlanzi kufanele sihambisane negumbi. Okubalulekile ukuthi sihlanza umoya kangaki ngehora.
p-115.principle: Ukushintshwa komoya ngehora kubalwa njenge-$\mathrm{ACH}=\mathrm{CADR}/V$, lapho i-CADR iwumthamo womoya ohlanziwe nge-$\mathrm{m^3/h}$.
p-115.example: Isihlanzi esine-CADR engu-300 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ ekamelweni elingu-25 $\mathrm{m^2}$ × 2.4 m = 60 $\mathrm{m^3}$ senza ukushintshwa komoya kube ngu-$300/60=5$ ngehora.
p-115.actionItem: Namuhla, phindaphinda indawo yaphansi yegumbi lakho ngokuphakama kophahla bese uhlola ukuthi i-CADR yesihlanzi sakho ingaba okungenani izikhathi ezi-5 zalowo mthamo.

p-116.title: Inkungu yewindi lemoto iphathelene nephuzu lamazolo
p-116.summary: Lapho ingilazi ibanda kakhulu kunephuzu lamazolo lomoya ophakathi emotweni, umhwamuko wamanzi uyajiyela ube yinkungu.
p-116.principle: Umswakama ohlobene $\mathrm{RH}$ kanye nezinga lokushisa banquma iphuzu lamazolo $T_d$, kusetshenziswa ifomula ye-Magnus $T_d\approx\dfrac{243.12\,\gamma}{17.62-\gamma}$, $\gamma=\ln\mathrm{RH}+\dfrac{17.62\,T}{243.12+T}$.
p-116.example: Ku-22 °C kanye ne-70% RH, iphuzu lamazolo licishe libe ngu-16.3 °C. Ingilazi eku-10 °C izoba nenkungu, futhi ukulayitha i-A/C (ukunciphisa umswakama) kanye nomoya ofudumele komisa ingaphandle lengilazi.
p-116.actionItem: Lapho iwindi lemoto yakho liba nenkungu namuhla, cindezela inkinobho ye-A/C bese ushintshela kumodi yomoya omusha ukuze ukhiphe umswakama.

p-117.title: Sika izinto eziwugqinsi eduze kophini lwesikelo
p-117.summary: Izikelo zingamaleva, ngakho-ke ukusika eduze kophini lwesikelo kunikeza amandla amakhulu okusika ngamandla afanayo esandla.
p-117.principle: Ukulingana kweleva kunikeza $F_{\text{cut}}\,d_c=F_{\text{hand}}\,d_h$. Lapho indawo esikwayo iseduze kakhulu nephini, $d_c$ iba ncane kanti $F_{\text{cut}}$ iba nkulu.
p-117.example: Nge-$d_h=10$ cm ukusuka esandleni kuye ophini, ukusika ku-3 cm ukusuka ophini kuguqula amandla esandla angu-50 N abe ngu-$50\times10/3\approx167$ N. Esihlokweni sayo (10 cm) ahlala engu-50 N.
p-117.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho usika amakhadibhodi noma amaphasela awugqinsi, yifake ijule ezindlamvini zesikelo eduze kophini.

p-118.title: Ukwenyuka izitebhisi kuwukujima okuhle ngisho nangokwamandla
p-118.summary: Ukwenyuka isitezi kuphakamisa umzimba wakho, ngakho-ke kudinga amandla amakhulu ngendlela emangalisayo ngesikhathi esifushane.
p-118.principle: Amandla okwenyuka atholakala nge-$P=\dfrac{mgh}{t}$, okungukwanda kwamandla angaba khona $mgh$ ehlukaniswe ngesikhathi esithathiwe.
p-118.example: Umuntu onesisindo esingu-70 kg owenyuka isitezi esisodwa (3 m) ngemizuzwana engu-15 ukhiqiza $P=70\times9.8\times3/15\approx137$ W. Isitezi esisodwa sigcina cishe u-2.1 kJ, noma cishe u-2 kcal wamandla omzimba ngokusebenza kwemisipha okungu-25%.
p-118.actionItem: Namuhla, sebenzisa izitebhisi ukukhuphukela ezitezini ezimbili esikhundleni selifti bese ubamba umzila wesandla ukuze uphephe.

p-119.title: I-adaptha yokuhamba imayelana namandla kagesi kanye nomsundu, hhayi nje isimo seplagi
p-119.summary: Iplagi elinganayo ayisho ukuthi idivayisi izosebenza. Amandla kagesi ahlukene ashintsha umsundu kagesi kanye nokuphepha.
p-119.principle: Amandla kagesi atholakala nge-$P=VI$, ngakho ngamandla afanayo amandla kagesi aphansi asho umsundu omkhulu $I=P/V$.
p-119.example: Idivayisi engu-1,500 W idonsa $I\approx6.8$ A ku-220 V kodwa idonse $I\approx13.6$ A ku-110 V, okungadlula kalula amandla avunyelwe e-adaptha.
p-119.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuhamba, hlola amandla kagesi endawo oya kuyo, amandla kagesi afanelekile edivayisi yakho (ngokwesibonelo 100-240 V) kanye nomkhawulo womsundu we-adaptha.

p-120.title: Goba amadolo akho bese uvula izinyawo zakho ebhasini elibhulekayo
p-120.summary: Lapho ibhasi libhuleka kakhulu, i-inertia ikuphonsa phambili. Isimo somzimba kanye nokungasheleli kwezinyawo kukugcina umile.
p-120.principle: Amandla e-inertia atholakala nge-$F=ma$, futhi izinyawo zakho ngeke zishelele kuphela uma $\mu\ge a/g$.
p-120.example: Lapho kunejubane lokuncipha elingu-$a=3\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ (cishe u-0.3 g), umgibeli ongu-60 kg uzwa amandla aphushela phambili acishe abe ngu-180 N futhi udinga $\mu\ge0.31$ phakathi kwezicathulo nephansi.
p-120.actionItem: Namuhla, uma umile ebhasini noma esitimeleni, qhelelisa izinyawo zakho zibheke ohlangothini ohamba ngalo bese ubamba insimbi yokubambelela.

p-121.title: Ummese obukhali udinga amandla amancane
p-121.summary: Umphetho obukhali unendawo encane yokuthintana, ngakho-ke ukusunduza okufanayo kunikeza umfutho ophakeme kakhulu bese ukudla kusikeka kalula.
p-121.principle: Umfutho utholakala nge-$P=\dfrac{F}{A}$. Indawo yomphetho encane $A$ inikeza umfutho omkhulu $P$ ngamandla afanayo $F$.
p-121.example: Umphetho ongu-1 cm nobubanzi obungu-0.02 mm une-$A=2\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, ngakho-ke u-20 N unikeza $P=10\ \mathrm{MPa}$. Uma ubuthuntu ube ngu-0.2 mm wehlela ku-1 MPa, okuwukuncipha ngeshumi, okukuphoqa ukuthi ucindezele kakhulu okwandisa ingozi yokushelela nokuzisika.
p-121.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ummese wakho ephepheni, futhi uma ungakwazi ukusika ngokuhlanzekile, wucole noma uwulolole.

p-122.title: Ungayicishi uphinde uyivule i-air conditioner ye-inverter
p-122.summary: I-AC ye-inverter ilungisa isivinini se-compressor ukuze igcine izinga lokushisa elimisiwe, ngakho ukuyiyeka isebenza konga amandla kakhulu.
p-122.principle: I-cooling coefficient of performance $\mathrm{COP}=\dfrac{Q_c}{W}$ iyenyuka lapho umthwalo ungemkhulu, ngoba izishintshanisi zokushisa (heat exchangers) ziba zinkulu ngokuqhathaniswa futhi umehluko wokushisa uyancipha.
p-122.example: Uma iyunithi enejubane elimisiwe isebenzisa isilinganiso esingu-480 W (0.8 kW ku-60% womsebenzi) kanti i-inverter isebenzisa cishe u-300 W, amahora ayisithupha ngosuku anikeza u-2.88 uma kuqhathaniswa no-1.8 kWh, okonga cishe u-32 kWh ezinsukwini ezingama-30.
p-122.actionItem: Namuhla, setha i-AC yakho ku-26-28 °C bese uyiyeka isebenza esikhundleni sokuyicisha uphinde uyivule.

p-123.title: Nika iyunithi yangaphandle ye-AC umthunzi
p-123.summary: Lapho umoya ozungeze iyunithi yangaphandle ubanda kakhulu, i-compressor isebenza kancane ukuze ilethe ukupholisa okufanayo.
p-123.principle: Ukusebenza okuhle kakhulu kokupholisa yi-Carnot $\mathrm{COP}_\mathrm{max}=\dfrac{T_c}{T_h-T_c}$, eyanda lapho izinga lokushisa lokujiya (condensing temperature) $T_h$ lehla.
p-123.example: Nge-evaporator $T_c=280\ \mathrm{K}$, $T_h=318\ \mathrm{K}$ inikeza u-7.4 kanti $308\ \mathrm{K}$ inikeza u-10, cishe ephakeme ngo-35%. Kumayunithi angempela, umoya ongenayo obanda ngo-3-5 °C wonga cishe u-5-10% kagesi.
p-123.actionItem: Namuhla, faka umthunzi ngaphezu kweyunithi yangaphandle, kodwa ungawuvimbi umoya ngaphakathi kuka-30 cm phambili noma ngemuva kwayo.

p-124.title: Sebenzisa ifeni kanye nesipholisi-moya (AC)
p-124.summary: Umoya ohambayo wenza kube sengathi kubanda ngo-2-3 °C ngaphezulu, ngakho ungakhuphula izinga lokushisa le-AC.
p-124.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa komzimba (convective heat loss) esikhumbeni kungu-$Q=hA(T_s-T_a)$, futhi i-coefficient yokudluliswa kokushisa $h$ iyenyuka ngejubane lomoya.
p-124.example: Esikhumbeni esingu-33 °C, ekamelweni elingu-28 °C kanye no-1.8 m², umoya omile $h\approx5$ ulahlekelwa ngu-45 W, kanti umpepho ongu-1 m/s $h\approx10$ ulahlekelwa cishe ngu-90 W, ngakho uzizwa upholile. Ukwenyusa izinga ngo-1 °C ngakunye kunciphisa ugesi cishe ngo-5-10%.
p-124.actionItem: Namuhla, khuphulela i-AC yakho ku-28 °C bese uvula ifeni ngejubane eliphansi eceleni kwayo.

p-125.title: Pholisa ithini ngokushesha ngethawula lephepha elimanzi
p-125.summary: Amanzi ahwamukayo ahamba nokushisa, ngakho ithawula elimanzi kanye nompepho kunciphisa izinga lokushisa lesiphuzo ngamazinga amaningana.
p-125.principle: Ukuhwamuka kudinga ukushisa okungu-$Q=mL_v$, no-$L_v\approx2.4\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$ emanzini, futhi lokho kushisa kuvela esiphuzweni.
p-125.example: Ukuhwamuka kuka-10 g wamanzi kumunca cishe u-24 kJ, okungapholisa isiphuzo esingu-355 mL ngo-$\Delta T=24/(0.355\times4.0)\approx17\ \mathrm{K}$ ngokombono omuhle. Empeleni kuncipha cishe ngo-5-8 °C emizuzwini engu-10 emoyeni ophephulayo.
p-125.actionItem: Namuhla, bopha ithini elifudumele ngethawula lephepha elimanzi bese ulibeka phambi kwefeni imizuzu engu-10.

p-126.title: Ukwenza umthunzi kusebenza kangcono ngaphandle kwengilazi
p-126.summary: Uma ukukhanya kwelanga sekudlule engilazini, ukushisa sekungaphakathi kakade, ngakho imithunzi yangaphandle isebenza kangcono kakhulu.
p-126.principle: Ukushisa kwelanga okungena efasiteleni kungu-$Q=\mathrm{SHGC}\times A\times I$. Umthunzi wehlisa i-SHGC esebenzayo.
p-126.example: Efasiteleni elingu-2 m² elinokushisa kwelanga okungu-600 W/m², ingilazi ecacile (SHGC 0.8) ingenisa u-960 W, ikhethini langaphakathi (0.5) lingenisa u-600 W, kanti umthunzi wangaphandle (0.15) ungenisa cishe u-180 W, okungaphansi cishe ngo-80%.
p-126.actionItem: Namuhla, sesha imithunzi yangaphandle ongayifaka, njenge-awning, umthunzi woqalo (bamboo) noma i-roller screen.

p-127.title: Imoto emile iyashisa ngemizuzu embalwa nje
p-127.summary: Imoto eselangeni ivimba ukushisa njenge-greenhouse, okwenza ngisho nokuhlala isikhathi esifushane kube yingozi ezinganeni nasezifuyweni.
p-127.principle: Ingilazi idlulisa ukukhanya kwelanga okunama-shortwave bese ivimbela i-infrared ende (longwave) ekhiqizwa ingaphakathi elifudumele. Ukushisa okumuncwe $Q=\alpha IA$ kudlula ukulahleka kokushisa (convective and conductive loss).
p-127.example: Ku-30 °C ngaphandle, ngaphakathi emotweni kungafinyelela cishe ku-50 °C emizuzwini engu-30 kanti ideshibhodi ingadlula ku-70 °C. Ukuvula iwindi kancane akusizi ngalutho ukwehlisa lokhu kwenyuka.
p-127.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola isihlalo sangemuva ngaso sonke isikhathi uma uphuma emotweni yakho, futhi ungalokothi ushiye ingane noma isilwane ngaphakathi.

p-128.title: Lungisa isihlalo sebhayisikili ukuze idolo lihlale ligobe kancane
p-128.summary: Isihlalo esiphansi kakhulu siwacindezela kakhulu amadolo, kanti esiphakeme kakhulu sinyakazisa ukhalo futhi singalimaza umhlane namadolo.
p-128.principle: Umthetho ovamile uwukuthi ukuphakama kwesihlalo kulingana no-$\approx0.883\times$ ubude bangaphakathi bomlenze (inseam). Phansi lapho i-pedal ifike khona, idolo ligoba ngo-25-35°.
p-128.example: Ngomlenze ongu-80 cm, ukuphakama kwesihlalo kungu-$0.883\times80\approx70.6$ cm, kukalwa kusukela ku-axis ye-pedal kuya phezulu esihlalweni.
p-128.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokugibela namuhla, kala ukuphakama kwesihlalo bese uhlola ukuthi idolo lakho licishe liqonde yini lapho isithende sakho siphezu kwe-pedal ngaphansi.

p-129.title: Ukwehlisa izinga lokushisa leshawa ngo-2-4 °C konga amandla
p-129.summary: Ngisho nangesilinganiso esifanayo samanzi ashisayo, ukushisa amanzi afike ezingeni lokushisa eliphakeme kuthatha amandla amaningi ngokulinganayo.
p-129.principle: Ukushisa okudingekayo ukufudumeza amanzi kungu-$Q=mc\Delta T$, lapho ukushisa okucacile kwamanzi kungu-$c=4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\,K)}$.
p-129.example: Ukushisa u-40 L kusuka ku-15 °C kuya ku-42 °C kuthatha u-$40\times4.18\times27\approx4{,}514$ kJ (1.25 kWh); kuya ku-38 °C kuthatha cishe u-3,846 kJ (1.07 kWh). Lokho kungu-0.19 kWh ngeshawa ngayinye, cishe u-68 kWh ngonyaka.
p-129.actionItem: Namuhla, zama ukwehlisa izinga lokushisa leshawa yakho ngo-2-4 °C, noma uma uzwa amakhaza, qale ufinyeze isikhathi sokugeza eshaweni.

p-130.title: Yehlisa ijubane ngo-10 km/h kuthelawayeka
p-130.summary: Ukumelana nomoya kukhula ngesikwele sejubane, ngakho ukwehlisa ijubane kancane konga uphethiloli obonakalayo.
p-130.principle: Amandla okudonsa komoya (drag) ngu-$F_d=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^2$ kanti amandla adingekayo ngu-$P=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^3$.
p-130.example: Nge-$C_dA=0.7\ \mathrm{m^2}$, u-110 km/h (30.6 m/s) uthatha cishe u-12.0 kW kanti u-100 km/h uthatha cishe u-9.0 kW, okuncane ngo-25%. Amandla ngebanga ngalinye ehla ngo-$(100/110)^2\approx0.83$, okuncane ngo-17%, futhi u-100 km uthatha imizuzu engaba ngu-5 kuphela ngaphezulu.
p-130.actionItem: Namuhla, yehlisa ngo-10 km/h kuthelawayeka bese ugijima ngesivinini esizinzile, uhlale ngaphansi komkhawulo wejubane.

p-131.title: Hlola isisindo esifanele nesigaba sokuntanta (N) sejakhethi lokusindisa impilo
p-131.summary: Iringi yokubhukuda ayilona ijakhethi lokusindisa impilo. Ijakhethi lokusindisa impilo linikeza amandla okuntanta anele ukugcina ubuso bakho ngaphezu kwamanzi.
p-131.principle: Amandla okuntanta ngu-$F_b=\rho V g$. Ukususa u-1 L wamanzi kunikeza cishe u-9.8 N.
p-131.example: Ijakhethi lesigaba se-50 N lilingana nokuntanta kwamanzi angaba ngu-5 L (cishe u-5.1 kgf). Izingane nabantu abadala badinga amanani ahlukene, ngakho isisindo esibhalwe kulebula kumele sihambisane.
p-131.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokudlala emanzini, hlola isisindo esifanele nophawu lwesitifiketi kulebula yejakhethi bese uqinisa amabhande ngokuqinile ngemva kokuligqoka.

p-132.title: Ukugibela ibhayisikili ngemva komunye umgibeli kuthatha amandla amancane
p-132.summary: Umgibeli ophambili uvimba umoya, ngakho umoya ohambayo (slipstream) ukwenza ukwazi ukugcina ijubane elifanayo ngamandla amancane kakhulu.
p-132.principle: Amandla okudonsa komoya ngu-$P=\tfrac{1}{2}C_d\rho A v^3$. Ukugibela ngemuva kwehlisa i-$C_d$ esebenzayo.
p-132.example: Endaweni eyisicaba ngo-30 km/h (8.3 m/s) nge-$C_dA=0.35\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $P\approx0.5\times0.35\times1.2\times8.3^3\approx120\ \mathrm{W}$; ngemuva ncamashi komunye umgibeli yehla ngo-30-40% iye cishe ku-75-85 W.
p-132.actionItem: Ekugibeleni njengeqembu namuhla, shiya igebe elingu-1-2 m ngemva komgibeli ophambili futhi ungalokothi ugqagqanise isondo lakho langaphambili nelakhe langemuva.

p-133.title: Hlola isitifiketi nokushisa kumashaja asheshayo
p-133.summary: Amandla amakhulu wokushaja asho ukushisa okwengeziwe, ngakho ishaja enesitifiketi nokungena komoya kunquma ukuphepha nempilo yebhethri.
p-133.principle: Amandla kagesi ngu-$P=VI$ kanti ukulahleka kokuguqulwa ngu-$P_\mathrm{loss}=(1-\eta)P$. Ekusebenzeni kahle okungu-$\eta=0.88$, ishaja ye-20 W iguqula cishe u-2.4 W ube ukushisa.
p-133.example: Ishaja ye-5 W ikhipha cishe u-0.6 W wokushisa, eye-65 W ikhiphe cishe u-7.8 W. Uma ukushisa kungenakho ukuphuma, njengaphansi kwengubo, ibhethri lidlula u-35 °C, lishaje kancane, futhi liguge ngokushesha.
p-133.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ishaja yakho ukuthi inophawu lwesitifiketi sokuphepha kanye ne-wattage efanele yedivayisi yakho, futhi ugweme ukushaja ngaphansi kwezingubo zokulala.

p-134.title: Uma uzoma isikhathi esingaphezu kwemizuzwana eyi-10, cisha injini
p-134.summary: Injini eduma imile iyaqhubeka nokushisa uphethiloli ngaphandle kokuhambisa imoto, kanti ukumosheka kukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
p-134.principle: Ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli ngu-$V_f=\dot V_f\,t$, kanti izinga likaphethiloli wemoto eduma imile $\dot V_f$ livamise ukuba ngu-0.6-1 L/h.
p-134.example: Ku-$\dot V_f=0.8$ L/h, imizuzu engu-5 (300 s) yokuduma imile isebenzisa u-$0.8/3600\times300\approx0.067$ L; kanye ngosuku unyaka wonke lokho cishe kungu-24 L.
p-134.actionItem: Lapho ulinde endaweni yokupaka noma ulinde othile, cisha injini (izimoto ezine-automatic stop-start zingaqhubeka nokuyisebenzisa kumarobhothi).

p-135.title: Isithende esincane singaphindaphinda ingcindezi yesisindo somzimba esifanayo
p-135.summary: Lapho isisindo sigxile endaweni eyodwa, ingcindezi iyenyuka bese icindezela kokubili unyawo lwakho naphansi.
p-135.principle: Ingcindezi ingu-$P=F/A$. Emandleni afanayo, indawo yokuthintana encane engu-$A$ isho ingcindezi ephakeme kakhulu.
p-135.example: Lapho i-60 kgf (cishe engu-588 N) incike onyaweni olulodwa, isithende esinendawo yokuthinta engu-1 cm² sinikeza cishe u-5.9 MPa, kanti isithende esibanzi esingu-20 cm² sinikeza cishe u-0.29 MPa, okungumehluko ophindaphindeke ka-20.
p-135.actionItem: Oswukeni olude namuhla, gqoka izicathulo ezinendawo ebanzi yokuthinta phansi ukuze wehlise umthwalo ezinyaweni nasemadolweni akho.

p-136.title: Umsindo wokushayeka phansi udinga isisindo kanye nokumunca umsindo
p-136.summary: Izinto ezisindayo neziwugqinsi zivimba umsindo kangcono kakhulu, kanti amamethi noma amaphedi athambisa ukushayeka.
p-136.principle: Ngomthetho wesisindo (mass law), ukulahleka kokudluliswa kungu-$TL\approx20\log_{10}(mf)-47\ \mathrm{dB}$ ($m$ iku-kg/m², $f$ iku-Hz), futhi ukuphinda kabili isisindo kwengeza cishe ama-dB angu-6.
p-136.example: Ukuncipha ngo-10 dB kuzwakala sengathi umsindo wehle ngengxenye. Amaphedi e-felt ngaphansi kwemilenze yezihlalo anganciphisa umsindo wokuhlikihla cishe ngo-5-10 dB, futhi amamethi awugqinsi athambisa umsindo wokunyathelisa kwezinyawo.
p-136.actionItem: Namuhla, namathisela amaphedi e-felt emilenzeni yezihlalo zakho bese ubeka umethi owugqinsi lapho uhamba khona kakhulu.

p-137.title: Izinduku zokuhamba zehlisa umthwalo emadolweni akho lapho wehla
p-137.summary: Izinduku zabelana ngengxenye yomthwalo nezingalo zakho futhi zinciphisa ingcindezi emadolweni lapho wehla emthambekeni.
p-137.principle: Lapho wehla, idolo lithatha cishe izikhathi ezi-3 zesisindo somzimba ekumunceni ukushayeka, futhi lapho izinduku zithwala amandla okusekela angu-$F_s$, amandla asedolweni ehlela ku-$F_k=3mg-F_s$.
p-137.example: Kumuntu ongu-70 kg, isisindo somzimba singu-686 N kanti amandla asemadolweni acishe abe ngu-2,060 N. Uma izinduku zithatha cishe amaphesenti angu-20, lokho kunciphisa cishe ngo-410 N.
p-137.actionItem: Ohambweni lwakho lokugibela izintaba namuhla, lungisa izinduku zakho ukuze indololwane yakho ibe kuma-degree angu-90 futhi uzelule lapho wehla.

p-138.title: Ncibilikisa ukudla okuqandisiwe esiqandisini ukuze usebenzise kabusha amakhaza ako
p-138.summary: Iqhwa elincibilikayo limunca ukushisa, ngakho ukukuncibilikisa esiqandisini kwenza lawo makhaza asize ekupholiseni ingaphakathi lesiqandisi.
p-138.principle: Ukuncibilikisa iqhwa kudinga u-$Q=mL_f$, lapho u-$L_f\approx334\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
p-138.example: Uma u-1 kg wenyama eqandisiwe unamanzi akha iqhwa angaba ngu-70%, ukuncibilika kumunca u-$0.7\times334\approx234$ kJ (cishe u-0.065 kWh), okungasenziwa isiqandisi ngokwaso.
p-138.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku, susa izithako zakusasa efrijini eliqandisayo uzibeke esiqandisini esivamile ngobusuku obandulelayo, futhi ugweme ukuncibilikisa ekushiseni kwegumbi ukuze uqinisekise inhlanzeko.

p-139.title: Intambo yezingubo eqine kakhulu ilayisha izingwegwe zayo kakhulu
p-139.summary: Ukudonsa intambo yokweneka ize iqine kakhulu kunciphisa ukulenga kwayo, kodwa ukudonsana okusentanjeni nasezisekelweni zayo kwenyuka kakhulu.
p-139.principle: Ngomthwalo ongu-$W$ phakathi nendawo entanjeni evundlile eyenza i-engeli engu-$\theta$ nendawo evundlile, ukudonsana kungu-$T=\dfrac{W}{2\sin\theta}$.
p-139.example: Emthwalweni ongu-5 kg (cishe ongu-49 N), i-engeli yokulenga engu-30° inikeza u-$T=49$ N, kodwa engu-5° inikeza u-$T\approx281$ N (cishe engu-29 kgf), okuphakeme cishe ngokuphindwe ka-6.
p-139.actionItem: Uma ulenga intambo noma ithala namuhla, ungayidonsele ekubeni iqine bha; yishiye ilenge cishe ngo-5-10% wobude bayo.

p-140.title: Yahlulela ukushisa usebenzisa inkomba yokushisa (heat index)
p-140.summary: Ezingeni lokushisa lomoya elifanayo, umswakama ophezulu uvimbela ukujuluka ukuba kungomi futhi kwenza kube nokushisa okukhulu nobungozi obukhulu.
p-140.principle: Inkomba yokushisa incike ekushiseni nasemswekameni ohlobene, $HI = f(T, RH)$; ukuphola okuvela ekuhwamukeni okuncane kusho izinga lokushisa elibonakala liphezulu kakhulu.
p-140.example: Ku-32°C nomswakama ongu-40% kuzwakala njengokungathi kuku-32°C, kodwa kumswakama ongu-70% kuzwakala njengokungathi kuku-41°C, okuyibanga eliyingozi lokugula okubangelwa ukushisa.
p-140.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuphuma ngenkathi yezimvula, hlola umswakama kanye nezinga lokushisa bese uhlela kabusha isikhathi sakho sokuba ngaphandle.

p-141.title: Ukuphakama kwephimbo lenhlabamkhosi ye-ambulensi kukutshela ukuthi iyasondela yini
p-141.summary: Inhlabamkhosi izwakala iphezulu kakhulu lapho isondela futhi iphansi lapho iqhela. Lowo umthelela we-Doppler.
p-141.principle: Kumthombo ohamba nge-$v_s$, imvamisa ezwakalayo ithi $f'=f\,\dfrac{v}{v\mp v_s}$ ($-$ iyasondela, $+$ iyaqhela).
p-141.example: Inhlabamkhosi engu-1,000 Hz emotweni ehamba ngo-20 m/s izwakala njenge-$1000\times343/323\approx1{,}062$ Hz lapho isondela kanye ne-$1000\times343/363\approx945$ Hz lapho iqhela.
p-141.actionItem: Lapho inhlabamkhosi izwakala kakhulu futhi iphakama namuhla, hlola indawo ekuzungezile bese uvula indlela.

p-142.title: Ukukhetha amandla e-AC ngobukhulu begumbi
p-142.summary: I-air conditioner enkulu ayisho ukuthi ingcono; ukusebenza kahle kuba ngcono kakhulu lapho amandla ehambisana nomthwalo wokupholisa wegumbi.
p-142.principle: Umthwalo wokupholisa ngu-$Q \approx q_0 A$ (cishe 150-200 W/m²). Iyunithi enkulu ngokweqile iyazicisha futhi izivule kaningi.
p-142.example: Igumbi elingu-15 m² lidinga cishe u-2.3-3.0 kW (cishe 8,000-10,000 BTU/h). Ukuba nkulu ngokweqile kubangela ukucima nokuvula njalo (short-cycling) kanye nokusebenza kancane ngendlela efanele.
p-142.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuthenga, bhala phansi indawo yegumbi lakho, amafasitela abheke entshonalanga kanye nesitezi, bese uqhathanisa amandla nomthengisi.

p-143.title: Ukunyusa izinga lokushisa le-AC ngo-1-2 °C kunciphisa umthwalo wokupholisa
p-143.summary: Uma umehluko phakathi kwangaphakathi nangaphandle umncane, kuncipha ukushisa okungena ezindongeni nasemafasiteleni, ngakho-ke i-AC isebenza kancane.
p-143.principle: Ukushisa okudluliswayo ngu-$\dot Q=UA\,\Delta T$, okulingana ngqo nomehluko wezinga lokushisa u-$\Delta T$.
p-143.example: Ngo-33 °C ngaphandle, ukunyusa izinga legumbi lisuke ku-24 °C liye ku-26 °C kunciphisa u-$\Delta T$ usuke ku-9 K uye ku-7 K, kunciphise ukushisa okungenayo cishe ngo-22%.
p-143.actionItem: Namuhla, setha i-AC yakho ku-26 °C bese wengeza ifeni esezingeni eliphansi.

p-144.title: Ilangabi elibanzi kunesinqe sebhodwe limosha igesi
p-144.summary: Ilangabi elibanzi kunesinqe sebhodwe likhotha izinhlangothi bese lifudumeza umoya kuphela. Ukuligcina ngaphansi kwesisekelo kuthumela ukushisa okwengeziwe ebhodweni.
p-144.principle: Ukushisa okufinyelela ebhodweni ngu-$Q=\eta E_{\text{fuel}}$. Lapho ukusebenza kahle kuka-$\eta$ kuphakama, kudingeka uphethiloli omncane ekushiseni okufanayo.
p-144.example: Ukushisa ilitha elingu-1 lamanzi kusuka ku-20 °C kuya ku-100 °C kuthatha u-334 kJ, ngakho-ke u-$\eta=40\%$ udinga u-835 kJ kaphethiloli kanti u-50% udinga u-668 kJ. Ngala manani acatshangelwe wonga u-20%.
p-144.actionItem: Lapho upheka namuhla, pholisa ilangabi lize lihlale ngaphansi konqenqema lwesinqe sebhodwe.

p-145.title: Ukuxosha amanzi kwesambulela kanye ne-contact angle
p-145.summary: Isambulela sixosha amanzi ngoba ingaphandle laso line-contact angle ephezulu, futhi lokhu okunamathelisiwe kungavuselelwa.
p-145.principle: Isibalo sika-Young: $\cos\theta = \frac{\gamma_{sv} - \gamma_{sl}}{\gamma_{lv}}$. I-contact angle engu-$\theta > 90^\circ$ isho ukuthi i-hydrophobic (ixosha amanzi).
p-145.example: Indwangu yesambulela exosha amanzi ine-contact angle elinganiselwa ku-110-120°, ngakho-ke amathonsi aba yizigaxa bese eyagingqika. Lapho ukuguga kuyehlisa ngaphansi kuka-70°, indwangu iqala ukuba manzi.
p-145.actionItem: Yomisa isambulela sakho esimanzi sivulekile emthunzini, bese ufaka isifutho esixosha amanzi uma amathonsi eqala ukungena ngaphakathi.

p-146.title: Linganisa ibanga lombani ngokubambezeleka kokuduma
p-146.summary: Bala imizuzwana phakathi kokubanika kanye nokuduma kwayo ukuze ubone ukuthi umbani useduze kangakanani.
p-146.principle: Umsindo uhamba ngo-$v \approx 343\ \mathrm{m/s}$ kanti ukukhanya kufika ngokushesha okukhulu, ngakho ibanga ngu-$d = vt$.
p-146.example: Uma ukuduma kulandela ngemva kwemizuzwana engu-9 ngemva kokubanika, $d \approx 343 \times 9 \approx 3.1\ \mathrm{km}$. Ngaphakathi kwemizuzwana engaba ngu-10 (3.4 km) ususendaweni lapho umbani ungashaya khona.
p-146.actionItem: Lapho uzwa ukuduma ngenkathi yezimvula, misa imisebenzi yangaphandle bese ungena esakhiweni noma emotweni.

p-147.title: Bopha ibhayisikili ngawo womabili amabhuleki, ugxile kakhulu kwelangaphambili
p-147.summary: Uma ubhuleka, isisindo sishintshela esondweni langaphambili, elingase linikeze amandla amakhulu okubhuleka.
p-147.principle: Umthwalo odluliselwa esondweni langaphambili ngu-$\Delta N=\dfrac{m a h}{L}$ ($h$: ukuphakama kwenhliziyo yesisindo, $L$: ibanga phakathi kwamasondo).
p-147.example: Ngo-$m=80$ kg, $h=1.0$ m, $L=1.0$ m kanye nokwehlisa isivinini $a=4\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$, $\Delta N=320$ N. Imithwalo enganyakazi engu-314 N ngaphambili kanye no-470 N ngemuva iba ngu-634 N ngaphambili kanye no-150 N ngemuva.
p-147.actionItem: Uma ugibela namuhla, cindezela womabili amabhuleki ngokushelela kunokusebenzisa elingemuva kuphela. Ukubamba elingaphambili kuphela ngamandla kungakuphonsa phambili.

p-148.title: Hlola ibanga kanye ne-emissivity ku-thermometer engathintwa
p-148.summary: I-thermometer ye-infrared ifunda izinga lokushisa emisebeni ephumayo, ngakho isimo sendawo kanye nebanga kuyawushintsha umphumela.
p-148.principle: Amandla emisebe ngu-$P=\varepsilon\sigma T^4$. Indawo ecwebezelayo ene-emissivity ephansi $\varepsilon$ ifundeka ngaphansi kwenani langempela.
p-148.example: Isikhumba sine-$\varepsilon\approx0.98$ futhi sifundeka kahle, kuyilapho insimbi ecwebezelayo ku-0.1-0.3 inikeza amaphutha amakhulu. Nge-ratio yebanga engu-12:1, ku-1.2 m idivayisi ibala isilinganiso sendawo enobubanzi obungu-10 cm.
p-148.actionItem: Uma uthenga eyodwa, hlola ibanga elihlosiwe nendawo yokukala, futhi ulandele ibanga elisencwadini yemiyalelo (ngokuvamile amasentimitha ambalwa) uma uyisebenzisa.

p-149.title: Ihhavini elincane le-toaster lisebenzisa ukushisa okuncane ezingxenyeni ezincane
p-149.summary: Ihhavini elikhulu kumele lifudumeze umoya omningi nensimbi, ngakho-ke ngokudla okungaphekela umuntu oyedwa noma ababili ihhavini elincane lidinga ukushisa okuncane kakhulu.
p-149.principle: Ukushisa okudingekayo ngu-$Q=\sum m c\,\Delta T$. Uma isisindo esifudunyezwako sincane, amandla asetshenziswayo mancane.
p-149.example: Ukuphakamisa ama-tray angu-5 kg nensimbi yangaphakathi ($c\approx0.45$ kJ/(kg K)) ngo-180 K kuthatha cishe ama-405 kJ, kodwa u-1 kg uthatha cishe ama-81 kJ. Ukufudumeza ama-60 L omoya kwengeza cishe ama-13 kJ kuphela.
p-149.actionItem: Namuhla, uma ubhaka inani elincane kuphela, sebenzisa ihhavini le-toaster noma i-air fryer esikhundleni sehhavini elikhulu.

p-150.title: Cisha ukushisa kusekunesikhathi bese uqedela ngokushisa okusele
p-150.summary: Amanzi nokudla ebhodweni kugcina ukushisa, ngakho uma isivalo sivaliwe, ukupheka kuyaqhubeka ngaphandle kwelangabi.
p-150.principle: Ukushisa okugciniwe ngu-$Q=mc\Delta T$, futhi uma kunesivalo ukulahleka kokushisa kuncane ngakho izinga lokushisa lehla kancane.
p-150.example: Ukucisha isitofu esingu-3 kW kusasele imizuzu engu-2 konga ama-$3\times120=360$ kJ okushisa kukaphethiloli. Amalitha angu-1.5 amanzi ebhodweni elinesivalo ahlala engaphezu kuka-90 °C imizuzu eminingana.
p-150.actionItem: Namuhla, uma upheka ama-noodle, isobho noma izitsha ezibiliswayo, cisha kusasele imizuzu engu-1-2 bese ugcina isivalo sivaliwe ukuze kuqedelwe ngokushisa okusele.

p-151.title: Sonta izintambo zama-earphone ngesimo sesibalo sesishiyagalombili (8) ukugwema ukuhlangana
p-151.summary: Ukugoqa intambo iye ohlangothini olulodwa kugcina ukusonteka okuzithandelayo uma ikhululwa. Isimo sesishiyagalombili siyakuqeda lokho kusonteka.
p-151.principle: Ukujika ngakunye okugcwele kwengeza i-twist angle $\theta=2\pi$, kanti i-torsional moment ingu-$\tau=\dfrac{GJ}{L}\theta$.
p-151.example: Ukugoqa imitha elingu-1 lentambo kayishumi ohlangothini olulodwa kugcina ukusonteka okungu-10, kodwa ukujika oku-5 ngale noku-5 ngale (isishiyagalombili) kuhlanganisa u-0 futhi cishe akushiyi mafindo.
p-151.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho uqoqa ama-earphone noma izintambo zokushaja, zisonge ngesimo sesishiyagalombili esikhundleni sokuzisonga eminweni yakho.

p-152.title: Amanzi ahlala endlebeni yakho ngenxa ye-surface tension
p-152.summary: Ithonsi lamanzi kumgudu omncane wendlebe libanjwa umfutho owenziwa yi-surface tension.
p-152.principle: Umfutho we-Laplace ngu-$\Delta P=\dfrac{2\gamma}{r}$, lapho u-$\gamma\approx0.072$ N/m emanzini. Uma i-radius $r$ incane, umfutho uba mkhulu.
p-152.example: Ku-$r=3$ mm, $\Delta P=2\times0.072/0.003=48$ Pa, ngakho-ke amandla adonsela phansi awodwa cishe awakwazi ukulikhipha ithonsi.
p-152.actionItem: Ngemuva kokubhukuda, tshekisa ikhanda lakho, udonse kancane unqenqema lwendlebe bese ugxuma ngonyawo olulodwa. Ungasebenzisi izinduku zikakotini (cotton swabs), futhi ubonane nodokotela uma kukhona ubuhlungu noma okuphumayo.

p-153.title: Shayela izikhonkwane zentente nge-engeli ebheke kude nentambo
p-153.summary: Isikhonkwane esitsheke kakhulu siqondane ngokuphambana nentambo sivumela umhlabathi ukuthi umelane kangcono nokudonswa.
p-153.principle: Ukudonsa kwentambo $T$ kuhlukana kabili: okuvundlile $T\cos\theta$ nokuqondile phezulu $T\sin\theta$, kanti ingxenye eqonde phezulu iphakamisa isikhonkwane.
p-153.example: Uma $T=100$ N nentambo ekuma-45°, uthola ama-71 N avundlile nama-71 N aphakamisayo. Ukushayela isikhonkwane sitshekele kude nentambo ngama-45–60° kuvumela umhlabathi ukuthi usibambe siqine.
p-153.actionItem: Namuhla, uma ukanisa noma uya epikinikini, shayela izikhonkwane zitsheke zicishe ziqondane ngokuphambana nentambo bese uqinisa intambo ku-engeli ecishe ibe ngama-45°.

p-154.title: Khetha i-cooler ngokobukhulu bodonga, isivalo esingangeni moya kanye nenani leqhwa
p-154.summary: Ukuthi i-cooler ihlala ibanda isikhathi esingakanani kuncike obukhulwini bokuvikela ukushisa kanye nenani leqhwa elingaphakathi.
p-154.principle: Ukushisa okungena ezindongeni kungu-$\dot Q=\dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$, kanti ukuncibilika kweqhwa kumunca u-$Q=mL_f$ lapho u-$L_f\approx334$ kJ/kg.
p-154.example: Lapho kungenisa ukushisa okungu-10 W, i-2 kg yeqhwa (668 kJ) ihlala amahora angu-$668{,}000/10\approx18.6$; ku-20 W, ihlala cishe amahora angu-9.3.
p-154.actionItem: Uma unohambo namuhla, faka ama-2 kg noma ngaphezulu eqhwa neziphuzo ezipholile ngaphandle kwezikhala, futhi uvule isivalo kancane ngangokunokwenzeka.

p-155.title: Ingxenye yamandla e-AC ngenkathi yezimvula iya ekujiyiseni umswakama
p-155.summary: Ngezinsuku ezinomswakama omningi, i-AC akumele nje ipholise umoya kuphela kodwa futhi kumele iguqule umhwamuko wamanzi ube uketshezi.
p-155.principle: Lapho umhwamuko ujiyela ekubeni uketshezi, kukhishwa ukushisa okungu-$Q=mL_v$, lapho u-$L_v\approx2{,}260\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$ emanzini.
p-155.example: Ekamelweni elingama-60 $\mathrm{m^3}$ (cishe ama-72 kg omoya), ukukhipha ama-2 g omhwamuko ngekhilogremu ngayinye yomoya kusho ukubhekana nama-$0.144\times2{,}260\approx325$ kJ (cishe ama-0.09 kWh).
p-155.actionItem: Ngezinsuku ezinomswakama omningi namuhla, sebenzisa i-dry mode ye-AC noma i-26–28 °C efeni ephansi bese ugcina iminyango namafasitela kuvaliwe ukuze umswakama ungangeni.

p-156.title: Iketela likagesi lingcono kunesitofu segesi ekubiliseni amanzi
p-156.summary: Ngenxa yokuthi kuncane ukushisa okuphumayo, iketela likagesi lisebenzisa amandla amancane kunesitofu segesi ukubilisa inani elifanayo lamanzi.
p-156.principle: Ukusebenza kahle ngu-$\eta = \frac{mc\Delta T}{E_{in}}$. Ukushisa ilitha elilodwa lamanzi lisuke ku-20°C liye ku-100°C kudinga ama-$1 \times 4.18 \times 80 = 334\ \mathrm{kJ}$ ($\approx 0.093\ \mathrm{kWh}$).
p-156.example: Iketela elisebenza kahle cishe ngama-90% lisebenzisa cishe ama-0.103 kWh, kuyilapho isitofu segesi esisebenza cishe ngama-40% sisebenzisa cishe amandla angama-0.23 kWh.
p-156.actionItem: Kala kuphela amanzi owadingayo bese uwabilisa eketeleni likagesi.

p-157.title: Bala isikhathi sokushisa inkomishi eyodwa
p-157.summary: Ukuqagela isikhathi se-microwave kuvame ukuyenza isebenze isikhathi eside kakhulu futhi kumoshe amandla.
p-157.principle: Ukushisa kudinga u-$Q=mc\Delta T$, kanti isikhathi sithi $t=Q/P_{\text{output}}$.
p-157.example: Ukushisa ama-250 g amanzi kusuka ku-20 °C kuya ku-90 °C kudinga ama-$0.25\times4.18\times70\approx73$ kJ, okuthi kumandla aphumayo angu-700 W kuthathe cishe ama-104 s (umzuzu ongu-1 nemizuzwana engama-44).
p-157.actionItem: Namuhla, qala isiphuzo cishe ngomzuzu ongu-1 nemizuzwana engama-30 bese wengeza imizuzwana engama-20 ngesikhathi uma kunesidingo.

p-158.title: Lapho imvula ina iqonde phansi ngqo, ukugijima kukugcina womile kakhudlwana
p-158.summary: Ukugijima emvuleni kunciphisa isikhathi imvula eshaya ngaso ikhanda namahlombe akho, kodwa imvula eshaya ngaphambili kuncike ebangeni.
p-158.principle: Emvuleni eqonde phansi ngqo, inani elifika ezingxenyeni ezingaphezulu lithi $W_{\text{top}}\propto t=L/v$, eliphikisana nesivinini, kanti ukumanzi kwengxenye engaphambili kuncike kuphela ebangeni $L$.
p-158.example: Ukuhamba amamitha ayi-100 kuthatha cishe ama-71 s ngokuhamba (1.4 m/s) kodwa cishe ama-29 s ngokugijima (3.5 m/s), okunciphisa isikhathi izingxenye ezingaphezulu eziba manzi ngaso ngama-59%. Umoya uyawushintsha lo mphumela.
p-158.actionItem: Uma lina namuhla, hamba ngokushesha ezindaweni ezimfishane ezingamboziwe kuphela ngendlela ephephile, futhi uqaphele phansi lapho kushelela khona.

p-159.title: Umthetho wama-20-20-20: bheka kude ngo-6 m imizuzwana engama-20 njalo ngemizuzu engama-20
p-159.summary: Uma ubuka isikrini esiseduze isikhathi eside, ilensi yeso lakho ihlala igxile futhi iqina isikhathi eside, okuholela ekukhathaleni okwengeziwe.
p-159.principle: Kwi-equation yelensi ethi $\dfrac1f=\dfrac1{d_o}+\dfrac1{d_i}$, uma into isondela kakhulu, kudingeka amandla amakhulu okugxila (ama-dioptres) $D=1/d_o$.
p-159.example: Isikrini esiku-40 cm sidinga cishe i-2.5 D yokuzilungiselela, kanti into eku-6 m idinga kuphela cishe i-0.17 D, okuwumzamo omncane cishe ngokuphindwe ka-15.
p-159.actionItem: Namuhla, setha i-timer yemizuzu engama-20 futhi njalo uma ikhala, bheka into eqhele okungenani ngo-6 m imizuzwana engama-20.

p-160.title: Uma ubanjwe umsinga oyingozi (rip current), bhukuda ubheke eceleni kuhambisane nogu
p-160.summary: Umsinga oyingozi (rip current) umsele wamanzi omncane, osheshayo ophuma uye olwandle, futhi ukubhukuda ubheke kuwo kumane kukuqede amandla.
p-160.principle: Ngokwe-equation yokuqhubeka ethi $A_1v_1=A_2v_2$, amanzi ampintshwe emseleni omncane asheshisa kakhulu.
p-160.example: Imisinga eyingozi ingafinyelela cishe ku-2 m/s, ngokushesha kunejubane lomuntu lokubhukuda elingaba ngu-1 m/s, kodwa ivamise ukuba nobubanzi obungamamitha ambalwa kuphela, ngakho-ke ukuhamba amamitha angama-20-30 ukuya eceleni kuyakukhipha kuyo.
p-160.actionItem: Uma uhlela ukubhukuda olwandle namuhla, hlala lapho abatakuli (lifeguards) besebenza khona. Uma ubanjiwe, yonga amandla akho, bhukuda ubheke eceleni kuhambisane nogu bese uphakamisa isandla ucele usizo.

p-161.title: Khetha isambulela selanga esikhanyayo ngaphandle futhi esimnyama ngaphakathi
p-161.summary: Ingaphandle elimhlophe libonisa imisebe yelanga emuva kanti ingaphakathi elimnyama limunca ukukhanya okubonakale kusuka phansi.
p-161.principle: Imisebe emuncwe indawo ethile ingama-$q=(1-\alpha)I$, lapho $\alpha$ kungukubonakaliswa kokukhanya (reflectance).
p-161.example: Emini lapho imisebe ingu-800 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$, indawo emhlophe ene-$\alpha=0.7$ imunca i-240 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$ kanti emnyama ene-$\alpha=0.05$ imunca i-760 $\mathrm{W/m^2}$ (amanani okucatshangelwe).
p-161.actionItem: Lapho uthenga isambulela selanga, hlola umbala wangaphandle kanye nelebula lokuvikela imisebe ye-UV njenge-UPF 50+.

p-162.title: Kungani amafeni amakhulu esebenza kahle kakhulu
p-162.summary: Ukuze uthole umoya ofanayo, ifeni enezimpiko ezinkulu egijima ngesivinini esiphansi isebenzisa amandla kagesi amancane kakhulu.
p-162.principle: Amandla akinetiki omoya athi $P = \frac{1}{2}\rho A v^3 = \frac{\rho Q^3}{2A^2}$ ($Q = Av$ ukugeleza komoya).
p-162.example: Ku-0.5 m³/s, ifeni engu-30 cm idinga cishe i-15 W yamandla omoya afanele uma kuqhathaniswa cishe ne-1 W yefeni engu-60 cm. Indawo ephindwe kane isho u-1/16 wamandla.
p-162.actionItem: Lapho uthenga ifeni, qhathanisa ububanzi bezimpiko bese usebenzisa enkulu ngesivinini esiphansi.

p-163.title: Ibhayisikili lisebenzisa amandla amancane kakhulu kune moto ebangeni elingu-5 km
p-163.summary: Ukushintsha uhambo olufushane lwemoto ngokugibela ibhayisikili kunciphisa kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kukaphethiloli namandla.
p-163.principle: Umsebenzi uthi $W=Pt$ bese uhlukaniswa ngokusebenza kahle (efficiency). Ilitha likaphethiloli liqukethe cishe amandla amakhemikhali angu-9 kWh.
p-163.example: Uhambo lwamakhilomitha angu-5 (15 km/h, 100 W, imizuzu engama-20) lusebenzisa i-33 Wh, noma cishe i-0.13 kWh uma kubalwa ukusebenza kahle kwemisipha okungu-25%. Imoto ehamba i-12 km/L isebenzisa cishe i-3.7 kWh ebangeni elingu-5 km, umehluko ophindwe ka-28.
p-163.actionItem: Namuhla, hamba ngezinyawo noma ugibele ibhayisikili ohambweni olungaphansi kuka-5 km.

p-164.title: Chelela imbiza yezitshalo ngaphansi bese isenzo se-capillary senza okunye
p-164.summary: Izikhala ezincane phakathi kwezinhlayiya zenhlabathi zidonsela amanzi phezulu, ngakho ukugcwalisa isosi kuletha amanzi ezimpandeni.
p-164.principle: Ukwenyuka kwe-capillary kuthi $h=\dfrac{2\gamma\cos\theta}{\rho g r}$. Lapho indawo yembobo $r$ incane, ukwenyuka kuba kukhulu.
p-164.example: Nge-$\gamma=0.072$ N/m, $\theta\approx0$ kanye no-$r=0.1$ mm, $h\approx2\times0.072/(1000\times9.8\times10^{-4})\approx0.15$ m (15 cm).
p-164.actionItem: Namuhla, thela amanzi esitsheni/esosini sesitshalo, linda imizuzu engama-20 bese uchitha asele. Amanzi amile abangela ukubola kwezimpande futhi azala omiyane.

p-165.title: Kala umfutho wegazi ingalo yakho isezingeni lenhliziyo
p-165.summary: Uma ingalo yakho ilenga ngaphansi kwenhliziyo, isisindo segazi (hydrostatic pressure) sinezela ekufundweni komfutho bese sikwenza kube phezulu kakhulu.
p-165.principle: Umehluko we-hydrostatic ngu-$\Delta P=\rho g h$. Ukuminyana kwegazi kungaba ngu-1,060 $\mathrm{kg/m^3}$ kanti u-1 kPa ucishe ulingane no-7.5 mmHg.
p-165.example: Ingalo engaphansi kwenhliziyo ngo-20 cm yengeza u-$\Delta P=1060\times9.8\times0.2\approx2.08$ kPa, cishe u-15.6 mmHg, ekufundweni komfutho.
p-165.actionItem: Lapho ukala umfutho wegazi, hlala esihlalweni uncike bese ubeka ingalo enebhande edeskini ukuze ilingane nenhliziyo yakho.

p-166.title: Impahla engagxilile iba yisikhali esindizayo uma imoto ima kungazelelwe
p-166.summary: Into engagxiliwe iyaqhubeka nokuya phambili ngenxa ye-inertia lapho imoto ima, iphenduke amandla amakhulu omthelela.
p-166.principle: Amandla asebenza empahleni ngesikhathi kuncipha isivinini ngu-$F=ma$ lapho $a=v/\Delta t$.
p-166.example: Isikhwama esingu-10 kg ngejubane elingu-50 km/h (13.9 m/s) esimiswa ngo-0.1 s sine-$a\approx139\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$ no-$F\approx1{,}390$ N (cishe 140 kgf).
p-166.actionItem: Namuhla, layisha impahla phansi ebhuthini bese uyibopha iqine, futhi ungalokothi ushiye izinto ezisindayo eshalofini elingemuva noma esihlalweni.

p-167.title: Izinga le-IPX lichaza izimo zokuhlolwa kokungangeni kwamanzi
p-167.summary: I-IPX4 isho ukuthi imelana nokuchaphazeleka kanti i-IPX7 isho ukuthi ingahlala imizuzu engama-30 ekujuleni okungu-1 m; inani elikhudlwana alisho njalo ukuthi lihle kukho konke ukusetshenziswa.
p-167.principle: Umfutho wamanzi ngu-$P=\rho g h$. Ekujuleni okungu-1 m cishe uba ngu-9.8 kPa.
p-167.example: I-IPX4 ihlolelwa ukuchaphazeleka okuvela kuzo zonke izinhlangothi kanti i-IPX7 ihlolelwa ukucwiliswa kufika emizuzwini engama-30 ekujuleni okungu-1 m, futhi abakhi abaningi abayifaki indaba yamanzi olwandle, anensipho noma ashisayo.
p-167.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola izinga le-IPX lama-earbud akho noma isipikha, futhi uma uzisebenzisa emvuleni, qiniseka ukuthi okungenani ziku-IPX4.

p-168.title: Izinto zokukhipha umswakama: i-compressor uma iqhathaniswa ne-Peltier
p-168.summary: Sebenzisa imodeli ye-compressor emakamelweni amakhulu bese usebenzisa imodeli ye-Peltier ezindaweni ezincane kuphela njengamawodilophu.
p-168.principle: I-Coefficient of performance $COP = \frac{Q_c}{W}$: cishe ingu-3 ezintweni ezine-compressor kanti cishe ingu-0.5 ezintweni ze-Peltier.
p-168.example: Ukujiya kuka-1 kg wamanzi kuthatha cishe u-2.26 MJ (0.63 kWh). Into ene-compressor isebenzisa cishe u-0.2 kWh kanti into ye-Peltier isebenzisa cishe u-1.3 kWh.
p-168.actionItem: Ngesikhathi sezulu semvula, qondanisa amandla okukhipha umswakama nekululeko yegumbi lakho bese usebenzisa imodeli ye-compressor egumbini lokuphumula.

p-169.title: Ngenisa umoya lapho umoya wasebusuku ubanda kakhulu ukuze ukhiphe ukushisa
p-169.summary: Ukushisa okwakheke emini kungakhishwa ebusuku ngokuvula amafasitela lapho umoya wangaphandle ubanda, ngaphandle kwezindleko zamandla kagesi.
p-169.principle: Ukushisa okukhishwa ukungena komoya ngu-$\dot Q=\dot m c_p\Delta T$.
p-169.example: Lapho kungu-28 °C ngaphakathi kanti kungu-22 °C ngaphandle, ukungenisa umoya ngo-600 $\mathrm{m^3/h}$ (cishe u-0.2 kg/s womoya) kukhipha u-$0.2\times1.005\times6\approx1.2$ kW wokushisa.
p-169.actionItem: Uma namhlanje ebusuku kubanda kakhulu kunasegumbini lakho, vula amafasitela ukuze kungene umoya ovunguzayo bese uwavala ekuseni kakhulu.

p-170.title: Ukugxobhoza kwedreyini kubangelwa ukushintsha komfutho womoya epayipini
p-170.summary: Lapho amanzi ehla ngesikhathi esisodwa, umfutho osepipayipini uyashintsha bese umunca umoya ngaphakathi kwesicupho samanzi (trap), okuwenza uzwakale ugxobhoza.
p-170.principle: Ikholomu yamanzi ifaka umfutho othi $P=\rho g h$, ngakho ukumunca $\Delta P$ kudonsa amanzi ngo-$h=\Delta P/(\rho g)$.
p-170.example: Ukumunca okungu-100 Pa kuhambisana nekholomu yamanzi engu-$100/(1000\times9.8)\approx10$ mm. Isivikelo sesicupho esingu-50 mm noma ngaphezulu ngokuvamile siyavimba.
p-170.actionItem: Uma idreyini igxobhoza namuhla, sebenzisa amanzi ahambe kancane, futhi uma kuphindeka, cela umphathi wesakhiwo noma umplamba ukuba ahlole.

p-171.title: Ifeni igcina omiyane bekude
p-171.summary: Omiyane bandiza kancane, ngakho-ke bayahluleka ukusondela lapho ifeni ivunguza khona.
p-171.principle: Ijubane lokundiza kukamiyane lingaba ngu-1.5 m/s noma ngaphansi, ngakho-ke uma $v_{wind} > v_{mosq}$ ukusondela kuba nzima, futhi umoya uhlakaza nomkhondo we-CO₂.
p-171.example: Ifeni ekhipha umoya ongu-3 m/s iphindaphinda kabili ijubane eliphezulu likamiyane. Ukukhomba umoya emilenzeni yakho kunciphisa ukulunywa.
p-171.actionItem: Kuvulandi noma ngaphandle, khomba ifeni ekuphakameni kwemilenze.

p-172.title: Zilungiselele umoya ovela eceleni lapho udlula izimoto ezinkulu noma uwela amabhuloho
p-172.summary: Isiphepho somoya esingazelelwe eceleni kweloli noma ebhulohweni singaphushela imoto yakho eceleni.
p-172.principle: Amandla omoya emotweni atholakala nge-$F=\tfrac12\rho C A v^2$, alingana nesikwele sejubane lomoya $v$.
p-172.example: Ngomoya ongu-20 m/s (72 km/h), indawo eseceleni engu-2.5 $\mathrm{m^2}$ kanye no-$C\approx0.8$, $F\approx0.5\times1.2\times0.8\times2.5\times400\approx480$ N.
p-172.actionItem: Uma kubikezelwa umoya onamandla noma imvula namhlanje, bamba isondo lokuqondisa ngezandla zombili futhi wehlise ijubane emabhulohweni nasezindaweni eziphuma emhubheni.

p-173.title: Khetha izindwangu ezipholisayo ngevelyu yokupholisa ngokuthinta (Q-max)
p-173.summary: Indwangu epholile izwakala ipholile ngoba idonsa ukushisa esikhunjeni ngokushesha lapho uthinta okokuqala, futhi i-Q-max ikala lokho.
p-173.principle: Ukuphuma kokushisa kokuqala kulingana no-$q\propto\dfrac{b\,\Delta T}{\sqrt{t}}$, futhi lapho i-thermal effusivity $b=\sqrt{k\rho c}$ iba nkulu, kuba yilapho izwakala ipholile kakhulu.
p-173.example: Ku-$\Delta T=5$ K efanayo, indwangu ene-Q-max engu-0.25 $\mathrm{W/cm^2}$ idonsa ukushisa cishe ngokuphindwe ka-1.7 kunesinye esine-0.15 (njengesibonelo).
p-173.actionItem: Lapho ukhetha izingubo zasehlobo noma okokwembatha embhedeni, hlola i-Q-max eselebuleni (imvamisa engu-0.2 noma ngaphezulu ibhalwa ngokuthi iyapholisa).

p-174.title: Bala ibanga lebhayisikili likagesi (e-bike) ngokusebenzisa i-Wh yebhethri nokusetshenziswa kwamandla
p-174.summary: Ukuhlukanisa amandla ebhethri (Wh) ngamandla ngekhilomitha (Wh/km) kunikeza isilinganiso sebanga elingahanjwa.
p-174.principle: Ibanga litholakala nge-$d=E/e$, futhi njengoba ukuhudula komoya kukhula ngokuthi $F\propto v^2$, ijubane eliphezulu likhulisa u-$e$.
p-174.example: Ibhethri elingu-500 Wh ku-15 Wh/km linikeza cishe amakhilomitha angu-33. Ukugibela ngo-25 km/h kunokuhudula komoya okuphindwe kabili ngo-$(25/20)^2\approx1.56$ kunejubane lika-20 km/h, ngakho ibanga liyancipha.
p-174.actionItem: Namhlanje, gcina ijubane le-e-bike yakho libe seduze kuka-20 km/h futhi uhlole umfutho wamathayi.

p-175.title: Umthwalo ongasetshenziswa ongu-100 kg ushisa uphethiloli owengeziwe ebangeni elingaphezu kuka-100 km
p-175.summary: Imoto esindayo idinga amandla amaningi wokumelana nokuginqika kanye nokusheshisa, ngakho ukuthwala impahla engasetshenziswa kumosha uphethiloli.
p-175.principle: Ukumelana nokuginqika kungu-$F_r=C_{rr}mg$ kanti umsebenzi wenziwa ngu-$W=F_r d$.
p-175.example: Ngo-$C_{rr}=0.01$ no-$m=100$ kg, $F_r\approx9.8$ N kanti $W\approx0.27$ kWh ebangeni elingu-100 km. Ngokusebenza kwenjini okungu-25% kanye no-9 kWh/L kaphethiloli lokho kucishe kube ngu-0.12 L, ngaphandle kokubala amandla okusheshisa.
p-175.actionItem: Namhlanje, khipha noma yiziphi izinto ezingasetshenziswa ebhuthini yemoto yakho.

p-176.title: Kungani phansi endlini yokugezela emanzi kushelela
p-176.summary: Uqweqwe lwamanzi lwehlisa kakhulu ukungqubuzana (friction), ngakho beka umata ongashibiliki endlini yokugezela.
p-176.principle: Umkhawulo wokungqubuzana okumile $F \le \mu N$; uyashibilika lapho u-$\mu$ engaphansi kwalokho okudingwa ukuhamba (cishe u-0.3-0.4).
p-176.example: Ithayela elomile line-$\mu \approx 0.6$, ithayela elibushelelezi elinamanzi cishe line-0.2, kanti umata wenjoloba une-0.6 ngisho noma emanzi.
p-176.actionItem: Beka umata wokuvikela ukushibilika phansi endlini yokugezela nasendaweni yeshawa.

p-177.title: I-UV idlula emafwini
p-177.summary: Amafu afiphalisa ukukhanya okubonakalayo kodwa adlulisa i-UV eningi, ngakho zivikele ngisho nangezinsuku eziguqubele.
p-177.principle: Inkomba ye-UV $UVI = 40 \int E_\lambda\, s(\lambda)\, d\lambda$ (i-erythemal action spectrum $s$). Amafu azacile awanciphisi i-UV kangako.
p-177.example: Amafu azacile adlulisa cishe amaphesenti angama-80-90 e-UV. Enkombeni ye-UV yasemini engu-8 ngoJuni, isikhumba esikhanyayo singasha cishe ngemizuzu engama-20.
p-177.actionItem: Bheka inkomba ye-UV ngaphambi kokuphuma, ngisho nangezinsuku ezinamafu, futhi ugcobe isivikela-langa (sunscreen).

p-178.title: Ngemuva kokushayela emachibini amanzi, cindezela kancane amabhuleki ukuze ome
p-178.summary: Amaphedi namadiski amanzisiwe alahlekelwa ukungqubuzana, ngakho ukubhuleka kuyacotha. Ukucindezela kancane kuyawashisa bese kuhwamuka amanzi.
p-178.principle: Ibanga lokubhuleka lingu-$d=\dfrac{v^2}{2\mu g}$, futhi ukuncipha kokungqubuzana kwamabhuleki kwenza u-$d$ abe mkhulu.
p-178.example: Ku-60 km/h (16.7 m/s), $\mu=0.4$ inikeza cishe amamitha angama-35.5, kodwa uma ukuba manzi kunciphisa kufike ku-$\mu=0.25$ iba cishe amamitha angama-56.7, cishe izikhathi ezingu-1.6 ubude (amanani acatshangwayo).
p-178.actionItem: Namuhla, ngemuva kokuwela ichibi elijulile lamanzi esimweni sezulu esinemvula, cindezela ngobumnene amabhuleki izikhathi ezimbalwa uma kuphephile ukwenza njalo ukuze uwahlole.

p-179.title: Khetha amabhodwe ngobukhulu besisekelo nangezinto zokwakha
p-179.summary: Isisekelo esiwugqinsi esinongqimba lwe-aluminium noma ithusi sisabalalisa ukushisa ngokulinganayo futhi sinciphisa ukusha kokudla.
p-179.principle: Umthetho ka-Fourier $q = k\frac{\Delta T}{d}$: insimbi engagqwali (stainless steel) $k \approx 16$, i-aluminium $\approx 237$ W/(m·K).
p-179.example: Kwisisekelo esingu-3 mm kanye ne-ΔT = 10 K, insimbi engagqwali ithwala cishe ama-53 kW/m² kanti i-aluminium cishe ama-790 kW/m², cishe ukushisa okuphindwe ka-15.
p-179.actionItem: Lapho uthenga ibhodwe, hlola ukuthi isisekelo salo sihlelekile futhi siwugqinsi, futhi sinamandla kazibuthe uma usebenzisa i-induction.

p-180.title: Fudumeza ithangi lamanzi elangeni ukuze unciphise ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi ashisayo
p-180.summary: Ukukhanya kwelanga kuletha kufika cishe ku-1 kW ngemitha yesikwele ngayinye, ngakho-ke amanzi asesitsheni esimnyama angafudunyezwa mahhala.
p-180.principle: Ukushisa okumuncwe kungu-$Q=\alpha I A t$, futhi ukukhuphuka kwezinga lokushisa kungu-$\Delta T=Q/(mc)$.
p-180.example: Kwisitsha esimnyama esingu-20 L (0.25 $\mathrm{m^2}$) esine-$I=700\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$ kanye nokumunca okungu-0.9, kungena cishe $0.9\times700\times0.25\approx158$ W. Emahoreni ama-2 lokho cishe kungu-1.1 MJ, okufudumeza amanzi cishe ngo-13 °C.
p-180.actionItem: Ngosuku olunelanga namuhla, shiya amanzi esitsheni esimnyama noma epayipini elangeni amahora angu-2 kuya kwangu-3 bese uwasebenzisela izitshalo noma ukuwasha imoto.

p-181.title: Umnyango okhencezayo: ukungqubuzana kohlobo lwe-stick-slip
p-181.summary: Ihinji liyakhenceza ngoba ukungqubuzana okumile (static friction) kudlula ukungqubuzana okunyakazayo (kinetic friction), ngakho liyaxhuma njengoba lishelela.
p-181.principle: I-stick-slip: $F_s = \mu_s N > F_k = \mu_k N$; ukugcoba kunciphisa womabili amanani ka-$\mu$.
p-181.example: Insimbi eyomile ene-$\mu \approx 0.5$ yehlela cishe ku-0.1 ngemva kokugcotshwa, okunciphisa ukungqubuzana cishe ngama-80% futhi kuthulise umsindo.
p-181.actionItem: Faka ithonsi elilodwa lesithambisi se-silicone noma uwoyela ephini lehinji bese wesula eyeqile.

p-182.title: Umsindo uyahlangana: amafeni amabili
p-182.summary: Imithombo emibili yomsindo elinganayo yengeza kuphela ama-3 dB, hhayi ukuphinda umsindo kabili, futhi ubusuku obuthule bubalulekile ekulaleni.
p-182.example: Amafeni amabili angu-40 dB anikeza $10\log_{10}(2\times10^4) \approx 43\ \mathrm{dB}$. I-WHO incoma umsindo wasebusuku egumbini lokulala ongaba ngu-30 dB noma ngaphansi.
p-182.actionItem: Qhathanisa izilinganiso ze-dB ezintweni zikagesi zasegumbini lokulala bese usebenzisa kuphela leyo ethule kakhulu ngenkathi ulele.

p-183.title: Kungani isihlabathi sasebhishi esomile sishisa kakhulu emini kanti esimanzi sihlala sipholile
p-183.summary: Isihlabathi esomile sishisa ngokushesha okwanele ukushisa amathe ezinyawo ezingagqokile phakathi nemini, kanti isihlabathi esimanzi siphola kakhulu.
p-183.principle: Ngokushisa okufanayo okumuncwayo u-$Q$, ukwenyuka kwezinga lokushisa kungu-$\Delta T=\frac{Q}{mc}$. Isihlabathi esomile sine-$c\approx0.8\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$ kanti amanzi ane-$4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, ngakho amanzi afudumala kancane kakhulu, futhi ukuhwamuka kwamanzi nakho kususa ukushisa.
p-183.example: Uma u-1 kg wesihlabathi no-1 kg wamanzi ngamunye emunca ama-50 kJ, isihlabathi senyuka cishe ngo-$62\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kanti amanzi acishe abe ngu-$12\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Kungakho isihlabathi esomile sasemini singafinyelela ku-50-60 °C kanti isihlabathi esihlanjwa amagagasi sihlala sizungeze u-30 °C.
p-183.actionItem: Emini, gqoka izimbadada lapho unqamula isihlabathi esomile sasebhishi bese uhamba esihlabathini esimanzi esiseduze konqenqema lwamanzi.

p-184.title: Amanzi olwandle akugcina untanta kangcono kunamanzi ahlanzekile
p-184.summary: Umuntu ofanayo untanta phezulu kancane olwandle kunasechibini lokubhukuda noma emfuleni.
p-184.principle: Amandla okuntanta alingana nesisindo soketshezi olugudluziwe: $F_b=\rho g V$. Amanzi olwandle anobuningi obuyi-$\rho\approx1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ uma kuqhathaniswa ne-$1000\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ yamanzi ahlanzekile, okungaphezulu cishe ngo-2.5%.
p-184.example: Umuntu onesisindo esingama-70 kg kufanele agudluze amalitha angama-70 amanzi ahlanzekile ukuze antante ngokuphelele, kodwa kudingeka kuphela i-$70/1.025\approx68.3$ L yamanzi olwandle, okungaphansi cishe ngo-1.7 L womthamo ocwile. Olwandle Olufile olunosawoti omningi kakhulu (cishe i-1240 kg/m³) ukuntanta kulula kakhulu.
p-184.actionItem: Zijwayeze ukuntanta ngomhlane ngokukhululeka emanzini olwandle angashoni amaphaphu egcwele kahle, futhi ugcine ijakhethi yakho yokuphila igqokiwe lapho idingeka khona.

p-185.title: Gcina amashubhu e-snorkel emfishane, angalokothi abe ngaphezu kwangama-30 cm ngaphezu kwamanzi
p-185.summary: I-snorkel ende yenza ukuphefumula kube nzima kakhulu ngenxa yomfutho wamanzi, futhi ivalele umoya okade uphefumulelwa ngaphandle.
p-185.principle: Umfutho wamanzi uyenyuka njenge-$\Delta P=\rho g h$, cishe i-0.1 atm (9.8 kPa) ngemitha ngayinye yokujula. Isifuba sakho kufanele sisebenze kanzima ngokumelene nawo ukuze udonse umoya, futhi ishubhu elide lengeza indawo engenalutho lapho kuhlala khona umoya ophefumulelwe ngaphandle.
p-185.example: Lapho ingxenye engenhla yeshubhu isebusweni bamanzi, ukujula okungama-30 cm kunikeza i-$\Delta P\approx2.9\ \mathrm{kPa}$, kodwa ku-1 m kucishe kube yi-9.8 kPa, okuseduze kakhulu nomkhawulo womfutho wokudonsa umoya womuntu, ngakho ukuphefumula cishe akunakwenzeka. Ishubhu elinobubanzi obungama-18 mm nobude obungama-30 cm liqukethe cishe ama-75 mL endawo engenalutho.
p-185.actionItem: Hlola ubude be-snorkel yakho namuhla futhi ungalokothi usebenzise ishubhu elide noma ipayipi elifakwe ekugcineni.

p-186.title: Iphansi lechibi lokubhukuda libonakala lingashonile kakhulu kunalokho eliyikho ngempela
p-186.summary: Ingxenye engezansi yamanzi ibonakala ijule cishe ngezingxenye ezintathu kwezine kuphela zalokho eyikho ngempela, ngakho-ke amanzi ajule kakhulu kunalokho abonakala ngakho.
p-186.principle: Ukukhanya kuyagoba lapho kusuka emanzini kuya emoyeni, ngakho ukujula okubonakalayo kungu-$d'=\frac{d}{n}$. Amanzi ane-$n\approx1.33$, ngakho $d'\approx0.75\,d$.
p-186.example: Iphansi lechibi elijule ngamamitha angu-2.0 libonakala lingu-$2.0/1.33\approx1.5$ m lapho libukwa phezulu. Ukujula okungamamitha angu-3 kubonakala kungama-2.3 m, okungumehluko wamamitha angu-0.7.
p-186.actionItem: Funda izimpawu zokujula ezisodongeni lwechibi ngaphambi kokungena, futhi ungalokothi ungene ngekhanda engxenyeni ongakwazi ukujula kwayo.

p-187.title: Kungani uzuma uhlangabezana nongqimba lwamanzi abandayo olwandle
p-187.summary: Izilwandle namachibi ehlobo akha ungqimba olufudumele ngaphezu kwamanzi abandayo, ngakho izinyathelo ezimbalwa ezijulile zingazuma zibande kakhulu.
p-187.principle: Amanzi angaphezulu afudunyezwe yilanga anobuningi obuphansi $\rho(T)$ futhi ayantanta, kuyilapho amanzi abandayo ecwila, akhe ungqimba oluzinzile (i-thermocline). Ungqimba oluzinzile lwenqaba ukuxubana, ngakho izinga lokushisa lishintsha ngokukhulu ukushesha emngceleni.
p-187.example: Ubuningi bamanzi bungaba ngu-997.0 kg/m³ ku-25 °C kanye no-999.1 kg/m³ ku-15 °C, umehluko ongu-0.2% kuphela, kodwa owanele ukugcina izingqimba zihlukene. Ukwehla ngo-5-10 °C phakathi kwamamitha ambalwa kuvamile emachibini nasezilwandle, kanti umoya ovunguza usuka ogwini oqhubela amanzi angaphezulu kude ungadonsela amanzi abandayo ebhishi.
p-187.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuya ekujuleni, yehlisa imilenze yakho kancane ukuze uzwe ukushintsha kwezinga lokushisa, futhi ngezinsuku zamanzi abandayo ungabhukudi uze uye kude kakhulu kanyekanye.

p-188.title: Isivinini sokungena ngesikhathi ugxumela emanzini: ukusuka ku-3 m ushaya amanzi cishe ngejubane elingama-28 km/h
p-188.summary: Ukugxuma usuka ku-3 m kusho ukushaya amanzi cishe ngejubane elingama-28 km/h, ngakho ukungena ngaphandle kokuhlola ukujula kuyingozi.
p-188.principle: Uma ungabali ukudonswa komoya, ukongiwa kwamandla kunikeza isivinini ngemva kokuwa ukusuka ekuphakameni okungu-$h$: $v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-188.example: Ku-$h=3\ \mathrm{m}$, $v=\sqrt{2\times9.8\times3}\approx7.7\ \mathrm{m/s}\approx27.6\ \mathrm{km/h}$. Ukusuka ku-10 m cishe kuba yi-14 m/s (cishe i-50 km/h): ukuphakama okuphindaphindwe izikhathi ezingaphezu kwezi-3 kunikeza isivinini esiphindaphindwe cishe izikhathi ezingu-1.8.
p-188.actionItem: Hlola uphawu lokujula ngaphambi kwanoma yikuphi ukugxuma, futhi ungalokothi ungene ngekhanda lapho ukujula kungaziwa khona.

p-189.title: Thenga izingubo zasehlobo ngokubheka amandla azo okubonisa ukukhanya, hhayi umbala kuphela
p-189.summary: Ukuthi ingubo yasehlobo ipholile kangakanani kuncike ekutheni ibonisa ukukhanya kwelanga kangakanani nokuthi umoya ungena kahle kanjani kuyo, hhayi egameni lombala kuphela.
p-189.principle: Amandla amuncwayo angu-$q=(1-\alpha)\,I$, lapho i-$\alpha$ iyi-albedo (ukubonisa ukukhanya) kanti i-$I$ kungukukhanya kwelanga okufikayo. Imibala ekhanyayo ibonisa ukukhanya okubonakalayo okwengeziwe, ngakho-ke imunca okuncane.
p-189.example: Ku-$I=1000\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, izingubo ezimhlophe ezine-$\alpha=0.7$ zimunca cishe i-300 W/m², kanti ezimnyama ezine-$\alpha=0.1$ zimunca cishe i-900 W/m², okuwumehluko ophindwe kathathu. Ezinye izindwangu ezimnyama zivimba imisebe ye-UV kangcono, ngakho-ke hlola nesilinganiso se-UPF.
p-189.actionItem: Lapho uthenga izingubo zasehlobo, khetha imibala ekhanyayo enendwangu engenisa umoya kahle futhi uhlole ilebula le-UPF.

p-190.title: Ibhodlela lamanzi elikhanyayo noma indishi yezinhlanzi yengilazi kungabhebhethekisa umlilo
p-190.summary: Ibhodlela eliyindilinga elikhanyayo noma indishi enamanzi ingagxilisa ukukhanya kwelanga njengelensi bese ibasa izinto ezivuthayo.
p-190.principle: Ilensi eyisifumbu ilandela umthetho othi $\frac{1}{f}=\frac{1}{u}+\frac{1}{v}$, futhi ukukhanya okuvela entweni ekude kakhulu njengelanga ($u\to\infty$) kugxila ku-$v=f$. Imbulunga egcwele amanzi inobude bokugxila obungaba ngu-$f\approx\frac{nD}{4(n-1)}$.
p-190.example: Ibhodlela elinobubanzi obungu-$D=8\ \mathrm{cm}$ linikeza u-$f\approx1.33\times8/(4\times0.33)\approx8\ \mathrm{cm}$. Ku-1000 W/m², ingxenye engaba ngu-50 cm² iqoqa cishe u-5 W, ocindezelwa endaweni encane engamamilimitha-skwele ambalwa, eshisa ngokwanele ukuba ingashisa iphepha noma indwangu.
p-190.actionItem: Susa amabhodlela amanzi, izindishi zezinhlanzi kanye nemihlobiso yengilazi emafasiteleni anelanga, kuvulandi nasezimotweni, noma uzimboze ngendwangu engafiphele.

p-191.title: Khetha ikhabe ngokulalela umsindo wokungqongqoza
p-191.summary: Ikhabe elivuthiwe livame ukukhipha umsindo ophansi, ononakalo, ngakho ukungqongqoza kuyinkomba ewusizo, kodwa kuhlanganise nesisindo nokubukeka kwalo.
p-191.principle: Imvamisa yemvelo yento ingu-$f\propto\sqrt{k/m}$. Njengoba ingaphakathi levuthwa, ukuqina kwalo $k$ kwehla, kwehlisa nephimbo lomsindo, kanti ikhabe elingavuthiwe lizwakala liphezulu futhi liqine kakhudlwana.
p-191.example: Ngesisindo esifanayo, uma ukuqina kwehla ngo-36% kuya ku-$0.64k$, imvamisa iba ngokuphindaphindwe ngo-$\sqrt{0.64}=0.8$, okuwukwehla ngo-20%. Emakhabeni anobukhulu obufanayo, khetha futhi lelo elisinda kakhulu nelinendawo ephansi ephuzi.
p-191.actionItem: Lapho uthenga ikhabe, ngqongqoza ukuze ulalele umsindo ophansi, ononakalo bese ukhetha elisinda kakhulu phakathi kwalawo anobukhulu obulinganayo.

p-192.title: Faka umoya emashubheni okubhukuda nasemabhuloni olwandle afinyelele cishe ku-80% kuphela
p-192.summary: Ngaphansi kwelanga elishisayo umoya ongaphakathi uyanda, ngakho-ke ishubhu noma ibhola lolwandle eligcwele kakhulu lingaqhuma; ukugcwalisa ngo-80% kuphephe kakhudlwana.
p-192.principle: Egesi ekahle $PV=nRT$, ngaphansi kwengcindezi engaguquki $V\propto T$ (umthetho ka-Charles), futhi lapho umthamo ungaguquki $P\propto T$. Sebenzisa izinga lokushisa eliphelele ngamRounding/kelvin.
p-192.example: Ukusuka ku-25 °C (298 K) kuye ku-50 °C (323 K) kwandisa umthamo ngo-$323/298\approx1.084$, okuwukwanda ngo-8.4%. Ishubhu eligcwaliswe ku-95% selivele lidlula umkhawulo walo, futhi ebhuthini yemoto eno-60 °C (333 K) ukwanda kungaba ngu-12%.
p-192.actionItem: Faka umoya emashubheni nasemabhuloni olwandle afinyelele ku-80-90% kuphela futhi ungawashiyi emotweni eshisayo noma elangeni eliqondile isikhathi eside.

p-193.title: Kungani amathonsi emvula engalimazi: isivinini sokugcina esingaba ngu-9 m/s
p-193.summary: Ngisho namathonsi aphuma kumakhilomitha amaningana phezulu ayayeka ukusheshisa cishe ku-30 km/h ngenxa yokuhudula komoya, ngakho imvula ayilimazi, kodwa isichotho siyashesha futhi siyingozi.
p-193.principle: Isivinini siyalingana lapho amandla adonsela phansi elingana nokudonsa komoya: $mg=\tfrac{1}{2}\rho v^2C_dA$ okunikeza isivinini sokugcina esingu-$v_t=\sqrt{\frac{2mg}{\rho C_dA}}$.
p-193.example: Ithonzi lemvula elingu-5 mm liwa cishe ngo-9 m/s (32 km/h) kanti ithonsi elingu-2 mm liwa cishe ngo-6.5 m/s. Egunjini elingenawo umoya (vacuum) ukuwa kuka-1 km kungafinyelela cishe ku-140 m/s. Isichotho esingu-2 cm siwa cishe ngo-20 m/s (72 km/h), okwenele ukuba singabhoboza noma sidilize imoto.
p-193.actionItem: Ngezinsuku lapho kubikezelwe khona isichotho, hlola isibikezelo sezulu bese upaka imoto yakho endaweni efulelwe.

p-194.title: Khomba umoya we-air conditioner phezulu
p-194.summary: Lapho upholisisa, thumela umoya ubheke phezulu ukuze umoya obandayo wehle bese igumbi lonke liphola ngokulinganayo.
p-194.principle: Ukuminyana kwegesi ekahle kungu-$\rho=\frac{PM}{RT}$, okuphakeme ezingeni lokushisa eliphansi. Umoya obandayo uyasinda futhi uyehlela phansi kanti umoya ofudumele uyakhuphuka, okuqhuba ukujikeleza kwemvelo (natural convection).
p-194.example: Ku-1 atm, umoya oku-18 °C (291 K) ucishe ube ngu-1.21 kg/m³ kanti oku-28 °C (301 K) ube cishe ngu-1.17 kg/m³, ngakho-ke umoya obandayo uminyene cishe ngo-3.4% ngaphezulu. Ukuwukhomba phezulu kugwema ukufuthela kubantu ngqo, ngakho izinga elimisiwe eliphezulu ngo-1-2 °C lingazizwa lintofontofo, ligcine ugesi.
p-194.actionItem: Lapho upholisisa namuhla, misa izikhalazo zomoya (louvres) zibheke phezulu noma zime ngokuqondile, bese uzibhekisa phansi lapho ufudumeza.

p-195.title: Ukubuka amagagasi usemthangalasweni: phinda kabili ukuphakama kwegagasi, amandla aphindaphindeka kane
p-195.summary: Ukuphinda kabili ukuphakama kwegagasi kuphindaphinda amandla alo kane, ngakho ukubuka amagagasi usemthangalasweni noma emadwaleni kuyingozi kakhulu kunendlela okubukeka ngayo.
p-195.principle: Emagagasini ajwayelekile, amandla endaweni ngayinye angu-$E=\frac{1}{8}\rho g H^2$, alingana nesikwele sokuphakama kwegagasi $H$.
p-195.example: Ngo-$\rho=1025\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, igagasi elingu-1 m lithwala cishe u-1.26 kJ/m² kanti igagasi elingu-2 m lithwala cishe u-5.0 kJ/m², okuphindaphindwe kane. Amagagasi ageleza phezu kodonga angakhukhula umuntu ngokushaya kanye nje.
p-195.actionItem: Ngezinsuku zolwandle olunolaka, qhela emithangalasweni nasemadwaleni, futhi uhlole isibikezelo sasolwandle sokuphakama kwamagagasi ngaphambi kokuba uhambe.

p-196.title: Ucingo olushisa kakhulu phakathi nehlobo: khipha ikhava ukuze uvikele impilo yebhethri
p-196.summary: Ukushisa kunciphisa impilo yebhethri ngokushesha, ngakho-ke phakathi nehlobo khipha ikhava futhi ugweme ilanga eliqondile ukuze ukushisa kuphume.
p-196.principle: Ukumelana nokushisa okuqhutshwayo kungu-$R=\frac{L}{kA}$, kanti ngokukhipha ukushisa okungu-$P$, umehluko wezinga lokushisa ngu-$\Delta T=PR$. Ikhava ewugqinsi evikela ukushisa ikhuphula u-$R$ bese ivalele ukushisa ngaphakathi.
p-196.example: Ikhava ye-silicone engu-2 mm ene-$k\approx0.2\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ phezu kwendawo engu-70 cm² inikeza u-$R\approx1.4\ \mathrm{K/W}$. Ku-3 W, njengalapho usebenzisa i-navigation, ucingo lushisa kakhulu ngo-4 °C. Amaseli e-Lithium-ion aguga ngokushesha ngaphezu kuka-35 °C, cishe aphinda kabili izinga lawo lokuguga njalo uma izinga lokushisa likhuphuka ngo-10 °C.
p-196.actionItem: Lapho usebenzisa i-navigation noma ushaja elangeni, khipha ikhava bese ugcina ucingo emthunzini noma endaweni enomoya ophefumulayo.

p-197.title: Idiski endizayo indiza iye kude futhi iqonde kakhudlwana uma iphothwa
p-197.summary: Ukujikijela ngesihlakala ukuze uphothe idiski kuyenza izinze futhi indize iye kude kakhulu, kanti futhi ukujikijela kungukuzivocavoca okulula komzimba wonke.
p-197.principle: Ngaphandle kwe-torque yangaphandle, i-angular momentum $L=I\omega$ iyagcinwa. Idiski ephothwayo imelana nezinguquko endleleni ebheke ngayo, okungumphumela we-gyroscopic oqinisekisa ukuzinza kwayo emoyeni.
p-197.example: Idiski ejikijelwe ngokuphenduka cishe izikhathi ezingu-5-8 ngomzuzwana indiza ngokuzinza amamitha angu-30-40, kanti leyo ejikijelwe iplati ingaphothwanga iyaphenduka noma iwe phakathi kwamamitha ambalwa. Ngejubane elifanayo, ukuphinda kabili ukuphotha kuphinda kabili u-$L$, ngakho-ke kudingeka i-torque ephindwe kabili ukuze iphazamiseke.
p-197.actionItem: Chitha imizuzu engu-10 epaki ujikijela idiski ngokuphendula isihlakala, futhi qala ngokuthukulula amahlombe nezihlakala zakho kuqala.

p-198.title: Amanzi afakwe ku-microwave angase angabonakali ebila, bese echichima ngokuzumayo
p-198.summary: Ukufudumeza amanzi enkomishini ebushelelezi isikhathi eside kakhulu kungawenza adlule izinga lokubila ngaphandle kwamagwebu, bese ehlakazeka ngamandla lapho ephazanyiswa futhi angasha.
p-198.principle: Amagwebu adinga izindawo zokuqala (nucleation sites) ezinjengemihuzuko noma izinhlayiya. Inkomishi ebushelelezi namanzi ahlanzekile akunakho lokhu, ngakho-ke amanzi angashisa kakhulu ngaphezu kuka-100 °C. Ukugubha noma ukufaka impushana kwenza aphenduke umhwamuko ngaso leso sikhathi.
p-198.example: Ukufudumeza u-250 mL ukusuka ku-20 °C kuye ku-100 °C kudinga u-$Q=0.25\times4.18\times80\approx84\ \mathrm{kJ}$, cishe imizuzwana engu-105 ku-microwave engu-800 W. Ukufudumeza isikhathi eside kungashiya amanye amanzi engaphezu kuka-100 °C, ngakho-ke ngisho nesipuni sempushana singawenza achichime amagwebu.
p-198.actionItem: Lapho ufudumeza amanzi, faka induku yokhuni noma isipuni esiphephile se-microwave, wayeke aphumule imizuzwana engu-30 ngaphambi kokuwakhipha, futhi ugcine ubuso bakho buqhele enkomishini.

p-199.title: Fudumeza ipani kuze kube yilapho amathonsi amanzi egigiyela njengobuhlalu
p-199.summary: Fudumeza ipani lensimbi engagqwali kuphela kuze kube yilapho amathonsi amanzi egingqika njengobuhlalu: ukudla kunamathela kancane, futhi ukushisa okweqile kuchitha igesi.
p-199.principle: Ngaphezu kwama-200 °C kwakheka ungqimba lomhwamuko ngaphansi kwethonsi lamanzi, ngakho-ke liyantanta futhi ligingqike esikhundleni sokubila lihwamuke (umphumela we-Leidenfrost). Leso yisibonakaliso esihle sokufaka amafutha.
p-199.example: Ukufudumeza ipani lensimbi engagqwali elingu-1.2 kg (i-specific heat ecishe ibe ngu-0.5 kJ/(kg·K)) ukusuka ku-20 °C kuye ku-200 °C kuthatha u-$Q=1.2\times0.5\times180\approx108\ \mathrm{kJ}$ (cishe u-0.03 kWh). Uma ithonsi litswina bese linyamalala ngokushesha, ipani lisengaba cishe ku-150-190 °C.
p-199.actionItem: Fafaza ithonsi lamanzi epanini; lapho ligingqika njengobuhlalu, faka amafutha bese wehlisa amandla omlilo.

p-200.title: Sebenzisa ama-anchor odongeni lwe-drywall ukuze usabalalise umthwalo
p-200.summary: I-drywall ibuthakathaka futhi isikulufu esingenalutho siyaphuma kalula, ngakho-ke sebenzisa i-anchor evuleka ngemuva kwebhodi ukuze usabalalise umthwalo endaweni ebanzi.
p-200.principle: Ingcindezi yokuthwala ingu-$p=\frac{F}{A}$. Uma indawo yokuxhumana $A$ inkulu, ingcindezi iba ncane ebhodini kumthwalo ofanayo. Ama-expansion nama-toggle anchor ayavuleka ngemuva kodonga ukuze akhulise indawo.
p-200.example: Uhlaka olungu-10 kg ($F\approx98\ \mathrm{N}$) olubanjwe yisikulufu esinendawo yokuthwala ecishe ibe ngu-1 cm² lunikeza cishe u-0.98 MPa, kodwa i-toggle anchor eno-8 cm² inikeza cishe u-0.12 MPa, okungokukodwa kokuyisishiyagalombili. I-anchor ngayinye inesisindo sayo esilinganiselwe, ngakho-ke hlola iphakethe.
p-200.actionItem: Lengisa izinto ezisindayo kuhlaka lwezingodo (stud), noma khetha i-anchor enesisindo esilinganiselwe esidlula ngokukhululekile isisindo sento oyilengisayo.

p-201.title: Izinga lokushisa lombala wesibani: 3000K egumbini lokuphumula, 5000K egumbini lokufundela
p-201.summary: Lapho izinga lokushisa lombala wesibani liphezulu, ukukhanya kwaso kuba luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka futhi kuphole kakhudlwana. Khetha i-K ephansi ezindaweni zokuphumula kanye ne-K ephezulu ekufundeni nasekusebenzeni.
p-201.principle: I-blackbody eshisayo ikhipha imisebe enamandla kakhulu ku-$\lambda_{max}=\frac{b}{T}$ (umthetho ka-Wien), $b=2.898\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Izinga lokushisa eliphezulu lishintshela kokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, futhi izinga lokushisa lombala wesibani liqanjwe ngokuqhathaniswa nalowo mbala we-blackbody.
p-201.example: I-blackbody engu-3000 K ifinyelela phezulu eduze kuka-966 nm, engu-5000 K eduze kuka-580 nm kanti engu-6500 K eduze kuka-446 nm, ngakho-ke izinga eliphezulu lizwakala liluhlaza ngokwesibhakabhaka. Amagumbi okuphumula ngokuvamile asebenzisa u-2700-3000 K (omhlophe ofudumele) kanti amagumbi okufundela asebenzisa u-4000-5000 K (ukukhanya kwasemini).
p-201.actionItem: Lapho uthenga izibani, hlola izinga le-K ebhokisini bese ukhetha cishe u-3000 K egumbini lokuphumula kanye nocishe abe ngu-5000 K egumbini lokufundela.

p-202.title: Hlola ukucwayiza kwe-LED ngemodi yokuhamba kancane yefoni yakho
p-202.summary: Izibani ze-LED zingacwayiza ngendlela engabonakali, kanti ezishibhile zicwayiza kakhulu, okungakhathaza amehlo akho. Ividiyo ehamba kancane (slow-motion) ikubonisa kalula lokhu.
p-202.principle: I-LED esebenzisa i-AC elungisiwe ishintshashintsha ngokuphindwe kabili kwemvamisa kagesi: 120 Hz kugridi ye-60 Hz kanye ne-100 Hz kugridi ye-50 Hz. Isikhathi somjikelezo sithi $T=\frac{1}{f}$, cishe ama-8.3 ms ku-120 Hz.
p-202.example: Ukuthwebula isibani nge-slow motion ye-240 fps kunikeza igebe lohlaka elingaba ngu-4.2 ms, ngakho-ke cishe izinhlaka ezi-2 zingena kumjikelezo ngamunye futhi kubonakala imigqa noma izinguquko zokukhanya. Imikhiqizo ecwayiza kakhulu ingadala ukukhathala kwamehlo noma ubuhlungu bekhanda kwabanye abantu.
p-202.actionItem: Thwebula izibani zasekhaya lakho nge-slow motion, futhi uma ubona imigqa, cabanga ngokuzishintsha ufake umkhiqizo ongacwayizi.

p-203.title: Sebenzisa amabhuleki enjini uma wehla umqansa ukugwema ukushisa kakhulu kwamabhuleki
p-203.summary: Emqanseni omude owehlayo, ukusebenzisa amabhuleki kuphela kwakha ukushisa futhi kunciphisa amandla okumisa, ngakho-ke sebenzisa namabhuleki enjini ngegiya eliphansi, okungonga nophethiloli.
p-203.principle: Amandla atholakalayo $mgh$ alahlekile, kususwe ushintsho kumandla kinetic $\frac{1}{2}mv^2$, aphenduka ukushisa kuma-brake pads. Uma eshisa kakhulu, ukungqubuzana kuyaphela kulokho okubizwa nge-brake fade.
p-203.example: Imoto enesisindo esingu-1500 kg eyehla ngo-500 m iguqula cishe u-$1500\times9.8\times500\approx7.4\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (cishe ama-2 kWh) abe ukushisa. Ukuma usuka ku-100 km/h (27.8 m/s) kukodwa kungaba ngu-580 kJ. Ukusebenzisa igiya eliphansi kuvumela ukudonsa kwenjini ukuba kulekelele lowo mthwalo.
p-203.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukwehla okude, shintshela egiyni eliphansi ukuze kudingeke ukuthi ubhuleke ngezikhathi ezithile kuphela.

p-204.title: Ukushwiba izingalo zakho ngenkathi uhamba konga amandla
p-204.summary: Ukuhamba ushwiba izingalo ngokwemvelo kusebenzisa amandla amancane kunokugcina izingalo zinganyakazi, futhi kugcina umzimba wakho uzinzile.
p-204.principle: Ingalo eshwiba kusukela ehlombe iyiphendulamu enenkathi yemvelo engu-$T=2\pi\sqrt{L/g}$. Lapho ukushwiba kuhambisana nesinyathelo sakho, umzamo uyancipha, futhi izingalo ezishwibayo zikhansela ukusonteka kwesifuba okudalwa imilenze.
p-204.example: Ngobude bengalo obusebenzayo $L\approx0.35\ \mathrm{m}$, $T\approx1.2\ \mathrm{s}$, kuseduze nenkathi yesinyathelo ecishe ibe ngu-1.1 s. Ucwaningo luthola ukuthi ukuvimba ukushwiba kwezingalo kukhuphula izindleko zamandla okuhamba cishe ngo-10%.
p-204.actionItem: Ohambweni lwanamuhla lokuzivocavoca, thambisa amahlombe akho bese uvumela izingalo zakho zishwibe ngokwemvelo imizuzu eyi-10.

p-205.title: Kungani ukucula kuzwakala kamnandi eshaweni: ukunanela komsindo
p-205.summary: Amathayela nengilazi endlini yokugezela akunconsi msindo nhlobo, ngakho-ke uhlala isikhathi eside futhi wenze ukucula kuzwakale kugcwele, kodwa ocingweni lwevidiyo lokho kunanela kuyinkinga.
p-205.principle: Isikhathi sokunanela silandela ifomula ka-Sabine $T=\frac{0.161\,V}{A}$, lapho u-$V$ eyivolumu yegumbi (m³) kanti u-$A$ kungukuncela komsindo okuphelele (m²), okuyisamba sendawo engaphezulu ngayinye ephindwe nge-coefficient yayo yokuncela.
p-205.example: Ngevolumu engu-7.2 m³, indawo engaphezulu ecishe ibe ngu-23 m² kanye ne-coefficient yokuncela yethayela eseduze kuka-0.02, $A\approx0.46\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kanti $T\approx2.5\ \mathrm{s}$. Igumbi lokuphumula elinokhaphethi namakhethini lingaba ngu-0.4-0.6 s, ngakho umsindo ufa ngokushesha kakhulu.
p-205.actionItem: Uma udinga ukuphendula ucingo noma ukuqopha endlini yokugezela, lengisa amathawula noma umata ukuze unciphise ukunanela, noma dlulela egumbini elinezimpahla ezithambile.

p-206.title: Gcina ipayipi lokukhipha amanzi le-AC lehlele phansi ngaso sonke isikhathi
p-206.summary: Amanzi ajiyile e-AC ageleza kuphela ngamandla adonsela phansi, ngakho-ke ipayipi lokukhipha amanzi kufanele lehlele phansi kuyo yonke indawo yalo, kungenjalo ukugoba nokugoqana kungalimisa futhi luvuzele amanzi endlini.
p-206.principle: Amanzi ajiyile ageleza ukusuka phezulu kuye phansi ngaphansi kwamandla adonsela phansi, ngakho ipayipi lidinga ukwehla okungenani ngo-1 cm ngemitha ngalinye (umthambeka ongu-1/100 noma ngaphezulu). Amanzi amile adala ukungcola, ukuvaleka kanye nokuvuza.
p-206.example: Ngezinsuku ezinomswakama i-air conditioner yenza cishe ilitha eli-1 lamanzi ajiyile ngehora. Ipayipi elingamamitha angu-5 kufanele liphelele okungenani ngo-5 cm ngaphansi kwalapho liqala khona. Ukuvuza okumanzisa udonga naphansi kungabiza kakhulu ukukulungisa.
p-206.actionItem: Bheka ukuthi ipayipi lokukhipha amanzi liyaphansi yini kuze kube sekugcineni, alinazo izindawo ezigoqekile noma ezilengayo, nokuthi isiphetho salo asicwile yini emanzini.

p-207.title: Kunzima ukubona lapho umsindo uvela khona ngaphansi kwamanzi
p-207.summary: Umsindo uhamba ngokushesha kakhulu emanzini kangangokuthi umehluko wesikhathi phakathi kwezindlebe zakho uyanyamalala, okwenza kube nzima ukusho ukuthi isikebhe noma umuntu uvela ngaluphi uhlangothi.
p-207.principle: Umsindo uhamba cishe ngo-343 m/s emoyeni kanti cishe ngo-1500 m/s emanzini. Sahlulela isiqondiso ngomehluko wesikhathi sokufika phakathi kwezindlebe, $\Delta t=\frac{d\cos\theta}{v}$, oba mncane kakhulu lapho u-$v$ emkhulu.
p-207.example: Ngezindlebe eziqhelelene ngo-$d\approx0.2\ \mathrm{m}$, umehluko wesikhathi omkhulu cishe ngu-0.58 ms emoyeni kodwa cishe ngu-0.13 ms ngaphansi kwamanzi, omncane ngokuphindwe ka-4.4. Ubuchopho bunenkinga yokukuxazulula lokho, ngakho awukwazi ukusho ukuthi injini ikuphi.
