p-207.actionItem: Lapho ubhukuda, hlala ngaphakathi kwendawo enemiphongolo emisiwe (buoys) futhi uphakamise ikhanda lakho njalo ukuze ubheke izikebhe ngamehlo akho.

p-208.title: Isibhamu samanzi sidubula kude kakhulu kuma-degrees angama-45
p-208.summary: Lapho umoya ungabambezeli kakhulu, ijethi yamanzi edutshulwe kuma-degrees angama-45 iya kude kakhulu. Zamele lokhu uma nincintisana ngebanga epaki yamanzi.
p-208.principle: Kumcibisholo oqalwe futhi wafika endaweni ephakeme ngokufanayo, ibanga lingu-$R=\frac{v^2\sin2\theta}{g}$, liba likhulu kakhulu lapho u-$\sin2\theta$ ephezulu kakhulu, ku-$\theta=45^\circ$. Empeleni ukuhudula komoya kunganciphisa i-angle engcono kancane.
p-208.example: Ijethi egijima ngo-10 m/s ifinyelela ku-$R=10^2/9.8\approx10.2\ \mathrm{m}$ kuma-degrees angama-45. Kuma-degrees angama-30 noma angama-60, u-$\sin60^\circ\approx0.866$ unikeza cishe u-8.8 m, okuwu-86% webanga.
p-208.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa isibhamu samanzi, shintsha i-angle ukuze uthole ukuphonsa okukude kakhulu, kodwa ungalokothi uqondise ebusweni nanoma emehlweni omuntu.

p-209.title: Kungani ibhola ligoba: ukujikeleza kanye namandla e-Magnus
p-209.summary: Ibhola elijikelezayo ligobela eceleni lapho lindiza ngoba ukujikeleza kwenza umfutho womoya uhluke ezinhlangothini zalo zombili.
p-209.principle: Ibhola elijikelezayo elihamba emoyeni lizwa amandla aqondene ngqo kokubili nesivinini salo $\vec v$ kanye ne-axis yokujikeleza $\vec\omega$: $\vec F=S(\vec\omega\times\vec v)$ (amandla e-Magnus). Umoya uhamba ngokushesha ohlangothini olulodwa, okudala umehluko womfutho.
p-209.example: I-free kick yebhola likanobhutshuzwayo ngejubane elingu-108 km/h (30 m/s) elijikeleza cishe izikhathi eziyi-8 ngomzuzwana lingagoba eceleni cishe ngamamitha angama-3-4 phezu kwamamitha angama-25. Ngaphandle kokujikeleza lindiza liqonde.
p-209.actionItem: Ngokuzayo uma ukhahlela ibhola epaki, lifake ukujikeleza okuseceleni usebenzisa ingaphakathi lonyawo lwakho bese ubuka indlela igophe elishintsha ngayo.

p-210.title: Umkhathizwe wasolwandle uqhele ngamakhilomitha angaba ngu-4.7 kuphela
p-210.summary: Kusukela ekuphakameni kweso okungu-1.7 m umkhathizwe wolwandle uqhele ngamakhilomitha angaba ngu-4.7 kuphela, ngakho-ke ulwandle oluvulekile olubonayo lusondele kakhulu kunendlela olubukeka ngayo.
p-210.principle: Ngenxa yokuthi uMhlaba uyindilinga, ibanga eliya emkhathizweni kusukela ekuphakameni kweso $h$ (m) lingu-$d\approx3.57\sqrt{h}$ km. Leli nani selivele lihlanganisa ukulungiswa kokugoba kokukhanya emoyeni (atmospheric refraction).
p-210.example: Ekuphakameni kweso okungu-1.7 m, $d\approx3.57\times\sqrt{1.7}\approx4.65$ km, futhi kusukela esakhiweni esiphakeme ngo-10 m cishe lingu-11.3 km. Umkhumbi okude uqala ngokulahlekelwa umzimba wawo kuqala, bese kusala insika yawo kuphela ebonakalayo.
p-210.actionItem: Olwandle, bukela umkhumbi okude bese uqaphela ukuthi umzimba wawo unyamalala kanjani ngaphansi komkhathizwe kanti kusala insika kuphela.

p-211.title: Cindezela inkinobho yokuhlola ye-RCD njalo ngenyanga ngenkathi yezimvula
p-211.summary: Ingcuphe yokuvuza kukagesi iyenyuka esimweni sezulu esinomswakama senkathi yezimvula, ngakho-ke hlola njalo ngenyanga ukuthi isivikeli-kuvuza sakho (RCD) siyasebenza yini ngokucindezela inkinobho yaso yokuhlola.
p-211.principle: I-RCD ibona umehluko phakathi kwamanzi kagesi angenayo naphumayo, $I_\Delta=|I_{in}-I_{out}|$, futhi ivamise ukunqamula ugesi phakathi kwemizuzwana engaba ngu-0.03 uma ifinyelela izinga layo elibekiwe, ngokuvamile elingu-30 mA. Inkinobho yokuhlola idala lokho kungalingani ngamabomu.
p-211.example: Uketshezi oluvuzayo olungu-30 mA lungaba yingozi kumuntu othinta ingxenye enogesi, ngakho kumele linqamule ngokushesha kulelo zinga. Uma ucindezela inkinobho yokuhlola, i-lever kumele yehle futhi ugesi unqamuke.
p-211.actionItem: Gcina noma yimuphi umsebenzi ovuliwe, cindezela inkinobho yokuhlola ye-RCD ukuze uhlole ukuthi iyanqamuka yini, bese ubiza umsebenzi kagesi uma kungenzeki njalo.

p-212.title: Hlola i-infrared yesilawuli se-AC usebenzisa ikhamera yocingo lwakho
p-212.summary: Uma i-air conditioner yakho ingasinaki isilawuli kude (remote), sebenzisa ikhamera yefoni ukubona ukuthi isilawuli sithumela isignali yini ukuze ugweme ukubiza umkhandi ngokungenasidingo.
p-212.principle: I-LED ye-infrared yesilawuli ithumela amasignali cishe ku-940 nm, engabonakali ngeso, enamandla e-photon $E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{940\ \mathrm{nm}}\approx1.32\ \mathrm{eV}$. Inzwa ye-CMOS yekhamera ithola lokhu kukhanya bese ikubonisa njengokukhanya okugqamile esikrinini.
p-212.example: Khomba isilawuli kude kwilensi yekhamera bese ucindezela inkinobho: ukubaneka okubushelelezi okunsomi noma okumhlophe esikrinini kusho ukuthi isilawuli siyasebenza. Uma kungekho okubonakalayo, shintsha amabhethri (imvamisa amabili e-AAA) noma uhlole isilawuli kuqala. Amanye amakhamera angaphambili anezihlungi ezibuthakathaka ze-infrared futhi azibonisa kangcono.
p-212.actionItem: Vula ikhamera yangaphambili yefoni yakho, cindezela inkinobho yesilawuli kude bese uhlola ukuthi uyakubona yini ukukhanya.

p-213.title: Kungani isisindo sakho sishintsha lapho ilifti iqala futhi ima
p-213.summary: Uzizwa usinda kakhulu lapho ilifti iqala ukukhuphuka futhi ube lula lapho ima, kodwa isisindo somzimba wakho asishintshile: ukusunduza kwaphansi kuwe yikho okushintshile.
p-213.principle: Eliftini esheshisa phezulu ku-$a$, phansi kukuphushela ngamandla ajwayelekile $N=m(g+a)$. Isikali sifunda leli nani, ngakho-ke isisindo esibonakalayo siyashintsha.
p-213.example: Kumuntu ongu-70 kg onesivinini esikhuphukela phezulu esingu-1 m/s², $N=70\times(9.8+1)\approx756\ \mathrm{N}$, ngakho isikali sifunda cishe u-77 kg. Lapho ilifti ekhuphukayo ima ngokusheshisa okuya phansi okungu-1 m/s², izwakala njengengaba ngu-63 kg.
p-213.actionItem: Njengoba ilifti iqala futhi ima, goba amadolo akho kancane bese ubambelela ku-handrail ukuze uhlale uzinzile.

p-214.title: Uhlangothi lwesokudla lwendlela yesiphepho luyingozi kakhulu
p-214.summary: Enkambeni Enyakatho ye-Ikhweytha, imimoya yesiphepho inamandla kakhulu kwesokudla sendlela yaso, ngakho-ke izindawo ezingakwesokudla zendlela kufanele zizilungiselele umonakalo omkhulu.
p-214.principle: Isiphepho sinomoya ojikeleza ngokuphambene newashi $v_{rot}$ kanye nejubane lesiphepho ngokwaso eliya phambili $v_{move}$. Kwesokudla sendlela ayahlanganiswa bese kwesobunxele ayasuswa: $v_{wind}=v_{rot}\pm v_{move}$.
p-214.example: Ngomoya ojikelezayo ongu-40 m/s kanye nejubane lokuya phambili elingu-8 m/s, uhlangothi lwesokudla lubona cishe u-48 m/s kanti uhlangothi lwesobunxele lubona cishe u-32 m/s, futhi njengoba umfutho womoya ulingana nesikwele sejubane, isilinganiso siba ngu-$(48/32)^2=2.25$. Uhlangothi lwesokudla lubizwa ngokuthi isigamu sendilinga esiyingozi.
p-214.actionItem: Ngesikhathi sesiphepho, hlola umzila obikezelwe, futhi uma ungasokudla kwawo, khansela noma uhlehlise uhambo nokuphuma okuya ogwini.

p-215.title: Phinda kabili ijubane lomoya wesiphepho, umthwalo womoya uphindaphindeke kane
p-215.summary: Lapho ijubane lomoya liphindaphindeka kabili, amandla asebenza emafasiteleni nasezinsizeni zokukhangisa aphindaphindeka kane, ngakho-ke awukwazi ukwahlulela isiphepho ngokuzizwa komoya ovunguzayo ojwayelekile.
p-215.principle: Amandla omoya endaweni engu-$A$ atholakala ngo-$F=\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2A$ (kucatshangwa ukuthi i-drag coefficient isondele ku-1), elingana nesikwele sejubane. Ukuminyana komoya ngu-$\rho\approx1.225\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$.
p-215.example: Efasiteleni elingu-1 m², umoya ongu-20 m/s unikeza u-$F\approx245\ \mathrm{N}$ kanti u-40 m/s unikeza cishe u-980 N (cishe u-100 kgf), okuphindaphindeke kane. Amawindi amakhulu engilazi athwala amandla amakhulu kakhulu.
p-215.actionItem: Ngaphambi kwesiphepho, hlola ukuthi izikhiye zamawindi akho zikhiyiwe yini, futhi phakathi naso qhela emafasiteleni.

p-216.title: Uma amafasitela eqaqaza emoyeni onamandla, faka izinto zokuvikela izikhala
p-216.summary: Ifasitela eliqhaqhazayo lisho ukuthi umoya uhambisana nemvamisa yalo yemvelo, ngakho-ke ukuvala izikhala kunciphisa kokubili umsindo nomoya obandayo ongenayo.
p-216.principle: Imvamisa yemvelo yefasitela ithi $f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}$. Lapho imvamisa yomoya ovunguzayo isondele ku-$f$ ifasitela liyadlidliza futhi liqhaqhaze kakhulu. Ukufaka izivikeli kwengeza ukudambisa futhi kuguqule ukuqina okungu-$k$ ukugwema ukudlidliza okuhambisanayo.
p-216.example: Ifasitela elinesinesisindo esingu-8 kg elibanjwe ngo-$k=80\ \mathrm{kN/m}$ line-$f=\frac{1}{2\pi}\sqrt{80000/8}\approx15.9\ \mathrm{Hz}$. Uma izinto zokuvikela ziphinda kabili u-$k$, ikhuphukela cishe ku-22.5 Hz futhi ukudambisa kuyakhula, ngakho ukuxhaphaza kuyancipha. Ukuvala izikhala kubuye kunciphise umoya obandayo ebusika futhi konge amandla okufudumeza.
p-216.actionItem: Namathisela izinsipho zokuvikela zesimo sezulu ezingaba ngu-5-10 mm ezikhaleni zohlaka lwamafasitela ubone ukuthi umsindo wokuxhaphaza uyathula yini.

p-217.title: Kungani ithende lokukhempa liphaphazela futhi liphakama emoyeni
p-217.summary: Umoya osheshayo odlula ngaphezu kwetende wehlisa umfutho bese uphakamisa indwangu, ngakho-ke indlela olibethela ngayo inquma ukuphepha ngezinsuku ezinomoya.
p-217.principle: Ngomthetho ka-Bernoulli, umfutho uyehlela lapho ijubane loketshezi noma lomoya liphezulu, futhi umehluko womfutho phakathi kwezinhlangothi zombili ucishe ube ngu-$\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\rho v^2$. Lowo mehluko yiwo ophakamisa indwangu.
p-217.example: Ku-10 m/s, $\Delta P\approx\frac{1}{2}\times1.225\times10^2\approx61\ \mathrm{Pa}$, ngakho itende elingamamitha angu-4 ngamamitha angu-4 (16 m²) lingathola amandla angafika cishe ku-980 N (cishe u-100 kgf). Ku-20 m/s aphindaphindeka kane.
p-217.actionItem: Lapho uthenga itende hlola inani lezimbobo nendlela eziqiniswe ngayo, futhi lapho ulimisa jika unqenqema oluphansi lubheke emoyeni bese ushayela izikhonkwane zijule nge-engeli.

p-218.title: Qhuba ifeni ye-AC imizuzu engu-10 ngaphambi kokuyicisha
p-218.summary: Ukusebenzisa i-AC kwimodi yefeni cishe imizuzu engu-10 ngaphambi kokuyicisha komisa ingaphakathi futhi kunciphisa iphunga lesikhunta, ngaphandle kwezindleko zikagesi.
p-218.principle: Ngemuva kokupholisa, amathonsi ajiyile asala ekhoyilini yomshini ohwamukisayo. Izinga lokuhwamuka lihambisana nokushoda komfutho womhwamuko $(p_s-p)$, ngakho-ke ukukhipha umoya onomswakama ngokuwuphephetha kwenza yome ngokushesha.
p-218.example: Imodi yefeni idonsa cishe u-40 W, ngakho-ke imizuzu engu-10 isebenzisa u-$40\times\frac{10}{60}\approx6.7\ \mathrm{Wh}$ kuphela. Umswakama osalile uvumela isikhunta namagciwane ukuba kukhule, okubanga iphunga futhi kuholele ezindlekweni zokuhlanza nokusebenza okuncishisiwe.
p-218.actionItem: Namuhla, ngaphambi kokucisha i-AC, sebenzisa imodi yefeni noma yokomisa imizuzu engu-10, noma vula umsebenzi wokuzomisa ngokuzenzakalelayo uma inawo.

p-219.title: Gcina ibhande lakho lesihlalo liboshiwe phakathi nendiza, noma nini lapho uhlezi phansi
p-219.summary: Ukuphazamiseka komoya (turbulence) kufika ngaphandle kwesixwayiso, ngakho-ke ukugcina ibhande lakho lesihlalo liboshiwe njalo lapho uhlezi kuyindlela eqinisekile yokugwema ukulimala.
p-219.principle: Ngomthetho wesibili ka-Newton othi $F=ma$, lapho indiza ishesha kakhulu iqonde phezulu noma phansi, umzimba wakho uzwa ukusheshisa okufanayo. Ngokusheshisa okumile okungu-$\pm1\,g$, isisindo sakho esibonakalayo siba yize noma siphindaphindeke kabili.
p-219.example: Umuntu ongu-70 kg uzwa ushintsho lwamandla olungaba ngu-$0.5\times70\times9.8\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$ ngisho nasekuphazamisekeni komoya okumaphakathi okungu-$\pm0.5\,g$. Ekuphazamisekeni okukhulu okungaphezu kuka-1 g, umuntu ongaboshiwe angaphakanyiswa esihlalweni ashaye uphahla.
p-219.actionItem: Ngesikhathi uhlezi endizeni, gcina ibhande lakho lesihlalo liboshwe liqine phansi ezinqulwini zakho.

p-220.title: Imoto ecwile emanzini ayikwazi ukuvulwa umnyango wayo
p-220.summary: Iminyango yemoto ecwile emanzini ngeke ivuleke ngenxa yomfutho wamanzi, ngakho-ke phuma ngokushesha ngefasitela kunokuzama umnyango.
p-220.principle: Amandla wamanzi emnyango angumfutho wokujula okumaphakathi ophindaphindwe ngendawo (area): $F=\rho g\frac{h}{2}A$. Kuze kube yilapho amazinga wamanzi ngaphakathi nangaphandle elingana, kufanele uphushe ngokumelene nala mandla.
p-220.example: Ngomnyango obubanzi obungu-1.0 m namanzi ajule ngo-0.5 m (indawo engu-0.5 m²), $F=1000\times9.8\times0.25\times0.5\approx1225\ \mathrm{N}$, cishe amakhilogremu-mandla (kgf) angu-125. Amafasitela kagesi angase ayeke ukusebenza maduze. Kufanele uthathe isinyathelo ngokushesha lapho imoto iqala ukucwila, ngaphambi kokuba igcwale.
p-220.actionItem: Gcina isando esiphula amafasitela sesimo esiphuthumayo lapho ungafinyelela khona emotweni yakho, futhi ungalokothi ushayele emgwaqweni ogcwele amanzi.

p-221.title: Khipha izinto zikagesi ezintweni zokuxhuma lapho liduma
p-221.summary: Umbani ungadala amandla kagesi aphakeme kakhulu wesikhashana (i-surge) ezintanjeni ezingacekela phansi omabonakude namakhompyutha, ngakho-ke khipha amapulaki ngaphambi kokuba isiphepho sifike.
p-221.principle: Lapho amandla kagesi wombani eshintsha ngokushesha, adala i-voltage $V=-M\frac{dI}{dt}$ ezindilingeni zezintambo eziseduze ($M$ i-mutual inductance). Lapho ushintsho lusheshe kakhulu, kuvela ama-kilovolts amaningi.
p-221.example: Nge-$M=1\ \mathrm{\mu H}$ kanye ne-$dI/dt=6\times10^9\ \mathrm{A/s}$, $V\approx6\ \mathrm{kV}$, okungaphezu kuka-1.5-2.5 kV cishe izinto zikagesi zasendlini ezingu-220 V ezingakwazi ukukubekezelela. Kodwa ungasondeli kumapulaki ukuze uwakhiphe ngenkathi umbani uqhuma ngqo ngaphezu kwakho.
p-221.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuba isiphepho sifike, khipha i-TV yakho, ikhompyutha kanye ne-router yakho emapulakini noma usebenzise i-surge-protector, futhi ungathinti izintambo noma amadivayisi ngesikhathi sokuduma kwezulu.

p-222.title: Letha izimbiza zezitshalo zasevulandeni ngaphakathi ngaphambi kwesiphepho
p-222.summary: Imbiza yezitshalo ephephethwe noma ewuswe yisiphepho ingabulala umuntu ongaphansi, ngakho-ke letha izimbiza zasevulandeni nezinto ngaphakathi kusengaphambili.
p-222.principle: Umzimba owa usuka ekuphakameni okungu-$h$ uphethe amandla angu-$mgh$, futhi ngaphandle kokudonswa komoya isivinini sawo siba ngu-$v=\sqrt{2gh}$. Ingozi ikhula ngesisindo nokuphakama.
p-222.example: Imbiza engu-5 kg ewa cishe ebangeni elingu-30 m (isitezi se-10) ifinyelela ku-$v\approx24\ \mathrm{m/s}$ (cishe 87 km/h) enamandla acishe abe ngu-$5\times9.8\times30\approx1470\ \mathrm{J}$, efana nento ecishe ibe ngu-3.8 kg ehamba ngejubane elingaba ngu-100 km/h.
p-222.actionItem: Lapho kubikezelwa isiphepho esinamandla, letha izimbiza ezisensimbini yasevulandeni, izindawo zokweneka izingubo kanye nefenisha encane endlini bese ukhiya amafasitela.

p-223.title: Isiyezi sokugula olwandle sincane engxenyeni ephansi, ephakathi nendawo yomkhumbi
p-223.summary: Izingxenye eziphakathi nendawo nezingezansi zomkhumbi zinyakaza kancane, ngakho-ke ukugula olwandle kuba ngcono lapho. Khetha ikhabethe noma isihlalo kuleyo ndawo.
p-223.principle: Umkhumbi unyakaza uzungeze indawo eseduze nenkaba yawo, ngakho-ke ubukhulu bokunyakaza endaweni buhambisana nebanga lawo ukusuka enkabeni yokujikeleza ($s\approx r\theta$). Ukunyakaza okubonwa ngamehlo akho okuphikisana nalokho okuzwiwa yizinzwa zangaphakathi zendlebe (vestibular system) kubangela ukugula olwandle.
p-223.example: Ekuzuleni okungu-$\pm2^\circ$ (0.035 rad), umnsalo webanga elingu-40 m ukusuka phakathi unyakaza cishe ngo-$\pm1.4\ \mathrm{m}$, kanti indawo engu-5 m ukusuka phakathi inyakaza cishe ngo-$\pm0.17\ \mathrm{m}$ kuphela, umehluko ophindaphindwe ka-8. Izitezi eziphakeme nazo ziyantengantenga kakhulu.
p-223.actionItem: Lapho ubhukha umkhumbi, khetha ikhabethe eliphansi n经历了naphakathi nendawo yomkhumbi, futhi uma usukhwile, bheka lapho umkhathizwe uhlangana khona nolwandle.

p-224.title: Izinkanyezi ezicijile zivela ngemva kokuba amehlo akho ejwayele ubumnyama imizuzu engu-20
p-224.summary: Ukusuka endaweni ekhanyayo, amehlo akho adinga cishe imizuzu engama-20-30 ukuze ajwayele ubumnyama, futhi kuze kube yileso sikhathi amameteor afiphele kunzima ukuwabona.
p-224.principle: Ebumnyameni, amangqamuzana e-rod aya ngokuya ezwela kakhulu njengoba i-photopigment yawo ivuseleleka, futhi izinga lokukhanya elidingekayo ukuze ubone lehla kakhulu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ukujwayela ngokugcwele kwe-rod kuthatha cishe imizuzu engu-20-30, futhi ukukhanya kwesikrini sefoni kuyakuphazamisa lokho.
p-224.example: Uma usujwayele ubumnyama, ukuzwela ekukhanyeni kuphakeme cishe ngokuphindwe ka-10,000 noma ngaphezulu kunalapho kukhanya. Imvula yezinkanyezi ze-Perseid ifika esicongweni cishe ngomhlaka-12-13 ku-Agasti minyaka yonke, futhi ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka esimnyama esinokukhanya okuncane kwenyanga noma kwedolobha kungabonakala inqwaba ngehora.
p-224.actionItem: Lapho uphuma uyobuka imvula yezinkanyezi, hlala endaweni emnyama kakhulu ongayithola, ungayisebenzisi ifoni yakho imizuzu engu-20 bese ubuka kabanzi esibhakabhakeni.

p-225.title: Kungani isikrini singafundeki ngaphandle emini: ukukhanya nokukhanya okubonakaliswayo
p-225.summary: Isikrini asifundeki lapho kukhanya kakhulu ngaphandle hhayi ngoba sithiphiswe ukukhanya kwaso, kodwa ngoba ukukhanya kwelanga okubonakala ebusweni baso kuhlula ukukhanya esikukhiphayo.
p-225.principle: Isilinganiso sokuqhathanisa sithi $CR=\frac{L+L_a}{L_a}$, lapho u-$L$ kuwukukhanya kwesikrini (nit) kanti u-$L_a=\frac{RE}{\pi}$ kuwukukhanya kwendawo ezungezile okubonakaliswa ebusweni ($R$ ukukhombisa, $E$ ukukhanyisa). Ukukhanya okubonakaliswayo okunamandla kuphoqa isilinganiso sokuqhathanisa siye ku-1.
p-225.example: Elangeni eliqondile elino-$E=100{,}000\ \mathrm{lx}$ nokukhombisa $R=2\%$, $L_a\approx637\ \mathrm{nit}$. Isikrini esingu-800 nit sinikeza $CR\approx(800+637)/637\approx2.3$:1, cishe asifundeki, kanti egumbini elingu-300 lx $L_a\approx1.9\ \mathrm{nit}$ kanti i-$CR$ iba ngamakhulu.
p-225.actionItem: Ezinsukwini ezikhanyayo, setha ukukhanya kwesikrini sibe sezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu noma ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese uvika isikrini ngomzimba wakho noma ngesandla.

p-226.title: Kungani i-app yakho yekhampasi yemephu ikhomba endleleni okungeyona ngenkathi usohambweni
p-226.summary: Ikhampasi yefoni ifunda amandla kazibuthe omhlaba abuthakathaka, ngakho ozibuthe noma izinsimbi eziseduze ziyiphazamisa kalula indlela ekhomba ngayo.
p-226.principle: Amandla kazibuthe woMhlaba acishe abe ngu-$50\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ kuphela (e-Korea), ngakho lapho kunezelwa amandla kazibuthe aphazamisayo $B_{int}$ avela ezintweni ezingozibuthe eziseduze, iphutha lokuqondisa liba ngu-$\theta\approx\arctan\frac{B_{int}}{B_{earth}}$.
p-226.example: Ngisho no-$10\ \mu\mathrm{T}$ owengeziwe ovela kukhava enozibuthe noma isibambi sefoni emotweni unikeza iphutha elingu-$\arctan(10/50)\approx11^\circ$. Futhi i-Korea ine-magnetic declination ecishe ibe ngu-8°, ngakho umehluko phakathi kwenyakatho kazibuthe nenyakatho yangempela kumele ucatshangelwe.
p-226.actionItem: Uma i-app yakho yemephu ikhombisa isiqondiso esingajwayelekile, zungezisa ifoni yakho ngendlela yesibalo u-8 ukuze ulungise ikhampasi futhi uyigcine kude nozibuthe kanye nensimbi.

p-227.title: Kuyo yonke i-100 m oyikhuphukayo, umoya uba makhaza cishe ngama-degree angu-0.65
p-227.summary: Intaba ephakeme ibanda kakhulu kunezigodi ngosuku olufanayo, ngakho ukugqokela ukushisa kwasesigodini kukushiya ugodola esiqongweni.
p-227.principle: Izinga lokushisa lomoya lehla nokuphakama kwendawo ngesilinganiso sokwehla esivamile esingu-$\Gamma\approx6.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C/km}$. Ngomehluko wokuphakama $\Delta z$ izinga lokushisa lishintsha ngo-$\Delta T=-\Gamma\Delta z$.
p-227.example: Uma kungu-30 °C ekuqaleni kokungama-100 m, isiqongo se-Cheonwangbong yase-Jirisan (1915 m) siba ngu-$30-0.65\times18.15\approx18.2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Umoya wenza kuzwakale kubanda kakhulu.
p-227.actionItem: Ngaphambi kohambo lwasentabeni, hlola isibikezelo sezinga lokushisa ekuphakameni kwesiqongo bese upakishe ijazi elilula elivikela umoya.

p-228.title: Ubusuku basezindaweni ezishisayo: ukushisa okugcinwe yizindonga emini kuphuma ebusuku
p-228.summary: Ubusuku basezindaweni ezishisayo buzizwa bushisa ngoba ukushisa okugcinwe ezindongeni naphansi emini kudedelwa ebusuku, ngakho vimba ilanga emini bese ungenisa umoya ebusuku.
p-228.principle: Impahla enesisindo sokushisa (thermal mass) efana nokhonkolo igcina ukushisa okungu-$Q=mc\Delta T$ lapho izinga layo lokushisa likhuphuka futhi ikudedele lapho igumbi liphola. Isisindo esikhulu nokushisa okuqondile kusho ukugcina okwengeziwe.
p-228.example: Udonga lukakhonkolo olujiyile ngo-20 cm, olungu-10 m² (cishe 4800 kg, ukushisa okuqondile cishe 0.88 kJ/(kg·K)) olufudumala ngo-5 °C lugcina $Q\approx4800\times0.88\times5\approx21\ \mathrm{MJ}$ (cishe 5.9 kWh). Lokho kushisa kungena kancane egumbini ubusuku bonke.
p-228.actionItem: Emini, vala amakhethini noma amaphuphu emafasiteleni anelanga, futhi lapho sekubanda ngaphandle kunangaphakathi ebusuku, vula amafasitela ukuze kungene umoya, bese usetha i-AC ibe ku-26-27 °C.

p-229.title: Ukugeza ngamanzi afudumele amahora angu-1-2 ngaphambi kokulala
p-229.summary: Ukugeza ngamanzi afudumele amahora angu-1-2 ngaphambi kokulala kusiza umzimba ukuba ukhiphe ukushisa, okuvumela ukwehla kwezinga lokushisa okusiza ukuba ulale masinyane.
p-229.principle: Amanzi afudumele avula imithambo yegazi engaphandle, ngakho ukushisa kuphuma ngesikhumba futhi izinga lokushisa elingaphakathi liyawa: $q = hA(T_s - T_a)$.
p-229.example: Ukugeza kwemizuzu engu-10 ngamanzi acishe abe ngu-40°C okwenziwa amahora angu-1-2 ngaphambi kokulala kubikwa ezifundweni ukuthi kufinyeza isikhathi sokulala cishe ngemizuzu engu-10 ngokwesilinganiso.
p-229.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku, geza imizuzu engu-10 ngamanzi acishe abe ngu-40°C, emahoreni angu-1-2 ngaphambi kokuba ulale.

p-230.title: I-plunger isebenza ngokudonsa, hhayi ngokusunduza kuphela
p-230.summary: I-plunger isebenza kangcono lapho inkomishi ivalwe ngci ngaphansi kwamanzi bese idonswa ngamandla, okuhlambulula ukuminyana.
p-230.principle: Umehluko wengcindezi kuyo yonke inkomishi udala amandla: $F = \Delta P \cdot A$. Amanzi, hhayi umoya, adlulisa leyo ngcindezi ngokugcwele.
p-230.example: Ngebanga lenkomishi elingu-$0.01\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kanye no-$\Delta P = 5\ \mathrm{kPa}$, cishe amandla angu-50 N (cishe 5 kgf) asebenza kulokho okuminyene.
p-230.actionItem: Namuhla, vala inkomishi ye-plunger ngamanzi, uyiqinise, bese ucindezela kancane bese udonsa ngamandla izikhathi ezingu-10 (ungalinge uyihlanganise namakhemikhali okuvula amapayipi).

p-231.title: Imicu yesikulufu ecwebile ingena ngamandla amancane
p-231.summary: Lapho igebe phakathi kwemicu lincane (pitch), isikulufu sandisa amandla kakhulu, ngakho imicu ecwebile ifanele ukhuni oluqinile.
p-231.principle: Inzuzo efanelekile yomshini yesikulufu ingu-$MA = \dfrac{2\pi r}{p}$ ($r$: irediyasi yesikuludilayiva, $p$: i-pitch).
p-231.example: Ngo-$r = 2\ \mathrm{mm}$, i-pitch engu-1.0 mm inikeza $MA \approx 12.6$ futhi i-pitch engu-0.5 mm inikeza $MA \approx 25$, ingxenye yamandla (ngaphandle kokubala ukungqubuzana).
p-231.actionItem: Namuhla, khetha isikulufu esine-pitch ecwebile sokhuni oluqinile bese ubhoboza imbobo yokuhlola kuqala.

p-232.title: Amabhande okuzivocavoca ashintsha ukumelana ngobude bokwelulwa
p-232.summary: Ibhande lokuzivocavoca lidonsela emuva ngokulingana cishe nokuthi leluleke kangakanani, ngakho-ke ubude bokwelulwa obungashintshi bugcina amandla okuzivocavoca engaguquki.
p-232.principle: Umthetho ka-Hooke: $F = kx$ (isilinganiso, ngoba irabha alilandeli umugqa oqondile lapho seluleke kakhulu).
p-232.example: Ibhande elino-$k = 100\ \mathrm{N/m}$ linikeza cishe u-30 N lapho leluleke ngo-0.3 m kanye cishe no-60 N lapho leluleke ngo-0.6 m.
p-232.actionItem: Ekuzivocavoceni kwanamuhla ngebhande, phawula ibanga lezandla zakho ukuze welule ngobude obufanayo isikhathi ngasinye.

p-233.title: Umoya opholile kungazelelwe ngaphambi kwemvula usho ukuthi funa indawo yokukhosela
p-233.summary: Ukubhuvuza komoya obandayo okuzumayo ngaphambi nje kwesiphepho kuwumoya obandayo ovela phansi esiphephweni sokuduma, okuxwayisa ngokuthi umbani nemimoya enamandla kuseduze.
p-233.principle: Umoya obandayo uminyene kakhulu, ngakho uyazika bese usakazeka: $\rho = \dfrac{P}{R_s T}$.
p-233.example: Ku-1 atm, ukuminyana komoya cishe kungu-$1.165\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ ku-30°C kanye no-$1.204\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ ku-20°C, cishe usinda ngo-3%, kanti ukubhuvuza kungafinyelela ku-60-90 km/h.
p-233.actionItem: Uma uzwa umoya opholile obandayo ungaphandle futhi uzwe ukuduma kwezulu, ngena ngaphakathi esakhiweni noma emotweni ngokushesha.

p-234.title: I-AC yemoto: qala ngomoya wangaphandle, bese uyijikeleza uma sekupholile
p-234.summary: Khipha umoya oshisayo emotweni ngokuvula amafasitela kuqala, bese ushintshela ekujikelezeni komoya wangaphakathi uma sekupholile ukunciphisa umthwalo wokupholisa.
p-234.principle: Umthwalo wokupholisa ukhula nokuhamba komoya kanye nomehluko wokushisa: $\dot{Q} = \dot{m}\, c_p\, \Delta T$.
p-234.example: Ngo-$\dot{m} = 0.1\ \mathrm{kg/s}$ kanye no-$c_p = 1.005\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$, ukupholisa umoya wangaphandle kusuka ku-35°C kuya ku-22°C kuthatha cishe u-1.3 kW, kanti umoya ojikelezayo ongu-25°C uthatha cishe u-0.3 kW.
p-234.actionItem: Namuhla, vula amafasitela umzuzu ongu-1 ngemva kokungena, bese ushintshela ekujikelezeni komoya uma sekupholile (vuselela ngomoya wangaphandle ngezikhathi ezithile ohambweni olude).

p-235.title: Izithombe zasebusuku ezingantengantengi ngomthetho ka-1/ubude bokugxila
p-235.summary: Lapho uthwebula ngesandla, ukugcina isikhathi se-shutter sisifushane kunokuphambana kobude bokugxila kunciphisa kakhulu ukufiphala kokuxhawuzela kwesandla.
p-235.principle: Umthetho wesithupha: $t \le \dfrac{1}{f}$ (imizuzwana, lapho u-$f$ ewubude bokugxila obulingana ne-full-frame ngama-mm).
p-235.example: Ilensi engu-50 mm ihlala iphephile cishe ku-1/50 s noma ngokushesha futhi ilensi engu-200 mm ku-1/200 s noma ngokushesha; ekukhanyeni okufiphele, nyusa i-ISO noma usekele izandla zakho.
p-235.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku, sekela izindololwane zakho emzimbeni wakho noma odongeni bese usebenzisa isibali sikhathi semizuzwana emi-2 ukuthatha isithombe sasebusuku.

p-236.title: Umlilo wamathala uvutha kangcono uma izingodo zibekwe zime phezulu
p-236.summary: Ukuncika kwezingodo zime njenge-teepee kudonsa umoya usuka ngezansi ngomphumela kashimula, ukuze umlilo ubambe kahle.
p-236.principle: Umfutho wokudonsa ovela kukholomu yegesi eshisayo: $\Delta P \approx \rho g h \dfrac{\Delta T}{T}$.
p-236.example: Ngo-$h = 0.5\ \mathrm{m}$, igesi eseceleni komlilo eku-600 K nomoya oku-300 K, $\Delta P \approx 1.2 \times 9.8 \times 0.5 \times \dfrac{300}{600} \approx 3\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-236.actionItem: Emlilweni wakho olandelayo, ncikisa izingodo ezincane zime njenge-teepee, gcina amanzi eduze, futhi ungawubasi lapho imililo ivinjelwe khona.

p-237.title: Iqhwa elincibilikayo alilenzi ingilazi ichichime
p-237.summary: Iqhwa elintantayo alilushintshi neze izinga lamanzi lapho lincibilika, ngakho ingilazi egcwele phama ayichichimi.
p-237.principle: Iqhwa elintantayo lisusa amanzi alingana nesisindo salo: $V_{\mathrm{d}} = \dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$, kanti namanzi ancibilikile athatha indawo engu-$\dfrac{m}{\rho_w}$.
p-237.example: U-90 g weqhwa ususa u-90 mL wamanzi (cishe ngu-$8\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ kuphela kuwo acishe abe ngu-$98\ \mathrm{cm^3}$ ophumayo ngaphandle), futhi lincibilika libe ngu-90 mL, ngakho izinga lihlala lingashintshile.
p-237.actionItem: Namuhla, gcwalisa ingilazi ize iphuphume ngeqhwa namanzi bese ubukela izinga njengoba lincibilika (ungalicindezeli iqhwa phansi).

p-238.title: Hlola ukuthi igeji yesicimi-mlilo sakho isengxenyeni eluhlaza
p-238.summary: Isicimi-mlilo esigcina umfutho silungele ukusetshenziswa kuphela lapho inaliti yegeji yaso isendaweni eluhlaza (okujwayelekile okungu-0.7-0.98 MPa).
p-238.principle: Umfutho ungamandla endaweni ngayinye: $P = \dfrac{F}{A}$. Uma igesi ivuza, umfutho wesitsha uyehla futhi ukufutha kuyenqena.
p-238.example: Okujwayelekile okungu-0.7-0.98 MPa kucishe kulingane no-7-9.8 bar (izikhathi ezingu-7 kuye kwezingu-10 zomfutho womoya); inaliti ebonisa kokubomvu noma eduze kukaziro isho ukuthi kudingeka lishintshwe noma ligcwaliswe kabusha.
p-238.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ukuthi igeji yesicimi-mlilo sasekhaya noma semoto yakho isengxenyeni eluhlaza, uphinde uhlole nephini lokuphepha kanye nepayipi.

p-239.title: I-seesaw iyalingana lapho umgibeli osindayo ehlala eduze nendawo yokujika
p-239.summary: Abagibeli abanezinsindo ezahlukene bangalinganisa i-seesaw uma osindayo ehlala eduze nendawo yokujika (pivot).
p-239.example: Ingane enesisindo esingu-30 kg eqhele ngo-2 m ukusuka phakathi iyalingana nengane enesisindo esingu-60 kg eqhele ngo-1 m, njengoba $30 \times 2 = 60 \times 1$.
p-239.actionItem: Enkundleni yokudlala namuhla, zama ukushintsha izindawo zokuhlala ukuze uthole indawo yokulingana, futhi nehle ngamunye ngendlela ephephile.

p-240.title: Kungani amabhuloho nemigwaqo inezikhala emalungeni ayo
p-240.summary: Insimbi nokhonkolo kuyanwebeka lapho kushisa, ngakho amabhuloho nemigwaqo kunezikhala zokunwebeka emalungeni akho.
p-240.example: Ucezu lwensimbi olungamamitha ayi-100 ($\alpha \approx 12 \times 10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$) olusuka ku--10°C luya ku-40°C luyakhula ngo-$\Delta L \approx 0.06\ \mathrm{m}$, cishe ngo-60 mm.
p-240.actionItem: Namuhla, bheka izikhala zokunwebeka lapho uwela ibhuloho noma indlela yabahamba ngezinyawo, futhi ungalokothi uhlohle amatshe noma udoti kuzo.

p-241.title: Amabhethri ethoshi: ochungechungeni (series) ayakhanya kakhulu, ngokuhambisana (parallel) ahlala isikhathi eside
p-241.summary: Amabhethri ahlelwe ngoxhaxha anezela i-voltage ukuze kukhanye kakhudlwana; ngokuhambisana, i-voltage ihlala ifana futhi amandla okugcina (capacity) ayanezela, kodwa amandla ewonke ayalingana.
p-241.principle: Uchungechunge: $V = V_1 + V_2$. Ngokuhambisana: $Q = Q_1 + Q_2$. Amandla $E = VQ$.
p-241.example: Amangqamuzana amabili angu-1.5 V, 2500 mAh anikeza u-3 V ku-2.5 Ah ochungechungeni noma u-1.5 V ku-5 Ah ngokuhambisana, womabili cishe angu-7.5 Wh.
p-241.actionItem: Namuhla, shintsha amabhethri ethoshi wonke ngesikhathi esisodwa usebenzise uhlobo olufanayo nezinga elifanayo lokushaja, futhi ungalokothi uxube amadala namasha.

p-242.title: Isivikelo somoya sinciphisa umsindo womoya kumavidiyo asolwandle
p-242.summary: Isivikelo somoya esinoboya phezu kombhobho sihlakaza ukuyaluza komoya futhi sinciphisa kakhulu umsindo womoya.
p-242.principle: Ukuqala kokuyaluza kulawulwa inombolo ye-Reynolds: $\mathrm{Re} = \dfrac{\rho v D}{\mu}$.
p-242.example: Emoyeni onejubane elingu-5 m/s nombhobho ongu-1 cm, $\mathrm{Re} \approx 3{,}300$, kanti isembozo esinoboya sinciphisa umsindo womoya cishe ngo-10-20 dB.
p-242.actionItem: Namuhla olwandle, faka isivikelo somoya esinoboya kumbhobho wakho bese uwuqondisa kude nomoya.

p-243.title: Kungani izikrini zokuthinta zingasebenzi kahle ngezandla ezimanzi
p-243.summary: Amaconsi amanzi ayawadlulisa amandla kagesi futhi asakazeke esikrinini, ashintshe i-capacitance kuma-electrode amaningi futhi abangele ukuthinta okungamanga.
p-243.principle: I-Capacitance: $C = \dfrac{\varepsilon A}{d}$ (i-relative permittivity yamanzi cishe ingu-80, kanti eyomoya icishe ibe ngu-1).
p-243.example: Iconsi lingaveza ushintsho lwe-capacitance olufana nolwengxenye yomunwe, ngakho izinkinga eziningi zesikrini esimanzi akusona isici sangempela sokonakala.
p-243.actionItem: Uma isikrini sakho singasebenzi kahle namuhla, sula izandla zakho nesikrini ngendwangu ngaphambi kokucabanga ukuthi sidinga ukulungiswa.

p-244.title: Vikela isitofu sasekamu emoyeni, kodwa ungalokothi usonge ikhanhista yegesi
p-244.summary: Isivikelo somoya sinciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa esitofini nasembizeni, kodwa ukusonga ikhanhista yegesi kungayenza ishise kakhulu futhi kuyingozi.
p-244.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa nge-convection: $q = hA\Delta T$ ($h$ iyenyuka nomoya).
p-244.example: Endaweni yembiza engu-$0.05\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kanye no-$\Delta T = 80\ \mathrm{K}$, ukukhulisa u-$h$ kusuka ku-10 kuya ku-30 $\mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$ kwandisa ukulahleka kusuka ku-40 W kuya ku-120 W (ngokomfanekiso).
p-244.actionItem: Lapho upheka ngaphandle namuhla, beka isivikelo somoya sizungeze imbiza nesitofu kuphela, gcina ikhanhista ngaphandle kwaso, futhi ungalokothi usebenzise isitofu ngaphakathi etendeni.

p-245.title: Kungani inkungu yakheka ekuseni ngokuntwela kokusa kwekwindla okucwebile
p-245.summary: Ebusuku obucwebile, obungenamoya umhlaba upholisa ngokukhipha imisebe kuze kufike lapho umoya ufinyelela khona eqophelweni lamazolo, bese kwakheka inkungu.
p-245.principle: Ukuqagela kweqophelo lamazolo: $T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100 - \mathrm{RH}}{5}$ (°C, RH nge-%).
p-245.example: Nge-20°C nomswakama ongu-70% ntambama, $T_d \approx 14$°C, ngakho-ke uma ubusuku buphola bufinyelele ku-12°C umoya uyasutha bese kwakheka inkungu.
p-245.actionItem: Uma ushayela enkungwini namhlanje ekuseni, sebenzisa izibani eziphansi nezibani zenkungu bese ushiya ibanga elikhudlwana kunokujwayelekile phakathi kwezimoto.

p-246.title: Khetha amagiya ebhayisikili ngejubane lokunyakazisa imilenze, hhayi ngamandla emisipha
p-246.summary: Emandleni afanayo, igiya elikuvumela ukuthi ujikeleze amaphedali ngo-70-90 rpm lehlisa umthwalo emadolweni akho.
p-246.example: Ukuze ukhiqize cishe ama-210 W udinga cishe ama-33 N·m e-torque ngo-60 rpm kodwa cishe ama-22 N·m kuphela ngo-90 rpm.
p-246.actionItem: Ohambweni lwanamuhla, shintsha amagiya ukuze ugcine i-cadence yakho ku-70-90 rpm.

p-247.title: Izindawo ezingajulile zamagagasi zivuleka ngemuva kwemizuzu engaba ngu-50 nsuku zonke
p-247.summary: Inyanga ithatha imizuzu eyengeziwe engaba ngu-50 usuku ngalunye ukuze iphinde izungeze, ngakho izikhathi zamagagasi zihlehliselwa emuva ngemizuzu engaba ngu-50 nsuku zonke.
p-247.principle: Usuku lwenyanga luyi-$T_{\mathrm{lunar}} \approx 24\ \mathrm{h}\ 50\ \mathrm{min}$ futhi kukhona amagagasi amabili ngosuku lwenyanga, ngakho-ke amagagasi eza ngokwehlukana ngamahora angaba ngu-12 nemizuzu engama-25.
p-247.example: Uma igagasi eliphansi lingu-10:00 namhlanje, lizoba cishe ngo-10:50 kusasa futhi, ezinsukwini eziyisithupha ezilandelayo, sekudlule imizuzu engu-$6 \times 50 = 300$, lizoba cishe ngo-15:00.
p-247.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuya endaweni engajulile yolwandle, hlola ishadi lamagagasi bese ubeka isikhathi ozobuyela ngaso ngaphambi kokuba igagasi libuye.

p-248.title: Umsiki womoya (vacuum sealer) uvumela umfutho womoya ukuthi wenze umsebenzi wokucindezela
p-248.summary: I-vacuum sealer isusa umoya esikhwameni ukuze umfutho womoya wangaphandle ucindezele iphakethe liqine ekudleni.
p-248.example: Esikhwameni esingu-$0.03\ \mathrm{m^2}$ esinomehluko womfutho ongu-80 kPa, cishe ama-2.4 kN (cishe ama-240 kgf) asatshalaliswa kuyo yonke indawo engaphezulu.
p-248.actionItem: Namuhla, phatha izimpahla ezomile noma izingxenye zokubeka efrijini ngomshini we-vacuum, kodwa qhubeka nokufaka ukudla okonakalayo efrijini noma endaweni ebandayo.

p-249.title: Isitshisi sipheka ngokushesha ngokushisa kokujiya kwesisi (condensation heat)
p-249.summary: Isisi sijiyela ekudleni bese sikhipha ukushisa okukhulu okufihlekile (latent heat), sithumele ukushisa ngokushesha okukhulu kunamanzi abilayo.
p-249.principle: Ukushisa okukhululwa lapho isisi sijiyela: $Q = mL$ ($L \approx 2260\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$).
p-249.example: Ukujiyisa ama-50 g esisi kukhulula cishe ama-113 kJ, cishe ngokuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-6.8 kune-16.7 kJ ekhululwa ngama-50 g amanzi angu-100°C apholela ku-20°C.
p-249.actionItem: Lapho ushisa ukudla ngesisi namuhla, gcina isivalo sivaliwe, futhi usiphakamisele kude nobuso bakho ukugwema ukushiswa yisisi.

p-250.title: Ungaqagela izinga lokushisa ngokulalela ukukhala kwezinyekevu (crickets)
p-250.summary: Izinyekevu zikhala ngokushesha lapho kufudumele, ngakho-ke ukubala ukukhala kwazo kunikeza izinga lokushisa eliqagelwe.
p-250.example: Ukukhala okungu-100 ngomzuzu kunikeza cishe i-65°F (cishe i-18°C) kanti okungu-160 kunikeza cishe i-80°F (cishe i-27°C), okuyisilinganiso esiqagelwayo esihluka ngohlobo lwesinambuzane.
p-250.actionItem: Kusihlwa namhlanje, bala ukukhala kwenyekevu imizuzwana engu-15, uphindaphinde ngo-4, bese ulinganisela izinga lokushisa usebenzisa ifomula.

p-251.title: Kungani ukushona kwelanga kubomvu
p-251.summary: Lapho ilanga liphansi, ukukhanya kuhamba ibanga elide emoyeni, umbala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka uhlakazeka kuqala, bese kusala obomvu.
p-251.example: Oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (450 nm) luhlakazeka ngokuphindwe $(700/450)^4 \approx 5.9$ ngaphezulu kunobomvu (700 nm), ngakho luphuma kuqala.
p-251.actionItem: Buka imibala yesibhakabhaka lapho lishona ilanga namuhla, kodwa ungalokothi ubheke ilanga ngqo noma uqondise ikhamera noma amabhonokhula kulo.

p-252.title: Inyanga egcwele ibukeka njengohlamvu lwemali olubanjelwe kude
p-252.summary: Inyanga egcwele incane kunendlela ebonakala ngayo, incane kangangokuthi uhlamvu lwelayisi olubanjwe ngobude bengalo lungayimboza.
p-252.example: Uhlamvu lwemali olungu-24 mm oluqhele ngamamitha angaba ngu-2.7 lunobukhulu be-engeli obufanayo, futhi ngobude bengalo obungaba ngu-60 cm into ecishe ibe ngu-5 mm ububanzi imboza iNyanga.
p-252.actionItem: Lapho inyanga egcwele iphuma namuhla, yelula ingalo yakho bese uyimboza ngohlamvu olulodwa lwelayisi.

p-253.title: Umsindo wokuminyana kwethrafikhi ngamaholide uqala ngokuthinta ibhuleki kanye
p-253.summary: Emgwaqweni omatsheketshe, imoto eyodwa ebhulekayo yandisa ukulibaziseka kokusabela ngemuva kwayo bese igagasi lokuminyana libuyela emuva.
p-253.principle: Ibanga lokuma: $d = v\,t_r + \dfrac{v^2}{2a}$; igagasi lokuminyana livame ukuhamba libuyela emuva ngesivinini esingaba ngu-15-20 km/h.
p-253.example: Ku-100 km/h (cishe 27.8 m/s), ukusabela komzuzwana o-1 kuthatha amamitha angu-27.8 ngaphambi kokuba ngisho nokubhuleka kuqale, futhi ukugcina ibanga lemizuzwana engu-3 ngokushayela kahle kungonga cishe u-5-10% kaphethiloli.
p-253.actionItem: Ohambweni lwanamuhla, gcina ibanga lemizuzwana engu-2-3 bese udedela i-throttle kusenesikhathi ukuze ubhuleke kancane.

p-254.title: Qhela okungenani ngamamitha angu-15 kumshini wokugunda utshani (brush cutter)
p-254.summary: Isihloko se-blade yomshini wokugunda sihamba ngesivinini esikhulu kangangokuthi amatshe andiza njengezinhlamvu zesibhamu, ngakho-ke gcina wonke umuntu eqhele ngamamitha angaphezu kuka-15 endaweni yokusebenza.
p-254.principle: Isivinini sesihloko se-blade: $v = \omega r$; ibanga lokuphonswa: $R = \dfrac{v^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}$.
p-254.example: Nge-blade engu-0.115 m radius ku-6,500 rpm ($\omega \approx 681\ \mathrm{rad/s}$), $v \approx 78\ \mathrm{m/s}$, cishe 280 km/h.
p-254.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokugunda ngomshini wokugunda utshani namuhla, qinisekisa ukuthi abekho abantu noma izimoto ebangeni elingaphakathi kuka-15 m futhi ugqoke izivikeli zamehlo nobuso.

p-255.title: Bheka izinga lokufudumala lesikhwama sokulala (sleeping bag) kanye ne-R-value yecansi
p-255.summary: Ebusuku ukushisa okuningi kulahlekela emhlabathini kunasemoyeni, ngakho-ke hlola kokubili izinga lokufudumala lesikhwama kanye ne-R-value yecansi.
p-255.example: I-foam mat engu-2 cm ene-$k = 0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ ine-$R \approx 0.57\ \mathrm{m^2 K/W}$ (cishe 3.2 kumayunithi e-US R-value), futhi i-R-value engu-3 noma ngaphezulu iyisiqondiso esivamile sokukhempa ekwindla.
p-255.actionItem: Lapho ukhetha izinto zokukhempa namuhla, hlola ukuthi izinga lokufudumala lesikhwama lingaphansi noma lilingana namakhaza alindelekile nokuthi i-R-value yecansi ingu-3 noma ngaphezulu.

p-256.title: I-barometer yefoni ingafunda izinguquko zokuphakama
p-256.summary: Amafoni amaningi anenzwa yokucindezela (pressure sensor), ngakho-ke izinguquko zokucindezela zingalinganisa ukuthi ukhuphuke noma wehle kangakanani.
p-256.principle: $\Delta P \approx -\rho g\,\Delta h$; eduze nezinga lolwandle, ukwehla cishe kuka-1 hPa = cishe ukukhuphuka ngo-8 m.
p-256.example: Nge-$\rho = 1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, njalo ngo-8 m kungu-$1.2 \times 9.8 \times 8 \approx 94\ \mathrm{Pa} \approx 0.94\ \mathrm{hPa}$, ngakho isakhiwo esinezitezi ezingu-30 (cishe 90 m) sinokucindezela okuphansi cishe ngo-11 hPa phezulu.
p-256.actionItem: Namuhla, vula uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-barometer bese uqhathanisa ukufundwa phansi nasesitezi esiphezulu (linganisa ngokushesha, ngoba isimo sezulu naso siguqula ukucindezela).

p-257.title: Bophela amashalofu ezincwadi neziqandisi phansi ngenxa yokuzamazama komhlaba
p-257.summary: Ifenisha ende, ewumngcingo iyawa lapho kukhona ukuzamazama okuncane, ngakho ukuyibophela odongeni kuyigcina iphephile.
p-257.principle: Isimo sokuwa: $mg\,\dfrac{b}{2} < m a\, h_c$, okuwukuthi $a > g\,\dfrac{b}{2 h_c}$ ($b$: ububanzi, $h_c$: ukuphakama kwenkaba yesisindo).
p-257.example: Ishalofu lezincwadi eliphakeme ngo-1.8 m ($h_c = 0.9\ \mathrm{m}$) elinokushona phakathi okungu-0.3 m liwa ku-$a > 0.3/1.8\, g \approx 0.17\,g$.
p-257.actionItem: Namuhla, vikela ifenisha ende kusigxobo sodonga ngama-L-bracket bese ubeka izinto ezisindayo emashalofini aphansi.

p-258.title: Kungani isigingci siphuma kushuni lapho amazinga okushisa eshintsha kakhulu
p-258.summary: Lapho izinga lokushisa lishintsha, ukudonseka kwentambo kuyashintsha bese iphimbo liyaphuma, ngakho lungisa ushuni ngaphambi kokudlala.
p-258.example: Ukwehla ngo-1% ekudonsekeni kwehlisa i-frequency cishe ngo-0.5%, ngakho inothi le-440 Hz lehla cishe ngo-2.2 Hz (cishe amasenti angu-9), okungaba yinto ebonakalayo.
p-258.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokudlala namuhla, phinda ulungise ushuni nge-tuner (naphinde futhi ngemva kokuba isigingci sesijwayele izinga lokushisa).

p-259.title: Tshekela ngaphakathi kwejika enkundleni yokugijima
p-259.summary: Ukutshekela ngaphakathi kwejika kuvumela ukungqubuzana ukuba kunikeze amandla e-centripetal ukuze ujike ngaphandle kokushelela.
p-259.example: Ukugijima ngo-14.4 km/h (4 m/s) ujikeleza ijika eline-radius engu-20 m kunikeza $\tan\theta \approx 16/196 \approx 0.082$, okungukutsheka okucishe kube ngu-4.7°.
p-259.actionItem: Ejikeni namuhla, yehlisa isivinini kusenesikhathi bese utshekela kancane ngaphakathi kusukela emaqakaleni njengoba ujika.

p-260.title: Imikhondo yomusi yezindiza ehlala isikhathi eside ikhombisa umoya onomswakama phezulu
p-260.summary: Uma umkhondo womusi wendiza (contrail) ungashabalali ngokushesha futhi ukhula, umoya ophezulu unomswakama owanele ukuba ugcwale ngokweqile maqondana neqhwa.
p-260.principle: Umswakama ohlobene maqondana neqhwa: $\mathrm{RH}_i = \dfrac{e}{e_i} \times 100\%$; umkhondo womusi uhlala lapho $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$.
p-260.example: Cishe ku--40°C, ukucindezela komhwamuko wokugcwala phezu kweqhwa kungaba ngu-68% kuphela kwalokho okuphezu kwamanzi, ngakho umswakama ongu-70% ohlobene namanzi usuvele unikeza $\mathrm{RH}_i > 100\%$.
p-260.actionItem: Namuhla, buka ukuthi imikhondo yezindiza ihlala isikhathi esingakanani esibhakabhakeni, futhi uthathe ehlala isikhathi eside neyendlalekayo njengenkomba nje yomoya onomswakama phezulu, hhayi njengesibikezelo sezulu esiqinisekile.

p-261.title: Uhlelo lwenduku ye-chopstick embizeni yerayisi lungaphakamisa yonke imbiza
p-261.summary: Ggiba irayisi embizeni bese uphushela induku ye-chopstick phakathi, bese izinhlamvu ziyibamba ngokuqinile kangangokuthi yonke imbiza iyaphakama.
p-261.principle: Ukucindezela phakathi kwezinhlamvu kukhwabanisa i-chopstick futhi kudala ukungqubuzana (friction): $f = \mu N$.
p-261.example: Njengomfanekiso, amandla asemaceleni $N = 50\ \mathrm{N}$ ano-$\mu = 0.4$ anikeza cishe u-20 N wokungqubuzana, okwanele ukuphakamisa cishe u-1 kg (cishe u-9.8 N) wembiza nerayisi.
p-261.actionItem: Namuhla, gcwalisa imbiza ewumngcingo ngerayisi, uligxobe liqine, phushela i-chopstick ijule bese uyaphakamisa, ukwenzele phezu kwetafula ukuze kungaphuki lutho.

p-262.title: Khetha isithelo esisindayo lapho osayizi belingana
p-262.summary: Phakathi kwezithelo ezinosayizi olinganayo, esisinda kakhulu ngokuvamile sinamajusi amaningi futhi asomanga kangako.
p-262.example: Kulamawolintshi amabili anomthamo ofanayo kwelingu-220 g ($\rho \approx 1.10\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$) nelingu-190 g ($\rho \approx 0.95\ \mathrm{g/cm^3}$), elisinda kakhulu ngokuvamile linamajusi amaningi.
p-262.actionItem: Lapho uthenga izithelo namuhla, phatha ezinosayizi ofanayo esandleni ngasinye ukuze uqhathanise isisindo, futhi uhlole nokuthi azilimele yini.

p-263.title: Ukuhamba ephaseji elihambayo lesikhumulo sezindiza kuhlanganisa amaphuzu esivinini
p-263.summary: Ukuhamba ephaseji elihambayo kuhlanganisa isivinini sakho sokuhamba nesivinini sebhande, ngakho-ke uhamba ngokushesha kakhulu uye phambili.
p-263.example: Iphaseji elihamba ngo-0.75 m/s kuhlanganise nokuhamba ngo-1.4 m/s kunikeza u-2.15 m/s; ebangeni elingamamitha angama-200 lokho kuthatha cishe imizuzwana engama-93 esikhundleni semizuzwana engama-267 uma umile nje, kusheshe cishe ngemizuzu emi-3.
p-263.actionItem: Uma uhamba ephaseji elihambayo namuhla, hlala ohlangothini olulodwa, bambelela othango lwesandla, futhi ugcine imithwalo yakho iseduze.

p-264.title: Izitikha ezikhanyayo zebhayisikili zibuyisela ukukhanya lapho kuvela khona
p-264.summary: Izitikha ezibonisa ukukhanya (retroreflective) zibuyisela ukukhanya kwamalambu emoto lapho kuvela khona, okwenza ibhayisikili libonakale kalula emigwaqweni emnyama.
p-264.principle: I-corner cube isebenzisa izibuko ezintathu ezihlangana ngokuma ngokulinganayo ukuze zibuyisele ukukhanya emuva ngendlela ephambene ncamashi: $\vec{r}_{out} = -\vec{r}_{in}$.
p-264.example: Izinto zokugqoka ezikhanyayo zivame ukubonakala kusukela ebangeni elingaba amamitha ayi-150, kanti izingubo ezimnyama zivame ukuqashelwa kuphela phakathi kwamamitha angama-30 kuya kwangama-50.
p-264.actionItem: Namuhla, namathisela izinto ezibonisa ukukhanya emasondweni, ohlakeni nasemanyathelweni ebhayisikili lakho, futhi usebenzise namalambu angaphambili nangemuva.

p-265.title: Ungayigayi isobho elishisayo ngokushesha kwi-blender
p-265.summary: Ukugaya isobho elishisayo ku-blender evaliwe kwenza umhwamuko wande bese uqhuma ususa isivalo, okungadala ukusha okukhulu.
p-265.principle: Umthetho wegesi efanele (Ideal gas law): $PV = nRT$. Igremu elilodwa lamanzi eliphenduka umhwamuko lithatha cishe amalitha ayi-1.7 ku-100°C kanye no-1 atm.
p-265.example: Uma $n = \dfrac{1}{18} \approx 0.056\ \mathrm{mol}$, $V = \dfrac{nRT}{P} \approx 1.7\ \mathrm{L}$, okucishe kube izikhathi eziyi-1,700 zevolumu yoketshezi.
p-265.actionItem: Namuhla, yeka isobho elishisayo liphole okungenani imizuzu eyi-10 noma ngaphezulu, gcwalisa imbiza ingeqi engxenyeni, vula imbobo yesivalo bese usimboza ngethawula ngenkathi ugaya.

p-266.title: Kungani imini nobusuku kucishe kulingane nge-equinox yasekwindla
p-266.summary: Nge-equinox yasekwindla, iLanga liba ngaphezu kwenkabazwe ngqo, ngakho-ke imini nobusuku kucishe kulingane amahora ayi-12 yonke indawo eMhlabeni.
p-266.principle: Ukutsheka kwe-eksisi ngama-degree angu-$23.4^\circ$; ukutsheka kwelanga (solar declination) $\delta \approx 23.44^\circ \sin\!\left[\dfrac{360^\circ}{365}(d - 81)\right]$.
p-266.example: Ukutsheka kungu-+23.4° nge-solstice kaJuni (cishe ngoJuni 21), kube ngu-0° nge-equinox yasekwindla (cishe ngoSepthemba 22), kanye no--23.4° nge-solstice kaDisemba (cishe ngoDisemba 21).
p-266.actionItem: Namuhla, bheka izikhathi zokuphuma nokushona kwelanga bese ubale ukuthi ngabe usuku luhlala cishe amahora ayi-12 yini.

p-267.title: Khipha umoya ku-boiler nakuradijetha lapho kushintsha isizini
p-267.summary: Umoya ovaleleke ohlelweni lokufudumeza uvimba ukugeleza kwamanzi, okushiya ingxenye ephezulu yeradijetha ibanda; ukukhipha umoya kunikeza ukufudumala okukhulu ngamafutha afanayo.
p-267.principle: Ukushisa okulethwayo kuncike ekugelezeni kokujikeleza: $Q = \dot{m}\, c\, \Delta T$.
p-267.example: Iradijetha engu-1 kW idinga cishe $1\ \mathrm{L/min}$ wamanzi ku-$\Delta T = 15\ \mathrm{K}$, futhi ingxenye egcwele umoya ayikhiphi ukushisa nhlobo.
p-267.actionItem: Uma uhlelo lokufudumeza lucishiwe futhi selupholile, vula ivalvu yomoya kuradijetha ebandayo phezulu ukuze ukhiphe umoya, bese uhlola umfutho we-boiler njengokusho kwencwadi yemiyalelo.

p-268.title: Emthambekeni, paka amasondo ephendulelwe ngasekunqenqemeni lomgwaqo
p-268.summary: Lapho upaka emthambekeni, ngaphezu kwebhuleki lesandla kanye negiya, phendula amasondo ukuze unqenqema lomgwaqo lumise imoto uma igingqika.
p-268.principle: Amandla athambekele ohlangothini: $F = mg\sin\theta$; ukungqubuzana (friction): $f = \mu N$.
p-268.example: Imoto enesisindo esingu-1,500 kg emthambekeni ongu-10% ($\theta \approx 5.7^\circ$) idonselwa phansi ngamandla angaba ngu-1.46 kN (cishe u-150 kgf).
p-268.actionItem: Namuhla, paka ubheke phansi nomthambeka amasondo ephendulelwe ngasekunqenqemeni, noma ubheke phezulu eduze konqenqema amasondo ephendulelwe kude nalo, bese ubamba ibhuleki lesandla bese ufaka ku-P (noma igiya lokuqala).

p-269.title: Indawo eseduze idlula ngejubane efasiteleni lesitimela
p-269.summary: Ngejubane elifanayo, izinto eziseduze zidlula emehlweni akho ngokushesha okukhulu, kanti izintaba ezikude zibonakala zihamba kancane kakhulu.
p-269.example: Ku-100 km/h (27.8 m/s), isihlahla esiqhele ngamamitha angama-20 sidlula ngo-$\omega \approx 1.39\ \mathrm{rad/s} \approx 80^\circ/\mathrm{s}$, kanti intaba eqhele ngo-5 km idlula cishe ngo-$0.3^\circ/\mathrm{s}$.
p-269.actionItem: Uma uzizwa unesiyezi noma unesicanucanu ngenkathi usohambweni namuhla, bheka izintaba ezikude noma isibhakabhaka esikhundleni sokubheka indawo eseduze.

p-270.title: Umncintiswano wokudonsisana ngentambo unqotshwa ukungqubuzana kwezinyawo phansi, hhayi isisindo somzimba
p-270.summary: Emqhudelwaneni wokudonsisana ngentambo, intambo idonsa ngokulinganayo nhlangothi zombili, futhi umphumela unqunywa ukungqubuzana okukhulu (friction) umhlabathi ongakunikeza izinyawo zakho.
p-270.principle: Ukungqubuzana okumile (static friction): $f \le \mu N$ ($N = mg$); amandla okudonsa kwentambo ayafana nhlangothi zombili (isenzo nokusabela kwaso).
p-270.example: Kumuntu onesisindo esingu-70 kg, $\mu = 0.8$ endaweni eyomile ivumela amandla angafika cishe ku-550 N, kodwa $\mu = 0.4$ endaweni eshelelayo ivumela kuphela cishe u-270 N.
p-270.actionItem: Uma udlala umncintiswano wokudonsisana ngentambo namuhla, gqoka izicathulo ezibambayo phansi bese uncika emuva ubheke phansi, kodwa ungalokothi ugoqe intambo engalweni yakho.

p-271.title: Ukusika inyama phakathi kuyenza ivuthwe ngokushesha cishe ngokuphindwe kane
p-271.summary: Ukusika inyama ibe nguhhafu wobukhulu kunciphisa isikhathi sokuba ukushisa kufike phakathi nendawo sibe cishe ikota yesikhathi sokuqala, okonga nomlilo noma ugesi.
p-271.principle: Isikhathi sokusabalala kokushisa: $t \propto \dfrac{L^2}{\alpha}$ ($L$: ubukhulu, $\alpha$: ukusabalala kokushisa).
p-271.example: Uma ucezu oluwugqinsi ngo-6 cm luthatha cishe imizuzu engama-60, ucezu olungu-3 cm luthatha cishe $60 \times \left(\dfrac{3}{6}\right)^2 = 15$ min.
p-271.actionItem: Namuhla, sika izingcezu ezinkulu zenyama zibe mncane ngaphambi kokuzipheka, futhi uhlole nge-thermometer ukuthi ingaphakathi lifinyelela cishe ku-75°C noma ngaphezulu.

p-272.title: Shaya ngenkaba ebhola (sweet spot) yesagila se-baseball ukuze ugweme ukuluma kwezandla
p-272.summary: Isagila sinendawo eyisikhungo sokushayeka (sweet spot), lapho ukushaya ibhola kungenzi ukuthi amandla amakhulu adlulele ezandleni zakho.
p-272.principle: Ibanga lesikhungo sokushayeka kusuka lapho kubanjwe khona: $q = \dfrac{I}{m d}$ ($I$: isilinganiso sokunganyakazi kwento ezungezayo, $d$: ibanga ukusuka endaweni yokubamba kuya enkabeni yesisindo).
p-272.example: Othini olufanayo olungamamitha angu-0.84 olubanjwe ekugcineni, $q = \dfrac{2}{3} L \approx 0.56\ \mathrm{m}$; izagila zangempela zisinda kakhulu ekugcineni, ngakho le ndawo ishintsha kancane.
p-272.actionItem: Ekuzilolongeni kokushaya namuhla, hlose ukuhlangana nebhola ngengxenye ephakathi nendawo yesagila (sweet spot), hhayi ngesihloko saso.

p-273.title: Ukugoqa intambo kathathu esigxotsheni kunciphisa kakhulu amandla adingekayo
p-273.summary: Ukugoqa intambo izikhathi ezimbalwa esigxotsheni kwandisa ukungqubuzana (friction) kakhulu kangangokuthi amandla amancane kakhulu ayakwazi ukubamba umthwalo osindayo.
p-273.example: Nge-$\mu = 0.3$ kanye nokugoqa oku-3 ($\varphi = 6\pi \approx 18.85\ \mathrm{rad}$), $e^{5.65} \approx 285$, ngakho umthwalo ongu-1,000 N ubanjwa cishe ngo-3.5 N nje kuphela (inani elifanelekile).
p-273.actionItem: Lapho ubopha umthwalo namuhla, goqa intambo izikhathi eziyi-2 kuya kwezi-3 esigxotsheni, kodwa ungalokothi ugoqe intambo esandleni noma emzimbeni wakho noma uyisebenzisele imithwalo eyingozi empilweni.

p-274.title: Uju noma isiraphu efudumele igeleza kalula kakhulu
p-274.summary: Njengoba uju noma isiraphu ifudumala, ukunamathela kwayo kwehla kakhulu, okushiya okuncane kakhulu kubambelele ebhodleleni.
p-274.principle: Ukuncika kokunamathela kwetshezi ekushiseni (uhlobo lwe-Arrhenius): $\eta = A\,e^{E/(RT)}$.
p-274.example: Uju olucishe lube ngu-10 Pa·s ku-20°C luba mncane lube cishe ku-1-2 Pa·s ku-40°C, okuwukuthi luconsa ngokushesha ngokuphindwe ka-5 kuya kweyisi-10.
p-274.actionItem: Namuhla, beka ibhodlela loju elivaliwe emanzini afudumele acishe abe ngu-40°C imizuzu emi-5 ngaphambi kokulisebenzisa, futhi ugweme amanzi abilayo noma i-microwave.

p-275.title: Gcina i-kimchi kuvulandi onomthunzi ngaphakathi kwebhokisi le-styrofoam
p-275.summary: I-Styrofoam ayihambisi ukushisa kahle futhi umthunzi uvimba ukushisa kwemisebe evela elangeni. Zombili zenza ukuthi i-kimchi egciniwe ihlale ibanda futhi izinze isikhathi eside.
p-275.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa ngokuhamba (conduction) kungu-$q=\frac{kA\Delta T}{L}$. Igwebu le-polystyrene line-$k\approx0.035\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$, eliphansi kuneleplanki (cishe u-$0.12$). Ukukhanya kwelanga okuqondile kushisa ingaphandle lesitsha ngemisebe, ngakho umthunzi uyadingeka nawo.
p-275.example: Ebhokisini elinezindonga ezingama-$3\ \mathrm{cm}$ kanye nendawo engu-$1\ \mathrm{m^2}$ kanye nomehluko wamazinga okushisa wangaphakathi nangaphandle ongu-$10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $q=0.035\times1\times10/0.03\approx12\ \mathrm{W}$. Ibhokisi lamapulangwe elinobukhulu obufanayo livuza cishe ama-$40\ \mathrm{W}$, ngaphezu kokuphindwe ka-3.
p-275.actionItem: Namuhla, beka isitsha se-kimchi ebhokisini legwebu ohlangothini oluhlinzekwe ngomthunzi kuvulandi bese uvala izikhala ngamaphephandaba ngaphambi kokuvala isivalo.

p-276.title: Susa amahlamvu emiseleni yamanzi ngaphambi kokuba amanzi aphuphume
p-276.summary: Amahlamvu amboza umsele anciphisa umthamo wamanzi angadlula kuwo, ngakho imvula efanayo ingama iphuphume idale izikhukhula. Umzuzu owodwa wokuhlanza ngaphambi kwemvula uwukuvikela okungabizi kakhulu.
p-276.principle: Isivinini sokugeleza kwamanzi singu-$Q=Av$, ngakho uma indawo evulekile $A$ incipha, ukuphuma kwamanzi kwehla ngendlela efanayo. Amahlamvu avala izimbobo zokusefa anciphise u-$A$ kakhulu.
p-276.example: Umsele onobubanzi obungama-$10\ \mathrm{cm}$ unendawo engaba ngu-$79\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Uma amahlamvu emboza ingxenye yawo, $A\approx39\ \mathrm{cm^2}$, futhi ngesivinini sokugeleza esifanayo ukuphuma kwamanzi kwehla cishe ngo-$50\%$.
p-276.actionItem: Namuhla, susa amahlamvu kusivalo somsele kuvulandi, ophahleni lwendlu noma emnyango usebenzisa amagilavu noma udlawu.

p-277.title: Imizuzu eyishumi yokukhanya kwasukuseni iqhakaze ngokuphindwe izikhathi eziningi kunezibani zasendlini
p-277.summary: Ngisho nasekuseni kuguqubele ngaphandle kukhanya kakhulu kunezibani zasendlini, futhi ukukhanya okuqhakazile kusiza ukuhlela isigqi somzimba sansuku zonke. Ukuphuma kancane ekuseni kuwumkhuba wokukhanya olula kakhulu.
p-277.principle: I-illuminance ukukhanya okufinyelela endaweni ethile, $E=\frac{\Phi}{A}$, kukalwa ngama-lux ($\mathrm{lm/m^2}$). Ngaphandle ngosuku olucwathile kuba cishe ama-$10{,}000\sim100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$; ukukhanya okujwayelekile kwangaphakathi kungama-$100\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$.
p-277.example: Ekuseni okucwathile ngaphandle cishe ngama-$10{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$ kuphindaphindwe cishe ka-20 ehhovisi elinama-$500\ \mathrm{lux}$ futhi cishe ngokuphindwe ka-70 egumbini lokuphumula elinama-$150\ \mathrm{lux}$. Ngisho nezinsuku eziguqubele zivame ukuba ngaphezu kwama-$1{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$, ziqhakaze kakhulu kunangaphakathi.
p-277.actionItem: Kusasa ekuseni, chitha imizuzu eyi-10 uhamba ngaphandle kunokumane ubheke ngefasitela. Ungalokothi ubuke ilanga ngqo.

p-278.title: Ohambweni lokugibela izintaba ekwindla ilanga lishona ngaphambi kwesikhathi esisemthethweni ngenxa yomthunzi wentaba
p-278.summary: Amathebula okushona kwelanga acabangela umkhathizwe oyisicaba, ngakho ugwalo lwentaba ngasentshonalanga lufihla ilanga ngokushesha okukhulu. Ezintabeni ukushona kwelanga kwangempela kwenzeka lapho ilanga lifinyelela engxenyeni ephezulu yentaba.
p-278.principle: Uma ugwalo lwasentshonalanga luvimba ilanga kufika endaweni ephakeme engu-$h$, ukushona kwelanga kwangempela kulapho ilanga lehla lifinyelela kulowo mphakamo, cishe ngo-$\Delta t\approx\frac{h}{\omega}$ ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ezindaweni eziphakathi nezwe ekwindla izinga lokwehla kwelanga cishe lingu-$\omega\approx12^\circ/\mathrm{h}$.
p-278.example: Ngogwalo olungama-$10^\circ$ ngasentshonalanga, umthunzi ufika cishe ngo-$\Delta t\approx10^\circ/12^\circ\mathrm{/h}\approx50\ \mathrm{min}$ ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Uma wengeza ukuhwalala okulandelayo, isikhathi sakho sokwehla ngokuphepha sincipha ngaphezu kwehora.
p-278.actionItem: Namuhla, hlela isikhathi sakho sokuqeda uhambo lwezintaba sibe amahora angu-1.5 kuya kwangu-2 ngaphambi kokushona kwelanga okusekhalendeni bese upakisha isibani sasekhanda.

p-279.title: Hlola kokubili i-fill power kanye nesisindo sokugxishwa (fill weight) sejantshi le-down
p-279.summary: I-Fill power ikala ukuthi uboya bwezinyoni (down) buqumba kangakanani ukuze bubambe umoya. Inombolo ephezulu isho ukufudumala okufanayo nesisindo esincane, kodwa ukufudumala okuphelele kuncike nasekuthini kungakanani okugxishiwe.
p-279.principle: I-Fill power ingu-$\mathrm{FP}=\frac{V\,(\mathrm{in^3})}{m\,(\mathrm{oz})}$, umthamo weyunithi ngayinye yesisindo se-down. Ukufudumala kuncike ebukhulwini bomoya omile obanjwe ngaphakathi ($k\approx0.026\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$), ngakho-ke isisindo esidingekayo ukugcwalisa umthamo othile singu-$m\propto\frac{1}{\mathrm{FP}}$.
p-279.example: Ukuze kugcwaliswe ubukhulu obufanayo, i-fill power 600 idinga ama-$100\ \mathrm{g}$ bese i-fill power 800 idinga $600/800\times100=75\ \mathrm{g}$. Ngokufudumala okufanayo lokho kulula cishe ngo-$25\%$.
p-279.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho uthenga ibhantshi le-puffer, qhathanisa kokubili i-fill power kanye nesisindo sokugxishwa (g) kulebula.

p-280.title: I-calculator esebenzisa amandla elanga iyasebenza ngisho nangaphansi kwezibani zasendlini
p-280.summary: I-calculator idinga ama-microwatt ambalwa kuphela, ngakho ukukhanya okufiphele kwangaphakathi kwanele. Okubalulekile ukuthi amandla e-photon ngayinye afinyelela izinga elidingekayo yini, hhayi ukuthi ukukhanya kuqhakaze kangakanani.
p-280.principle: Amandla e-photon angu-$E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}\approx\frac{1240\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}}{\lambda}$. Uma edlula i-semiconductor band gap, ama-electron ayadedelwa bese ugesi ugeleza; ukukhanya okufiphele kumane kunciphise amandla kagesi.
p-280.example: I-photon ebonakalayo engama-$550\ \mathrm{nm}$ iphethe $E\approx2.25\ \mathrm{eV}$, ngaphezu kwe-band gap ecishe ibe ngu-$1.7\ \mathrm{eV}$ ye-amorphous silicon. Igumbi elinama-$500\ \mathrm{lux}$ licishe libe ngu-1/200 wokukhanya kwelanga ngosuku olucwathile (cishe ama-$100{,}000\ \mathrm{lux}$) kodwa lisanela i-calculator edinga ama-$\mu\mathrm{W}$ ambalwa.
p-280.actionItem: Namuhla, vula i-calculator yelanga ngaphansi kokukhanya kwegumbi bese umboza iphaneli layo ngesandla sakho ukuze ubuke isikrini sificika sicima.

p-281.title: Imodi emnyama yonga ibhethri kumafoni e-OLED
p-281.summary: Iphikseli ngayinye ye-OLED izenzela ukukhanya kwayo, ngakho-ke amaphikseli amnyama awasebenzisi amandla cishe nhlobo. Lapho ingemuva elimnyama lisiba likhulu esikrinini, yilapho amandla okubonisa asetshenziswa kancane.
p-281.principle: Amandla okubonisa ayisamba sawo wonke amaphikseli $P=\sum_i P_i$, kanti iphikseli elimnyama line-$P_i\approx0$. I-LCD enokukhanya kwangemuva okuhlala kuvuliwe idonsa amandla acishe alingane kungakhathaliseki ukuthi yini eboniswayo, ngakho imodi emnyama ayenzi mehluko omkhulu lapho.
p-281.example: Ake sithi amandla okubonisa ayi-$1.0\ \mathrm{W}$ engemuva elimhlophe bese eba yi-$0.5\ \mathrm{W}$ kwelimnyama. Emahoreni angu-3 lokho konga u-$0.5\ \mathrm{W}\times3\ \mathrm{h}=1.5\ \mathrm{Wh}$, cishe i-$10\%$ yebhethri elingu-$15\ \mathrm{Wh}$.
p-281.actionItem: Namuhla, uma ifoni yakho inesikrini se-OLED, vula imodi emnyama kuzilungiselelo. Efoni ye-LCD, nciphisa ukugqama esikhundleni salokho.

p-282.title: Shayela enkungwini ngezibani eziphansi nezibani zenkungu
p-282.summary: Enkungwini, izibani eziphezulu zishayeka emaconsini amanzi zibuyele kuwe futhi zenze ukungaboni kahle kube kubi kakhulu. Izibani eziphansi nezibani zenkungu, ezibheke phansi, zinikeza ukubona okucacile.
p-282.principle: Amathonsi enkungu (angaba ngu-$1\sim20\ \mu\mathrm{m}$ ngobubanzi) ayaqhathaniseka nobude begagasi lokukhanya, ngakho ukuhlakazeka kwe-Mie kuthumela ukukhanya ngamandla kuzo zonke izinhlangothi, kuhlanganise nokubuyela emuva kumshayeli. Ukukhanya kuyafiphala njenge-$I=I_0e^{-\beta x}$, futhi ukukhanya kwezibani eziphezulu eduze kwamehlo kubonakala kubuyela emuva njengokuxhopha.
p-282.example: E-Korea, lapho ukubona kungaphansi kuka-$50\ \mathrm{m}$, umkhawulo wejubane kumele wehliswe okungenani nge-$50\%$, ngakho umgwaqo ongu-$100\ \mathrm{km/h}$ uba ngu-$50\ \mathrm{km/h}$ noma ngaphansi.
p-282.actionItem: Kusukela namuhla, ngezinsuku ezinenkungu vula izibani eziphansi nezibani zenkungu, cisha izibani eziphezulu bese ushiya ibanga elikhudlwana emotweni ephambi kwakho.

p-283.title: Beka isibani sakho sokufunda ohlangothini olubhekene nesandla sakho sokubhala
p-283.summary: Ngenxa yokuthi ukukhanya kuhamba emigqeni eqondile, isandla sakho nepeni kwenza ithunzi phezu kwamagama. Isibani esisohlangothini oluhlukile siphonsa lelo thunzi ngemuva kwesandla sakho ukuze amehlo akho angakhathazeki kangako.
p-283.principle: Emthonjeni wokukhanya onephuzu eliphakeme ngo-$H$, into ephakeme ngo-$h$ ebangeni elivundlile elingu-$d$ yenza ithunzi elinwebeka ngo-$s=\frac{dh}{H-h}$ ngemuva kwayo. Isibani esisohlangothini olufanayo nesandla sakho sokubhala sibeka lelo thunzi phezu kombhalo.
p-283.example: Ngokuphakama kwesibani okungu-$H=40\ \mathrm{cm}$, ukuphakama kwesandla okungu-$h=3\ \mathrm{cm}$ nebanga elingu-$d=30\ \mathrm{cm}$, ithunzi lingaba ngu-$s=\frac{30\times3}{37}\approx2.4\ \mathrm{cm}$. Ukukhanya kokufunda okungama-$300\sim500\ \mathrm{lux}$ kuvamile.
p-283.actionItem: Namuhla, uma usebenzisa isandla sokudla, beka isibani sedeskhi ngaphambili kwesobunxele; uma usebenzisa isobunxele, sibeke ngaphambili kwesokudla.

p-284.title: Hamba ngendlela ye-zigzag lapho ukhwela imiqansi eyehlelayo kakhulu
p-284.summary: Ukuphakama okufanayo kuthatha umsebenzi ofanayo, kodwa ukuthatha indlela egobile kwehlisa amandla adingekayo esinyathelweni ngasinye ukuze ungakhathali kakhulu. Inkokhelo yalokho ukuhamba ibanga elide.
p-284.principle: Emmangweni umsebenzi ngu-$W=mgh$ kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uhamba ngayiphi indlela, kodwa amandla alandela ummango athi $F=mg\sin\theta=mg\frac{h}{L}$, ehlana njengoba ubude bendlela $L$ bukhula.
p-284.example: Umuntu ongu-$70\ \mathrm{kg}$ okhwela u-$100\ \mathrm{m}$ wenza umsebenzi ongu-$W\approx69\ \mathrm{kJ}$. Ukukhuphuka ngokuqondile ngo-$30^\circ$ kudinga u-$F\approx343\ \mathrm{N}$ ebangeni elingu-$200\ \mathrm{m}$; i-zigzag engu-$15^\circ$ idinga u-$F\approx178\ \mathrm{N}$ ebangeni elingaba ngu-$386\ \mathrm{m}$.
p-284.actionItem: Namuhla, endaweni eyehlelayo kakhulu, landela amajika aphawuliwe endleleni futhi unganqamuli ngqo kuwo.

p-285.title: Amathayi asebusika ahlala ethambile ngaphansi kuka-7 °C
p-285.summary: Injoloba iyajiya emakhazeni bese ingabambeleli kahle, kodwa amathayi asebusika asebenzisa ingxube ehlala ithambile emazingeni aphansi okushisa. Ngisho nangaphandle kweqhwa, ayasiza lapho izinga lokushisa licishe libe ngu-7 °C.
p-285.principle: Injoloba ihlala inwebeka ngaphezu kwezinga layo lokushisa lokuntshintsha kwengilazi $T_g$ bese iqina eduze kwalo. Ukungqubuzana kungu-$F=\mu N$ nebanga lokuma lingu-$d=\frac{v^2}{2\mu g}$, ngakho-ke i-$\mu$ ephansi iyalinweba lelo banga.
p-285.example: Ku-$80\ \mathrm{km/h}$ ($22.2\ \mathrm{m/s}$), i-$\mu=0.8$ inikeza cishe u-$31\ \mathrm{m}$, kanti ithayi eliqiniswe amakhaza eline-$\mu=0.6$ lidinga cishe u-$42\ \mathrm{m}$. Lawa manani ayizibonelo zokulinganisa.
p-285.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola isibikezelo sezulu ukuze ubone ukuthi izinga lokushisa eliphansi lihlala liseduze kuka-7 °C yini bese uhlela ukushintshela emathayini asebusika.

p-286.title: Isibani sephaseji esizwa ukunyakaza sizwa imisebe ye-infrared ephuma ekushiseni komzimba
p-286.summary: Isibani esizwa ukunyakaza siyakhanya lapho sizwa izinguquko emisebeni ye-infrared ekhishwa umzimba wakho lapho unyakaza. Ukukhanyisa kuphela lapho kudingeka kunciphisa kakhulu amandla okukhanyisa asephaseji.
p-286.principle: Ubude begagasi lemisebe ephakeme kakhulu bulandela umthetho ka-Wien $\lambda_{\max}=\frac{b}{T}$ lapho u-$b\approx2898\ \mu\mathrm{m\cdot K}$. Esikhumbeni esingaba ngu-$33\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ($306\ \mathrm{K}$), $\lambda_{\max}\approx9.5\ \mu\mathrm{m}$, futhi inzwa ye-PIR ibheka izinguquko kule misebe ye-infrared.
p-286.example: I-LED yasephaseji engu-$10\ \mathrm{W}$ eshiywe ivuliwe amahora angu-24 isebenzisa u-$240\ \mathrm{Wh}$. Ngenzwa eyikhanyisa amahora angu-2 ngosuku nesebenzisa u-$0.5\ \mathrm{W}$ ngenkathi ilindile, isamba siba ngu-$20+12=32\ \mathrm{Wh}$, okunciphe cishe ngo-$87\%$.
p-286.actionItem: Namuhla, shintsha isibani sasephaseji noma sasesicabheni ufake esizwa ukunyakaza, noma usethe isikhathi saso sokukhanya sibe imizuzu engu-1 kuya kwemi-2.

p-287.title: Vala umnyango wamagumbi angasetshenziswa ukuze unciphise umthamo owushisayo
p-287.summary: Umoya omncane kanye nendawo encane yodonga okumele kufudunyezwe kusho ukushisa okuncane okudingekayo ekushiseni okufanayo. Nokho, ungaluvali ngokuphelele igumbi, ngoba kungakheka umswakama obandayo; gcina izinga lokushisa eliphansi.
p-287.principle: Ukushisa okudingekayo ukufudumeza umoya kungu-$Q=mc\Delta T$ lapho u-$m=\rho V$, ngakho-ke kukhula ngokuhambisana nomthamo $V$ ofudunyezwayo. Umoya une-$\rho\approx1.2\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ kanye no-$c\approx1005\ \mathrm{J/(kg\cdot K)}$.
p-287.example: Ukukhuphula izinga lokushisa lomoya egumbini elingenalutho elingu-$25\ \mathrm{m^3}$ ngo-$5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kuthatha u-$Q=1.2\times25\times1005\times5\approx151\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.04\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Uma wengeza izindonga, ifenisha kanye nokuvuza okuqhubekayo, isibalo sangempela sikhulu ngokuphindaphindiwe.
p-287.actionItem: Namuhla, vala umnyango wegumbi elingasetshenziswa futhi wehlise ivalvu yalo yokufudumeza ibe sezingeni eliphansi kakhulu kunokuyicisha ngokuphelele.

p-288.title: Ukuxhopha okuvela ezibani zemoto eqhamuka ngaphambili: bheka ngasemaphethelweni omzila wesokudla
p-288.summary: Lapho amehlo akho ekude kakhulu nomthombo wokukhanya, ukukhanya okuhlakazekile ngaphakathi kweso lakho kunciphisa kancane umbono wakho. Ukubheka emaphethelweni omzila wesokudla kunciphisa ukuxhopha futhi kusekugcina ubona umgwaqo.
p-288.principle: Ukukhanya okusithayo okuvela ekukhanyeni okuhlakazekile esweni cishe kungu-$L_v\approx\frac{10E}{\theta^2}$, lapho u-$E$ kungukukhanya okufika esweni ($\mathrm{lux}$) kanti u-$\theta$ kuyi-engeli ephakathi komthombo nokubuka kwakho ($^\circ$).
p-288.example: Ukubuka okungu-$5^\circ$ ukusuka emthonjeni kunikeza u-$L_v\propto1/25$, kanti u-$10^\circ$ unikeza u-$1/100$, ngakho-ke ukukhanya okusithayo kwehla kufike ku-$1/4$. Imboni yeso lakho iyancipha futhi ekukhanyeni okugqamile, okusiza kakhulu.
p-288.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku, uma uhlangana nezibani eziphezulu zemoto eqhamuka ngaphambili, ungawavali amehlo akho; gxilisa ukubuka kwakho kulayini womzila wesokudla bese wehlisa ijubane.

p-289.title: Kungani isikrini esikhanyayo egumbini elimnyama sikhathaza amehlo akho
p-289.summary: Egumbini elimnyama izimboni zamehlo akho zivuleka kakhulu ngenkathi isikrini sikhanya kakhulu, ngakho amehlo akho ahlala elungisa igebe lokukhanya. Ukukhanyisa kancane indawo ekuzungezile kunciphisa leli gebe futhi kunciphise ukukhandleka kwamehlo.
p-289.principle: Indawo yemboni yeso ingu-$A=\frac{\pi d^2}{4}$ lapho ububanzi buhluka kusuka cishe ku-$2\sim8\ \mathrm{mm}$, kanti ukukhanya okungena kuretina kuhambisana no-$E_r\propto L\,A$. Igebe elikhulu lokukhanya phakathi kwesikrini nendawo ekuzungezile liphoqa ukulungisa kabusha njalo.
p-289.example: Ukusuka embonini engu-$2\ \mathrm{mm}$ ukuya ku-$8\ \mathrm{mm}$ kwandisa indawo ngokuphindwe ka-16. Ngezindawo ezizungezile eziku-$0.5\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$ kanye nesikrini esiku-$200\ \mathrm{cd/m^2}$, isilinganiso singu-$400:1$, okungaphezulu kakhulu kokuvame ukutuswa okungu-$3:1\sim10:1$.
p-289.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku, uma usebenzisa isikrini, khanyisa isibani esingemuva kwaso noma isibani esincane sedeski ukuze ukhanyise igumbi kancane.

p-290.title: Ulayini wokuphepha endaweni yesiteshi sesitimela ukhona ngenxa yomoya wesitimela
p-290.summary: Isitimela esihamba ngesivinini sandisa ijubane lomoya eceleni kwaso futhi sehlise ukucindezela kwawo, okungadonsela umuntu ngasesitimeleni. Ukuma ngemuva komugqa wokuphepha kuyisixwayiso esiqinisekile kakhulu.
p-290.principle: Ngomthetho ka-Bernoulli, $p+\frac12\rho v^2=\mathrm{const}$, isivinini somoya esisheshayo $v$ sisho ukucindezela okuphansi $p$. Ukwehla kokucindezela kungu-$\Delta p=\frac12\rho v^2$.
p-290.example: Uma umoya oseceleni kwesitimela uhamba ngo-$10\ \mathrm{m/s}$, $\Delta p=0.5\times1.2\times10^2=60\ \mathrm{Pa}$, okwenza kube namandla acishe abe ngu-$F\approx36\ \mathrm{N}$ (cishe u-$3.7\ \mathrm{kgf}$) endaweni yomzimba eseceleni engu-$0.6\ \mathrm{m^2}$. Umoya ophephukayo wenza inani langempela lihlale liguquka.
p-290.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho isitimela sisondela endaweni yokugibela, thatha elinye igxathu uhlehlele ngemuva komugqa wokuphepha.

p-291.title: Amapani okubhaka amnyama abhaka ngokushesha
p-291.summary: Ipani elimnyama limunca ukushisa okuningi kwemisebe ye-ovini, kanti ipani elisiliva elicwebezelayo libuyisela iningi lakho emuva. Iresiphi efanayo yenza ingxenye engezansi ibe nsundu ngokushesha epanini elimnyama.
p-291.principle: Ingaphezulu limunca amandla emisebe ngokuhambisana nokumunca kwalo (okulingana ne-emissivity) $\varepsilon$, kanti amandla aphumayo ngu-$P=\varepsilon\sigma AT^4$. Ingaphezulu elimnyama line-$\varepsilon\approx0.95$ kanti i-aluminium epholishiwe inecishe ibe ngu-$0.1$.
p-291.example: Endaweni efanayo yemisebe yokushisa, ipani elimnyama limunca cishe ukushisa kwemisebe ngokuphindwe ka-$0.95/0.1\approx9$ kunele siliva elipholishiwe. Yingakho izindlela zokupheka zivame ukuphakamisa ukuthi kuncishiswe izinga le-ovini cishe ngo-$10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kumapani amnyama.
p-291.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho ubhaka epanini elimnyama, yehlisa i-ovini ngo-$10\sim15\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ bese uhlola ukuba nsundu kwaso kusenesikhathi.

p-292.title: I-thermostat yengubo kagesi iyinsimbi eyizicucu ezimbili (bimetal strip)
p-292.summary: Ucezu oluncane olwenziwe ngezinsimbi ezimbili ezihlanganisiwe luyagoba lapho lufudumala futhi luvule noma luvale ukuxhumana kukagesi. Lokho kwenza i-thermostat elula enqamula amandla kagesi ezingeni lokushisa elimisiwe.
p-292.principle: Ukunwebeka komugqa kungu-$\Delta L=\alpha L\Delta T$. Ngenxa yokuthi lezi zinsimbi zombili zihlukile nge-coefficient yokunwebeka ngo-$\Delta\alpha$, ucezu luyagoba, kanti isihloko salo sihamba ngo-$\delta=\frac{3\Delta\alpha\Delta T L^2}{4t}$ ($t$: ubukhulu obuphelele).
p-292.example: Uma u-$L=50\ \mathrm{mm}$, $t=1\ \mathrm{mm}$, $\Delta\alpha=7\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{/K}$ kanye no-$\Delta T=40\ \mathrm{K}$, isihloko sihamba ngo-$\delta\approx0.5\ \mathrm{mm}$, okwanele ukuhlukanisa indawo yokuxhumana kagesi.
p-292.actionItem: Namuhla, sebenzisa ingubo kagesi yendlalwe phansi yaba yisicaba, ingalinge isongwe noma ifincwe, bese uyibeka ezingeni eliphansi lapho ulala.

p-293.title: Umthombo wokushisa eduze kwe-thermostat ye-boiler ukhohlisa ukufudumeza kwakho
p-293.summary: I-thermostat ikala kuphela izinga lokushisa lapho ilenga khona ukuze ivule noma icishe i-boiler. Isifudumezi noma ilanga eduze kwayo kwenza yonke enye ingxenye yendlu ibande kakhulu kunalokho okumisiwe, kanti udonga olubandayo eduze kwayo lubangela ukufudumala ngokweqile.
p-293.principle: I-thermostat isebenza kuphela uma izinga lokushisa lenzwa yayo, $T_{\mathrm{sensor}}$, lingaphansi kwezinga elimisiwe $T_{\mathrm{set}}$. Ngakho-ke ngokwesilinganiso segumbi $T_{\mathrm{room}}=T_{\mathrm{sensor}}+\epsilon$, iphutha lokubekwa $\epsilon$ liba yiphutha lokufudumeza.
p-293.example: Uma umthombo wokushisa oseduze wenza inzwa ifunde u-$23\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kanti isilinganiso segumbi singu-$20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, i-boiler iyacisha ngisho noma kumiswe u-$22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ bese igumbi libanda ngo-$2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Esimweni esiphambene nalokho, ukufudumala ngokweqile ngo-$2\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kukhuphula izindleko zokufudumeza cishe ngo-$14\%$ (umthetho ovamile umayelana no-$7\%$ nge-1 °C ngayinye).
p-293.actionItem: Namuhla, susa izifudumezi zikagesi, ama-TV kanye neminye imithombo yokushisa noma ifenisha kude ne-thermostat.

p-294.title: Ukushintshanisa i-polarity kusipika esisodwa kwenza umsindo we-bass unyamalale
p-294.summary: Uma u-+ no-− wesipika esisodwa kuhlanganiswe ngokuphambene, lezi zipika ezimbili zikhipha umsindo ngezikhathi eziphambene (opposite phase) bese i-bass enobude begagasi obude iyabhubhisa. Uma umsindo unciphile futhi ungemuhle, qala ngokuhlola i-polarity kuqala.
p-294.principle: Amagagasi amabili ahluke ngesigaba ngo-$\pi$ aphazamisana ngokucekela phansi (destructive interference) futhi inani lawo liyancipha. Lapho ubude begagasi $\lambda=\frac{v}{f}$ bude kakhulu kunesikhala esiphakathi kwezipika, ukunyamalala komsindo kucishe kuphelele cishe yonke indawo.
p-294.example: Ku-$100\ \mathrm{Hz}$, $\lambda=343/100=3.4\ \mathrm{m}$, kude kakhulu kunesikhala esiphakathi kwezipika esingu-$2\ \mathrm{m}$, ngakho izinga lomsindo lehla kakhulu phakathi nendawo. Ku-$5\ \mathrm{kHz}$, $\lambda\approx6.9\ \mathrm{cm}$, ngakho ukuhamba amamitha ambalwa kuphela kwenza izinga liye phezulu naphansi; umphumela uwukuthi i-bass iyalahleka.
p-294.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ukuthi zombili izipika zixhunywe u-+ (obomvu) kutheminali ka-+ kanye no-− (omnyama) kutheminali ka-− ngendlela efanayo.

p-295.title: Ama-push-up ngamadolo afinyeza i-lever yomzimba
p-295.summary: Ukuzisekela ngamadolo akho kufinyeza i-lever, ngakho izingalo zakho zithwala umthwalo omncane. Uma ama-push-up avamile enzima, ukuqala ngama-push-up ngamadolo ngesimo esihle kuyasiza kakhulu.
p-295.principle: Ngokuthatha umzimba njenge-lever, ibhalansi ye-torque $F_{\mathrm{hand}}\,L=mg\,d$ inikeza amandla esandla $F_{\mathrm{hand}}=mg\frac{d}{L}$. Ukuhambisa iphuzu lokuzisekela (pivot) lisuke ezinzwaneni liye emadolweni kushintsha u-$L$ no-$d$ futhi kunciphise ingxenye yomthwalo.
p-295.example: Ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi umthwalo wesandla ucishe ube ngu-$64\%$ wesisindo somzimba kuma-push-up ajwayelekile kanti ucishe ube ngu-$49\%$ kuma-push-up ngamadolo. Kumuntu ongu-$70\ \mathrm{kg}$, lokho kumayelana no-$45\ \mathrm{kg}$ uma kuqhathaniswa no-$34\ \mathrm{kg}$, okulula cishe ngo-$23\%$.
p-295.actionItem: Namuhla, zama amasethi angu-2 wama-push-up ngamadolo angu-8, ugcine ikhanda, izinqulu namadolo kusolayini oqondile. Yima uma kukhona okubuhlungu.

p-296.title: Thola iningizimu ngewashi lezinaliti kanye nelanga
p-296.summary: Khomba inaliti yamahora elangeni, bese kuthi indawo ephakathi nendawo phakathi kwenaliti yamahora no-12 kube cishe yiningizimu. Lena indlela elula engasebenzisi ikhampasi eNyakatho Nenkabazwe.
p-296.principle: Ilanga lihamba $\omega_\odot=15^\circ$ ngehora kanti inaliti yamahora ihamba $\omega_h=30^\circ$ ngehora. Isilinganiso $\frac{\omega_\odot}{\omega_h}=\frac12$ yingakho indawo ehlukanisa phakathi ikhomba eningizimu.
p-296.example: Ngo-4 ntambama, khomba inaliti yamahora (eku-$120^\circ$ ukusuka ku-12) elangeni, bese indawo ephakathi nendawo, okungo-2 ezimpondweni, iba yiningizimu. I-standard meridian yase-Korea ($135^\circ$ E) ihlukile kweyase-Seoul (cishe $127^\circ$ E), ngakho isikhathi selanga siphambuka cishe ngemizuzu engu-$30$ kanti iphutha liba cishe $\pm15^\circ$.
p-296.actionItem: Namuhla, ngosuku olunelanga ngaphandle, linganisela iningizimu ngewashi lezinaliti bese uqhathanisa nekhampasi yefoni yakho.

p-297.title: Isikhulisi esine-dioptre ephezulu sinobude bokugxila (focal length) obufushane
p-297.summary: Amandla esikhulisi yisiphambano sobude bokugxila, ngakho inombolo enkulu isho ukugxila okufushane nokukhulisa okwengeziwe. Uma ilensi inamandla kakhulu, indawo oyibonayo incane kakhulu futhi kumele igcinwe eduze kakhulu neso kanye nento ebhekwayo.
p-297.principle: Amandla elensi atholakala ngo-$D=\frac{1}{f}$ ($f$ ngamamitha, $D$ ngama-dioptres), kanti ukukhuliswa kwezigxobo zamehlo endaweni eseduze engu-$25\ \mathrm{cm}$ kungu-$M\approx\frac{25\ \mathrm{cm}}{f}=\frac{D}{4}$.
p-297.example: I-$5\ \mathrm{D}$ isho ukuthi $f=20\ \mathrm{cm}$ nokukhulisa cishe ngo-$1.25\times$; i-$10\ \mathrm{D}$ isho ukuthi $f=10\ \mathrm{cm}$ nokukhulisa cishe ngo-$2.5\times$; i-$20\ \mathrm{D}$ isho ukuthi $f=5\ \mathrm{cm}$ nokukhulisa cishe ngo-$5\times$.
p-297.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho ukhetha isikhulisi, khetha amandla afanele ukusetshenziswa kwakho, futhi ungasishiyi elangeni, ngoba singagxilisa imisebe yelanga bese siqala umlilo.

p-298.title: Ukungenisa umoya okubuyisa ukushisa kuthatha kabusha ukushisa okuphumayo
p-298.summary: Le mishini idlulisela ukushisa okuvela emoyeni wasendlini ophumayo ikuyise emoyeni obandayo ongenayo. Ushintsha umoya ngenkathi ugcina ukushisa okuningi kwasekhaya.
p-298.principle: Ukusebenza kahle kokubuyisa ukushisa kungu-$\eta=\frac{T_{\mathrm{supply}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}{T_{\mathrm{in}}-T_{\mathrm{out}}}$, kanti ukulahleka kokushisa komoya kungu-$P=\rho c\,\dot V\,\Delta T$ ($\rho c\approx1200\ \mathrm{J/(m^3\cdot K)}$).
p-298.example: Ngo-$22\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ngaphakathi, u-$0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ngaphandle kanye no-$150\ \mathrm{m^3/h}$ wokuhamba komoya, ukulahleka kungu-$1200\times\frac{150}{3600}\times22\approx1100\ \mathrm{W}$. Ku-$\eta=70\%$ kwehla kufike cishe ku-$330\ \mathrm{W}$ futhi umoya ongenayo ungena cishe ku-$15.4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-298.actionItem: Namuhla, uma unomshini wokungenisa umoya obuyisa ukushisa, hlanza isihlungi sawo ngesikhathi esishiwo encwadini yawo yokuyisebenzisa.

p-299.title: Ukhaphethe waphansi wengeza olunye ungqimba lokumelana nokushisa
p-299.summary: Ukhaphethe wengeza ungqimba oluvikelayo phakathi kwaphansi nezinyawo zakho. Nokho, phansi lapho kunokushisa khona, ukhaphethe owugqinsi uvimba nokushisa ukuba kungangeni ekamelweni, ngakho khetha ozacile.
p-299.principle: Ezingqimbeni ezilandelanayo, ukumelana nokushisa kungu-$R=\sum\frac{L_i}{k_i}$ kanti ukuhamba kokushisa kungu-$q=\frac{\Delta T}{R}$. Ukwengeza ungqimba kukhuphula u-$R$ futhi kwehlise u-$q$.
p-299.example: Ukhaphethe ongu-$1\ \mathrm{cm}$ ukugqinsela one-$k\approx0.05\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$ une-$R=0.2\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$. Uma phansi kune-$R=0.5$ kanye ne-$\Delta T=10\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ukuhamba kokushisa kwehla kusuka ku-$20$ kuya ku-$14.3\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, cishe ngaphansi ngo-$29\%$.
