p-299.actionItem: Namhlanje, beka ukhaphethe lapho uvame ukuhlala noma ukuma khona phansi lapho kubanda, bese ukhetha ozacile uma igumbi lifudunyezwa ngaphansi.

p-300.title: Uma umnyango uxengethuka, qinisa izikulufo zehinji eliphezulu kuqala
p-300.summary: Isisindo somnyango sidonsa ihinji eliphezulu bese sicindezela kweliphansi, ngakho izikulufo ezingaphezulu zixega kuqala. Ukuqinisa izikulufo zehinji eliphezulu kuphela kuvame ukulungisa ukuxengethuka.
p-300.principle: Umnyango omile usesimweni sokulingana kwe-torque, $\sum\tau=0$. Ngesisindo esingu-$W$ esisebenza phakathi nendawo emnyango ($\frac{w}{2}$ kusuka kumahinji) nebanga phakathi kwamahinji elingu-$h$, amandla avundlile angu-$F=\frac{W\,w/2}{h}$.
p-300.example: Kumnyango ongu-$20\ \mathrm{kg}$ ($W\approx196\ \mathrm{N}$), onobubanzi obungu-$0.9\ \mathrm{m}$ onamahinji aqhelelene ngo-$1.6\ \mathrm{m}$, $F=\frac{196\times0.45}{1.6}\approx55\ \mathrm{N}$ edonsa ihinji eliphezulu bese icindezela kweliphansi.
p-300.actionItem: Namhlanje, uvule umnyango, qinisa izikulufo zehinji eliphezulu usebenzisa i-Phillips screwdriver; vala noma iyiphi imbobo egugile ngezinti zamazinyo neglue yokhuni, bese uqinisa kabusha.

p-301.title: Uma usukuma esihlalweni, qala ngokutshekisela umzimba ngaphambili
p-301.summary: Uma uhlezi, isikhungo sakho sesisindo siba ngemva kwezinyawo zakho, ngakho ukutshekela phambili ukuze sibe phezu kwezinyawo kwenza ukusukuma kube lula futhi kuqine.
p-301.principle: Ukuze usukume, ukubonakala okuqondile kwesikhungo sesisindo (COM) kufanele kuwele ngaphakathi kwendawo yokusekela eyenziwa izinyawo zakho. Uma i-COM iqhelelene ngokuvundlile ngebanga elingu-$x$ ezinyaweni, i-torque yomxhwele ingu-$\tau=mg\,x$.
p-301.example: Lapho uhlezi i-COM ingaba ngu-$15\ \mathrm{cm}$ ngemva kwezinyawo, ukutshekisela umzimba ngaphambili cishe ngo-$30^\circ$ kusa i-COM cishe ngo-$10\ \mathrm{cm}$ ngaphambili futhi kususa ingxenye enkulu ka-$x$ (amanani alinganiselwe).
p-301.actionItem: Namhlanje, lapho usukuma esihlalweni, tshekisela ikhala lakho ezinzwaneni zakho, donsela izinyawo eduze kwesihlalo, bese uyasukuma. Uma isiyezi siqhubeka, khuluma nochwepheshe.

p-302.title: Ebusuku basebusika, ukuphakama kwe-Polaris kulingana ne-latitude yakho
p-302.summary: I-Polaris ihlezi eduze kwesigxobo esisenyakatho sesibhakabhaka, ngakho ukuphakama kwayo phezu komkhathizwe kucishe kulingane ne-latitude yombukeli. Inkanyezi eyodwa ikuvumela ukuba ulinganisele i-latitude yakho.
p-302.principle: Ukuphakama kwesigxobo esisenyakatho sesibhakabhaka kulingana ne-latitude yombukeli engu-$\varphi$, kanti i-Polaris iqhelelene ngaba ngu-$0.7^\circ$ nesigxobo, ngakho $h_{\mathrm{Polaris}}\approx\varphi$.
p-302.example: E-Seoul (cishe $37.5^\circ$ N) i-Polaris ingaba ngu-$37.5^\circ$ ngaphezu komkhathizwe, kanti e-Jeju (cishe $33.5^\circ$ N) ingaba ngu-$33.5^\circ$. Isibhakela eseluliwe singaba ngu-$10^\circ$, ngakho i-Polaris yase-Seoul iphakeme cishe ngezibhakela ezingu-3.75.
p-302.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku, uma isibhakabhaka sicwathile, thola i-Polaris usebenzisa i-Big Dipper noma u-W wase-Cassiopeia bese ukala ukuphakama kwayo ngesibhakela sakho.

p-303.title: Kungani amakhava ezibuko avikela ukukhanya abonakala eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
p-303.summary: Ikhava evikela ukukhanya iyifilimu encane kakhulu eyenza amagagasi okukhanya abonakaliswayo acimelelane. Ilinganiswe ngokuya ngobude bamagagasi aphakathi nendawo aluhlaza okotshani, ngakho amanye aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nabomvu ayasala bese enikeza umbala ekubonisweni kwayo.
p-303.principle: Uma ukugqinsela kwefilimu kungu-$d=\frac{\lambda}{4n}$, ukubonakala okuvela phezulu naphansi kule filimu kwehluka ngendlela engu-$\frac{\lambda}{2}$ bese kuyacimelana. I-index yefilimu ekahle ingu-$n_c=\sqrt{n_s}$.
p-303.example: Ifilimu ye-$\mathrm{MgF_2}$ ($n=1.38$) ku-$\lambda=550\ \mathrm{nm}$ idinga i-$d=\frac{550}{4\times1.38}\approx100\ \mathrm{nm}$. Ingilazi engenakhava ibonisa cishe u-$4\%$ ngasohlangothini ngalunye; ikhava ikunciphisa kube ngaphansi kuka-$1\%$.
p-303.actionItem: Namhlanje, hlanza izibuko zakho ngesihlanzi samalensi nangelembu le-microfiber, futhi ugweme ukuzisula zomile noma ukusebenzisa amanzi ashisayo.

p-304.title: Intambo yokushaja ezacile ishaja kancane
p-304.summary: Intambo ezacile inokumelana okuphezulu, ngakho amandla kagesi (voltage) ayawehlela entanjeni kanti amanye amandla alahleka njengokushisa. Ngeshaja efanayo, intambo ewugqinsi ithwala umsinga omkhulu kagesi.
p-304.principle: Ukwehla kwamandla kagesi kungu-$V=IR$ kanti ukumelana kwentambo kungu-$R=\frac{\rho L}{A}$. Amandla alahleka njengokushisa entanjeni angu-$P=I^2R$.
p-304.example: Ukushaja kuka-$2\ \mathrm{A}$ ohambweni oluya nolubuya olungu-$2\ \mathrm{m}$ lwethusi ($\rho=1.7\times10^{-8}\ \Omega\mathrm{m}$), intambo engu-$0.08\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (28 AWG) ine-$R\approx0.42\ \Omega$, eyehlisa u-$0.84\ \mathrm{V}$ futhi ilahlekelwe ngu-$1.7\ \mathrm{W}$. Intambo engu-$0.2\ \mathrm{mm^2}$ (24 AWG) ine-$0.17\ \Omega$, $0.34\ \mathrm{V}$ kanye no-$0.7\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-304.actionItem: Namhlanje, shintsha intambo ezacile ehamba kancane noma eshisayo ufake ewugqinsi ebonisa amandla ayo kagesi alinganiselwe.

p-305.title: Isiqandisi se-kimchi esivuleka phezulu sichitha umoya obandayo omncane uma sivulwa
p-305.summary: Umoya obandayo unesisindo esikhulu futhi uyashona phansi, uqoqane phansi. Isivalo esivuleka phezulu sigcina lowo moya obandayo ngaphakathi kubhavu, ngakho-ke uphuma kancane uma usivula.
p-305.principle: Ukwuminyana komoya ngu-$\rho=\frac{p}{R_sT}$, kukhulu emazingeni okushisa aphansi. Amandla okuntanta avela kumehluko wokuminyana ngu-$\Delta\rho\,g\,V$, ngakho umoya obandayo uhlala ngokuzinzile ngezansi.
p-305.example: Umoya ku-$4\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ucishe ube ngu-$1.27\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$ kanti ku-$25\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ucishe ube ngu-$1.18\ \mathrm{kg/m^3}$, osinda kakhulu cishe ngo-$7\%$. Isiqandisi esinomnyango oseceleni sivumela lo moya obandayo osindayo ukuthi uchitheke ngaphandle komnyango ovulekile.
p-305.actionItem: Namuhla, nquma kusengaphambili ukuthi yini ozoyikhipha esiqandisini se-kimchi bese uvula isivalo kanye nje, okwesikhashana.

p-306.title: Beka induku yokudla yokhuni phezu kwebhodwe elibilayo elichithekayo
p-306.summary: Ibhamuza elithinta induku yokhuni livame ukuqhuma, okungabambezela ukuchitheka kokubilayo. Akusona isisombululo esiphelele, ngakho ukwehlisa umlilo nokubheka ibhodwe kuhlala kungumthetho oyisisekelo.
p-306.principle: Umehluko wengcindezi kungqimba lwefilimu yebhamuza ubizwa nge-Laplace relation $\Delta p=\frac{2\gamma}{r}$ ($\gamma$: ukushuba kwengaphezulu, $r$: irediyasi yokugoba). Ifilimu ethinta ukhuni olungabushelelezi iyacaba futhi iqhume kalula.
p-306.example: Emanzini aku-$100\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $\gamma\approx0.059\ \mathrm{N/m}$, ibhamuza elinerediyasi engu-$1\ \mathrm{mm}$ linikeza $\Delta p=\frac{2\times0.059}{0.001}\approx118\ \mathrm{Pa}$. Amanzi anesitashi sama-noodle noma e-pasta enza amafilimu amabhamuza aqine kakhulu.
p-306.actionItem: Namuhla, uma ubilisa ama-noodle, beka induku yokudla yokhuni eyomile phezu kodonga lwebhodwe bese usebenzisa umlilo ophakathi naphansi. Gcina induku ikude nelangabi lomlilo.

p-307.title: I-1 m/s ngayinye eyengeziwe yomoya yehlisa izinga lokushisa elizwakalayo cishe ngo-1 °C
p-307.summary: Umoya ususa ungqimba lomoya ofudumele eduze kwesikhumba sakho, ngakho izinga lokushisa lomoya elifanayo lizwakala libanda kakhulu. Ebusika, hlola umoya kanye nezinga lokushisa lapho ukhetha izingubo.
p-307.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa ngokuvunguza okuphoqiwe (forced-convection) kungu-$q=h(v)\,A\,(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}})$, futhi u-$h$ uyakhula ngejubane lomoya $v$. Inkomba yomoya obandayo (wind chill index) ithi $T_{wc}=13.12+0.6215T-11.37v^{0.16}+0.3965Tv^{0.16}$ ($v$ iku-$\mathrm{km/h}$).
p-307.example: Ezingeni lokushisa lomoya elingu-$0\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, umoya ongu-$1.4\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($5\ \mathrm{km/h}$) uzwakala njengocishe ube ngu-$-1.6\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ kanti u-$5\ \mathrm{m/s}$ ($18\ \mathrm{km/h}$) uzwakala njengocishe ube ngu-$-4.9\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, okungukwehla okungaba ngu-$3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ngenxa yokwanda komoya cishe ngo-$3.6\ \mathrm{m/s}$.
p-307.actionItem: Namuhla, ngosuku olunomoya, vala isikhumba esingambozile ngengubo yangaphandle evimba umoya kanye nesivikelo sentamo.

p-308.title: Isiyingi esizungeze inyanga singabonisa imvula ezayo
p-308.summary: Isiyingi senyanga (halo) siyindilinga eyakheka lapho amakristalu eqhwa emafwini aphakeme egobisa ukukhanya kwenyanga. Lawa mafu avame ukuvela lapho kusondela umumo wesimo sezulu (front), ngakho imvula iba maningi amathuba okuba ifike, nakuba kungenasiqiniseko esiphelele.
p-308.principle: Ku-prism yeqhwa ene-hexagon, ukuchezuka okuncane kakhulu (minimum deviation) kungu-$D_{\min}=2\arcsin\left(n\sin30^\circ\right)-60^\circ$. Ngeqhwa elingu-$n\approx1.31$, $D_{\min}\approx22^\circ$, okwenza isiyingi esingu-$22^\circ$ sizungeze inyanga.
p-308.example: Ngo-$n=1.31$, $\arcsin(0.655)\approx40.9^\circ$, ngakho-ke $D_{\min}\approx2\times40.9-60\approx21.8^\circ$. Isandla esivulekile eseluliwe silinganiselwa ku-$20^\circ$, ngakho lesi siyingi singaba buqamama obungangobubanzi besandla ukusuka enyangeni.
p-308.actionItem: Namuhla ebusuku, uma ubona isiyingi senyanga, hlola isibikezelo sesimo sezulu sakusasa uphathe nesambulela.

p-309.title: U-9H kufilimu yengilazi eqinisiwe (tempered-glass) umele ubulukhuni bepensela
p-309.summary: U-9H usho ukuthi ipensela elilukhuni kunawo wonke alishiyi phawu; akubona ubulukhuni buka-Mohs obungu-9. Uthuli olusephaketheni lakho lungaba lukhuni kakhulu futhi luyinwaye ifilimu.
p-309.principle: Ingaphezulu liyanwayeka lapho inhlayiya ilukhuni kunalo, $H_{\mathrm{particle}}>H_{\mathrm{surface}}$. Isikali sobulukhuni bepensela kanye nesikali sika-Mohs yizikali ezimbili ezahlukene.
p-309.example: I-Quartz, okuwungxenye eyinhloko yesihlabathi, inobulukhuni buka-Mohs obungu-$7$, obulukhuni kunezingilazi (cishe $5.5\sim6$). Ifilimu engu-9H isengaklwebheka othulini lwesihlabathi uma ubulukhuni bayo buka-Mohs bungaphansi kuka-7.
p-309.actionItem: Namuhla, beka ifoni yakho ephaketheni elihlukile kokhiye nezinhlamvu zemali, bese uthulula uthuli lwesihlabathi emaphaketheni akho.

p-310.title: Ebusika, vula amakhethini abheke eningizimu emini ukuze ungenise ilanga
p-310.summary: Ngisho noma ilanga lasebusika liphansi, ifasitela elibheke eningizimu lilibamba ngqo futhi lithola ukushisa okukhulu. Ukuvula amakhethini emini nokuwavala lapho kuhwalala kuwukushisisa kwendlu kwamahhala.
p-310.principle: Ukuthola ukushisa kwelanga ngefasitela kubalwa ngokuthi $Q=A\,I\,\mathrm{SHGC}\cos\theta$ ($I$: amandla okukhanya kwelanga, SHGC: i-solar heat gain coefficient, $\theta$: i-engeli yokungena). Ifasitela elimile elibheke eningizimu ebusika line-engeli encane yokungena futhi lidlulisela ukushisa okuningi.
p-310.example: Efasiteleni elingu-$2\ \mathrm{m^2}$, amandla elanga emini endaweni emile engu-$I\approx500\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$ ngosuku olucwathile kanti ne-$\mathrm{SHGC}=0.6$, inzuzo iba ngu-$600\ \mathrm{W}$. Uma sicabanga isilinganiso esingu-$400\ \mathrm{W}$ emahoreni angu-4, lokho cishe kungu-$1.6\ \mathrm{kWh}$ yokushisa (inani elilinganisiwe).
p-310.actionItem: Namuhla, ngosuku olucwathile, vula amakhethini nezimpumputhe zamafasitela abheke eningizimu bese uwavala ngaphambi kokushona kwelanga ukuze unciphise ukulahleka kokushisa ebusuku.

p-311.title: Umnyango wendlu wokungena (vestibule) uyisikhala sokuvimba umoya obandayo
p-311.summary: Isikhala esincane esiphakathi komnyango wangaphandle kanye nomnyango wangaphakathi sisebenza njengesivimbi esivimbela umoya obandayo ukuba ungangeni ngqo endlini. Into esemqoka ukungavuli yomibili le minyango ngesikhathi esisodwa.
p-311.principle: Ukushintshana komoya emnyango ovulekile kwenzeka ngokuvunguza (convection), kanti ukulahleka kokushisa kubalwa ngo-$Q=\rho cV\Delta T$ ($V$: umthamo womoya oshintshanisiwe). Umnyango wangaphakathi unciphisa umthamo oshintshaniswayo ube cishe ngowesikhala sokungena kuphela.
p-311.example: Uma isikhala sokungena esingu-$3\ \mathrm{m^3}$ sishintshanisa umoya kumehluko ongu-$20\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $Q=1.2\times1005\times3\times20\approx72\ \mathrm{kJ}\approx0.02\ \mathrm{kWh}$. Ngaphandle komnyango wangaphakathi, umkhawulo ophezulu onegumbi lokuphumula elingu-$60\ \mathrm{m^3}$ elithintekayo cishe ungaphezulu ngo-$0.4\ \mathrm{kWh}$.
p-311.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho ufika ekhaya, vala umnyango wangaphandle ngaphambi kokuvula umnyango wangaphakathi, futhi lapho uphuma, vala umnyango wangaphakathi ngaphambi kokuvula owangaphandle.

p-312.title: Uma kungusha ingxenye engaphezulu kuphela yokudla kuhhavini, sola indawo yereki
p-312.summary: Lapho kusondela kakhulu kusifudumezi esiphezulu, ukushisa kwemisebe kuqina kakhulu, ngakho ingxenye engaphezulu isha kuqala. Ukwehlisa ireki ngezinga elilodwa kupheka phezulu naphansi ngokulinganayo.
p-312.principle: Esimweni sokulinganisa somthombo oyiphuzu, ukuqina kwemisebe kungu-$I=\frac{P}{4\pi r^2}$, okuhambisana ngokuphambene nesikwele sebanga. Isifudumezi sangempela siwumthombo owandisiwe ngakho ushintsho luthambile, kodwa lusaqhubeka lukhula njengoba usondela.
p-312.example: Kusibonelo esilula, ireki eqhele ngama-$5\ \mathrm{cm}$ kusifudumezi ithola imisebe ephindwe ka-$(10/5)^2=4$ kunaleyo eqhele ngama-$10\ \mathrm{cm}$. Ngasifudumezini sangempela esiyisicaba iphindeka cishe ka-2 kuya ku-3.
p-312.actionItem: Namuhla, uma ingxenye engaphezulu iba nsundu kuqala, yehlisa ireki ngezinga elilodwa futhi, uma kudingeka, yimboze kancane ingxenye engaphezulu nge-foil.

p-313.title: Ukugqoka amapheya amabili amasokisi kunciphisa amabhamuza
p-313.summary: Amabhamuza abangelwa ukungqubuzana njengoba isikhumba sihuhleka kusokisi; ngezendlalelo ezimbili ukuhuhleka kwenzeka phakathi kwezendlalelo zamasokisi ngakho isikhumba sidonswa kancane. Uma izicathulo zakho ziqina kakhulu, kuba nomphumela ophambene, ngakho shiya isikhala esincane.
p-313.principle: Ukungqubuzana kungu-$F=\mu N$ kanti ukucindezeleka kokugunda esikhunjeni kungu-$\tau=\frac{F}{A}$. Uma i-coefficient yokungqubuzana phakathi kwezendlalelo iphansi kunaphakathi kwesikhumba nesokisi, ukushelela kwenzeka phakathi kwezendlalelo bese ukucindezeleka kwesikhumba kwehla.
p-313.example: Ake sithi $N\approx700\ \mathrm{N}$ onyaweni olulodwa lapho uhamba phezu kwe-$A\approx100\ \mathrm{cm^2}$. Nge-$\mu=0.5$, $\tau\approx35\ \mathrm{kPa}$; nge-$\mu=0.3$ phakathi kwezendlalelo, $\tau\approx21\ \mathrm{kPa}$, cishe kunciphe ngo-$40\%$ (amanani acatshangelwe).
p-313.actionItem: Namuhla, uma unohambo olude lokuhamba ngezinyawo, gqoka isendlalelo sesibili phezu kwesokisi elincane elimunca umswakama bese uhlola ukuthi izicathulo zakho aziqinile yini.

p-314.title: Kungani izithombe zeqhwa ziphuma zimpunga futhi zimnyama
p-314.summary: I-auto exposure yekhamera isetha isilinganiso sesimo sibe mpunga ophakathi nendawo, ngakho iqhwa elimhlophe livela limpunga. Ukukhulisa i-exposure kwenza iqhwa liphume limhlophe.
p-314.principle: I-auto exposure ihlose ukucabangela okumaphakathi ku-$18\%$ ompunga. Uma iqhwa linokucabangela okungu-$\rho$, ukulungiswa okudingekayo kungu-$\Delta\mathrm{EV}=\log_2\frac{\rho}{0.18}$.
p-314.example: Eseqhweni eline-$\rho\approx0.8$, $\Delta\mathrm{EV}=\log_2\frac{0.8}{0.18}\approx2.1$. Yingakho abathwebuli bezithombe ngokuvamile befaka ukulungisa okungu-$+1\sim+2\ \mathrm{EV}$.
p-314.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho uthwebula iqhwa, thepha iqhwa esikrinini bese ukhuphula isilayidi sokukhanya ngo-$+1\sim+2$.

p-315.title: Khetha isambulela esicwebezelayo esinembobo yomoya
p-315.summary: Lapho umoya uphusha kakhulu esambuleleni, imbobo evumela umoya ukuba uphume inciphisa umehluko wokucindezela nethuba lokuba siphendukele ngaphandle. Asikho isambulela okufanele sisetshenziswe esivunguvungwini esinamandla.
p-315.principle: Ukudonsa kungu-$F_D=\frac12\rho C_DAv^2$, okuhambisana nesikwele sejubane lomoya. Uma umklamo onezimbobo unciphisa umehluko wokucindezela futhi ngaleyo ndlela wehlise i-$C_D$, amandla ehla ngengxenye efanayo.
p-315.example: Ku-$15\ \mathrm{m/s}$ enobubanzi obungama-$100\ \mathrm{cm}$ ($A\approx0.79\ \mathrm{m^2}$) kanye ne-$C_D=1.2$, $F_D\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$ (cishe ama-$13\ \mathrm{kgf}$). Uma i-$C_D$ yehla yaba ngu-$0.9$, amandla aba cishe ngama-$95\ \mathrm{N}$, anciphe ngo-$25\%$ (amanani acatshangelwe).
p-315.actionItem: Namuhla, lapho ukhetha isambulela, bheka umklamo onezendlalelo ezimbili noma imbobo yomoya kanye nezimbambo ze-fiberglass.

p-316.title: Isifudumezi sikagesi esingu-1 kW sishisa ncamashi ngo-1 kW
p-316.summary: Isifudumezi sikagesi siguqula cishe wonke ugesi osisebenzisayo ube ukushisa. Ngakho-ke ugesi odingekayo ngenani elithile lokushisa uwamandla aphindwe ngesikhathi.
p-316.principle: Ukushisa okumelana nogesi kusebenza kahle ngo-$100\%$, futhi amandla asetshenzisiwe angu-$E=Pt$. I-heat pump (isiphephetha-moya esifudumezayo) ine-coefficient of performance $\mathrm{COP}=\frac{Q}{W}$ ecishe ibe ngu-3, ekhiqiza ukushisa okufanayo nge-$\frac13$ kagesi.
p-316.example: Isifudumezi esingu-$1\ \mathrm{kW}$ esisebenza amahora angu-3 sisebenzisa i-$3\ \mathrm{kWh}$; uma kucatshangwa ukuthi kubiza ama-200 KRW/kWh, lokho kungama-600 KRW (cishe i-USD 0.45). I-heat pump ene-$\mathrm{COP}=3$ idinga i-$1\ \mathrm{kWh}$, cishe ama-200 KRW, ngokushisa okufanayo.
p-316.actionItem: Namuhla, uma usebenzisa isifudumezi, hlola amandla aso alinganiselwe (W) bese usetha isibali sikhathi ukuze sisebenze kuphela ngesikhathi esidingekayo.

p-317.title: Ingubo yethanga imelela u-1 kuya ku-2 °C wokushisa
p-317.summary: Ukuzwa ukufudumala kuyenyuka njengoba ukushisa okuncane kuphuma emzimbeni wakho, ngakho ingubo eyodwa yethanga inikeza umphumela wokukhuphula igumbi ngo-1 kuya ku-2 °C. Ungahlala ufudumele ngokushisa okusethwe kancane phansi.
p-317.principle: Ukulahleka kokushisa kungu-$q=\frac{T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_{\mathrm{air}}}{R_{\mathrm{clo}}+R_{\mathrm{air}}}$, futhi emsebenzini wokuhlala phansi, i-$1\ \mathrm{clo}$ yezingubo ($0.155\ \mathrm{m^2K/W}$) yehlisa izinga lokushisa lokunethezeka cishe ngo-$5.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
p-317.example: Ingubo yethanga ecishe ibe ngu-$0.3\ \mathrm{clo}$ yehlisa izinga lokushisa lokunethezeka cishe ngo-$1.7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Njengomthetho ojwayelekile, ukwehlisa isilungiselelo sokushisa ngo-$1\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ngakunye kunciphisa izindleko zokushisa cishe ngo-$7\%$, ngakho i-$1.5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ icishe ibe ngu-$10\%$.
p-317.actionItem: Namuhla, yehlisa izinga lokushisa lasegunjini lokuphumula ngo-1 °C bese ugcina ingubo yethanga kusofa.

p-318.title: Izinhlansi zocwecwe lwe-aluminium ku-microwave ziqala ezihlokweni ezicijile
p-318.summary: Esihlokweni sensimbi esicijile inkundla kagesi iyagxila futhi ihlukanise umoya, ikhiphe izinhlansi. Ungafaki ucwecwe lwe-aluminium, izitsha ezinonqenqema lwegolide noma imihlobiso yensimbi.
p-318.principle: Esihlokweni esine-radius encane yokugoba, inkundla ikhula njenge-$E\approx\frac{V}{r}$. Umoya uhlukana cishe ku-$E_b\approx3\ \mathrm{MV/m}$, okukhiqiza i-corona nokukhishwa kwezinhlansi.
p-318.example: Ake sithi i-voltage ebangelwe ithi $V=300\ \mathrm{V}$ onqenqemeni locwecwe olunerediyasi yesihloko ethi $r=0.1\ \mathrm{mm}$: $E=\frac{300}{10^{-4}}=3\ \mathrm{MV/m}$, ngqo lapho kuphuka khona (amanani acatshangelwe). Ishidi elikhulu eliyisicaba lisengozini encane kunonqenqema lwalo kodwa liseyingozi.
p-318.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina iziqukathi zensimbi, ucwecwe lwe-aluminium nezitsha ezinonqenqema lwegolide ngaphandle kwe-microwave. Uma kuphuma izinhlansi, yimise ngokushesha bese ukhipha ukudla ngemva kokuphola.

p-319.title: Kungani ukuhlala eduze kwefasitela elibandayo kuzwakala kubanda kakhulu kunasegumbini
p-319.summary: Umzimba wakho ulahlekelwa ukushisa ngemisebe ezindaweni ezibandayo ezikuzungezile kanye nasemoyeni. Ifasitela linobuso obubandayo, ngakho-ke lizwakala libanda nakuba izinga lokushisa lomoya lifana.
p-319.principle: Ukulahleka kwemisebe okuphelele kungu-$q=\varepsilon\sigma\left(T_{\mathrm{skin}}^4-T_s^4\right)\approx h_r\left(T_{\mathrm{skin}}-T_s\right)$, lapho u-$h_r\approx5\ \mathrm{W/(m^2\cdot K)}$ eduze kwezinga lokushisa legumbi.
p-319.example: Ngaphezulu kwengubo engu-$28\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$ nobuso befasitela obungu-$8\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, $q\approx5\times20=100\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$, uma kuqhathaniswa no-$50\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$ odongeni olungu-$18\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ngaphezu kuka-$0.5\ \mathrm{m^2}$ ebheke kulo, lokho cishe kungu-$25\ \mathrm{W}$ ngaphezulu (amanani acatshangelwe).
p-319.actionItem: Namuhla, uma isihlalo esiseduze kwefasitela sizwakala sibanda, hlehlisa isihlalo cishe nge-1 m noma ulengise ikhethini noma ifilimu efaka ukufudumala.

p-320.title: Misa itende lokukhempa ebusika phakathi nentaba kunezigodini
p-320.summary: Ebusuku obucwebile, obunokuthula, umoya obandayo uyashona futhi uqoqane ezigodini nasemigedeni. Isiqongo sentaba sinomoya omningi, ngakho-ke indawo eyisicaba evikelekile emthambekeni ingcono kakhulu.
p-320.principle: Umoya obandayo uminyene futhi ugeleza wehlele phansi ngokushesha kwe-buoyancy $a\approx g\frac{\Delta T}{T}$, wakhe amachibi omoya obandayo. Izinga lokushisa livame ukwehla cishe ngo-$0.65\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}/100\ \mathrm{m}$ ngokuphakama, kodwa i-inversion yasebusuku ikuguqula lokhu.
p-320.example: Ngo-$\Delta T=5\ \mathrm{K}$ kanye no-$T=278\ \mathrm{K}$, $a\approx9.8\times\frac{5}{278}\approx0.18\ \mathrm{m/s^2}$. Ebusuku obubandayo nobunokuthula ebusika phansi esigodini kungaba makhaza ngama-$^\circ\mathrm{C}$ ambalwa kunaphakathi nentaba.
p-320.actionItem: Namuhla, uma uhlela ukukhempa, hlala endaweni ebekelwe ukukhempa, gwema izigodi bese ukhetha indawo eyisicaba enomoya omncane.

p-321.title: Izifudumezi ze-radiant neze-convection zisebenza ngendlela ehlukile
p-321.summary: Isifudumezi se-radiant sifudumeza abantu nezinto ngokuqondile futhi sizwakala sifudumele ngokushesha, kanti isifudumezi se-convection sifudumeza umoya bese kancane sifudumeza lonke igumbi. Khetha ngokuya ngendlela ozoyisebenzisa ngayo.
p-321.principle: Imisebe idlulisela ukushisa ezindaweni ezingaphezulu ngaphandle kokufudumeza umoya, $q=\varepsilon\sigma(T_h^4-T_s^4)A$, kuyilapho i-convection ihambisa ukushisa ngokuzungezisa umoya ofudumele, $q=hA\,\Delta T$.
p-321.example: Iyunithi ye-radiant engu-1 kW ifudumeza isikhumba esiqhele ngemitha elingu-1 ngokushesha ngemva kokuyivula, kodwa iyunithi ye-convection idinga u-$Q=mc\Delta T\approx0.18\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ukuze nje inyuse igumbi elingu-30 m³ (cishe u-36 kg womoya) ngo-5°C, futhi kuthatha isikhathi eside kakhulu uma izindonga nefenisha sekuqala ukumunca ukushisa.
p-321.actionItem: Uma uhlela ukuthenga isifudumezi namuhla, thola ukusetshenziswa kwaso kuqala: i-radiant yendawo eyodwa njengedeski, i-convection yegumbi lonke.

p-322.title: Ebusika, fudumeza isihlalo esikhundleni somoya emotweni kagesi (EV)
p-322.summary: Isifudumezi sekhabethe le-EV sidonsa amandla amaningi ebhethrini, ngakho ukufudumeza umzimba wakho ngokuqondile ngezifudumezi zezihlalo nesiteringi nokwehlisa izinga lekhabethe kuvikela ibanga lokuhamba.
p-322.principle: Ukufudumeza ngokuthintana ngqo kudinga ukushisa okuncane kakhulu. Ukufudumeza umoya wekhabethe kuthatha u-$Q=mc\Delta T$ kanye nokunxephezela okuqhubekayo kokulahlekelwa emzimbeni wemoto nasengilazini.
p-322.example: Ukwehlisa isifudumezi sekhabethe sisuke cishe ku-3 kW siye engxenyeni nokusebenzisa isifudumezi sesihlalo esingu-60 W konga cishe u-1.4 kWh ngehora, okulingana cishe namakhilomitha angu-8 ebanga ku-6 km/kWh.
p-322.actionItem: Kuhambo lwakho olulandelayo, vula izifudumezi zezihlalo nesiteringi kuqala bese wehlisa izinga lokushisa lekhabethe ngo-1-2°C.

p-323.title: Ukushisa kwemoto ebusika kuwukushisa okumoshekile kwenjini, ngakho kucishe kube mahhala
p-323.summary: Isifudumezi semoto kaphethiloli sisebenzisa ukushisa kwenjini okuthwalwa yisipholisi, ngakho ukusisebenzisa akubizi uphethiloli owengeziwe. I-compressor ye-A/C yiyona eshisa uphethiloli.
p-323.principle: Cishe u-60% wamandla kaphethiloli uphuma njengokushisa okumoshekile ($Q_\mathrm{waste}\approx 0.6\,Q_\mathrm{fuel}$), futhi i-heater core iqondisa ingxenye yako ekhabetheni. I-compressor ye-A/C idonsa umsebenzi owengeziwe $W$ enjinini.
p-323.example: Ukufudumeza ikhabethe kuthatha cishe u-2-4 kW, okuyingxenye encane yokushisa kwenjini ngenkathi uhamba, kanti i-compressor ye-A/C ithatha cishe amandla enjini engeziwe angu-1-3 kW.
p-323.actionItem: Uma amafasitela engabi nenkungu, gcina inkinobho ye-A/C icishiwe ohambweni lwakho lwasebusika namuhla bese usebenzisa ukushisa kuphela.

p-324.title: Ungahlukuzi ibhodlela likatamatisi osikiwe (ketchup), lishaye libheke phansi
p-324.summary: Utamatisi osikiwe uhlala uzinzile njengento eqinile, bese uncibilika ngokuzumayo lapho ufakwa amandla. Bamba ibhodlela libheke phansi bese ulishaya kanye ngamandla ukuze usebenzise umfutho oqinile.
p-324.principle: Utamatisi osikiwe (ketchup) uwuketshezi olungewona owe-Newtonian oluncipha ngomfutho (shear-thinning): njengoba izinga lomfutho $\dot\gamma$ likhuphuka, ukujiya okubonakalayo $\eta=\tau/\dot\gamma$ kuyehla, futhi ugelezela phambili uma umfutho weqa umkhawulo wokuqala ukugeleza (yield stress).
p-324.example: Lapho uphumule, ukujiya kwawo kulinganiselwa ku-50 Pa·s noma ngaphezulu, futhi ngaphansi komfutho onamandla kwehla ngokuphindwe ngamashumi, nakuba kusekujiyile kakhulu kunamanzi (cishe u-0.001 Pa·s).
p-324.actionItem: Namuhla, bamba ibhodlela likatamatisi osikiwe libheke phansi bese ushaya ingxenye yentamo yalo kanye ngentende yesandla sakho.

p-325.title: Setha i-treadmill ekukhuphukeni okungu-1% ukuze ilingane nangaphandle
p-325.summary: I-treadmill ayinakho ukumelana nomoya, ngakho-ke isivinini esifanayo sizwakala silula kunangaphandle. Ukukhuphuka ngo-1% kucishe kuvale lowo mehluko.
p-325.principle: Umsebenzi olahleka ekumelaneni nomoya unxeshezelwa ngamandla adonsela phansi (gravitational potential energy): $P=mgv\sin\theta\approx mgv\times(\text{grade})$.
p-325.example: Umgijimi onesisindo esingu-70 kg ogijima ngo-10 km/h (cishe 2.78 m/s) wengeza u-$70\times9.81\times2.78\times0.01\approx19\ \mathrm{W}$ ezingeni lokukhuphuka elingu-1%.
p-325.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa i-treadmill namuhla, setha ukukhuphuka (incline) ku-1% ngaphambi kokuba uqale.

p-326.title: Cindezela ilensi yakho efasiteleni uma uthwebula ebhasini nasesitimeleni
p-326.summary: Ukukhanya kwangaphakathi okubonakala efasiteleni kuncipha kakhulu lapho ilensi isondele engilazini. Ukuvikela ngesandla noma ukusebenzisa isivikelo selensi kuyasiza kakhulu.
p-326.principle: Ingaphezulu lengilazi libonisa cishe u-4% ngokokukhanya kwe-Fresnel ($R=\left(\frac{n-1}{n+1}\right)^2,\ n\approx1.5$), futhi ilensi eseduze nengilazi inciphisa i-engeli lapho ukukhanya okubonakalayo kungangena khona.
p-326.example: Izindawo ezimbili zengilazi zibonisa cishe u-4% ngayinye, ngakho-ke cishe u-8% wokukhanya kwangaphakathi uvela efasiteleni, futhi le ngxenye ibonakala kakhulu uma kumnyama ngaphandle.
p-326.actionItem: Lapho uthatha izithombe ubheke ngaphandle efasiteleni namuhla, beka ilensi kancane engilazini bese uyithungatha ngesandla, kodwa ungacindezeli ngamandla engxenyeni eqhaqhazelayo.

p-327.title: Qondanisa ama-earphone nocingo lwakho ngokusho kwe-impedance (ama-ohm)
p-327.summary: I-earphone ene-impedance ephansi idlala ngokuzwakalayo kakhulu kusukela entweni enamandla kagesi aphansi njenge-smartphone. Uhlobo lwe-impedance ephezulu lunikeza amandla amancane kumthamo kagesi ofanayo.
p-327.principle: Amandla anikezwayo angu-$P=\frac{V^2}{R}$, ngakho kumthamo kagesi ofanayo $V$ i-impedance enkulu $R$ inikeza amandla amancane $P$.
p-327.example: Ku-0.5 V (rms), i-earphone engu-16 Ω ithola cishe u-15.6 mW kanti i-earphone engu-300 Ω ithola cishe u-0.83 mW, okuyizikhathi ezingaba ngu-19 ngaphansi.
p-327.actionItem: Bheka i-impedance ephepheni lemininingwane yama-earphone namuhla bese ukhetha u-16-32 Ω uma uzoyixhuma ngqo ocingweni.

p-328.title: I-1 kWh ingu-3.6 MJ, cishe ama-kcal angu-860
p-328.summary: I-kWh esikweletini sakho sikagesi, ama-kcal kumalebula okudla kanye ne-joule kwezesayensi konke kungamayunithi wamandla futhi kuguquleka ngendlela eqondile.
p-328.example: Usuku oludla ama-kcal angu-2,000 lulingana cishe no-8.4 MJ, noma 2.3 kWh, okuyisilinganiso esingaba ngu-97 W. I-kWh eyodwa ikhanyisa ibhalbhu engu-100 W amahora angu-10.
p-328.actionItem: Bheka ukusetshenziswa kwakho kwale nyanga nge-kWh esikweletini sakho sikagesi noma kuhlelo lokusebenza namuhla.

p-329.title: Njalo uma uvula umnyango we-ovini, ilahlekelwa cishe ngu-25°C
p-329.summary: Ukuvula umnyango we-ovini kukhipha umoya oshisayo futhi kungenise umoya obandayo, ngakho-ke izinga lokushisa lehla kakhulu futhi kudingeka amandla ukuze libuye.
p-329.principle: Umnyango ovulekile uvumela ukushintshana komoya ngokudluliselwa kokushisa (convection) okuqhutshwa umehluko wezinga lokushisa, futhi ukubuyisela kudinga ukushisa $Q=C\Delta T$ futhi. Izindonga zigcina ukushisa, ngakho-ke ukwehla kuyahluka kuye nge-ovini.
p-329.example: I-ovini engu-180°C ivamise ukubikwa ukuthi yehla cishe ngo-20-30°C ngemva kokuvulwa kanye, futhi ukululama kuthatha amaminithi, okwandisa isikhathi sokupheka nokusebenzisa ugesi omningi.
p-329.actionItem: Ngesikhathi ubhaka namuhla, gcina umnyango uvaliwe futhi uhlole ukuqhubeka ngefasitela usebenzisa ukukhanya kwe-ovini.

p-330.title: Hlukanisa iqanda eliluhlaza kweliphekiwe ngokuliphehla
p-330.summary: Phehla iqanda phezu kwetafula: iqanda eliphekiwe liphahlazeka kahle isikhathi eside, kanti iqanda eliluhlaza liyantenga bese lima ngokushesha.
p-330.principle: Iqanda elibilisiwe liyinto eyodwa eqinile, ngakho liphahlazeka ngokusimeme nge-$L=I\omega$. E qandeni eliluhlaza uketshezi luhamba ngokuhlukana negobolondo, lulahlekelwa amandla, futhi ngemva kokumisa igobolondo uketshezi luyaqhubeka nokuphenduka bese iqanda liphinda linhleleza kancane.
p-330.example: E qandeni elilinganiselwa ku-60 g, eliphekiwe liphahlazeka ngokusimeme imizuzwana eminingana kanti eliluhlaza livame ukuma ngokushesha okubonakalayo. Uma ulimisa kafushane bese uliyeka, iqanda eliluhlaza kuphela eliphinde lihambe.
p-330.actionItem: Phehla amaqanda amabili avela esiqandisini phezu kwetafula namuhla ubone ukuthi yiliphi eliphenduka kahle.

p-331.title: Khohlelela emkhonweni noma endololwaneni yakho, njengoba amaconsi ehamba amamitha
p-331.summary: Ukukhwehlela nokuthimula kwakha umoya osheshayo othwala amaconsi amamitha amaningana. Ukumboza ngaphakathi kwendololwane noma ngomkhono kufinyeza kakhulu ibanga ahamba ngalo.
p-331.principle: Umoya ophuma ngamandla emlonyeni uthwele umfutho $p=mv$ futhi usakazeka phambili, wehla ngesivinini kancane kancane njengoba uhlakazeka emoyeni.
p-331.example: Ukuphuma kokuqala komoya wokukhwehlela kubikwa cishe ku-10 m/s, futhi izinhlayiya ezincane zingalenga emoyeni zifinyelele kumamitha amaningana.
p-331.actionItem: Uma ukhwehlela namuhla, vala umlomo nekhala lakho ngaphakathi kwendololwane noma ngomkhono wakho esikhundleni sesandla sakho.

p-332.title: Khetha imibala yamalensi ezibuko ze-ski kuye ngesimo sezulu
p-332.summary: Ngezinsuku ezinelanga, sebenzisa amalensi amnyama ukuze wehlise ukukhanya okuxhopha; ngezinsuku ezinamafu noma ezineqhwa, amalensi aphuzi noma awolintshi agqamisa imiphetho yeqhwa.
p-332.principle: Amalensi ahlukile ekudluliseni ukukhanya ngobude bamagagasi, kanti ukukhanya kulandela ukudluliswa kokukhanya okubonakalayo $\mathrm{VLT}=I/I_0$. Okuphuzi nowolintshi kuhlaziya ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka futhi kukhuphula umehluko wokubona ekukhanyeni okuphansi.
p-332.example: Izinketho ezivamile amalensi ampunga kakhulu noma anezibuko anenani le-VLT elic Cishe 10-20% elangeni, kanye namalensi aphuzi noma abomvana anenani le-VLT elic Cishe 40-60% emafwini.
p-332.actionItem: Lapho upakisha izibuko ze-ski namuhla, hlola isibikezelo sezulu bese ukhetha umbala welensi, noma phatha ilensi eyisipele.

p-333.title: Gcina izipikha okungenani ziqhele ngama-20 cm odongeni
p-333.summary: Izipikha ezisunduzelwe odongeni zikhulisa umsindo webhesi ngokweqile futhi zicime amanye amanothi, okwenza umsindo ungangeni kahle futhi ungacaci.
p-333.principle: Eduze kodonga, imiphumela yemingcele ikhulisa ibhesi (cishe nge-3-6 dB), futhi umsindo uyancipha kumaza athi $f=\frac{c}{4d}$ lapho ukubuyela emuva komsindo odongeni kufika kungahambelani nomsindo oqondile.
p-333.example: Ku-20 cm ukusuka odongeni ukwehla kwenzeka eduze kuka-$f=\frac{343}{4\times0.2}\approx430\ \mathrm{Hz}$, futhi ku-50 cm eduze kuka-170 Hz, okushintsha ukulingana kwebhesi. Imiphumela iyahluka kuye ngegumbi.
p-333.actionItem: Namuhla, gqashula izipikha zakho okungenani ziqhele ngama-20 cm odongeni bese udlala kabusha leyo ngoma efanayo.

p-334.title: I-inverter yemoto idonsa amandla amakhulu kagesi ku-12 V
p-334.summary: Ukuxhuma idivayisi edinga amandla amakhulu njengeshaja ye-laptop ku-inverter yemoto kudonsa amandla amakhulu ohlangothini lwe-12 V futhi kungaqhumisa ifyuzi yesokhethi.
p-334.principle: Amandla athi $P=VI$, ngakho emandleni afanayo amandla aphansi e-voltage asho umsinga omkhulu kagesi, $I=P/V$.
p-334.example: Idivayisi ye-150 W idinga u-$150/12=12.5\ \mathrm{A}$ ngokwemfundiso, futhi ngokusebenza kahle kwe-inverter okungama-90% idinga cishe u-13.9 A, okusondelene kakhulu nomkhawulo wefyuzi evamile yesokhethi engu-10-15 A.
p-334.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola isilinganiso sefyuzi yesokhethi yemoto yakho ngama-amps bese uhlukanisa amandla e-watt edivayisi yakho nge-12 V.

p-335.title: Ukushisisa uhhavini kusengaphambili kuyizindleko ezingaguquki, ngakho bhaka ngesikhathi esisodwa
p-335.summary: Amandla okushisisa uhhavini kusengaphambili ayafana kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubhaka okungakanani. Ukupheka izinto eziningana ngesikhathi esisodwa kusho ukushisisa uhhavini izikhathi ezimbalwa.
p-335.principle: Ukushisa kokushisisa kusengaphambili kuncike emandleni okuthwala ukushisa kuka-hhavini kanye nokukhuphuka kwezinga lokushisa, $Q=C_\mathrm{oven}\Delta T$, hhayi enanini lokudla.
p-335.example: Ukushisisa uhhavini kagesi ufike ku-180°C kuthatha cishe i-0.3-0.4 kWh, ngakho ukubhaka ngeseshini eyodwa esikhundleni sezimbili konga cishe ama-70 KRW (cishe u-0.05 USD).
p-335.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa uhhavini namuhla, qoqa yonke into bese uyibhaka ndawonye emashalofini amabili.

p-336.title: Thola izinsika zodonga ngokungqongqoza
p-336.summary: Ngqongqoza odongeni lwe-drywall: indawo engenalutho izwakala iphansi futhi inomsindo onjengesigubhu, kanti phezu kwensika (uhlaka) izwakala iqinile futhi iphezulu.
p-336.principle: Iphaneli elingqongqoziwe lidlidliza ngemvamisa ye-resonance $f\propto\sqrt{k/m}$, futhi phezu kwensika ukuqina $k$ kukhulu kakhulu, ngakho umsindo uphakama kakhulu futhi umfushane.
p-336.example: Izinsika zivame ukuba buqamama ngo-400-600 mm, ngakho ukungqongqoza njalo ngemva kuka-10 cm odongeni kubonisa umsindo ushintsha ngezikhathi ezilinganayo.
p-336.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokushayela isipikili namuhla, ngqongqoza ukuze uthole insika futhi uhlole ukuthi awekho yini amacingo noma amapayipi adlula lapho.

p-337.title: Ungaphila ku-sauna engu-80°C kodwa hhayi emanzini ango-80°C
p-337.summary: Umoya awudlulisi ukushisa kahle, ngakho i-sauna engu-80°C ingabekezeleleka, kodwa amanzi analo lelo bizinga lokushisa ashisa khona manjalo.
p-337.principle: Ukugeleza kokushisa esikhunjeni kuhambisana nokuhanjiswa kokushisa (thermal conductivity) kanye nomthamo wokushisa. Amanzi ahambisa cishe u-$0.6\ \mathrm{W/m\,K}$, cishe ngokuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-25 kunomoya ($0.026$), futhi agcina ukushisa okuningi kakhulu ngevolumu ngayinye.
p-337.example: Amanzi ahambisa ukushisa kangcono cishe ngokuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-25 kunomoya futhi agcina ukushisa cishe ngokuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-3,500 ngevolumu, ngakho amanzi angaphezu kuka-60°C angasha kungakapheli imizuzwana.
p-337.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokushawa noma ukugeza namuhla, qala ngokuhlola amanzi engalweni yakho yangaphakathi.

p-338.title: Hamba phezu kwechibi eliqandisiwe kuphela uma iqhwa lingango-10 cm noma ngaphezulu
p-338.summary: Amandla eqhwa akhula ngesikwele sobukhulu balo, kodwa iqhwa elincanyana liyingozi. Hlola ubukhulu bese ulandela iziqondiso zendawo.
p-338.principle: Isisindo esingathwalwa ucezu lweqhwa sihambisana no-$P\propto h^2$, ngakho ukuphinda kabili ubukhulu $h$ kucishe kuphindaphinde amandla ngokuphindwe kane.
p-338.example: Ngokujwayelekile, u-5 cm ucishe ubambe umuntu oyedwa ohamba ngezinyawo kanti u-10 cm noma ngaphezulu uyadingeka emaqenjini, futhi ukusuka ku-5 cm kuya ku-10 cm kwandisa amandla cishe izikhathi ezingu-4.
p-338.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokunyathela eqhweni namuhla, qinisekisa iseluleko sendawo kanye nobukhulu balo, futhi unganyatheli uma unokungabaza.

p-339.title: Ahlulela izibani ngama-lumen, kanye nesikhathi sokusebenza ngama-watt-hour
p-339.summary: Qhathanisa ukukhanya kwesibani ngama-lumen (lm) kanye nesikhathi sokusebenza njengomthamo webhethri (Wh) ohlukaniswe ngokusetshenziswa kwamandla.
p-339.principle: Ukusebenza kahle ngu-$\eta=\mathrm{lm}/\mathrm{W}$, futhi isikhathi sokusebenza ngu-$t=\frac{E}{P}$.
p-339.example: I-300 lm ku-100 lm/W ingu-3 W. Ibhethri le-3.7 V 5,000 mAh (cishe i-18.5 Wh) liyisebenzisa cishe amahora angu-6 ngokombono.
p-339.actionItem: Hlola ama-lumen kanye ne-Wh yebhethri (noma i-mAh ephindaphindwe ngo-V) kusibani sakho namuhla bese ubale isikhathi saso sokusebenza.

p-340.title: Ukushona kwelanga kwasekuqaleni kakhulu akwenzeki nge-winter solstice
p-340.summary: Ukushona kwelanga kwasekuqaleni kakhulu kwenzeka ekuqaleni kukaZibandlela, cishe amaviki amabili ngaphambi kwe-solstice (cishe ngomhla ka-21 kuZibandlela), okuwusuku olufushane kakhulu. Ukuphuma kwelanga kwamuva kakhulu kwenzeka ekuqaleni kukaMasingana.
p-340.principle: Isikhathi lapho ilanga liwela khona ngqo eningizimu sishintsha nge-equation of time $E$, ngakho izikhathi ezeqisayo zokushona nokuphuma kwelanga ziwela ezinsukwini ezihlukile kune-solstice.
p-340.example: E-Seoul ukushona kwelanga kwasekuqaleni cishe kungu-17:16 ekuqaleni kukaZibandlela futhi cishe kungu-17:20 eduze kwe-solstice, cishe ngemizuzu engu-4 kamuva, nakuba ukukhanya kwelanga okuphelele kufushane kakhulu nge-solstice.
p-340.actionItem: Hlola isikhathi sokushona kwelanga sanamuhla bese ubheka ukuthi siqala yini ukushona sekwephuzile maphakathi noZibandlela.

p-341.title: Isikali sasekhishini sidla ukudla okuncane kunezinkomishi zokulinganisa
p-341.summary: Ufulawa othathwe ngenkomishi uyahlukahluka kuye ngokuthi uminyene kangakanani, kanti isikali silinganisa ngamagremu futhi sonakalisa okuncane.
p-341.principle: Isisindo sithi $m=\rho V$, kodwa izimpushana zishintsha ukuminyana $\rho$ ngo-20% noma ngaphezulu njengoba zihlangana, ngakho ivolumu efanayo inikeza isisindo esihlukile.
p-341.example: Inkomishi eyodwa kafulawa (cishe ama-240 mL) ingaba nesisindo esingaba ngu-100-150 g kuye ngokuthi ithathwe kanjani, umehluko ocishe ube ngu-50% owenza inhlama iqine noma inamathele.
p-341.actionItem: Uma ubhaka namuhla, linganisa izithako ngamagremu esikalini esikhundleni sokusebenzisa izinkomishi.

p-342.title: I-smartphone engilazini yengilazi izwakala kakhulu
p-342.summary: Ukubeka ifoni engilazini engenalutho kugxilisa umsindo phambili futhi kuyenze ikhale ngaphakathi kwengilazi, ngakho izwakala kakhulu ngama-dB ambalwa.
p-342.principle: Ipayipi elivaliwe kolunye uhlangothi linomsindo oseduze kuka-$f=\frac{c}{4L}$, futhi ingilazi iqoqa umsindo ibheke ohlangothini olulodwa, okwandisa ukuqondiswa kwawo.
p-342.example: Ingilazi ejule ngo-10 cm iqinisa umsindo eduze kuka-$f=\frac{343}{4\times0.1}\approx860\ \mathrm{Hz}$, cishe ngo-3-6 dB (izikhathi eziyi-2-4 zamandla omsindo), kuye ngocingo.
p-342.actionItem: Namuhla, beka ifoni ngasohlangothini lwesipikha engilazini bese uqhathanisa ubukhulu bomsindo.

p-343.title: Ukusha kwezinga lokushisa eliphansi kungenzeka ku-44°C emahoreni ambalwa
p-343.summary: Ngisho nokushisa okuncane okuvela engutsheni kagesi noma ephaketheni lokushisa kungalimaza isikhumba esijulile uma kuhlala endaweni eyodwa isikhathi eside kakhulu, futhi kulula ukungakunaki ngoba kubuhlungu kancane.
p-343.principle: Ukulimala kwesikhumba kubangelwa ukuthintana phakathi kwezinga lokushisa kanye nesikhathi sokuthintana ndawonye, ngakho ngisho nezinga lokushisa eliphansi liyalimaza uma ukuthintana kukude.
p-343.example: Ukuthintana cishe ku-44°C cishe amahora angu-6 noma ngaphezulu kuyaziwa ngokubangela ukusha, kanti iphakethe lokushisa elingaba ngu-60°C liyingozi ngezikhathi ezimfushane kakhulu.
p-343.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina amaphakethe okushisa nezingubo zikagesi phezu kwezingubo noma indwangu kunokuba zibe sesikhunjeni esingenalutho, futhi uzicime ngaphambi kokuba ulale.

p-344.title: Ukukhukhuleka kweqhwa maningi amathuba okwenzeka emithambekeni engu-30-45°
p-344.summary: Imithambeka eneqhwa ivamise ukukhululeka kakhulu ku-30-45°. Imithambeka ethambile igcina iqhwa, kanti eyehle kakhulu ililulaza phansi ngaphambi kokuba linqwabelane.
p-344.principle: I-slab iyashelela lapho ukucindezeleka kokugunda kusendlalelo esibuthakathaka, $\tau=\rho g h\sin\theta\cos\theta$, kudlula ukumelana kokushayisana, futhi $\tau$ ikhuphuka nge-engeli yomthambeka $\theta$ ifinyelele phezulu ku-45°.
p-344.example: Uqweqwe olungu-1 m lweqhwa elingu-300 kg/m³ emthambekeni ongu-38° lunikeza $\tau\approx300\times9.81\times1\times0.485\approx1.4\ \mathrm{kPa}$, futhi lapho lokho kudlula amandla ongqimba, liyakhululeka.
p-344.actionItem: Uma uya ezintabeni ezineqhwa namuhla, hlola isibikezelo sokukhukhuleka kweqhwa nama-engeli omthambeka kuqala, futhi ugweme imithambeka eyehle kakhulu kuno-30°.

p-345.title: Lengisa isisindo ku-tripod elula
p-345.summary: I-tripod elula iwisa umoya kalula. Ukulengisa isikhwama phansi futhi phakathi nendawo kuhlisa isikhungo samandla adonsela phansi futhi kuyenze izinze kakhulu.
p-345.principle: Iyawisa lapho amandla aphakeme edlula i-torque yokubuyisela: amandla okuwisa ngu-$F=\frac{mgr}{h}$, ngakho uma isikhungo sesisindo $h$ siphansi, amandla adingekayo makhulu.
p-345.example: Ku-tripod engu-1.5 kg (isikhungo singamamitha angu-1.2 ukuphakama, irediyasi yomlenze ingu-0.4 m), ukulengisa isikhwama esingu-3 kg ku-0.3 m kuhlisa isikhungo siye ku-0.6 m futhi kwenyusa amandla okuwisa kusuka cishe ku-4.9 N kuya cishe ku-14.7 N, cishe izikhathi ezi-3.
p-345.actionItem: Lapho usebenzisa i-tripod namuhla, lengisa isikhwama ehhukwini elingaphansi kwekholomu emaphakathi ukuze silenge phansi singathinti phansi.

p-346.title: Umuntu oyedwa uyisifudumezi esingu-100 W
p-346.summary: Umuntu ukhipha cishe u-100 W wokushisa ngisho noma ephumule, ngakho igumbi eligcwele abantu lifudumala ngokushesha ngaphandle kokushisisa.
p-346.principle: Amandla okudla agcina engukushisa, futhi amandla okusebenza komzimba okuvamile cishe angama-$P=E/t\approx80\text{-}120\ \mathrm{W}$.
p-346.example: Usuku lwe-2,000 kcal lingu-$\frac{8.37\ \mathrm{MJ}}{86400\ \mathrm{s}}\approx97\ \mathrm{W}$. Igumbi labantu abangu-20 linikeza cishe u-2 kW, okulingana nesifudumezi esisodwa esincane sikagesi.
p-346.actionItem: Uma abantu behlangana egumbini namuhla, yehlisa isilungiselelo sokushisa ngo-1-2°C.

p-347.title: Sula phansi ebhodweni elimanzi ngaphambi kokulibeka esitofini
p-347.summary: Amanzi angaphansi kwebhodwe ahwamuka elangabini futhi antshontshe ukushisa okuningi, amoshe isikhathi negesi, kanti amathonsi achaphazayo angaba yingozi.
p-347.principle: Ukuhwamuka kudinga ukushisa okucashile $Q=mL$, kanti ukushisa okucashile kokuhwamuka kwamanzi kungu-$L\approx2.26\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$.
p-347.example: U-10 g wamanzi phansi kwebhodwe uthatha $Q=10\times2.26=22.6\ \mathrm{kJ}$, cishe imizuzwana engu-11 yokushisa okuvela kusitofu esisebenza ngo-2 kW.
p-347.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokubeka ibhodwe esitofini namuhla, sula phansi kwalo ngendwangu lome.

p-348.title: Kungani ibhalbhu elilodwa lesihlahla elonakele licisha lonke uchungechunge
p-348.summary: Ochungechungeni lwamalbhalbhu axhunywe ngokulandelana (series), ukuphuka okukodwa kungenza kungabikho ndlela yomlilo kagesi, ngakho lonke uchungechunge luyacima.
p-348.principle: Umlilo kagesi ochungechungeni uyafana kuzo zonke izingxenye, $I=\frac{V}{R_1+R_2+\cdots}$. Indawo eyodwa evulekile yenza ukumelana (resistance) kungabi namkhawulo, ngakho-ke $I=0$.
p-348.example: Amalbhalbhu angamashumi amahlanu e-2.4 V alandelanayo abelana cishe ngo-120 V. Susa elilodwa bese amanye angama-49 angawutholi nhlobo umlilo kagesi.
p-348.actionItem: Ochungechungeni olungasebenzi namhlanje, luqaqe kuqala kugesi, bese ucindezela amalbhalbhu axegayo aqine noma ufake elinye elisele.

p-349.title: Kungani ukukhipha umoya ngomlomo ovulekile 'hah' kuzwakala kufudumele kanti ukukhipha ngodebe olunciphile 'hoo' kuzwakala kubanda
p-349.summary: Ukukhipha umoya ngomlomo ovulekile kuzwakala kufudumele, kanti ukukhipha umoya ngezindebe ezisontekile kuzwakala kubanda.
p-349.principle: Izindebe ezisontekile zenza umoya ophumayo uhambe ngesivinini esidonse umoya oyizungezile (entrainment). Izinga lokushisa elixubile lehla libe ngu-$T=\frac{m_1T_1+m_2T_2}{m_1+m_2}$, nokubanda okuncane okwengeziwe okuvela ekwandeni komoya.
p-349.example: Umoya ovela ngaphakathi cishe ku-34°C oxutshwe no-1:1 nomoya wegumbi ongu-20°C unikeza cishe u-27°C, ngakho-ke ukugeleza komoya esandleni sakho kuzwakala kubanda cishe ngo-7°C.
p-349.actionItem: Namuhla, faka umoya ngemuva kwesandla sakho ngomlomo ovulekile bese uphinda ngezindebe ezisontekile ukuze uzwe umehluko.

p-350.title: Isivinini se-sled sinqunywa ukuphakama kuphela
p-350.summary: Ngaphandle kokungqubuzana (friction), isivinini se-sled phansi sincike ekuphakameni kokuwa kuphela hhayi esisindweni somzimba. Empilweni yangempela ukungqubuzana nokudonsa komoya kuyenza ihambe kancane.
p-350.principle: Amandla atholakalayo (potential energy) aphenduka amandla okunyakaza (kinetic energy), ngakho-ke $mgh=\frac12mv^2$ kunikeza $v=\sqrt{2gh}$.
p-350.example: Kusuka ekuweni kwamamitha angu-5, $v=\sqrt{2\times9.81\times5}\approx9.9\ \mathrm{m/s}$, cishe u-36 km/h, futhi isivinini sangempela singaphansi kwalokho.
p-350.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa i-sled namuhla, khetha umqansi omnene ongenazo izithiyo futhi ugqoke isigqoko sokuvikela (helmet).

p-351.title: Lala kumatilasi imizuzu engu-10 bese uhlola isikhala emhlane wakho ophansi
p-351.summary: Lapho uthenga umatilasi, lala phansi cishe imizuzu engu-10 bese ubona ukuthi isandla singena kalula yini ngaphansi komhlane wakho ophansi. Isikhala esikhulu sishiya umhlane ungenakusekelwa futhi sigxilise ingcindezi.
p-351.principle: Ingcindezi ingu-$P=\frac{F}{A}$ futhi iyehla njengoba indawo yokusekela $A$ ikhula. Umatilasi usakaza umthwalo ngokusebenzisa i-spring constant yawo engu-$k$ nokwakheka kwezendlalelo.
p-351.example: Umzimba ongu-70 kg (cishe ama-686 N) ku-0.1 m² kuphela unikeza cishe u-6.9 kPa, kanti uma usakazwa ku-0.3 m² unikeza cishe u-2.3 kPa, okuwukuncipha ngengxenye yesithathu.
p-351.actionItem: Lapho uhlola umatilasi namuhla, lala futhi ngohlangothi lwakho imizuzu engu-10 bese uhlola ukuthi ihlombe, ukhalo kanye nenyonga kusekelwa ngokulinganayo yini.

p-352.title: Ifeni yesitofu iphenduka ngaphandle kukagesi
p-352.summary: Ifeni ebekwe phezu kwesitofu iphenduka ngokushisa kwesitofu kuphela, ngaphandle kwentambo kagesi noma ibhethri, futhi isakaza umoya ofudumele egunjini lonke.
p-352.principle: Ngomthelela we-Seebeck, umehluko wezinga lokushisa $\Delta T$ ezindaweni zokuhlangana udala amandla kagesi (voltage) angu-$V=S\Delta T$ aqhuba injini.
p-352.example: I-thermoelectric module ene-Seebeck coefficient ecishe ibe ngu-0.05 V/K inikeza cishe u-5 V we-open-circuit kumehluko ongu-100 K, nomphumela wama-watts ambalwa noma ngaphansi.
p-352.actionItem: Namuhla, beka ifeni yesitofu endaweni ephakathi kwebanga layo lokushisa eligunyaziwe, lapho izingane zingeke zifinyelele khona.

p-353.title: Isifudumezi sekhandlela le-tealight nembiza yezimbali asikwazi ukufudumeza igumbi
p-353.summary: Isifudumezi esenziwe ngamakhandlela ambalwa e-tealight nembiza yezimbali asikwazi ukukhiqiza ukushisa okwanele egunjini futhi sandisa kuphela ingozi yomlilo ne-carbon monoxide.
p-353.principle: Ikhandlela linikeza kuphela ukushisa kwalo kokuvutha, $P=\dot m\,\Delta H$, kanti ikhandlela elilodwa le-tealight linikeza cishe ama-40 W.
p-353.example: Ikhandlela elilodwa le-tealight lishisa cishe u-14 g wengcina (cishe u-0.6 MJ) emahoreni angu-4, okungaba ngu-40 W, ngakho amane anikeza cishe u-160 W, okuwiphesenti elincane kakhulu lama-1-3 kW adingwa yigumbi.
p-353.actionItem: Namuhla, vala izikhala ezizungeze amafasitela esikhundleni sokwakha isifudumezi sembiza yezimbali.

p-354.title: Ukhokho we-champagne undiza ngejubane elingu-50 km/h
p-354.summary: Ibhodlela le-champagne liqukethe umfutho ongaba ngu-6 atm, ngakho ukhokho okhululiwe ungandiza cishe nge-50 km/h futhi ulimaze iso.
p-354.principle: Umehluko womfutho uphusha ngamandla $F=\Delta P\cdot A$, futhi igesi eyandayo yenza umsebenzi ophenduka amandla kinetic $\frac12mv^2$.
p-354.example: Ngomehluko womfutho ongaba ngu-5 bar phezu kwendawo yesiphambano kakhokho ecishe ibe ngu-$2.5\times10^{-4}\ \mathrm{m^2}$, $F\approx127\ \mathrm{N}$, kanti ukhokho ongu-9 g ohamba ngo-14 m/s (50 km/h) uthwele cishe u-0.9 J.
p-354.actionItem: Lapho uvula i-champagne namuhla, tshekisa ibhodlela ngama-degree angaba ngu-45°, bamba ukhokho ngesithupha sakho bese uphendula ibhodlela kancane, uliqondise kude nabantu.

p-355.title: Umsindo omhlophe (white noise) ufihla imisindo evela kungazelelwe ngenkathi ulele
p-355.summary: Umsindo omhlophe othambile unciphisa igebe phakathi komsindo ovuka kungazelelwe nendawo ezungezile, okungakusiza ukuthi uphaphame kancane. Imiphumela iyahluka kumuntu nomuntu.
p-355.principle: Ekufihleni kokuzwayo (auditory masking), umsindo obanzi ukhuphula umkhawulo wokuzwakala kweminye imisindo. Umehluko ngu-$\Delta L=L_\mathrm{sound}-L_\mathrm{bg}$.
p-355.example: Ukuvalwa komnyango ngo-70 dB phezu komsindo wangemuva ongu-30 dB kuwukugxuma ngo-40 dB, kodwa ngomsindo omhlophe ongu-45 dB kuwukugxuma ngo-25 dB futhi kuthusa kancane.
p-355.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku, dlala umsindo omhlophe kancane cishe ku-40 dB eduze kwendlebe yakho usebenzise i-timer, futhi uwugcine kude kakhulu nezindlebe zengane.

p-356.title: Ama-crampon abambelela ngokungena ngomshini eqhweni
p-356.summary: Ama-crampon awakhulisi ukungqubuzana (friction). Amaphuzu awo acijile agubha eqhweni bese ebamba ngomshini ukuvimbela ukushelela.
p-356.principle: Isicathulo eqhweni sishelela emkhawulweni $\tan\theta=\mu$ nge-coefficient yokungqubuzana encane kakhulu $\mu$, kodwa izipikili zibamba ukumelana nokusika (shear resistance) kweqhwa esikhundleni salokho.
p-356.example: Amaloli ajwayelekile ezicathulo eqhweni ane-static friction coefficient ecishe ibe ngu-0.1, ngakho ashelela cishe ku-5.7° kuphela ($\tan^{-1}0.1$), kanti amaphuzu e-crampon angabambelela eqhweni elitsheke kakhulu.
p-356.actionItem: Ngaphambi kohambo lwakho lokuqwala intaba namuhla, hlola ukuthi amaphuzu akho e-crampon awabuthuntu yini nokuthi amabhande aqine ngokuqinile.

p-357.title: Khetha izikhombi ze-laser ezilinganiselwa ku-1 mW noma ngaphansi
p-357.summary: Isikhombi se-laser esiphephile emehlweni siyunithi ye-Class 2 engu-1 mW noma ngaphansi. Amandla aphezulu awakwazi ukuvinjelwa ngokuphelele ngisho nangokucwayiza kwamehlo.
p-357.principle: Ukusabela kokucwayiza kuthatha cishe imizuzwana engu-0.25 futhi amandla angena esweni ngu-$E=P\,t$. Lapho indawo ye-beam incipha, kukhula kakhulu i-irradiance $I=P/A$.
p-357.example: U-1 mW wemizuzwana engu-0.25 ungu-$E=0.25\ \mathrm{mJ}$. I-beam engu-3 mm ine-$I=1\ \mathrm{mW}/7.1\times10^{-6}\ \mathrm{m^2}\approx140\ \mathrm{W/m^2}$. Izikhombi ezishibhile kwesinye isikhathi zidlula amandla abhaliwe.
p-357.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola isikhombi sakho se-laser ukuthola ilebula ye-Class 2, 1 mW noma ngaphansi, futhi ungalinge usiqondise kubantu, ezilwaneni noma ezimotweni.

p-358.title: Izitofu zezinkuni namalahle zivutha kangcono ngoshimula omude
p-358.summary: Ushimula omude ongesi eshisa kakhulu ngaphakathi udonsa kakhulu (draft), ngakho umlilo ulayitheka kahle nentuthu iyaphuma.
p-358.principle: Ngomphumela kashimula (chimney effect), umfutho wokudonsa ngu-$\Delta P=gh(\rho_\mathrm{out}-\rho_\mathrm{in})$, olingana nokuphakama $h$ kanye nomehluko wokuminyana.
p-358.example: Ngonshimula ongamamitha angu-5, umoya wangaphandle ongu-0°C (1.29 kg/m³) negesi kashimula engu-200°C (cishe 0.75 kg/m³), $\Delta P\approx9.81\times5\times0.54\approx27\ \mathrm{Pa}$.
p-358.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa isitofu namuhla, hlola amalunga kashimula futhi uhlole nebhethri le-alamu yakho ye-carbon monoxide.

p-359.title: Izingubo zoma ngisho ziqandiswe zibe yiqhwa esimweni sezulu esingaphansi kuka-zero
p-359.summary: Izingubo eziyizwe ngaphandle emazingeni angaphansi kokuqanda ziyaqina, kodwa zoma kancane kancane nge-sublimation, lapho iqhwa liphenduka ngqo umusi. Asikho isidingo somshini wokomisa.
p-359.principle: I-Sublimation, $\mathrm{H_2O(s)\rightarrow H_2O(g)}$, idinga $L_s\approx2.83\ \mathrm{kJ/g}$, futhi ishesha kakhulu emoyeni owomile, onomoya.
p-359.example: Ukuguqula i-1 kg yamanzi nge-sublimation kuthatha cishe u-2.83 MJ. Kuthatha isikhathi eside kunomjikelezo womshini wokomisa (cishe 2-3 kWh) kodwa akusebenzisi ugesi.
p-359.actionItem: Osweni olucwathile, olwomile, olungaphansi kuka-zero namuhla, yeka izingubo ngaphandle bese uziqedela ngaphakathi ngemva kokuzithintitha.

p-360.title: Sula iqhwa ophahleni lwemoto yakho ngaphambi kokushayela
p-360.summary: Iqhwa elisophahleni lingandiza ngezicucu njengoba ushayela, lishaye imoto engemuva noma livimbe ifasitela lakho langaphambili. Sula uphahla, ibhonethi kanye nengilazi ngaphambi kokuba uhambe.
p-360.principle: Umoya ovela ekushayeleni uphushela izingcezu zeqhwa emuva, bese zishaya imoto elandelayo ngamandla e-kinetic $E=\frac12mv^2$.
p-360.example: Uqweqwe lweqhwa olungaba ngu-5 cm (ucabange ukuthi lingu-100 kg/m³) ophahleni olungu-2 m² luba nesisindo esingaba ngu-10 kg. Uma lishaya ngejubane elihlobene elingu-80 km/h (22.2 m/s) liphatha amandla angaba ngu-2.5 kJ.
p-360.actionItem: Uma likhithike namuhla, sula lonke iqhwa ophahleni, ebhonethini nasengilazini ngebhulashi elithambile ngaphambi kokushayela.

p-361.title: Kungani ukhulumela phezulu endaweni yokudlela enomsindo
p-361.summary: Njengoba umsindo ukhula, abantu baphakamisa amazwi abo bengaqondile, lokhu kubizwa nge-Lombard effect. Lapho wonke umuntu ekwenza lokho, igumbi liqhubeka nokuba nomsindo kakhulu.
p-361.principle: Ku-Lombard effect, izinga lezwi liyakhuphuka ngenxa yomsindo ukuze kugcinwe isilinganiso sesiginali nomsindo $\mathrm{SNR}=L_s-L_n$ esidingekayo ukuze uzwakale.
p-361.example: Lapho umsindo ukhuphuka ngo-20 dB, usuka ku-60 uya ku-80 dB, inkulumo yaziwa ngokukhuphuka cishe ngo-6-10 dB. Izindawo zokudlela zingafinyelela ku-70-80 dB.
p-361.actionItem: Emhlanganweni namuhla, khetha isihlalo esisekhoneni kude nezipikha bese uncika kumuntu okhuluma naye ukuze ukhulume ngokuthula.

p-362.title: Ukuphuma kwelanga koNyaka Omusha kufika kuqala empumalanga
p-362.summary: Ilanga liphuma kuqala empumalanga. Ezingeni elifanayo le-latitude, ukuphuma kwelanga kufika cishe ngemizuzu emi-4 ngaphambili ngezinga ngalinye le-longitude eliya empumalanga.
p-362.principle: Umhlaba uzungeza ngo-$15^\circ$ ngehora, ngakho-ke umehluko we-$1^\circ$ we-longitude ngu-$\frac{60\ \mathrm{min}}{15}=4\ \mathrm{min}$.
p-362.example: I-Homigot eku-129.6°E ingaba ngu-2.6° empumalanga ye-Seoul (127°E), ngakho-ke ukuphuma kwelanga kwayo kufika cishe ngemizuzu eyi-10 ngaphambili, kanti igebe langempela lihluka kancane ngokuya nge-latitude.
p-362.actionItem: Uma uhlela ukubona ukuphuma kwelanga koNyaka Omusha, hlola isikhathi sokuphuma kwelanga sendawo oya kuyo kusengaphambili.

p-363.title: Amayunithi okucindezela kwesondo i-bar, psi kanye ne-kPa ngesikhathi esisodwa
p-363.summary: Ukucindezela kwesondo kubhalwe nge-bar, psi noma i-kPa. Khumbula ukuguqulwa okukodwa ukuze ukwazi ukushintsha noma yiliphi iyunithi.
p-363.example: I-2.3 bar ingu-230 kPa kanti $2.3\times14.5\approx33\ \mathrm{psi}$. I-35 psi icishe ibe ngu-2.41 bar.
p-363.actionItem: Namuhla, funda ukucindezela okunconyiwe ohlakeni lomnyango womshayeli bese uhlola amasondo akho ngegeji.

p-364.title: Isikhathi sokushaja i-EV ekhaya siyi-kWh ehlukaniswe nge-kW
p-364.summary: Isikhathi sokushaja cishe singamandla okufanele wengezwe (kWh) ahlukaniswe ngamandla eshaja (kW). Ukulahleka kwamandla kwenza sithathe isikhathi eside kancane empeleni.
p-364.example: Ukushaja ibhethri elingu-60 kWh lisuka ku-10% liya ku-80% kwengeza u-$E=42\ \mathrm{kWh}$, kanti ngeshaja engu-7 kW ekusebenzeni kahle okungu-90% $t=\frac{42}{0.9\times7}\approx6.7$ amahora.
p-364.actionItem: Namuhla, bheka amandla ebhethri lemoto yakho (kWh) kanye namandla eshaja (kW) bese ubale isikhathi sokushaja.

p-365.title: Faka inkomishi yamanzi kuqala lapho uncibilikisa iqhwa ukuze uthole amanzi
p-365.summary: Iqhwa ligcwele izikhala zomoya futhi alihambisi kahle ukushisa, ngakho ukulifaka ebhodweni elingenalutho kushisa phansi kalula. Amanzi amancane ekuqaleni athuthukisa ukuthintana kokushisa futhi alincibilikisa ngokushesha okukhulu.
p-365.principle: Iqhwa alinayo i-conductivity ephezulu futhi linezikhala ezinkulu, ngakho-ke lithinta ibhodhi endaweni encane. Ukuncibilika kudinga ukushisa okufihliwe kokuhlangana $L_f=334\ \mathrm{kJ/kg}$.
p-365.example: Ukwenza ilitha eli-1 lamanzi kuthatha cishe ama-334 kJ, alingana nokushisa amanzi ngo-80°C. Iqhwa lingaba ngu-10% kuphela wamanzi ngevolumu, ngakho udinga cishe amalitha ayi-10 eqhwa.
p-365.actionItem: Uma uncibilikisa iqhwa ukuze uthole amanzi namuhla, fudumeza inkomishi yamanzi kuqala bese wengeza iqhwa elihlanzekile kancane kancane, futhi njalo bilisa ngaphambi kokuphuza.

p-366.title: Khuphuka amagquma aneqhwa ngokunyathela i-akselereyitha kancane futhi ungami
p-366.summary: Endleleni ekhuphukayo eneqhwa, ukuma kwenza kube nzima ukuqala kabusha futhi ukunyathela kakhulu i-akselereyitha kwenza amasondo ashelele. Shiya ibanga ngaphambi kwegquma bese ukhuphuka kancane ngesivinini esingaguquki.
p-366.principle: Ukungqubuzana okumile (static friction) $F\le\mu_sN$ kukhulu kunokungqubuzana okuhambayo (kinetic friction) $F=\mu_kN$ ($\mu_s>\mu_k$), ngakho-ke ukubamba kwehla kakhulu lapho amasondo ephenduka eshelela.
p-366.example: Eqhweni elicindezelwe eline-$\mu\approx0.2$, ummango ongu-10% ($\theta\approx5.7^\circ$) usebenzisa cishe u-$0.1\,mg$ wamandla adonsela phansi kokungqubuzana okukhona okungaba ngu-$0.2\,mg$, okushiya cishe u-$0.1\,mg$ kuphela oyinsalela.
p-366.actionItem: Egqumeni elineqhwa namuhla, shiya ibanga elikhulu ngemuva kwemoto ephambi kwakho bese ukhuphuka ngesivinini esingaguquki ukuze ungami phakathi nendawo.

c-001.title: Sebenzisa i-baking soda noviniga ngokuhlukana, hhayi ngokuhlanganisa
c-001.summary: Ukuhlanganisa lezi zinto kumane kwenze amagwebu futhi amandla azo okuhlanza ayacimezana. Sebenzisa i-baking soda ukususa amafutha kanti uviniga uwusebenzisele i-limescale, kancane ngakunye.
c-001.principle: I-base ebuthakathaka ($\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$) ne-asidi ebuthakathaka ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$) kuyahlangana kuthole ukungathathi hlangothi kube yi-sodium acetate ecishe ingathathi hlangothi: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + CH_3COOH \to CH_3COONa + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$
c-001.example: Ukuhlanganisa isipuni esingu-1 (cishe amagremu angu-12) se-baking soda nengxenye yenkomishi kaviniga kuletha uketshezi olucishe lungathathi hlangothi uma ukukhihliza amagwebu sekuphelile, ngakho-ke alususi amafutha noma i-scale kahle. Uma kusetshenziswe ngokuhlukana, lezo zilinganiso zombili zisingatha zombili izinhlobo zokungcola.
c-001.actionItem: Namuhla, sebenzisa inhlama ye-baking soda kuphela ezindaweni zikasilinki ezinamafutha bese usebenzisa ithawula lephepha elicwiliswe kuviniga kuphela ku-limescale kampompi.

c-002.title: Ungalokothi usebenzise i-bleach ndawonye nezihlanzi ezine-asidi
c-002.summary: Ukuhlanganisa i-sodium hypochlorite (i-bleach) nesihlanzi sangasese esine-asidi kukhipha igesi enobuthi ye-chlorine. Sebenzisa umkhiqizo owodwa ngesikhathi bese uhlanza kahle ngamanzi phakathi nendawo.
c-002.principle: Lapho ihlangana ne-asidi, i-hypochlorite iphenduka i-chlorine: $\mathrm{NaOCl + 2HCl \to NaCl + Cl_2\uparrow + H_2O}$
c-002.example: I-chlorine icasula amehlo nomphimbo cishe ku-3 ppm futhi ibangela ukukhwehlela okukhulu nobunzima bokuphefumula ngaphezu kuka-30 ppm. Endlini yokugezela encane ingafinyelela emazingeni ayingozi emizuzwini embalwa.
c-002.actionItem: Beka i-bleach nezihlanzi ezine-asidi (hydrochloric noma citric) emashalofini ahlukene namuhla, bese ubheka isexwayiso esithi 'ungahlanganisi' kulebula ngayinye.

c-003.title: I-bleach kanye ne-ammonia noma isihlanzi sengilazi kuyingozi futhi
c-003.summary: Ukuhlanganisa i-bleach nesihlanzi sengilazi esine-ammonia kukhiqiza igesi enobuthi ye-chloramine. Ngenisa umoya ohlanzekile, futhi ugweme ukusebenzisa le mikhiqizo emibili ilandelana.
c-003.principle: $\mathrm{NaOCl + NH_3 \to NH_2Cl + NaOH}$ yakha i-chloramine ($\mathrm{NH_2Cl}$), ecasula imigudu yokuphefumula.
c-003.example: Ngisho nethonsi nje le-bleach esihlanzini esine-ammonia elinganiselwa ku-5% lingabangela ukukhwehlela nokuhlaba emehlweni phakathi nemizuzu embalwa endlini yokugezela evaliwe. I-bleach ezindaweni ezinomchamo ikhipha uhlobo olufanayo lwegesi.
c-003.actionItem: Bheka igama elithi 'ammonia' kumalebula akho ezihlanzi, qaphela ukuthi ungawasebenzisi ne-bleach ngosuku olulodwa, futhi uvule iwindi lapho uhlanza.

c-004.title: Khetha i-sanitizer yezandla yokuhamba enokungenani i-ethanol engu-60%
c-004.summary: I-alcohol gel iyisixazululo lapho kungekho khona amanzi, kodwa ngaphansi kuka-60% we-ethanol isebenza kabi kakhulu. Ezindizeni, yithele ezitsheni ezingama-100 mL noma ngaphansi.
c-004.principle: I-ethanol iqumba amaprotheni amagciwane futhi incibilikise ulwelwesi lwamafutha (lipid membranes). Iyasha: $\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$.
c-004.example: Umkhiqizo one-ethanol engu-60-80% kufanele ucutshwe ezandleni cishe imizuzwana engu-20 bese ushiywa uze wome ngokuphelele. Ezandleni ezingcolile ngokusobala, insipho namanzi kuhlula i-sanitizer.
c-004.actionItem: Bheka iphesenti le-ethanol kulebula ye-sanitizer ozoyipakisha, bese uyithela esitsheni esingu-100 mL noma ngaphansi.

c-005.title: Funda i-pH kulebula lapho ukhetha isihlanzi
c-005.summary: Izihlanzi zasekhishini nasegunjini lokugezela ziyahluka nge-pH kuye ngenhloso yazo. Khetha i-alkaline yamafutha kanye ne-asidi ye-scale ukuze uthole ukuhlanzeka okwengeziwe ngemali efanayo.
c-005.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$, ngakho-ke ukwehla kweyunithi engu-1 ye-pH kusho izikhathi ezingu-10 ezengeziwe ze-$\mathrm{H^+}$. Amafutha ayancibilika abe yinsipho ku-alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + NaOH \to RCOONa + R'OH}$
c-005.example: Isihlanzi se-alkaline esine-pH engu-11-12 silungele amafutha, kanti esine-asidi se-pH engu-2-3 silungele i-limescale. Insipho yezitsha engathathi hlangothi (pH 6-8) ithambile ezandleni kodwa ihamba kancane emafutheni omile.
c-005.actionItem: Ekuthengeni kwakho okulandelayo, hlola i-pH nokusetshenziswa okuhlosiwe kumalebula ezihlanzi, bese ubhala phansi i-pH yezihlanzi ezintathu osuvele unazo.

c-006.title: Nciphisa amandla okushisa ngokuwasha ngo-30 °C
c-006.summary: Izinsipho zokuhlanza zesimanje zinezakhi ze-enzyme ezisebenza kahle cishe ku-30 °C, ngakho impahla yansuku zonke ayivamile ukudinga u-60 °C. Lapho ushisa amanzi amancane, usebenzisa ugesi omncane.
c-006.principle: Ukushisa okudingekayo ngu-$Q = mc\Delta T$ ($c = 4.18\ \mathrm{kJ/(kg\cdot K)}$), futhi ama-enzyme agaya amaprotheni asebenza kangcono kakhulu cishe ku-30-40 °C.
c-006.example: Ukushisa amalitha angu-10 amanzi kusuka ku-15 °C kuye ku-30 °C kuthatha cishe ama-627 kJ, kodwa kuya ku-60 °C kuthatha cishe ama-1,881 kJ, ngokuphindwe kathathu. Ngemithwalo emine ngesonto, ukonga kuyanda emithwalweni engaphezu kuka-200 ngonyaka.
c-006.actionItem: Setha umshini wakho wokuwasha ku-30 °C (noma emanzini abandayo) namuhla, bese uwukhuphulela ku-40 °C kuphela ezingutsheni ezijuluke kakhulu.

c-007.title: Khipha itshwayi leketela ngesipuni se-citric acid
c-007.summary: Uqweqwe olumhlophe ngaphakathi kweketela luyancibilika ku-citric acid. Iphunga layo lincane kunele-asidi (vinegar) futhi ayibizi, ngakho-ke zama lokhu ngaphambi kokuthenga iketela elisha.
c-007.principle: Uqweqwe lwe-calcium carbonate luyancibilika ku-asidi: $\mathrm{3CaCO_3 + 2C_6H_8O_7 \to Ca_3(C_6H_5O_7)_2 + 3H_2O + 3CO_2\uparrow}$
c-007.example: Ukubilisa amanzi angama-500 mL nespuni esingu-1 (cishe amagremu ayi-10) se-citric acid bese uyishiya imizuzu engama-20 kuxegisa iningi loqweqwe olungaba ngu-1 mm ukushona phansi. Ikhilogremu elilodwa le-citric acid lanele ukuhlanza izikhathi eziningi.
c-007.actionItem: Namuhla, bilisa amanzi anesipuni esingu-1 se-citric acid eketeleni, liyeke imizuzu engama-20, bese uyawachitha bese ulikhuculula kabili noma kathathu.

c-008.title: Kuyini ngempela udoti omhlophe wensipho ezingutsheni nasemathayilini
c-008.summary: Emanzini anensimbi eningi (hard water), amafutha ase-acid asensiphweni ahlangana ne-calcium bese eba yinsalela engancibiliki. Izinsipho zokuhlanza ezenziwe (synthetic detergents) noma ukuhlambulula nge-asidi (vinegar) kungakunciphisa lokhu.
c-008.principle: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$ kwakha inzika futhi kunciphisa amagwebu.
c-008.example: Ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphakeme kuno-200 mg/L (njenge-CaCO₃), inani elifanayo lensipho lingase lenze amagwebu angaphansi kwengxenye. Uqwembe olumhlophe kumathayili asendlini yangasese luyancibilika ngomkhiqizo wokuhlanza one-asidi.
c-008.actionItem: Fafaza uviniga noma isixazululo se-citric acid oqweqweni olumhlophe emathayilini asendlini yakho yangasese namuhla, linda imizuzu emi-5, bese uyesula.

c-009.title: Nciphisa i-chlorine esele emanzini kampompi ngokuwayeka ame noma ngokuwabilisa
c-009.summary: Amanzi ompompi agcina inani elincane le-chlorine yokubulala amagciwane. Kuphephile, kodwa uma ungalithandi iphunga, ukuwayeka engamboziwe noma ukuwabilisa kuyayinciphisa.
c-009.principle: I-hypochlorous acid iyabhidlika ngokuhamba kwesikhathi noma ngokukhanya: $\mathrm{2HOCl \to 2HCl + O_2\uparrow}$
c-009.example: I-chlorine esele empompini ivamise ukuba ngu-0.1-0.5 mg/L. Ukushiya amanzi ame amahora ambalwa ejekeni, noma ukuwabilisa imizuzu emi-5 engamboziwe, kunciphisa iphunga ngokucacile.
c-009.actionItem: Gcwalisa ijeke namhlanje ebusuku, liyeke lingamboziwe, bese uqhathanisa iphunga ngaphambi kokuphuza kusasa.

c-010.title: Kungani izinwele zizizwa zomile/zilukhuni ngemva kokugeza ezindaweni ezinamanzi anensimbi eningi
c-010.summary: Amanzi ezindaweni ezifana nezingxenye zaseYurophu acebe nge-calcium ne-magnesium, ngakho-ke i-shampoo yenza amagwebu amancane futhi izinwele zizizwa zilukhuni. Ukuhlambulula kokugcina nge-asidi kuyasiza.
c-010.principle: I-$\mathrm{Ca^{2+}, Mg^{2+}}$ yamanzi alukhuni ihlangana nama-anionic surfactants ase-shampoo bese kwakha insalela. Ubulukhuni bamanzi buboniswa nge-$\mathrm{mg/L\ CaCO_3}$.
c-010.example: Ngaphezu kuka-300 mg/L amanzi ahlukaniswa njengalukhuni kakhulu, ngokuphindwe kathathu kunamanzi avamile aseKorea (cishe 50-100 mg/L). Ukuhlambulula kokugcina ngesipuni esingu-1 se-apple cider vinegar ilitha ngalinye lamanzi kunciphisa ubulukhuni bezinwele.
c-010.actionItem: Faka impushana encane ye-citric acid noma ibhodlela elincane likaviniga ohambweni lwakho olulandelayo, bese ubuza lapho uhlala khona ngobulukhuni bamanzi endawo.

c-011.title: I-resin ethambisa amanzi (ion-exchange) ivuselelwa ngosawoti
c-011.summary: Izihlungi zokugeza ezithambisa amanzi nezinye izinhlelo zamanzi zibamba i-calcium nge-resin yokushintshisana ngama-ion (ion-exchange). Ezinye izinhlobo zivuselelwa ngamanzi anosawoti omningi kanti ezinye ziyashintshwa, ngakho hlola ngaphambi kokuthenga.
c-011.principle: I-resin ibamba i-calcium bese idedela i-sodium: $\mathrm{2R\text{-}Na + Ca^{2+} \to R_2Ca + 2Na^+}$. Ngemuva kokugcwala ibuyiselwa esimweni sayo ngamanzi anosawoti omningi (brine).
c-011.example: Uma i-cartridge yokufaka esikhundleni ibiza i-10,000 won futhi ishintshwa nyanga zonke, lokho kuyi-120,000 won ngonyaka. Uhlelo oluvuselelekayo lungasebenza iminyaka ngamakhilogremu ambalwa kasawoti.
c-011.actionItem: Qhathanisa isikhathi sokushintsha kanye nenketho yokuvuselela yesithambisi osicabangayo, bese ubale izindleko zonyaka.

c-012.title: Ihitha enoqweqwe lwensimbi isebenzisa amandla amaningi futhi ifa ngokushesha
c-012.summary: Lapho uqweqwe lwe-limescale lwakheka epuletini lokushisa leketela noma lesiswakimisi somoya (humidifier), ukushisa okuncane kufinyelela emanzini, ukufudumala kuthatha isikhathi eside futhi izingxenye zishisa ngokweqile. Ukukhipha uqweqwe njalo kusiza kokubili ukusetshenziswa kwamandla kanye nesikhathi sokusebenza.
c-012.principle: Ukudluliswa kokushisa kungu-$q = \dfrac{kA\Delta T}{d}$, kanti uqweqwe ($k \approx 1\text{-}3\ \mathrm{W/(m\cdot K)}$) luyisivikelo esivimba ukushisa kakhulu ukwedlula insimbi.
c-012.example: Ngolwelwesi olungaphezu kuka-2 mm ubukhulu, isikhathi sokushisa ukuya ezingeni lokushisa elifanayo singenyuka ngamaphesenti ambalwa kanti izinga lokushisa lezinsimbi liyakhuphuka lifushanise impilo yalo. Ukuhlanza nge-citric acid kanye ngenyanga kwanele.
c-012.actionItem: Faka isikhumbuzi njalo ekhalendeni: 'iSonto lokuqala lenyanga ngayinye: khipha uqweqwe lweketela nesiswakimisi somoya nge-citric acid'.

c-013.title: Ncibilikisa iqhwa ngosawoti, kodwa fafaza kancane lingakaqandi
c-013.summary: Ukusakaza usawoti omncane ngaphambi kokuba likhithike noma ngaphambi nje kokuba liqande kusebenzisa omncane kakhulu kunokuncibilikisa iqhwa eselimile, ngoba wehlisa izinga lokubanda lapho amanzi aqanda khona.
c-013.principle: Ukwehliswa kwezinga lokuqanda $\Delta T_f = i K_f m$ ($K_f = 1.86\ \mathrm{K\cdot kg/mol}$, $i \approx 2$ ku-NaCl)
c-013.example: Isixazululo sikasawoti esiyi-10% ngesisindo sine-$m \approx 1.9\ \mathrm{mol/kg}$, okukhipha $\Delta T_f \approx 7\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ngakho-ke liqala ukuqanda ngase- -7 °C. Ngezansi kuka- -10 °C usawoti uphelelwa amandla, ngakho-ke sebenzisa isihlabathi esikhundleni sawo.
c-013.actionItem: Uma isibikezelo sanamuhla ebusuku sithi amazinga okushisa azoba ngaphansi kokuqanda, fafaza kancane usawoti ogcwele isandla ezitebhisini zokungena.

c-014.title: I-calcium chloride uma iqhathaniswa nosawoti wamatshe: yini okufanele isetshenziswe kuphi
c-014.summary: I-calcium chloride isebenza emazingeni okushisa aphansi kakhulu kodwa ilimaza kakhulu ukhonkolo nensimbi. Khetha ngokuya ngezinga lokushisa kanye nendawo.
c-014.principle: I-calcium chloride ikhipha ukushisa njengoba incibilika: $\mathrm{CaCl_2 \to Ca^{2+} + 2Cl^-}$, $\Delta H \approx -82\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$
c-014.example: Empeleni i-NaCl isebenza kuze kufike cishe ku- -10 °C kanti i-$\mathrm{CaCl_2}$ ize ifike cishe ku- -25 °C. Eduze kukakhonkolo omusha noma izinsimbi zokubamba zensimbi, sebenzisa ikhlorayidi encane bese ukhetha isihlabathi.
c-014.actionItem: Bheka isithako (i-sodium chloride noma i-calcium chloride) esikhwameni sakho sokususa iqhwa namuhla bese usimaka ngokuthi akufanele sisetshenziswe eduze kwezinsimbi zensimbi.

c-015.title: Hlanza into yokususa iqhwa ezidladleni zezilwane nasezandleni
c-015.summary: Izinto zokususa iqhwa ezingamakhorayidi ezisemgwaqweni zenza izidladla zome futhi zingabangela ukuhlanza uma zilinywa. Geza ngamanzi afudumele ngemva kokuhambahamba.
c-015.principle: Amakhlorayidi amunca umswakama esikhunjeni aze asomise. Usawoti oncibilikile uhlala njengamanzi anosawoti, umthelela ofanayo we-colligative njengaku-$\Delta T_f = i K_f m$.
c-015.example: I-calcium chloride ikhipha ukushisa lapho incibilika, ngakho-ke esikhunjeni esimanzi ingadala ukushisa nokuluma. Ukuhlanza izidladla emanzini afudumele imizuzwana engama-30 nokuzomisa kuxazulula izinkinga eziningi.
c-015.actionItem: Ngemva kokuhambahamba kwanamuhla, hlanza izidladla zesilwane sakho emanzini afudumele, bese wesula amateku akho ngendwangu emanzi.

c-016.title: Bheka izinga lokuqanda koketshezi lwesikrini semoto ngaphambi kohambo lwasebusika
c-016.summary: Oketshezi lwesikrini olungamanzi nje luqanda ngo-0 °C bese luvimba ukubona kwakho. Oketshezi lwasebusika lusebenzisa utshwala ukwehlisa izinga lokuqanda.
c-016.principle: Njengoba $\Delta T_f = K_f m$, utshwala obuningi busho izinga lokuqanda eliphansi, kodwa futhi nokusha kalula ($\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + 3O_2 \to 2CO_2 + 3H_2O}$).
c-016.example: Ilebula ethi -20 °C noma -30 °C isho ukuthi akufanele liqande kuze kufike kulelo zinga lokushisa, kodwa ukulihlanza ngamanzi kwenyusa izinga lokuqanda. Intuthu ye-methanol inobuthi, ngakho-ke gcina ikhabethe lemoto lingena umoya.
c-016.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuhamba, hlola izinga loketshezi kanye nesilinganiso sezinga lokuqanda elebula.

c-017.title: Bheka isilinganiso sokuxuba kanye nemininingwane lapho uthenga i-antifreeze
c-017.summary: Ukuxuba i-antifreeze (ethylene glycol) koketshezi olupholisa imoto kunciphisa izinga lokuqanda futhi kwenyuse izinga lokubila. Landela isilinganiso nokucacisiwe, futhi ungalokothi uxube izinhlobo ezahlukene.
c-017.principle: Nge-$\Delta T_f = i K_f m$, cishe i-50 vol% ye-ethylene glycol iqanda ngase- -37 °C bese ibila ngase-106 °C.
c-017.example: Ukusebenzisa into engaxutshiwe kwenyusa izinga lokuqanda futhi kunciphise ukudluliswa kokushisa. I-ethylene glycol inambitheka kamnandi futhi iyingozi ebulalayo ezilwaneni ezifuywayo, ngakho-ke sula ngokushesha lapho ichitheke khona.
c-017.actionItem: Bheka ibhukwana lemoto yakho ukuthola imininingwane ye-antifreeze enconyiwe kanye nesilinganiso sokuxuba, bese ubuza ngakho ekuhlolweni kwemoto okulandelayo.

c-018.title: Bikela ukujuluka kwamafasitela ebusika usebenzisa i-dew point
c-018.summary: Lapho umoya wasendlini onomswakama uthinta ingilazi ebandayo, amaconsi ayazakhela abangele isikhunta nokulahleka kokushisa. Ukugcina umswakama wasendlini usesilinganisweni esifanele kunciphisa nokumoshakala kokushisisa.
c-018.principle: I-dew point ilinganiselwa ku-$T_d \approx T - \dfrac{100-\mathrm{RH}}{5}$ ($\mathrm{RH}>50\%$), futhi ukujuluka/ukujiya komoya kungu-$\mathrm{H_2O(g) \to H_2O(l)}$.
c-018.example: Ku-22 °C endlini nomswakama ongu-60%, i-dew point icishe ibe ngu-14 °C. Uma ingaphezulu lengilazi yangaphakathi lingu-10 °C, izojuluka; ukwehlisa umswakama ube ngu-40-50% kwehlisa i-dew point ibe cishe ku-10-12 °C futhi kuvimbele iningi lakho.
c-018.actionItem: Setha umshini wokufaka umswakama (humidifier) ukuthi ube ku-40-50% namuhla bese ubheka i-hygrometer namhlanje kusihlwa.

c-019.title: Khipha isikhutha se-silicone sasendlini yokugezela ngokuphepha usebenzisa ibhlitshi ehlanjululwe
c-019.summary: Isikhutha esimnyama ku-silicone siyaphela nge-bleach ene-oxidizing. Hlala ungenisa umoya futhi ukugcine kude nemikhiqizo ene-asidi.
c-019.principle: I-Hypochlorite oxidation: $\mathrm{NaOCl \to Na^+ + OCl^-}$, bese i-$\mathrm{OCl^-}$ i-oxidayiza umbala wesikhutha namaseli.
c-019.example: Hlambulula ibhlitshi yasendlini (cishe i-4-5%) ngesilinganiso esingu-1:10 namanzi, gcoba, linda imizuzu engu-10, bese uhlanza kahle. Isikhutha sikhula ngaphezu komswakama ohlobene ongaba ngu-60-70%, ngakho-ke ukungenisa umoya ngemva kokugeza kuvimbela ukubuya kwaso.
c-019.actionItem: Namuhla, vula ifasitela lasendlini yokugezela, gqoka amagilavu, sula i-silicone nge-bleach ehlanjululwe ngo-1:10, bese uyahlanza ngemva kwemizuzu engu-10.

c-020.title: Sebenzisa i-sodium percarbonate ukususa isikhutha namabala aphuzi ngokuphepha
c-020.summary: I-oxygen bleach (sodium percarbonate) imnene kune-chlorine bleach futhi ayinabungozi begesi ye-chlorine, futhi kulula ukuyisebenzisa ezindwangu ezinemibala. Isebenza kangcono kakhulu emanzini afudumele.
c-020.example: Qeda isipuni esi-1 (cishe amagremu ayi-10) ku-1 L wamanzi ango-40-50 °C bese ucwilisa imizuzu engama-30-60 ukususa amabala ezithukuthuku nawesikhutha. Ungayisebenzisi eboyeni noma kusilika.
c-020.actionItem: Namuhla, cwilisa isokisi elimhlophe eliphuzi noma indwangu yezitsha emanzini ango-40-50 °C anesipuni esi-1 se-percarbonate imizuzu engu-30.

c-021.title: Isisusa-mswakama sekhabethe sihlala isikhathi eside endaweni encane
c-021.summary: Amaphakethe e-calcium chloride asusa umswakama emoyeni aze ancibilike abe uketshezi. Uma esetshenziswa ezindaweni ezincane ezivaliwe njengamakhabethe ezingubo nawezicathulo kunezindlu ezinkulu, asebenza ngempumelelo kakhulu.
c-021.principle: $\mathrm{CaCl_2(s) + 6H_2O(g) \to CaCl_2\cdot 6H_2O}$, futhi ngomswakama owengeziwe incibilika ibe uketshezi.
c-021.example: I-calcium chloride ithatha amanzi aphindaphindwe kaningi kunesisindo sayo. Uma ibekwe lapho iminyango ivulwa khona njalo igcwala ngokushesha, ngakho-ke indawo encane evaliwe inyanga noma ngaphezulu inikeza inzuzo engcono kakhulu. Lahla uketshezi oluqoqiwe kude nesikhumba nensimbi.
c-021.actionItem: Beka iphakethe elilodwa lesisusa-mswakama phansi ekhabetheni lakho namuhla futhi unciphise ukuvula iminyango njalo.

c-022.title: Iphakethe elincane ekudleni okulula: i-silica gel vs i-quicklime
c-022.summary: Izinto zokumunca umswakama ekupakisheni ukudla ngokuvamile ziyi-silica gel noma i-quicklime, futhi akukho okufanele kudliwe. I-quicklime iyashisa emanzini, ngakho vikela amehlo nomlomo ikakhulukazi.
c-022.principle: I-quicklime: $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$ (ikhipha ukushisa, $\Delta H \approx -64\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$). I-silica gel imunca amangqamuzana amanzi ebusweni bayo.
c-022.example: I-silica gel ingasetshenziswa futhi ngemva kokomiswa amahora angu-1-2 kuhhavini ongu-100-120 °C. Iphakethe le-quicklime elimanzi liphenduka uketshezi olune-alkaline enamandla, ngakho ligcine kude namanzi lapho ulichitha.
c-022.actionItem: Thatha amaphakethe omisa umswakama ekhabetheni lasekhishini lakho, hlola ukuthi abhalwe ukuthi i-silica gel noma i-quicklime, bese uwagcina lapho izingane zingafinyeleli khona.

c-023.title: Vimbela izibuko nezibuko zokuzivikela ekubeni nenkungu ngethonsi le-surfactant
c-023.summary: Uma uphuma emakhazeni ngaphandle ungena ekamelweni elifudumele, izibuko ziba nenkungu ngenxa yamaconsi amancane. Ungqimba lwe-surfactant lwenza amanzi aphazalake abe yiphepha elincanyana ukuze usakwazi ukubona.
c-023.principle: Lapho i-contact angle iba nkulu, amaconsi aqina kakhulu. I-surfactant yehlisa ukudonsana kwaphezulu $\gamma$ ukuze amanzi asakazeke.
c-023.example: Ithonsi elilodwa lensipho yezitsha elisatshalaliswe kancane engilazini futhi lasulwa ngendwangu eyomile linciphisa inkungu amahora amaningi. Ezingilazini ezine-coating lingalimaza i-coating, ngakho-ke hlola imiyalelo yomkhiqizi.
c-023.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuphuma namuhla, vala imaski yakho iqine ekhaleni, bese usula izibuko zakho ngongqimba oluncane lwensipho yezitsha.

c-024.title: Frijisa ukudla kukuncane futhi kusheshe ukuze kuhlale kusha
c-024.summary: Ukubandisa kancane kwenza amakristalu amakhulu eqhwa adabule amangqamuzana, ngakho ukudla kuyaconsa futhi kuqine ngemva kokuncibilika. Ukukwenza kube yingxenye encane nokukubandisa ngokushesha kwenza amakristalu amancane agcina ikhwalithi.
c-024.principle: Ubukhulu bekristalu buncike kusivinini sokupholisa. Ukushintsha kwesimo $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(s)}$ kudinga ukukhipha $\Delta H_{fus} = 6.01\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$.
c-024.example: Ukwendlala insalela yesobho noma inyama ibe ngu-2 cm ubukhulu esikhwameni se-zip ethileyini lensimbi kubandisa ngokushesha ngamahora kunebhulokhi eliwugqinsi futhi kunciphisa ukulahleka koketshezi lapho kuncibilika. Gcina ku -18 °C noma ngaphansi.
c-024.actionItem: Pakisha insalela eyodwa esikhwameni se-zip, uyicindezele ibe lula, ubhale usuku kuyo, bese uyifrijisa namuhla.

c-025.title: Indlela yokuphatha amazambane ahlumile noma aluhlaza
c-025.summary: Imihlume yamazambane nezindawo eziluhlaza ziqukethe amazinga aphezulu obuthi i-solanine. Ukubilisa noma ukuthosa akubhubhisi kalula lobu buthi, ngakho-ke kusike kukhishwe ngokuphelele.
