c-025.principle: I-solanine imelana nokushisa futhi iphuka kuphela eduze kuka-$290\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ukukhanya kukhulisa kokubili ukwakheka kwe-chlorophyll kanye ne-solanine.
c-025.example: Ukusika okungenani u-1 cm ezindaweni ezizungeze imihlume nezindawo eziluhlaza kususa ingxenye enkulu yakho. Lahla amazambane aluhlaza wonke noma ababayo. Ukuwagcina endaweni emnyama nebandayo (8-10 °C) kunciphisa ukuhluma.
c-025.actionItem: Songa amazambane ngephephandaba uwagcine endaweni emnyama, ebandayo namuhla, futhi usike noma ulahle lawo ahlumile.

c-026.title: Bambezela ukuba nsundu kwama-aphula nokwatapheya ngeconsi lejusi kalamula
c-026.summary: Izithelo ezisikiwe ziphenduka zibe nsundu ngenxa yokusabela kwe-enzyme ne-oksijini. Ukwengeza i-asidi kuyakubambezela lokhu, futhi kuphephile ukudliwa.
c-026.principle: I-Polyphenol oxidase: $\mathrm{2\,catechol + O_2 \to 2\,o\text{-}benzoquinone + 2H_2O}$. I-Ascorbic acid (u-vitamin C) inciphisa i-quinone ibuyele emuva.
c-026.example: Ukusebenza kwe-enzyme kwehla kakhulu ngaphansi kwe-pH 4. Ukufafaza ithisipuni eli-1 le-lemon juice e-aphuleni elilodwa elisikiwe kubambezela ukuba nsundu ngamahora angu-2 kuye kwangu-3. Izingxenye eziphenduke zaba nsundu aziyona inkinga enkulu kwezomsoco noma ukuphepha.
c-026.actionItem: Uma usika i-aphula noma ukwatapheya namuhla, faka amaconsi ambalwa ejusi kalamula noma uwagcobhoze kafushane emanzini anosawoti.

c-027.title: Ibhodwe lokupheka elinomfutho (pressure cooker) lenyusa izinga lokubilisa ukuze kongeke isikhathi negesi
c-027.summary: Ebhodweni elivalwe ngci umfutho uyakhuphuka futhi amanzi abila ngaphezu kuka-100 °C. Izinga lokushisa eliphezulu lisheshisa ukusabela kwamakhemikhali.
c-027.principle: Ngokobudlelwano be-Clausius-Clapeyron, cishe ku-2 atm (ngokuphelele) amanzi abila eduze kuka-$120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Izinga lilandela ukuthi $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-027.example: Ukwenyuka ngakunye kuka-10 °C kuphinda kabili izinga lokusabela, ngakho-ke u-20 °C unikeza cishe ngokuphindwe ka-4. Ubhontshisi noma inyama eqinile ethatha imizuzu engu-60 ebhodweni elivulekile kuthatha cishe imizuzu engu-20 ebhodweni elinomfutho, kunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwegesi kakhulu.
c-027.actionItem: Zama ukudla okuphekwa isikhathi eside (ubhontshisi, inyama yomlenze) ebhodweni elinomfutho namuhla bese uqhathanisa isikhathi.

c-028.title: Kungani ujamu onoshukela omningi uhlala ungenaso isikhunta
c-028.summary: Ushukela ubopha amanzi, ushiye amancane ukuba asetshenziswe amagciwane. Ukubulala amagciwane ezitsheni nokugcina isilinganiso sikashukela kukuvumela ukuthi ugcine ujamu isikhathi eside esiqandisini.
c-028.principle: Lapho ukusebenza kwamanzi $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ kwehla ngaphansi kuka-0.85, amagciwane amaningi awakwazi ukukhula, nakuba isikhunta singaphila eduze kuka-0.8.
c-028.example: Ujamu onoshukela ongaba ngu-60% une-$a_w \approx 0.80$, okucindezela amagciwane kodwa kusavumela isikhunta esithile. Sebenzisa izitsha ezihlanzwe ngesibulali-magciwane, zigcine esiqandisini, futhi uwudle phakathi kwamaviki angu-2-3 ngemva kokuvula ukuze unciphise ukumosheka.
c-028.actionItem: Pheka izithelo ezisele ngoshukela ongu-40-50% uzenze ujamu namuhla bese uwugcina esitsheni esibulawa amagciwane esinelebula yosuku.

c-029.title: Sula amapani anamafutha kuqala, bese uwageza ngamanzi afudumele
c-029.summary: Amafutha apholile ayaqina futhi amelane nensipho namanzi. Ukusula ngethawula lephepha kuqala bese ugeza ngamanzi afudumele konga insipho namanzi.
c-029.principle: Amafutha asabela nge-alkali nama-surfactant ukwenza insipho egezekayo: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OOCR)_3 + 3NaOH \to C_3H_5(OH)_3 + 3RCOONa}$
c-029.example: Amafutha aqala ukuncibilika cishe ku-30-40 °C, ngakho-ke amanzi asondele ku-40 °C ayawathambisa amafutha. Ukusula kuqala kunganciphisa amanzi okugeza ngesigamu futhi kuvimbela ukuvaleka kwamapayipi.
c-029.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuwasha izitsha namuhla, sula amafutha epanini ngethawula lephepha kuqala, bese ugeza ngamanzi afudumele.

c-030.title: Yeka ukuthosa nokubhaka lapho sekumbala osagolide okhanyayo ukuze unciphise i-acrylamide
c-030.summary: Ukupheka amazambane noma isinkwa ngokushisa okuphezulu kakhulu aze abe nsundu ngokumnyama kwandisa i-acrylamide. Ukuma kusagolide kugcina ukunambitheka ngenkathi kunciphisa ukwakheka kwayo.
c-030.principle: I-Asparagine noshukela onciphayo babhekana nokusabela kwe-Maillard ngaphezu kuka-$120\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, kwakheke i-acrylamide ($\mathrm{C_3H_5NO}$).
c-030.example: Ukuthosa ama-chips ngaphansi kuka-175 °C aze abe sagolide kanye nokungawafaki amazambane esiqandisini kugcina ushukela uphansi futhi kunganciphisa ukwakheka kwayo kakhulu. Kungcono ukungazidli izingxenye ezinsundu kakhulu noma ezishile.
c-030.actionItem: Khipha ithosti noma amazambane athosiwe ngaphambi kokuba aphenduke abe nsundu ngokumnyama namuhla bese usika noma yiziphi izingxenye ezishile.

c-031.title: Isifudumezi sezandla esilahlwayo siwukushisa okuvela ekugqwaleni kwensimbi
c-031.summary: Impushana yensimbi esesifudumezini sezandla ihlangana nomoya-mpilo ovela emoyeni bese ikhipha ukushisa. Iwusizo kakhulu ohambweni lwasebusika, kodwa ukuthinta isikhumba isikhathi eside kungadala ukusha ngenxa yokushisa okuphansi.
c-031.principle: $\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$ ikhipha ukushisa (exothermic), kanti amalahle asebenzayo kanye nosawoti kusheshisa lokhu kusabela.
c-031.example: Ukushisa okukhulu kakhulu kungaba cishe ngu-50-60 °C futhi kuhlala amahora amaningi. Sinamathisele ngaphandle kwezingubo bese uyasisusa lapho ulala ukuze uvimbele ukusha ngenxa yokushisa okuphansi. Isikhwama saso esivalwe ngci sivimba umoya ngaphambi kokuvulwa.
c-031.actionItem: Lapho usebenzisa isifudumezi sezandla namuhla, sinamathisele phezu kwezingubo bese uhlola isikhumba sakho njalo ngehora.

c-032.title: Izinto zokukhipha iphunga zamalahle ziyamunca, aziwoli
c-032.summary: Amalahle kanye namalahle asebenzayo abamba amangqamuzana ephunga ebusweni bawo ukuze kunciphe iphunga. Ayayeka ukusebenza uma esegcwele ngokweqile, ngakho-ke hlonipha uhlelo lokushintsha noma lokuvuselela.
c-032.principle: Ukwamunca (Adsorption) kusho amangqamuzana anamathela ebusweni bento, futhi amalahle asebenzayo anendawo ebanzi engaba ngu-$500\text{-}1500\ \mathrm{m^2/g}$.
c-032.example: U-100 g wamalahle asebenzayo ungaba nendawo elingana nenkundla yebhola, eyanele ukubhekana neshalofu elilodwa lesiqandisi. Ukwomisa amalahle elangeni kanye ngenyanga kancane kuyawavuselela, futhi ukuwashintsha njalo ezinyangeni ezi-3 kuye kwezi-6 kwanele.
c-032.actionItem: Bhala usuku oshhintshe ngalo into yokukhipha iphunga esiqandisini kulebula yayo bese usetha isikhumbuzi sezinyanga ezi-3 ezizayo.

c-033.title: Ukucwilisa irayisi imizuzu engama-30 kunciphisa amandla okupheka
c-033.summary: Irayisi elicwiliswe emanzini selivele limunce amanzi, ngakho-ke ukushisa kuthatha isikhathi esincane futhi liphithwa ngokulinganayo. Usebenzisa ugesi noma igesi encane.
c-033.principle: Isitashi simunca amanzi bese siyavuvukala sibe njengejeli: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + nH_2O \to}$ ijeli evuvukele. Ukuvuvukala kuba njengejeli kwenzeka cishe ku-$60\text{-}70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-033.example: Irayisi elicwiliswe imizuzu engama-30 lithatha cishe u-20-25% wesisindo salo ngamanzi ukuze amanzi afinyelele phakathi nendawo. Isikhathi sokupheka sehla ngemizuzu embalwa uma kuqhathaniswa nelingacwiliswanga, okwengeza emizuzwini eminingi elondolozwe ngenyanga uma liphekwa nsuku zonke. Ebusika amanzi afudumele ashesha kakhulu.
c-033.actionItem: Geza futhi ucwilise irayisi imizuzu engama-30 namhlanje kusihlwa, lipheke, bese uqhathanisa isikhathi sokupheka.

c-034.title: Ukugeza izandla imizuzwana engama-20 kunika insipho isikhathi sokuzungeza ukungcola
c-034.summary: Amangqamuzana ensipho athanda uwoyela ngakolunye uhlangothi namanzi ngakolunye, ngakho-ke agoqa ukungcola namagciwane bese eyawahlanza ahambe. Lokhu kuthatha ukuhlikihla nesikhathi.
c-034.principle: Ngaphezulu kokugxila okubalulekile kwe-micelle (CMC), insipho yakha ama-micelles avalela amafutha: $\mathrm{RCOONa \to RCOO^- + Na^+}$
c-034.example: Ukukhiqiza amagwebu ezintendeni zezandla, ngemuva, phakathi kweminwe nangaphansi kwezinzipho imizuzwana engama-20 (ukucula kabili iculo lokuzalwa) kunciphisa kakhulu amagciwane ajwayelekile. Khetha izinga lokushisa lamanzi ngokunethezeka kwesikhumba kunomthelela.
c-034.actionItem: Bala imizuzwana engama-20 usebenzisa isibali sikhathi noma iculo lapho ugeza izandla namuhla, kuhlanganise nangaphansi kwezinzipho.

c-035.title: Igcobo lezindebe lasebusika lakha isivikelo kunokwengeza umswakama
c-035.summary: Amagcobo e-hydrocarbon anjenge-petroleum jelly akha ungqimba oluxosha amanzi olunciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi ezindebeni. Asebenza kangcono ezindebeni ezinomswakama omncane kunezindebe ezomile ezinamaxolo.
c-035.principle: Ukuhwamuka kuhambisana nomehluko wokucindezela komhwamuko wamanzi ebusweni, kanti ungqimba lwe-petroleum hydrocarbon $\mathrm{C_nH_{2n+2}}$ aluhlangani namanzi, ngakho lunciphisa lokho kulahleka.
c-035.example: Emoyeni owomile wasendlini ebusika (cishe u-20% womswakama ohlobene) izindebe ezingenalutho zilahlekelwa amanzi ngokushesha. Ungqimba oluncane lwe-petroleum jelly lunciphisa ngokusobala ukuhwamuka nokuqhekezeka.
c-035.actionItem: Namhlanje ebusuku, nyisa izindebe zakho ngamanzi bese ugcoba ungqimba oluncane lwegcobo lezindebe ngaphambi kokulala.

c-036.title: Gcoba ukhilimu wezandla esikhumbeni esiswakeme ukuze uhlale isikhathi eside
c-036.summary: Ezandleni eziswakeme, isigcobo simunca amanzi kangcono. Inani elifanayo ligcina isikhumba sinomswakama kakhudlwana, ngakho usebenzisa ukhilimu omncane.
c-036.principle: Ukulahleka kwamanzi esikhumbeni kulandela umthetho ka-Fick $J = -D\dfrac{dC}{dx}$, kanti i-glycerin idonsa amanzi kanti i-petrolatum ivimba ukuhwamuka.
c-036.example: Phakathi kwemizuzu emi-3 ugeze noma ugeza izandla, ukusula kancane ngethawula nokugcoba inani elingangesampula ye-pea kunganciphisa ukuthi uwugcoba kangaki ngisho nasebusika obomile. Ukugqoka amagilavu ubusuku bonke kwandisa umphumela.
c-036.actionItem: Ngemuva kokugeza izandla zakho namuhla, gcoba inani elingangesampula ye-pea likakhilimu wezandla ngaphambi kokuba zome ngokuphelele.

c-037.title: Khetha isicoci esiseduze ne-pH yesikhumba ene-asidi encane (cishe i-5.5)
c-037.summary: Isikhumba sinongqimba oluvikelayo olune-asidi encane lapho insipho ene-pH ephezulu ingalilimaza khona. Ebusika obomile isicoci esine-asidi encane asibangeli ukulunywa kakhulu.
c-037.principle: $\mathrm{pH = -\log[H^+]}$. Ubuso besikhumba bune-pH engu-4.5-5.5 kanti insipho evamile ine-pH engu-9-10, ene-$\mathrm{[H^+]}$ ephansi cishe ngokuphindwe kayizinkulungwane eziyishumi.
c-037.example: I-pH engu-5.5 uma iqhathaniswa ne-pH engu-9.5 umehluko wokuphindaphindeka okungu-$10^4$ ekugxileni kwe-hydrogen ion. Isicoci esibhalwe ukuthi sine-asidi encane sibangela ukucinana okuncane ngemva kokugeza futhi sinciphisa inani le-moisturizer oyidingayo.
c-037.actionItem: Lapho uthenga isicoci sakho esilandelayo, hlola i-pH encazelweni yomkhiqizo bese uqaphela ukuthi isikhumba sakho sizizwa kanjani ngemva kokugeza.

c-038.title: Kungani ama-power bank elahlekelwa amandla emakhazeni
c-038.summary: Emazingeni okushisa aphansi, ukusabela kwamakhemikhali nokuhamba kwama-ion kumaseli e-lithium-ion kancane, ngakho-ke umthamo osebenzisekayo uyehla. Ukuwagcina ephaketheni langaphakathi kunciphisa ukudonsa amandla.
c-038.principle: Ngesivinini $k = Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, i-$T$ ephansi yenza u-$k$ abe mncane futhi ikhuphula ukumelana kwangaphakathi kweseli.
c-038.example: Cishe ku-0 °C umthamo ungawa ngo-20-30%, nangaphezulu ku -10 °C. I-power bank engu-10,000 mAh ingase ikhiphe cishe u-7,000 mAh kuphela ngaphandle ebusika, ngakho-ke kubonakala sengathi idinga ukushajwa kaningi.
c-038.actionItem: Gcina i-power bank yakho nefoni yakho ephaketheni lejakhethi langaphakathi namuhla ukuze ukushisa komzimba kuzigcine zifudumele.

c-039.title: Bala imikhawulo yendiza ye-power bank nge-Wh
c-039.summary: Amabhethri e-lithium avunyelwe kuphela emithwalweni ephathwayo (carry-on), hhayi emithwalweni ebhalisiwe, futhi umkhawulo unikezwa nge-Wh. I-mAh iyodwa iyadida, ngakho-ke zibalele yona ngokwakho.
c-039.principle: $\mathrm{Wh = V \times Ah}$ (imvamisa engu-3.7 V ku-lithium-ion). Kufika ku-100 Wh kuvunyelwe; 100-160 Wh idinga imvume yezindiza.
c-039.example: 20,000 mAh = 20 Ah × 3.7 V = 74 Wh, okulungile, kanti i-27,000 mAh inikeza 99.9 Wh, emaphethelweni omkhawulo. I-30,000 mAh (111 Wh) idinga imvume.
c-039.actionItem: Namuhla, phindaphinda i-mAh ye-power bank yakho ngo-3.7 V ukuze uthole i-Wh futhi uhlole ukuthi ilebula iyakubonisa yini i-Wh.

c-040.title: Vimbela ubuthi be-carbon monoxide ekushiseni kwasebusika namalahle
c-040.summary: Izinto zokubasa ezisha ngokungaphelele lapho kungenangena khona umoya owanele zikhiqiza i-carbon monoxide engenaphunga. Ungalokothi usebenzise amalahle, ama-briquettes noma izifudumezi zokukhempa ezindlini.
c-040.principle: Ngomoya-mpilo omncane kakhulu, $\mathrm{2C + O_2 \to 2CO}$ yakha i-carbon monoxide, ebophezeleka ku-hemoglobin cishe ngokuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-200 ngaphezu komoya-mpilo.
c-040.example: Ku-200 ppm CO, izinhlungu zekhanda zivela emahoreni ambalwa, kanti ngaphezu kuka-800 ppm kuba yingozi phakathi nehora elilodwa. Hlola ukuxhumana komgudu we-boiler nokungena komoya, bese ufaka i-alamu ye-CO.
c-040.actionItem: Hlola ukuxhumana komgudu we-boiler yakho nebhethri ye-alamu yakho ye-CO namuhla.

c-041.title: Ilangabi legesi eliphuzi lisho uphethiloli owonakele
c-041.summary: Ilangabi legesi elinempilo liluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Okuphuzi noma okuwolintshi kusho ukusha okungaphelele okunomusi ne-carbon monoxide eyengeziwe. Ukuhlanza isitofu kubuyisela ukusebenza kahle.
c-041.principle: Ukusha okuphelele: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Ngomoya-mpilo omncane kakhulu: $\mathrm{CH_4 + \tfrac{3}{2}O_2 \to CO + 2H_2O}$.
c-041.example: Ilangabi eliphuzi elenza ibhodwe libe mnyama ngaphansi lidlulisa ukushisa okuncane futhi lisebenzisa uphethiloli olinganayo noma owengeziwe. Ukususa izinsalela zokudla ezimbobeni zesitofu nge-toothpick ngokuvamile kubuyisa ilangabi eliluhlaza.
c-041.actionItem: Hlanza izimbobo zesitofu sakho nge-toothpick namuhla bese uhlola umbala welangabi.

c-042.title: Gwema ukuphela kwamandla kwebhethri lemoto ebusika futhi wonge ekushintsheni
c-042.summary: Isimo sezulu esibandayo nohambo olufushane oluphindaphindiwe luqeda amabhethri e-lead-acid futhi lunciphise isikhathi sawo sokuphila. Ibhethri eliphelelwe amandla line-electrolyte ebuthaka futhi lingaqina libe yiqhwa emazingeni okushisa angaphansi kuka-zero.
c-042.principle: Ukuphela kwamandla: $\mathrm{Pb + PbO_2 + 2H_2SO_4 \to 2PbSO_4 + 2H_2O}$. I-sulfuric acid iyadliwa, ngakho-ke izinga lokuqina le-electrolyte liyakhuphuka.
c-042.example: Ibhethri eligcwele ngokuphelele liqina cishe ku -60 °C, kodwa eliphelelwe amandla lingaqina eduze kuka -7 °C. Ukushayela imizuzu engu-30 noma ngaphezulu kanye ngesonto, noma ukulishaja ngeshaja, kungahlehlisa ukuthenga elinye elibiza cishe ama-won angu-100,000.
c-042.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuqalisa imoto namuhla, cisha isifudumezi, isihlalo esifudumalayo nomsindo, bese uhlela ukushayela imizuzu engu-30 masonto onke.

c-043.title: Ukushisa ipani lensimbi enamafutha (seasoning) kwenza amafutha aphenduke ulwelwesi oluqinile
c-043.summary: Ukubhaka ungqimba oluncane lwamafutha ekushiseni okukhulu kwakha isivikelo esiqinile esinciphisa ukugqwala nokunamathela. Ungqimba oluwugqinsi luphenduka lunamathele.
c-043.principle: Ama-unsaturated fatty acid asabela nomoya-mpilo bese eba yizakhi ezixhumene (polymerize). Ukugqwala kwenzeka nge-$\mathrm{4Fe + 3O_2 + 6H_2O \to 4Fe(OH)_3}$.
c-043.example: Sula inani elincane lamafutha okupheka, wesule ngephepha lasekhishini, bese ubhaka ku-220 °C ihora elingu-1 ukuze kwakheke ulwelwesi. Ukulomisa ngokushesha ngemva kokulisebenzisa kwenza ipani elilungisiwe lihlale iminyaka eminingi, okwenza lingabizi ukuligcina.
c-043.actionItem: Ngemva kokugeza ipani lensimbi noma le-carbon steel namuhla, lomise phezu kokushisa bese wesula ungqimba oluncane lwamafutha kulo.

c-044.title: Hlanza isiliva elilimele ngombala nge-foil ye-aluminium ne-baking soda
c-044.summary: Lokhu kusabela kwe-electrochemical kuphendula i-silver sulfide emnyama esiliveni ibe yisiliva futhi. Ukungahlikihli kusho ukuthi isiliva elincane kakhulu liyakhuhleka limuke. Ngenisa umoya ohlanzekile, ngoba kunuka isibabule.
c-044.example: Ncibilikisa isipuni esingu-1 se-baking soda ku-500 mL wamanzi ashisayo bese ucwilisa isiliva ukuze lithinte i-foil imizuzu engu-2-5. Ungalisebenzisi kumaparele, amatshe ayigugu noma izibambo ezinanyathiselwe.
c-044.actionItem: Cwilisa isipuni esisodwa sesiliva esishintshe umbala emanzini ashisayo e-baking soda ane-foil namuhla.

c-045.title: Ungadli ekudleni okuthinte ukugqwala okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-luhlaza (patina) ezimbizeni zethusi
c-045.summary: Lapho ithusi lihlangana ne-asidi nomswakama, kwakheka ungqimba olunobuthi oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-luhlaza (verdigris). Ungashiyi ukudla okune-asidi ezitsheni zethusi, futhi hlola ungqimba lwangaphakathi.
c-045.principle: I-copper oxide incibilika kuviniga: $\mathrm{CuO + 2CH_3COOH \to Cu(CH_3COO)_2 + H_2O}$. I-verdigris iyi-$\mathrm{Cu_2(OH)_2CO_3}$.
c-045.example: Izimbiza zethusi ziphephile kuphela uma ngaphakathi kuhlanganiswe ne-tin noma i-stainless steel. Susa i-patina ngaphandle ngokuhlikihla inhlanganisela elinganayo kaviniga nosawoti imizuzu engu-5 bese uyahlanza. Ungapheki kuyo uma ungqimba lwangaphakathi selugugile.
c-045.actionItem: Hlola ungqimba lwangaphakathi lwembiza yakho yethusi namuhla, bese uyeka ukupheka kuyo uma selugugile.

c-046.title: Ukucwilisa amapani ashe nge-baking soda ebilisiwe kudinga umzamo namandla amancane
c-046.summary: Ukubilisa kancane esixazululweni esithambile se-alkaline kuxegisa izinsalela ezishe ngomdlandla omncane, kunokukhuhla isikhathi eside ngaphansi kwamanzi ashisayo. Kugweme emapanini e-aluminium, ashintsha umbala.
c-046.principle: Lapho ifudunyezwa, i-$\mathrm{2NaHCO_3 \to Na_2CO_3 + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$ yakha i-sodium carbonate bese ikhuphula i-pH ibe cishe ku-11.
c-046.example: Ukubilisa izipuni ezi-2 ze-baking soda ku-500 mL wamanzi imizuzu engu-10 kuxegisa amamaki ashe. Lokhu kusebenzisa amanzi amancane, insipho namanzi ashisayo amancane kunokukhuhla ngaphansi kompompi ovulekile.
c-046.actionItem: Namuhla, bilisa ibhodwe elishe ngezipuni ezi-2 ze-baking soda namanzi imizuzu engu-10, liyeke liphole, bese ulisula lihlanzeke.

c-047.title: Hlanza amabala egazi ngamanzi abandayo kuqala
c-047.summary: Igazi liphuma endwangwini ngamanzi abandayo (ngaphansi kuka-20 °C), hhayi amanzi afudumele.
c-047.principle: Amaphrotheni egazi anjenge-hemoglobin ne-fibrinogen ayonakala futhi ahlangane ngenxa yokushisa, anamathele ezintanjeni zendwangu. I-hydrogen peroxide ihlukaniswa yi-catalase egazini: $\mathrm{2H_2O_2 \xrightarrow{catalase} 2H_2O + O_2\uparrow}$
c-047.example: Ihembe likakotini elihlanzwe ngamanzi angu-60 °C lishiya ibala elinsundu, kodwa ukulicwilisa imizuzu engu-5 emanzini angu-15 °C nokuthela kancane i-3% hydrogen peroxide kwenza ligwebu (umoya-mpilo) bese lisusa ingxenye enkulu yebala. Yisebenzise ezintweni ezimhlophe kuphela, futhi uvivinye indwangu enemibala endaweni efihlekile kuqala.
c-047.actionItem: Uma kwenzeka ibala namuhla, thela amanzi abandayo phakathi kwalo kusukela ngemuva kwendwangu esikhundleni sokusebenzisa amanzi afudumele.

c-048.title: Linganisa insipho yokuwasha ngokuvumelana nokuqina kwamanzi akho
c-048.summary: Ukuphinda kabili insipho yokuwasha akuthuthukisi kakhulu ukuhlanza; kumane kubize kakhulu futhi kudinga ukuhlanjululwa kakhulu.
c-048.principle: Ama-surfactant ayayeka ukususa ukungcola okwengeziwe uma esedlule i-critical micelle concentration (CMC) yawo. Ama-ion e-calcium emanzini aqinile ahlukanisa insipho: $\mathrm{Ca^{2+} + 2C_{17}H_{35}COO^- \to Ca(C_{17}H_{35}COO)_2\downarrow}$
c-048.example: Ukusebenzisa i-80 mL esikhundleni se-40 mL enconyiwe kuhlanza cishe ngendlela efanayo kodwa kushiye izinsalela ezidinga umjikelezo owengeziwe wokuhlambulula. Ukonga i-40 mL emthwalweni ngamunye emithwalweni engu-20 ngenyanga kungu-9.6 L ngonyaka, cishe ama-USD angu-15.
c-048.actionItem: Hlola izimpawu zekhephu kusipho sakho sokuwasha ngaphambi kokuwasha kwanamuhla bese ulinganisa inani elinconyiwe kuphela.

c-049.title: Uthuli oluhle lwenziwa emoyeni
c-049.summary: Inxenye enkulu ye-PM2.5 yakheka emkhathini ngokusabela kwamakhemikhali, ngakho imaski ye-KF94 ehlezi kahle iyasiza ngezinsuku zasentwasahlobo ezinothuli oluningi.
c-049.principle: Ama-oxide esibabule ne-nitrogen asabela ne-ammonia ukuze akhe izinhlayiya zesibili: $\mathrm{NH_3 + HNO_3 \to NH_4NO_3}$, $\mathrm{2NH_3 + H_2SO_4 \to (NH_4)_2SO_4}$
c-049.example: Ezikhathini ezinzima ze-PM2.5 e-Korea, i-ammonium nitrate ne-sulfate kungenza cishe ingxenye yesisindo sezinhlayiya. I-KF94 ihluza okungenani ama-94% ezinhlayiya ezingama-0.4 μm, kodwa kuphela uma ivaleka kahle ebusweni.
c-049.actionItem: Uma isibikezelo somoya sanamuhla sithi Sibi, cindezela isiqeshana sekhala semaski ukuze kungabikho mbobo ngaphambi kokuphuma.

c-050.title: Isivikelo esixosha amanzi ku-windshield siyifilimu elincane le-silane
c-050.summary: Izingubo ezixosha amanzi zakha ifilimu yamangqamuzana e-siloxane noma e-fluorinated engilazini ukuze imvula nesichotho kuqoqane kube amaconsi bese kugoqeka kusuke. Ukubona kangcono kwenza ukushayela ebusika kuphephe kakhudlwana.
c-050.principle: Ama-silane abophelana namaqembu engilazi $\mathrm{Si{-}OH}$ ukuze akhe izixhumanisi ze-$\mathrm{Si{-}O{-}Si}$, futhi amaketango angaphandle axosha amanzi aphakamisa i-engeli yokuthintana kwamanzi u-$\theta$ ibe cishe ku-$100^\circ$ noma ngaphezulu.
c-050.example: Ingilazi engenalutho ine-engeli yokuthintana elinganiselwa ku-$30^\circ$ ngakho amanzi ayachaphazeka, kuyilapho ingilazi ehlanganisiwe engu-$100^\circ$ noma ngaphezulu ivumela amaconsi aphephetheke ngesivinini esingu-60-80 km/h. Lesi sivikelo sivamise ukuphela ngemva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa.
c-050.actionItem: Kuleli sonto, hlanza ifilimu elinamafutha ku-windshield, faka ungqimba oluncane lwento exosha amanzi bese uyipholisha ngendwangu eyomile.

c-051.title: Kungani ukotini ne-polyester koma ngendlela ehlukile
c-051.summary: Khetha i-polyester lapho uzivocavoca kanye nokotini wezingubo zangaphansi namathawula ukuze umelane nomjuluko nomswakama.
c-051.principle: I-cellulose kakotini inamaqembu amaningi e--OH ahlanganisa i-hydrogen namanzi, amunca kufika ku-~25% wesisindo sawo, kanti i-polyester exosha amanzi imunca kuphela cishe u-~0.4%. $\mathrm{HO{-}R + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HO{-}R{\cdots}H_2O}$
c-051.example: Isikibha sikakotini esingu-100 g esigcwele umjuluko singathatha amahora angaphezu kwama-2 ukuze some, kanti i-polyester yoma cishe ngehora elilodwa. Nokho, i-polyester ibambelela kumangqamuzana ephunga futhi idinga ukuwashwa.
c-051.actionItem: Ngesikhathi esilandelayo lapho uthenga, funda ilebula yemicu bese ukhetha ingxenye ephezulu ye-polyester yezingubo zezemidlalo.

c-052.title: Izikweletu zegesi yedolobha zikhokhisa ngamandla okushisa, hhayi ivolumu kuphela
c-052.summary: Igesi yedolobha ikhokhiswa ngevolumu (m³) ephindaphindwe ngesici senani lokushisa (MJ/m³), ngakho isikweletu sibonisa amandla. Ukwazi iyunithi kukusiza ukuthi uqhathanise ukusetshenziswa kokushisa inyanga nenyanga.
c-052.principle: Ukushiswa kwe-methane: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$, $\Delta H \approx -890\ \mathrm{kJ/mol}$. Imitha eyodwa eyikhiyubhu yegesi yedolobha inamandla acishe abe ngu-$42\ \mathrm{MJ}$.
c-052.example: Ukusbenzisa u-50 m³ ngenyanga kulingana cishe no-$50 \times 42 = 2100\ \mathrm{MJ}$. Ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa ngo-10% ngokwehlisa izinga lokushisa le-boiler konga cishe u-210 MJ.
c-052.actionItem: Namuhla, thola ukusetshenziswa kwale nyanga (m³) esikweletini sakho segesi bese uqaphela ukuthi kuqhathaniswa kanjani nenyanga edlule.

c-053.title: Ukuncibilikisa ukugqwala nge-citric acid
c-053.summary: Ukugqwala okubomvu kumathuluzi amancane ensimbi kuyanyamalala kakhulu ngemva kokuwacwilisa kusisombululo se-citric acid.
c-053.principle: I-iron(III) oxide iyancibilika futhi ibanjwe yi-citrate: $\mathrm{Fe_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Fe^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, bese i-$\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ ibopha ama-ion e-citrate.
c-053.example: Ncibilikisa u-25 g we-citric acid emanzini angu-500 mL (5%), cwilisa isikelo esigqwalile amahora angu-4-6, bese usikhuhla. Ungalokothi uyihlanganise nezihlanzi ze-chlorine; yomise ngokushesha bese wesula ifilimu encane kawoyela.
c-053.actionItem: Faka ithuluzi elilodwa elincane eligqwalile ku-5% citric acid namuhla, bese ulyomisa futhi uligcobe uwoyela kusasa.

c-054.title: I-oxygen bleach isebenza kangcono emanzini afudumele
c-054.summary: I-sodium percarbonate isebenza kakhulu cishe ku-40 °C futhi ivuselela izingubo ezimhlophe ngendlela engabizi kakhulu.
c-054.principle: I-sodium percarbonate ihlukana emanzini ibe yi-hydrogen peroxide ne-sodium carbonate: $\mathrm{2Na_2CO_3\cdot 3H_2O_2 \to 2Na_2CO_3 + 3H_2O_2}$, bese $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + \tfrac12 O_2}$
c-054.example: Ncibilikisa u-25 g emanzini angu-5 L ango-40 °C bese ucwilisa amasokisi amhlophe aphuziwe ihora elingu-1. Ishibhile kunezinto zokwenza mhlophe ezinophawu futhi ayinalo iphunga le-chlorine, kodwa ungayisebenzisi kuboya noma kasilika.
c-054.actionItem: Cwilisa umthwalo owodwa wezingubo ezimhlophe namuhla emanzini ango-40 °C anoxube olungu-5 g/L lwe-percarbonate.

c-055.title: Isikhathi sempova: hlambulula ikhala lakho ngamanzi anosawoti (saline)
c-055.summary: Kuzo izinkinga zokungezwani nokuthile zentwasahlobo, ukuhlambulula ngo-0.9% we-saline kugeza impova esikhunjeni sangaphakathi samakhala.
c-055.principle: U-0.9% we-NaCl une-isotonic efanayo noketshezi lomzimba, ngakho-ke awuvuvukisi futhi awushwabanisi amangqamuzana e-mucosa. Ingcindezi ye-osmotic: $\Pi = iMRT$
c-055.example: Ncibilikisa u-4.5 g kasawoti ku-500 mL wamanzi abilisiwe apholiswa (0.9%). Ungawasebenzisi amanzi kampompi angabilisiwe; amanzi angenalutho ane-hypotonic futhi ayashisa/ayahlabana.
c-055.actionItem: Ngemuva kokufika ekhaya namuhla, fafaza imbobo yekhala ngayinye kanye ngesifutho se-saline esithengwe esitolo.

c-056.title: Iphunga lezicathulo livela kumagciwane adla umjuluko, hhayi emjulukweni ngokwawo
c-056.summary: Umjuluko awunalo iphunga cishe; amagciwane asezicathulweni ahlukanisa amafutha namaprotheni awo abe ngama-fatty acid anuka kabi. I-baking soda iqeda la maphunga ane-asidi futhi imunce umswakama.
c-056.principle: Amangqamuzana anephunga njengama-fatty acid anamaketango amafushane (ngokwesibonelo i-isovaleric acid) asabela nesisekelo esibuthakathaka: $\mathrm{RCOOH + NaHCO_3 \to RCOONa + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-056.example: Ukushiya amathisipuni angu-1-2 e-baking soda esicathulweni ngasinye ubusuku bonke kunciphisa iphunga le-asidi futhi kumunce umswakama. Ihlintshe ngakusasa ngaphambi kokugqoka.
c-056.actionItem: Lapho ukhumula izicathulo zakho namuhla, fafaza isipuni se-baking soda ngaphakathi bese uyishiya ubusuku bonke.

c-057.title: Inombolo yepulasitiki engezansi nama-microwave
c-057.summary: Inombolo yokugaywa kabusha kwepulasitiki esitsheni ikutshela ukuthi kuphephile yini ukusetshenziswa ku-microwave nasekudleni okushisayo.
c-057.principle: I-PP (#5) incibilika cishe ku-160 °C futhi isetshenziselwa izinto eziphephile ku-microwave, kanti igwebu le-PS (#6) liyashwabana eduze kuka-80 °C. I-Polymerization: $\mathrm{n\,CH_2{=}CHCH_3 \to [-CH_2{-}CH(CH_3)-]_n}$
c-057.example: Ibhokisi lesidlo sasemini le-PP liyabekezelela isobho elingaphezu kuka-100 °C ngaphandle koshintsho olutheni, kodwa ukufudumeza ukudla okunamafutha okushisayo esitsheni se-noodle se-PS esilahlwayo kungasincibilikisa. Futhi bheka uphawu lokuphepha kwe-microwave.
c-057.actionItem: Hlola inombolo engezansi ezitsheni ezingu-3 ozisebenzisa njalo bese ugcina lezo ezingeyona i-#5 zingangeni ku-microwave.

c-058.title: Amavithamini A, D, E kanye no-K amunceka kangcono enamafutha athile
c-058.summary: Amavithamini ancibilika emafutheni cishe awancibiliki emanzini, ngakho adinga amafutha okudla ukuze athwalwe aye olwelwesini lwamathumbu ngaphakathi kwama-micelles. Ukuwaphuza ungalile kunganciphisa ukumuncwa kwawo.
c-058.principle: Amamolekyuli angewona ama-polar ancibilika ngaphakathi kwama-micelles akhiwe ama-bile acid. Ngaphandle kwamafutha, kwakheka ama-micelles ambalwa futhi ukumuncwa kwehla.
c-058.example: I-Beta-carotene ephuma ezinqathe eziphekwe ngesipuni samafutha omnqumo imuncwa kangcono ngokuphindaphindiwe kunezinkathe ezingaphekiwe. Izithasiselo zevithamini D nazo zithathwa kangcono nokudla.
c-058.actionItem: Uma uthatha ivithamini D noma esinye isithasiselo esincibilika emafutheni namuhla, sithathe kanye nesidlo esinamafutha.

c-059.title: Izinkomishi ezinamabala etiye kanye ne-baking soda
c-059.summary: Uqweqwe olunsundu lwetiye nekhofi ngaphakathi ezinkomishini luyaphuma ngehlama ye-baking soda ngenxa yokuguba okuncane kanye ne-alkalinity.
c-059.principle: Ama-tannin etiye nama-polyphenol ancibilika kangcono ku-alkali ethambile. $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 \rightleftharpoons Na^+ + HCO_3^-}$, i-pH ene-alkali ebuthaka ecishe ibe ngu-8.3
c-059.example: Ukuxuba isipuni esingu-1 se-baking soda nethisipuni elingu-1 lamanzi bese ukuhlikihla ngesiponji iminithi elingu-1 kususisa ingxenye enkulu yoqweqwe olunsundu, ngisho nasezinkomishini ezineminyaka zikhona, ngaphandle kokuthenga isihlanzi esikhethekile.
c-059.actionItem: Hlikihla inkomishi eyodwa enamabala ngehlama ye-baking soda namuhla.

c-060.title: Izinsalela zekhofi ezigayiwe aziyona umquba osheshayo
c-060.summary: Yomisa izinsalela zekhofi bese uzixuba ngamanani amancane; ukusebenzisa kakhulu kubangela isikhutha nokuvimbela ukukhula kwezitshalo.
c-060.principle: Ukwenza umquba kusebenza kahle kakhulu nge-carbon-to-nitrogen ratio (C/N) ecishe ibe ngu-25-30:1. Izinsalela zekhofi zilinganiselwa ku-20:1, zicebe nge-nitrogen, futhi i-caffeine esele ingavimbela izithombo ukuba zikhule.
c-060.example: Gcina izinsalela ezomisiwe ngaphansi kuka-10% womthamo womhlabathi (100 mL nge-1 L lomhlabathi) ukuze kuphephe. Ungqimba olukhulu olunomswakama lumilisa isikhutha.
c-060.actionItem: Chaza izinsalela zekhofi zanamuhla ephephandabeni ukuze zizome.

c-061.title: Lapho i-aspirin inuka njengeviniga
c-061.summary: Uma ibhodlela le-aspirin linuka iviniga, umswakama usuyonakalisile; ungayiphuzi futhi yilahle.
c-061.principle: I-Acetylsalicylic acid isabela namanzi: $\mathrm{C_9H_8O_4 + H_2O \to C_7H_6O_3 + CH_3COOH}$ (salicylic acid + acetic acid)
c-061.example: Eshalofini lasendlini yokugezela lapho umswakama ungaphezu kuka-80%, i-hydrolysis ingaqhubeka ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Gcina ivalwe ngesivalo ekhabetheni elipholile, elomile, kanye nephakethe elilodwa le-silica gel uma kungenzeka.
c-061.actionItem: Susa imithi nezithasiselo zomsoco endlini yokugezela uzise ekhabetheni elomile namuhla.

c-062.title: Vuselela ungqimba lwebhantshi elingangenwa amanzi ngokushisa
c-062.summary: Uma amanzi engasahlali njengamaconsi ebhantshini lemvula, ukuwasha nokushisa okuncane kungavuselela ungqimba oluxosha amanzi.
c-062.principle: Izingqimba ze-DWR zimisa amaketango e-hydrophobic endwangwini ukuze amanzi ahlangane abe amaconsi ngenxa yokushuba kwaphezulu (surface tension). I-contact angle $\theta>90^\circ$, i-equation ka-Young: $\cos\theta=\dfrac{\gamma_{SV}-\gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$
c-062.example: Izinsalela zensipho nokungcola kulalisa phansi la maketango. Ngemva kokuwasha ngensipho ethambile, imizuzu engu-20 kumshini wokomisa onesikhathi esiphakathi sokushisa (cishe 40-60 °C) noma uku-ayina kancane kumisa amaketango ukuze amanzi aphinde ahlale njengamaconsi. Uma kungenzeki, sebenzisa isipreyi esixosha amanzi esithengiswayo.
c-062.actionItem: Fafaza amanzi ebhantshini lakho lemvula namuhla ubone ukuthi ahlala njengamaconsi yini.

c-063.title: Kusho ukuthini u-20-10-10 esikhwameni sikamanyolo
c-063.summary: Izinombolo ze-N-P-K esikhwameni sikamanyolo zibonisa amaphesenti e-nitrogen, i-phosphorus, ne-potassium, ngakho-ke ziqondanise nezitshalo zakho.
c-063.principle: Izitshalo zisebenzisa i-nitrogen (NO3−, NH4+) emacembeni, i-phosphorus ($\mathrm{H_2PO_4^-}$) ezimpandeni nasezimbalini, ne-potassium ($\mathrm{K^+}$) ezihlahleni nasezitshelweni. I-Urea hydrolysis: $\mathrm{CO(NH_2)_2 + 2H_2O \to 2NH_4^+ + CO_3^{2-}}$
c-063.example: Ikhilogremu elingu-1 likamanyolo ongu-20-10-10 liqukethe u-200 g N, 100 g P2O5, kanye no-100 g K2O. Imifino enamacembe idinga i-N ephezulu; izimbali nezithelo zidinga i-P ne-K ephakeme kakhulu. Ukufaka ngokweqile ngale kwelebula kushisa izimpande.
c-063.actionItem: Bheka isilinganiso esingcono kakhulu se-N-P-K sesitshalo esisodwa osilimayo namuhla.

c-064.title: Amabhethri e-AA e-Alkaline uma eqhathaniswa nawelithium
c-064.summary: I-Alkaline ifanele amarimothi; amabhethri e-lithium primary ahlala isikhathi eside emakhazeni noma emishinini edla amandla kakhulu.
c-064.principle: I-Alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnO(OH)}$. I-electrolyte enamanzi iyanensa emakhazeni, kodwa amaseli e-lithium primary asebenzisa i-electrolyte engenamanzi futhi asebenza kuze kufike ku--40 °C.
c-064.example: Kukhamera yedijithali, ama-AA e-alkaline angu-2 ngokuvamile anikeza izithombe ezingaba ngu-300 kanti ama-AA e-lithium anikeza ezingu-800 noma ngaphezulu. Ezintweni ezisebenzisa amandla amancane njengamarimothi namawashi odonga, i-alkaline eshibhile iyona engcono ngokwenani.
c-064.actionItem: Bhala phansi namuhla ukuthi yimiphi imishini yakho okufanele isebenzise i-alkaline nokuthi yimiphi okufanele isebenzise i-lithium.

c-065.title: I-acidity yomhlabathi inquma umbala we-hydrangea
c-065.summary: Izimbali ze-hydrangea eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka noma eziphinki zincike ku-pH yomhlabathi, ngakho ungawushintsha umbala ngokulungisa umhlabathi.
c-065.principle: Emhlabathini one-asidi (i-pH engaphansi kuka-5.5), i-aluminum iyancibilika ibe yi-$\mathrm{Al^{3+}}$ bese ihlangana ne-anthocyanin ukukhiqiza umbala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka; emhlabathini ongathathi hlangothi kuya kokuyi-alkaline iyanyamalala ibe yi-$\mathrm{Al(OH)_3}$, ngakho izimbali zihlala ziphinki: $\mathrm{Al^{3+} + 3OH^- \to Al(OH)_3\downarrow}$
c-065.example: Ukunisela izimbali ze-hydrangea eziphinki nyanga zonke nge-aluminum sulfate cishe engu-3 g ilitha ngalinye kuzenza zibe luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Ukukhuphula i-pH ngaphezu kuka-6.5 ngekalikuni kuzenza zibe phinki. Ukweqisa kulimaza izimpande.
c-065.actionItem: Hlola umhlabathi webhodwe lakho ngomshwana wokuhlola i-pH namuhla bese unquma umbala owufunayo.

c-066.title: Kungani amajezi ewuli encipha
c-066.summary: Iwuli iyancipha ngenxa yamanzi ashisayo nokugudlana, ngakho-ke yiweshe ngezandla emanzini afudumele ngensipho engathathi hlangothi.
c-066.principle: Iwuli yenziwe ngephrotheni ebizwa nge-keratin, kanti ingaphandle layo elinamaxolo liyaxabana lapho ligqugquzelwa (felting). I-alkali nokushisa kuphula izibopho ze-peptide: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to RCOOH + R'NH_2}$
c-066.example: Cindezela uwashe imizuzu engu-2-3 emanzini angaphansi kuka-30 °C ngensipho engathathi hlangothi, ungawukhami, womise ngethawula ngokucindezela, bese uwendlala phansi ukuze wome ungenzeki ukuncipha. Umjikelezo ovamile womshini ku-40 °C ungawunciphisa usayizi ngokushesha futhi ucekele phansi ijezi elibizayo.
c-066.actionItem: Hlola ilebula yokunakekela engutsheni yewuli namuhla bese ubeka eceleni insipho engathathi hlangothi.

c-067.title: I-Vitamin C ibuthakathaka ekukhanyeni nasemoyeni
c-067.summary: Gcina izithasiselo ze-vitamin C ebhodleleni elimnyama, livalwe ngci, kude nelanga kanye nomswakama.
c-067.principle: I-Ascorbic acid i-oxidize emoyeni: $\mathrm{C_6H_8O_6 \rightarrow C_6H_6O_6 + 2H^+ + 2e^-}$ (dehydroascorbic acid), kanti ukushisa nokukhanya kusheshisa lokhu.
c-067.example: I-vitamin C eyimpushana eshiywe ebhodleleni elivulekile ku-25 °C kanye nomswakama ongu-70% iphenduka ibe nsundu futhi iphelelwe amandla phakathi namasonto. Uma igcinwe endaweni epholile, umkhiqizo ofanayo uhlala uzinzile kuze kube usuku lokuphelelwa yisikhathi.
c-067.actionItem: Susa izithasiselo zakho efasiteleni noma eshalofini lasekhishini uzibeke ekhabetheni elipholile namuhla.

c-068.title: Ukukhetha isibulali-zinambuzane se-DEET noma se-picaridin
c-068.summary: Ngaphambi kohambo lwangaphandle, umkhiqizo one-DEET engu-20-30% noma i-picaridin engu-10-20% uvikela amahora amaningi.
c-068.principle: I-DEET (N,N-diethyl-m-toluamide, $\mathrm{C_{12}H_{17}NO}$) iphazamisa izinzwa zokuhogela zomiyane ukuze bangakwazi ukukuthola. Ukugxila okuphezulu kuthatha isikhathi eside, kodwa inzuzo iyama ukwanda ngemva kwezinga elithile.
c-068.example: I-30% DEET ivame ukuvikela cishe amahora angu-6 kanti i-10% cishe amahora angu-2; ngaphezu kuka-50% akunezezeli lutho olutheni. Faka usebenzisa izandla zakho, ungayifutheli ebusweni, futhi ungayisebenzisi ezinganeni ezingaphansi kwezinyanga ezi-2.
c-068.actionItem: Hlola isithako esisebenzayo kanye nokugxila kwaso kusibulali-zinambuzane sakho namuhla bese usifaka esikhwameni sakho sangaphandle.

c-069.title: Insimbi engagqwali engu-304 uma iqhathaniswa nengu-316: ukufunda ilebula
c-069.summary: Ukuze isetshenziswe ngaselwandle noma ngokudla okunosawoti, insimbi engagqwali engu-316 ene-molybdenum imelana nokugqwala kangcono.
c-069.principle: Insimbi engagqwali yakha ifilimu evikelayo ye-$\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ kusuka okungenani ku-~10.5% we-chromium: $\mathrm{4Cr + 3O_2 \to 2Cr_2O_3}$. I-316 yengeza i-molybdenum engu-2-3% ukumelana nokuhlasela kwe-chloride (Cl−).
c-069.example: I-304 (18-8) ilungele izinto zasekhishini ezijwayelekile kodwa ingaba nezimbobo ezindaweni ezinosawoti. Ifilaski ye-316 ebiza u-20-30% ngaphezulu ihlala isikhathi eside olwandle.
c-069.actionItem: Thola umaka othi 304 noma 316 phansi kwento yensimbi engagqwali oyisebenzisayo namuhla.

c-070.title: I-Fluoride esikhasini samazinyo iphendula uqweqwe lwamazinyo lube yikristalu eqine kakhudlwana
c-070.summary: Ama-ion e-fluoride aguqula i-hydroxyapatite eqweqweni lwamazinyo abe yi-fluorapatite, emelana ne-asidi kangcono. Ukuhlambulula kancane ngemva kokuxubha kugcina i-fluoride eningi emazinyweni.
c-070.principle: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 2F^- \to Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6F_2 + 2OH^-}$. I-Fluorapatite iqala ukuncibilika eduze kwe-pH engu-4.5, uma iqhathaniswa cishe ne-pH engu-5.5 ye-hydroxyapatite.
c-070.example: Sebenzisa inani elilingana nophizi lomuthi wokuxubha one-fluoride engu-1000-1500 ppm bese uhlambulula kanye nje ngamanzi kancane ukuze ugcine umphumela wawo wokuvikela osele.
c-070.actionItem: Ngemva kokuxubha namhlanje ebusuku, hlambulula kanye kuphela kancane esikhundleni sokuhlambulula ngamanzi ngokuphindaphindiwe.

c-071.title: Kungani amabhodwe e-aluminium eba mnyama
c-071.summary: Ukudla okune-asidi okushiywe ebhodweni le-aluminium kuyalifiphaza, ngakho-ke gcina okusele kwesinye isitsha.
c-071.principle: Ifilimu ye-$\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$ eku-aluminium iyancibilika ku-asidi: $\mathrm{Al_2O_3 + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2O}$, $\mathrm{2Al + 6H^+ \to 2Al^{3+} + 3H_2}$. Izihlanzi ezine-alkali nazo ziyayilimaza.
c-071.example: Isobho likatamatisi (i-pH ecishe ibe ngu-4.5) elishiywe ebhodweni le-aluminium ubusuku bonke lingashintsha umbala walo futhi lengeze ukunambitheka kwensimbi. Bilisa izipuni ezi-2 ze-citric acid noma i-cream of tartar ilitha ngalinye lamanzi imizuzu engu-10 ukuze ususe ukufiphala okuningi.
c-071.actionItem: Dlulisela isobho lanamuhla elisele lisuke ebhodweni liye esitsheni sengilazi noma sensimbi engagqwali.

c-072.title: Kuyini ngempela ibala eliphuzi laphansi kwamakhwapha
c-072.summary: Ibala eliphuzi laphansi kwamakhwapha kumahembe amhlophe livela ekujulukeni naku-aluminium eseziqobeni zokujuluka, kanti i-bleach ye-oxygen iyalisusa.
c-072.principle: Amaphrotheni okujuluka namafutha ahlanganiswa nosawoti we-aluminium abe yizinsalela ezingancibiliki, kanti i-bleach ye-oxygen i-oxidize izinto eziphilayo: $\mathrm{H_2O_2 \to H_2O + [O]}$
c-072.example: Hlanganisa isipuni esingu-1 se-percarbonate nenkomishi yamanzi angu-40 °C kube yinhlama ewugqinsi, yishiye ebaleni imizuzu engu-30, bese uyawasha; umbala omningi uyaphuma. I-bleach ye-chlorine empeleni ingenza amabala amaphrotheni aphuze kakhudlwana.
c-072.actionItem: Faka inhlama ye-bleach ye-oxygen emakhwapheni ehembe elimhlophe lanamuhla ngaphambi kokuliwasha.

c-073.title: Iphunga lefenisha entsha libonisa ukuba khona kwe-formaldehyde
c-073.summary: Iphunga lefenisha entsha noma i-wallpaper liyizinhlanganisela eziphilayo ezihwamukayo (ama-VOC), ngakho-ke faka umoya ngokuvula amafasitela izinsuku eziningana.
c-073.principle: Izinhlaka ze-urea zeglue ye-plywood ziyahlangana bese zikhipha i-formaldehyde, $\mathrm{HCHO}$. Ukukhishwa kwayo kukhuphuka ngokushisa kanye nomswakama.
c-073.example: Emavikini okuqala angu-2 ngemva kokufika kwefenisha entsha, vula umoya imizuzu engu-30 kathathu ngosuku bese wengeza ukushisa (bake-out) ku-25-30 °C; amazinga ehla kakhulu. Umhlahlandlela wasendlini ungu-0.1 ppm noma ngaphansi.
c-073.actionItem: Ngenisa umoya namuhla ngokuvula amafasitela aqondene kathathu, okungenani imizuzu engu-10 isikhathi ngasinye.

c-074.title: Amanzi ohambo: ukubilisa kuqhathaniswa namaphilisi okuhlanza
c-074.summary: Amanzi angaphephile angahlanzwa ngokubiliswa okungenani umzuzu ongu-1 noma ngamaphilisi e-chlorine, kubulawe amagciwane amaningi.
c-074.principle: Amaphilisi e-chlorine akha i-hypochlorous acid emanzini, e-oxidize amagciwane: $\mathrm{NaDCC + H_2O \to HOCl + \cdots}$, $\mathrm{HOCl \rightleftharpoons H^+ + OCl^-}$
c-074.example: Faka iphilisi eli-1 ku-1 L wamanzi acwebile bese ulinda imizuzu engu-30 (isikhathi eside ku-Cryptosporidium). Amanzi anengilazi kufanele ahluzwe ngendwangu kuqala, futhi ngenhla kwamamitha angu-2,000 yelula ukubilisa kufike emizuzwini engu-3.
c-074.actionItem: Phaqa iphilisi lokuhlanza noma isihlungi esiphathekayo esikhwameni sakho sohambo namuhla.

c-075.title: Izikhwama zokuwasha i-fleece zinciphisa ama-microplastics
c-075.summary: Ukuwasha izingubo zokwenziwa esikhwameni emanzini abandayo kunciphisa kakhulu ama-microfiber aphumayo.
c-075.principle: I-polyester iyi-ester polymer engaboli kodwa ehlukana ngenxa yokugudlana: $\mathrm{n\,HOOC{-}C_6H_4{-}COOH + n\,HOCH_2CH_2OH \to [-OC{-}C_6H_4{-}COO{-}CH_2CH_2O-]_n + 2n\,H_2O}$
c-075.example: Ukuwashwa kwejazi elilodwa le-fleece kungadedela izinkulungwane kuye emakhulwini ezinkulungwane zama-microfiber. Isikhwama sokuwasha noma isihlungi sibamba ingxenye enkulu bese sikugcina kude nemifula, futhi ukuwasha ngamanzi abandayo konga namandla.
c-075.actionItem: Ziphisele izingubo ze-fleece neze-polyester, uzifake esikhwameni sokuwasha, bese uziwasha ngamanzi abandayo namuhla.

c-076.title: Khetha amabhethri ashajwayo e-NiMH anokuzikhipha kancane amandla
c-076.summary: Amangqamuzana ajwayelekile e-NiMH alahlekelwa cishe ngama-20% wamandla awo ngenyanga ngisho engasetshenziswa. Izinhlobo ezizikhipha kancane amandla zigcina ama-70-85% ngemuva konyaka, okufanele izilawuli kude namawashi.
c-076.principle: Ukusabela kwe-NiMH: $\mathrm{NiOOH + MH \rightleftharpoons Ni(OH)_2 + M}$. Ukuzikhipha amandla kwenzeka njengoba i-hydrogen ihamba kancane phakathi kwe-electrolyte nama-electrode.
c-076.example: Ibhethri elilodwa le-AA elizikhipha kancane amandla (cishe ama-2000 mAh) elishajwe izikhathi ezingama-500 lingangena esikhundleni samakhulu amabhethri alahlayo e-alkaline, kunciphise kakhulu izindleko zesikhathi eside.
c-076.actionItem: Namuhla, uma kukhona isilawuli kude noma iwashi elisebenzisa amabhethri alahlwayo, hlela ukulishintshela kulawo ashajwayo azikhipha kancane amandla.

c-077.title: Amabala kayinki we-ballpoint aphuma ngotshwala, hhayi ngamanzi
c-077.summary: Uyinki we-ballpoint ungowamafutha onodayi oncibilikiswe kusincibilikisi se-organic, ngakho amanzi awawususi neze. Ukugcoba ngendwangu emanzi enotshwala bokuhlikihla kuncibilikisa udayi.
c-077.principle: I-polarity efanayo ixubeka kahle. Odayi abangamafutha bancibilika kangcono kakhulu ku-ethanol ($\varepsilon \approx 25$) kunasemanzini ($\varepsilon \approx 80$).
c-077.example: Beka ithawula lephepha elomile ngaphansi kwebala bese ugcoba ukusuka ngaphandle uya ngaphakathi ngekotoni enotshwala obungama-70%; uyinki udlulela ethawuleni esikhundleni sokusabalala. Hlola endaweni encane efihlekile kuqala.
c-077.actionItem: Namuhla, uma unophawu lwe-ballpoint endwangwini noma efenisheni, hlola utshwala endaweni efihlekile kuqala.

c-078.title: Imifino ebunile iyavuka ngemuva kokucwiliswa emanzini abandayo
c-078.summary: Ulethisi nesipinashi esibunile kuyantenga ngoba amangqamuzana ako alahlekelwe ngamanzi. Ukucwilisa emanzini abandayo imizuzu engama-20-30 kuvumela i-osmosis ukuthi igcwalise kabusha amangqamuzana futhi kubuyise ubuqhwele.
c-078.principle: Amanzi angena emangqamuzaneni lapho ukugcwala kwezinto ezincibilikile ngaphakathi kuphezulu kunangaphandle. Ingcindezi ye-osmotic $\Pi = iMRT$ yakha i-turgor eqinisa iqabunga.
c-078.example: Ulethisi osele usuku olulodwa wengeza cishe ama-5-10% wesisindo futhi ubuyise ukuqhashaza kwawo ngemuva kokucwiliswa imizuzu engama-30. Amaqabunga ashelelayo noma abolile awabuyi esimweni.
c-078.actionItem: Namuhla, cwilisa imifino enamahlamvu ebunile evela efrijini lakho emanzini abandayo imizuzu engama-30, bese uyithintitha ize yome.

c-079.title: Izinto ezibanga ukungezwani komzimba nezilwanyana zothuli zehla kuphela ngokuwasha ngo-60°C noma ngaphezulu
c-079.summary: Izilwanyana ezincane ezingabonakali namaphrotheni abanga ukungezwani komzimba ezintweni zokulala azinciphi neze ngokuwashwa ngamanzi abandayo. Amanzi acishe abe ngu-60°C ashintsha ukwakheka kwamaphrotheni, abulale izilwanyana futhi anciphise izinto ezingezwani nomzimba.
c-079.principle: Ukushisa kuvula ukwakheka kwe-tertiary kwamaphrotheni ukuze alahlekelwe umsebenzi (i-thermal denaturation). Izilwanyana ngokuvamile zifa ngemizuzu embalwa ku-55-60°C.
c-079.example: Ukuwasha amashidi nezikhwama zemiqamelo ku-60°C kunciphisa kakhulu izinto ezibanga ukungezwani komzimba, kanti ukuwasha ku-30°C kusiza kancane. Uma ilebula yokunakekela ikwenqabela, ukusebenzisa isomisi esishisayo kungenye indlela.
c-079.actionItem: Namuhla, washa izikhwama zakho zemiqamelo noma amashidi ngohlelo olushisa kakhulu oluvunyelwe yilebula yokunakekela.

c-080.title: Amafutha okukhempa kanye ne-butane yasebusika
c-080.summary: Amakani e-isobutane ayantenga lapho kubanda kakhulu, ngakho sebenzisa amafutha ahlanganiswe ne-propane uma ukhempa ngasekupheleni kobusika.
c-080.principle: Amagesi ancibilikisiwe awahwamuki ngaphansi kwamaphuzu awo abilayo: i-butane cishe ku-$-1^\circ\mathrm{C}$, i-isobutane $-12^\circ\mathrm{C}$, i-propane $-42^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Ukusha: $\mathrm{C_4H_{10} + \tfrac{13}{2}O_2 \to 4CO_2 + 5H_2O}$
c-080.example: Ngaphansi kuka-0 °C ikani le-butane lilahlekelwa ingcindezi, ilangabi liyadamba, futhi ukubilisa amanzi kungathatha isikhathi esiphindwe kabili. Gcina ikani lifudumele esikhwameni sokulala noma eduze komzimba wakho, futhi uvule umoya etendeni ukuze ugweme ushevu we-CO.
c-080.actionItem: Bheka isilinganiso se-butane/propane ekanini lakho lamafutha okukhempa namuhla.

c-081.title: Ukufunda izithako zokuvikela elangeni (sunscreen)
c-081.summary: Ngaphambi kokuba i-UV yasentwasahlobo ikhuphuke, funda umehluko phakathi kwezihlungi zamaminerali (i-zinc oxide) namakhemikhali lapho ukhetha.
c-081.principle: I-Zinc oxide ($\mathrm{ZnO}$) iyayibuyisela emuva futhi iyihlakaze i-UV, kuyilapho izihlungi ze-organic ezifana ne-avobenzone ziyimunca bese zikhipha ukushisa: $h\nu + \text{filter} \to \text{filter}^* \to \text{heat}$
c-081.example: I-SPF 50 ivimba cishe u-98% we-UVB kanti i-SPF 30 ivimba cishe u-97%, okuwumehluko omncane. Ebusweni udinga cishe u-0.5 g (ubude beminwe emibili) ogcotshwa kabusha njalo ngemva kwamahora angu-2-3.
c-081.actionItem: Khipha ukhilimu ovikela elangeni olingana nobude beminwe emibili bese uwugcoba ngaphambi kokuphuma namuhla.

c-082.title: Ukukhafula amanzi kudoti wokudla kunciphisa iphunga nesisindo sakho
c-082.summary: Iphunga elibi lodoti wokudla livela kumagciwane aphula amaprotheni abe ngamagesi afana ne-hydrogen sulfide. Ukukhafula amanzi kuqala kunciphisa ukukhula kwamagciwane, kunciphise iphunga nesisindo.
c-082.principle: Ukuhlakazeka kwe-amino acid yesibabule: $\mathrm{R{-}SH \to H_2S}$. Ukukhula kwamagciwane kuncipha njengoba umsebenzi wamanzi $a_w$ wehla.
c-082.example: Udoti wokudla unamanzi angaba ngu-70-80%. Ukukhipha u-20% nje walawo manzi kunciphisa isisindo cishe ngo-15%, kunciphise izindleko zokulahlwa kanye nephunga kanyekanye.
c-082.actionItem: Namuhla, khipha amanzi futhi ukhame udoti wakho wokudla kusisefo ngaphambi kokuwulahla.

c-083.title: Isikhathi sokubola sinqunywa ukuthi izinga lokusabela lincike kanjani ekushiseni
c-083.summary: Ukusabela okubangela ukonakala kucishe kuphindaphindeke kabili ngejubane kuwo wonke ama-10°C anyukayo. Yingakho izinga lokushisa lokugcina elishiwo kufanele ligcinwe ukuze usuku olubhaliwe lube nencazelo.
c-083.principle: Isibalo se-Arrhenius: $k = A e^{-E_a/RT}$. Ekusabeleni okujwayelekile kokonakala, izinga likhuphuka cishe izikhathi ezingu-2-3 njalo ngo-10°C.
c-083.example: Ubisi oluthatha izinsuku ezingu-7 ku-4°C lungonakala cishe ezinsukwini ezingu-3-4 ku-14°C. Lugcine eshalofini elingaphakathi kunasemnyango, lapho izinga lokushisa lishintshashintsha kakhulu.
c-083.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ukuthi isiqandisi sakho siphakathi kuka-0 no-4°C.

c-084.title: I-washing soda yensila enamafutha
c-084.summary: I-washing soda (sodium carbonate) isusa amafutha amadala asekhishini kangcono kune-baking soda ngoba ine-alkali enamandla kakhulu.
c-084.principle: Amafutha (triglycerides) aphenduka insipho ku-alkali: $\mathrm{RCOOR' + OH^- \to RCOO^- + R'OH}$. I-washing soda $\mathrm{Na_2CO_3}$ ine-pH ecishe ibe ngu-11.
c-084.example: Ncibilikisa isipuni esi-1 ku-1 L wamanzi ashisayo, cwilisa imizuzu engu-10, bese wesula ukuze ukhulule amafutha anamathele. Iyacasula isikhumba, ngakho gqoka amagilavu, futhi ugweme i-aluminium namapani anamathelayo.
c-084.actionItem: Cwilisa isisefo esisodwa se-range hood kusixazululo se-washing soda namuhla.

c-085.title: Uthuli olucolile oluvela ekuthoseni
c-085.summary: Ukuthosa nokugazinga kukhuphula i-PM2.5 yasendlini ngokushesha, ngakho vula i-hood bese uvula ifasitela ngenkathi upheka.
c-085.principle: Amafutha ashise ngaphezu kwama-180 °C abola ngokushisa abe yizinhlayiya kanye ne-acrolein: $\mathrm{C_3H_5(OH)_3 \to CH_2{=}CHCHO + 2H_2O}$ (ukuphelelwa amanzi kwe-glycerol)
c-085.example: Izilinganiso zibonisa ukuthi ukuthosa inhlanzi yepani kungakhuphula i-PM2.5 yasendlini ifike kumakhulu e-μg/m³, futhi ukusebenzisa i-hood kuyayehlisa kakhulu. Gcina i-hood ivuliwe imizuzu engu-10 ngemva kokupheka.
c-085.actionItem: Vula i-hood ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukupheka namuhla bese uyiyeka ivuliwe imizuzu engu-10 ngemva kwalokho.

c-086.title: Hlanza ibhayisikili nemoto yakho ngemva kokuya olwandle
c-086.summary: Usawoti wasolwandle udla insimbi ngokushesha, ngakho-ke hlanza imoto nebhayisikili lakho ngamanzi ahlanzekile ngemva kohambo lwasolwandle.
c-086.principle: Ingxube ye-sodium chloride isebenza njenge-electrolyte kumaseli agqwalisa insimbi: $\mathrm{Fe \to Fe^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{O_2 + 2H_2O + 4e^- \to 4OH^-}$
c-086.example: Insimbi igqwasa ngokushesha ngokuphindaphindiwe emoyeni onosawoti nonomswakama kunezulu elomile. Ukugeza ingxenye engaphansi kwemoto neketango ngamanzi emahoreni angama-24 ngemva kokushayela ngasogwini nokugcoba iketango ngamafutha kunciphisa kakhulu ukugqwala.
c-086.actionItem: Uma ubugxambuza ngasogwini, hlanza ingxenye engaphansi yemoto yakho neketango lebhayisikili ngamanzi namuhla.

c-087.title: Ukugeza izithelo nemifino: amanzi kuqala, i-baking soda ngokulandelayo
c-087.summary: Amanzi agelezayo ayisisekelo, kanti ukucwilisa emanzini ane-baking soda imizuzu eyi-12 kubikwe ukuthi kususa izibulala-zinambuzane ezingaphezulu kakhudlwana.
c-087.principle: Ezinye izibulala-zinambuzane (njenge-thiabendazole) zibhidlika kalula ku-alkali ethambile. Ingxube ye-1% $\mathrm{NaHCO_3}$ ine-pH ecishe ibe ngu-8.1.
c-087.example: Ocwaningweni, ama-apula acwiliswe imizuzu eyi-12 ku-1% ye-baking soda (amagremu ayi-10 ilitha ngalinye) alahlekelwe izinsalela eziningi ebusweni kunalawo agezwe ngamanzi angenalutho. Hlanza futhi ngaphansi kwamanzi agelezayo ngemva kwalokho ezithelweni ozidla namaxolo.
c-087.actionItem: Cwilisani ama-apula noma amagilebhisi emanzini ane-10 g/L ye-baking soda namuhla, bese uyawahlanza.

c-088.title: Ubulongwe bezinyoni nokucindezeka kwezinambuzane kungamaprotheni futhi kudinga ukuthambisa kuqala
c-088.summary: Ubulongwe noketshezi lwezinambuzane kuqukethe ama-asidi namaprotheni anamathela kupende lapho oma. Ukuthambisa ngendwangu emanzi kuqala bese wesula ngobumnene kunciphisa ukulimala kukapende.
c-088.principle: Amaprotheni omisiwe anamathelana ndawonye futhi akhe ama-hydrogen bond ebusweni. Amanzi nesihlanzi esithambile se-alkaline (pH 8-9) zihlukana lezi zibopho.
c-088.example: Ubulongwe obushiywe usuku noma ngaphezulu bungadla upende ngokusobala ezinsukwini eziyi-1-2, ngakho ukubeka ithawula le-microfiber elimanzi phezu kwabo imizuzu emi-5 ngaphambi kokwesula kuphephe kakhudlwana.
c-088.actionItem: Namuhla, uma kukhona ubulongwe benyoni obomile emotweni noma efasiteleni lakho, beka indwangu emanzi phezu kwabo imizuzu emi-5, bese uyawesula.

c-089.title: I-baking powder ne-baking soda yizithako ezahlukene
c-089.summary: I-baking soda iyi-sodium bicarbonate nje kuphela futhi idinga i-asidi ukuze ikhukhumale, kanti i-baking powder isivele iqukethe i-asidi futhi iyakhukhumala uma ihlangana namanzi. Ukushintshanisa kungashiya ukunambitheka okubabayo noma ukungakhukhumali.
c-089.principle: $\mathrm{NaHCO_3 + H^+ \to Na^+ + H_2O + CO_2\uparrow}$. Isipuni esisodwa setiye se-baking soda (cishe amagremu ayi-5) singadedela cishe ilitha eli-1 le-carbon dioxide.
c-089.example: Uma iresiphi ine-1/2 yesipuni setiye se-baking soda kanye ne-yogurt (i-asidi), i-asidi isebenza ne-soda. I-soda iyodwa enhlama engenayo i-asidi ishiya i-soda engasebenzanga enokunambitheka kwensipho, okubabayo.
c-089.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola amalebula ku-baking soda yakho naku-baking powder yakho bese ukugcina ezitsheni ezihlukene, ezinelebula.

c-090.title: Gcina ama-apula nobhanana ngokuhlukana
c-090.summary: Ama-apula adedela i-ethylene, evuthisa ubhanana ngokushesha, ngakho gcina izithelo ezahlukene zihlukene.
c-090.principle: I-Ethylene $\mathrm{CH_2{=}CH_2}$ iyi-hormone yezitshalo evuselela ama-enzyme abhidliza udonga lweseli futhi asheshise ukuvuthwa. Ukukhululwa kwayo kuyanda kakhulu njengoba izithelo zivuthwa.
c-090.example: Ubhanana ongavuthiwe osesikhwameni esine-apula uvuthwa ngosuku olulodwa noma ezimbili ngaphambili, ongakusebenzisa ngenhloso. Ukuze ugcine ubhanana isikhathi eside, gcina ama-apula ngokuhlukana ukuze uzuze usuku olulodwa noma ezimbili futhi unciphise ukumosheka kokudla.
c-090.actionItem: Beka ama-apula nobhanana ezindaweni noma ezitsheni ezihlukene namuhla.

c-091.title: Ama-tannin etiyeni nasekhofini avimba ukumuncwa kwe-iron
c-091.summary: Ama-tannin nama-polyphenol etiyeni nasekhofini abopha ama-iron ion abe yizinhlanganisela okunzima ukuzimunca. Shiya okungenani amahora ayi-1-2 phakathi kwazo nezithako ze-iron noma ukudla okunothe nge-iron.
c-091.principle: Ama-tannin ahlanganisa i-iron: $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + tannin \to Fe{-}tannin\ complex}$. Le nhlanganisela imuncwa kabi emathunjini.
c-091.example: Itiye eliphuzwa nokudla kubikwe ukuthi linciphisa ukumuncwa kwe-non-heme iron ngama-40-60%. Ukulinda ihora ngemva kokudla kunciphisa kakhulu lo mphumela.
c-091.actionItem: Uma uphuze i-iron noma udle isipinashi noma ubhontshisi namuhla, hlehlisa itiye noma ikhofi ngehora elilodwa.

c-092.title: Ukufaka u-anyanisi efrijini kuqala kunciphisa izinyembezi uma uwasika
c-092.summary: Ukusika u-anyanisi kuphula amangqamuzana ukuze i-enzyme yenze igesi ecasula amehlo. Ukufaka u-anyanisi efrijini imizuzu engama-30 kubambezela leyo enzyme futhi kunciphise izinyembezi.
c-092.principle: I-Alliinase iguqula ama-sulfoxide abe yinto ecasulayo: i-propanethial S-oxide ($\mathrm{C_3H_6OS}$) ivuselela izinzwa zamehlo futhi ibangele izinyembezi. Izinga lokusabela kwe-enzyme liyehla njengoba izinga lokushisa lehla.
c-092.example: U-anyanisi opholiswe ku-4°C imizuzu engama-30 wenza into ecasulayo cishe ngesigamu sesivinini noma ngaphansi uma kuqhathaniswa nalowo osezingeni lika-25°C. Sika isiphetho sezimpande ekugcineni ngoba siphethe i-enzyme eningi kakhulu.
c-092.actionItem: Namuhla, faka u-anyanisi efrijini imizuzu engama-30 ngaphambi kokuba uwusike.

c-093.title: Imibimbi ingama-hydrogen bond aphinde asethwa ngendlela entsha
c-093.summary: Ezintanjeni ezinjengokotini, amanzi nokushisa kukhulula ama-hydrogen bond phakathi kwamaketanga, futhi aphinde asetheke ngendlela entsha njengoba indwangu iphola. Isisi nokushisa kuyawakhulula, futhi ukuyi-ayina ngaphambi kokuba iphole kususa imibimbi.
c-093.principle: Amaqembu e-$\mathrm{{-}OH}$ kumaketanga e-cellulose akha ama-hydrogen bond wodwa. Umswakama nokushisa kuphula la ma-bond, futhi aphinde akheke ngendlela eqondile njengoba ephola.
c-093.example: Amazinga okushisa e-ayini afanele acishe abe ngu-200°C kakotini futhi abe ngaphansi kuka-110°C ezintanjeni ezenziwe (synthetics). Ukulenga izingubo endlini yokugezela enesisi ngemva kokugeza ngamanzi ashisayo kungasusa imibimbi elula ngokwayo.
c-093.actionItem: Bheka ilebula yokunakekela yehembe ohlela ukuligqoka namuhla bese ulifaka isisi ezingeni lokushisa elivunyelwe.

c-094.title: Geza uthuli olucolile ngokuhlanza ngensipho imizuzwana engama-30
c-094.summary: Uthuli olucolile lunamathela emafutheni esikhumba, ngakho amanzi odwa awawususi kalula. Ukuhlanza okuphuphumayo kususa amafutha nothuli kanyekanye.
c-094.principle: Ama-surfactant anomsila othanda amafutha nekhanda elithanda amanzi; ngaphezu kwe-critical micelle concentration avalela amafutha esikhumba (sebum) nothuli ngaphakathi kwama-micelle ahambayo uma ehlanzwa. $c>\mathrm{CMC}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{micelle}\ (\text{amafutha + uthuli kuvaleleke ngaphakathi})$
c-094.example: Ukugcoba isihlanzi esinegwebu imizuzwana engama-30 emanzini angama-30-35 °C kususa uthuli oluningi olungaphezulu. I-pH yobuso besikhumba icishe ibe ngu-4.7-5.5, ngakho isihlanzi esineasidi encane (pH 5-6) siyisifanela kahle.
c-094.actionItem: Ngemva kokuphuma namuhla, yenza igwebu elihle emanzini angenisayo bese uhlanza kahle ngobumnene imizuzwana engama-30 (gwema amanzi ashisayo kakhulu).

c-095.title: Umoya owomile wendiza udinga isithambisi-sikhumba namanzi
c-095.summary: Umswakama ohlobene wendiza uvamise ukuba yi-10-20%, ofana nogwadule, ngakho isikhumba nolwelwesi lwamakhala kulahlekelwa ngamanzi ngokushesha. Isithambisi-sikhumba nokuphuza amanzi njalo kuyasiza.
c-095.principle: Umswakama ohlobene $RH = \dfrac{p_{\mathrm{H_2O}}}{p^{*}_{\mathrm{H_2O}}} \times 100\%$. Umoya wendiza uwumoya wangaphandle oshisisiwe, ngakho-ke umfutho wokugcwalisa uphakeme kanti umfutho womhwamuko wangempela uphansi, okunikeza i-$RH$ ephansi.
c-095.example: Umswakama ojwayelekile wasendlini ungu-40-60%, ngakho ukulahlekelwa ngamanzi endizeni ene-10-20% kushesha ngokuphindwe ka-2 kuya ku-3. Ohambweni olude lwendiza, cishe ama-mL ayi-100-200 amanzi ngehora ngumhlahlandlela ojwayelekile.
c-095.actionItem: Ohambweni lwakho olulandelayo lwendiza, phatha isithambisi-sikhumba esitsheni esingama-mL ayi-100 noma ngaphansi.

c-096.title: Cwilisa imifino eluhlaza emanzini abilayo imizuzwana engama-30 nje kuphela
c-096.summary: Ukucwilisa okufushane emanzini abilayo (blanching) kumisa ama-enzyme, kugcina umbala ukhanyile futhi kunciphisa umunyu nephunga lotshani. Ukubilisa isikhathi eside kwenza i-chlorophyll ibe luhlaza okotshani obubunile.
c-096.principle: Ukushisa kukhipha umoya ezicutshini futhi kungasebenzi ama-enzyme adiliza umbala. Ngokushisa ne-asidi, i-magnesium eku-chlorophyll ithathelwa indawo ngama-ion e-hydrogen, okunikeza i-pheophytin ensundu. $\mathrm{Chl\text{-}Mg}+2\,\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pheophytin}+\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$
c-096.example: Ukucwilisa u-100 g wesipinashi imizuzwana engama-30 ku-1 L wamanzi abilayo anoshukela/usawoti ongu-10 g (1%), bese uyapholisa, kugcina umbala uluhlaza ngokukhanyayo; ngale kwemizuzu emi-5 uphenduka ube luhlaza okotshani obubunile.
c-096.actionItem: Ngesikhathi esilandelayo uma uthenga imifino eluhlaza, yicwilise imizuzwana engama-30 emanzini abilayo anosawoti ongu-1% bese uyipholisa emanzini abandayo ngokushesha.

c-097.title: Izinkuni zivutha kangcono kakhulu uma umswakama wazo ungaphansi kuka-20%
c-097.summary: Izinkuni ezimanzi zisebenzisa ukushisa ukuhwamisa amanzi azo ngaphambi kokuba zivuthe, okunikeza intuthu eningi nokushisa okuncane. Izinkuni ezivikelwe emvuleni futhi zomiswe izinyanga eziyisithupha noma ngaphezulu zisebenza kangcono kakhulu.
c-097.principle: Ukushisa kokuhwamuka kwamanzi kungu-$\Delta H_{vap} \approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$, okususwa ekushiseni kokuvutha kwezinkuni (cishe $18\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ ngesisekelo esomile).
c-097.example: Izinkuni eziluhlaza ezinomswakama ongu-40% ziletha cishe ukushisa okusebenzisekayo okungaphansi ngo-30% noma ngaphezulu kunezinkuni ezomile (15-20%) futhi zenza umsizi omningi. Cwaza ukhuni ukuze uhlole ukuthi ingaphakathi lalo lomile yini.
c-097.actionItem: Uma uzosebenzisa izinkuni ngaphandle, zibeke endaweni eyomile nengenisa umoya, kude nemvula.

c-098.title: Bilisa itiye eliluhlaza emanzini angu-70-80°C ukuze lingabi munyu kakhulu
c-098.summary: Ama-catechin etiye eliluhlaza ancibilika kakhulu emazingeni okushisa aphezulu, okwenza libe munyu futhi lihlangane emlonyeni, kanti i-amino acid emnandi i-theanine iphuma kahle ngisho nasemazingeni aphansi okushisa. Amanzi apholiswe afika ku-70-80°C ayawakha ukulingana.
c-098.principle: Ukuncibilika ngokuvamile kuyakhula ngokwenyuka kwezinga lokushisa. I-catechin i-epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) ikhishwa ngokushesha ngaphezu kuka-80°C, okwandisa ukuhlangana emlonyeni.
c-098.example: Itiye elibiliswe emanzini angu-90°C imizuzu engu-3 likhipha ama-catechin amaningi ngokusobala kune-tiye elibiliswe ku-70°C, linambitheka libe munyu kakhulu. Ukuthela amanzi abilisiwe enkomishini kuqala kuhlisa izinga lokushisa cishe ngo-10°C.
c-098.actionItem: Lapho wenza itiye eliluhlaza namuhla, thela amanzi abilisiwe enkomishini kuqala ukuze aphole, bese uyafaka itiye imizuzu engu-2.

c-099.title: I-glacial acetic acid ayiyona iviniga; iyi-99% ye-acetic acid
c-099.summary: Iviniga yisisombululo se-acetic acid esingu-4-8%, kanti i-glacial acetic acid icishe ibe msulwa ngo-99% futhi ingashisa isikhumba namehlo. Ukuze isetshenziswe ekudleni kumele ibhalwe ukuthi yebanga lokudla (food grade) futhi ihlanjululwe kakhulu.
c-099.principle: Iviniga: $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$ cishe $0.7\ \mathrm{mol/L}$ (4-5%). I-glacial acetic acid icishe ibe yi-$17\ \mathrm{mol/L}$, inamandla aphindwe izikhathi ezingaphezu kwezingu-20. I-acetic acid emsulwa iba ngamaqhwa ngaphansi kuka-16.6°C, yingakho ibizwa kanjalo.
c-099.example: Uma iresiphi isebenzisa u-5% weviniga, ukusebenzisa inani elifanayo le-99% ye-glacial acid kwengeza i-asidi ephindwe cishe izikhathi ezingu-20. Ngaphandle kokuhlanjululwa kokusetshenziswa kokudla ebhodleleni, kuphephe kakhulu ukungayithengi.
c-099.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola i-asidi (%) nezithako kulebula yeviniga ekhaya lakho.

c-100.title: Utshwala buphenduka i-acetaldehyde esibindini, okuyiyona ebangela i-hangover
c-100.summary: Isibindi sihlukanisa utshwala bube yi-acetaldehyde, ebanga ikhanda elibuhlungu kanye nesicanucanu kuze kube iphenduka i-acetic acid. Ukuphuza amanzi akusheshisi ukusebenza kwesibindi ekuhlukaniseni utshwala.
c-100.principle: $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2OH \xrightarrow{ADH} CH_3CHO \xrightarrow{ALDH} CH_3COOH}$. Isibindi somuntu omdala ngokuvamile siqeda cishe u-$7\ \mathrm{g}$ wotshwala obumsulwa ngehora.
c-100.example: Ukucubungula ibhodlela le-soju (cishe ama-360 mL, cishe u-50 g wotshwala) kuthatha isibindi amahora angaphezu kwangu-7. Amanzi anciphisa ukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni kodwa awasheshisi ukuhlukaniswa kotshwala.
c-100.actionItem: Uma uphuza namuhla, phuza nengilazi yamanzi eceleni futhi ubeke umkhawulo kusenesikhathi.

c-101.title: Umlilo wekamu kumele ucinywe ngokuphelele ngamanzi
c-101.summary: Umlilo udinga uphethiloli/izinkuni, umoya-mpilo kanye nokushisa, futhi ukususa noma yikuphi kulezi kuyawucima. Ukuthela amanzi amaningi phezu kwamalahle avuthayo nokunyakazisa kuze kube umlotha uyabanda kuvimbela ukubhebhetheka kabusha.
c-101.principle: Kulezi zici ezintathu zomlilo, amanzi asusa ukushisa. Ukushisa kokuhwamuka kwamanzi $\approx 2.26\ \mathrm{MJ/kg}$ kumunca ukushisa okuningi kwamalahle avuthayo.
c-101.example: Iqatha lamalahle (cishe u-100 g) likhipha ama-MJ amaningana, kanti u-1 L wamanzi ungamunca kufika ku-2.3 MJ ngokuhwamuka. Qhubeka uthele kuze kube yilapho ukubeka ingemuva lesandla sakho eduze kungazwa ukushisa.
c-101.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa umlilo ngaphandle, gcwalisa ibhakede lamanzi kusenesikhathi ukuze uwucime.

c-102.title: I-sodium kulebula x 2.54 = usawoti
c-102.summary: Isibalo se-sodium sisisindo sama-ion e-sodium, hhayi usawoti wasetafuleni (sodium chloride). Ukuyiguqulela kusawoti kwenza kube lula ukuqonda inani olidlayo nsuku zonke.
c-102.principle: Ukuhlukanisa isisindo se-molar se-NaCl, 58.44 g/mol, ngese-Na, 22.99 g/mol, kunikeza cishe u-2.54, ngakho phinda i-sodium ngo-2.54 ukuze uthole usawoti. $m_{\mathrm{NaCl}}=m_{\mathrm{Na}}\times\frac{58.44}{22.99}\approx 2.54\,m_{\mathrm{Na}}$
c-102.example: Iphakethe lama-noodles asheshayo ane-1,800 mg ye-sodium lilingana cishe no-4.6 g kasawoti, cishe wonke umhlahlandlela we-WHO ongaphansi kuka-5 g kasawoti (2,000 mg ye-sodium) ngosuku.
c-102.actionItem: Namuhla, phinda i-mg ye-sodium yokudla okukodwa okupakishiwe ekhaya ngo-2.54 ukuze ubone usawoti wakho ngamagremu.

c-103.title: I-pasta ingaqeda ukupheka ngokushisa okusele isitofu sesicishiwe
c-103.summary: Ngemuva kokubilisa ama-noodle imizuzu engu-2-3, ungacisha isitofu bese umboza ibhodwe, kanti isitashi siqhubeka nokuvuthwa. Lokhu kunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwegesi.
c-103.principle: I-gelatinization yesitashi iqala cishe ku-60-70°C futhi iyaqhubeka ngenkathi amanzi ehlala engaphezu kuka-90°C. Izinga lokusabela liyakhuphuka ngokushisa.
c-103.example: Ebhodweni elimboziwe, amanzi ehla ngama-5-8°C kuphela emizuzwini emihlanu ngemuva kokuba isitofu sesicishiwe, ngakho-ke i-gelatinization iyaqhubeka. Ungonga imizuzu engu-3-4 yegesi.
c-103.actionItem: Lapho ubilisa i-pasta noma ama-noodle namuhla, cisha umlilo ngemuva kwezingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zesikhathi sephakethe bese umboza ibhodwe.

c-104.title: Gcina izimbali ezisikiwe zintsha ngoshukela nethonsi likaviniga
c-104.summary: Iziqu ezisikiwe zisaqhubeka nokuphefumula futhi zishisa ushukela. Ushukela omncane kanye ne-asidi emaphakathi kuyazondla futhi kunciphisa amagciwane asevazini.
c-104.principle: Izimbali ezisikiwe zisebenzisa iglukozi ukuthola amandla ngokuphefumula, futhi amanzi ane-asidi emaphakathi (cishe pH 3.5-4) anciphisa ukukhula kwamagciwane avimba imigudu yamanzi yesiqu. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O}$
c-104.example: Ukuxuba amagremu ayi-10 kashukela (1%) kanye nama-mL ayi-5 kaviniga ku-1 L wamanzi kunikeza cishe i-pH engu-3.7, futhi ukuwashintsha njalo ngemva kwezinsuku ezi-2 kuvame ukwengeza izinsuku eziningana.
c-104.actionItem: Namuhla, vuselela ivazi nge-1 L yamanzi ahlanzekile, amagremu ayi-10 kashukela nama-mL ayi-5 kaviniga, bese uphinde usike iziqu zitsheke.

c-105.title: Sula ingcina yesitika ngamafutha okupheka
c-105.summary: Ingcina esala ngemva kwesitika ayigezeki ngamanzi, kodwa amafutha ayayincibilikisa. Akudingeki neze ukusebenzisa amakhemikhali abukhali.
c-105.principle: Ingcina iyi-nonpolar polymer, ngakho-ke imelana namanzi ane-polar kodwa ixubana namafutha ane-nonpolar (okufanayo kuncibilikisa okufanayo). $\delta_{\text{oil}}\approx\delta_{\text{adhesive}}\;\Rightarrow\;\text{okufanayo kuncibilikisa okufanayo}$
c-105.example: Gcoba amaconsi ambalwa kawoyela wokupheka ensaleleni, linda imizuzu emi-5, wesule, bese ususa uwoyela ngensipho yezitsha; izitika eziningi zezingilazi nezitsha zobumba zisuka kalula.
c-105.actionItem: Namuhla, faka amafutha ophawini lwesitika esinamathelayo embizeni noma epuletini, linda imizuzu emi-5 bese uyesula (i-acetone ingalimaza ipulasitiki).

c-106.title: Amantongomane ayonakala ngoba amafutha awo angagcwele aya-oxidiya
c-106.summary: Ama-unsaturated fatty acid emantongomaneni nasemafutheni kasesame aya-oxidiya uma ehlangana nomoya bese eba nephunga elidala. Ukugcinwa endaweni engangeni moya efrijini kubambezela ukubola ngezinyanga.
c-106.principle: I-lipid autoxidation iqala nge-$\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$ futhi ikhiqiza ama-aldehyde anephunga. Izinga lokusabela licishe lehle ngesigamu ngokwehla ngakunye kwe-10°C.
c-106.example: Ama-walnut asezingeni lokushisa legumbi (25°C) aqala ukunambitheka ngokubola phakathi namasonto kuye ezinyangeni ezimbalwa, kodwa endaweni engangeni moya ku -18°C ahlala izinyanga ezi-6-12. Walahle amantongomane ababayo noma anuka kabi.
c-106.actionItem: Namuhla, beka amantongomane asele esikhwameni sokukhiya (zip bag) noma esitsheni esingangeni moya bese uwagcina efrijini lokubandisa (freezer).

c-107.title: Ukushisa kunganciphisa ukulunywa ukulunywa umiyane
c-107.summary: Amate omiyane abangela ukukhululwa kwe-histamine, okubangela ukuvuvukala nokulunywa. Ukushisa okufushane okungaba ngu-50°C kuncibilikisa amaprotheni asematheni bese kuthulisa isignali yokulunywa.
c-107.principle: I-Histamine $\mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}$ ivuselela iziphetho zemizwa, kanti ukushisa kuqaqa ukwakheka kwamaprotheni amate ukuze kuncishiswe ukusabela (thermal denaturation).
c-107.example: Imibiko iphakamisa ukuthi cishe imizuzwana eyi-10 yokushisa okungu-50°C kunciphisa ukulunywa amahora amaningana. Ukuze ugweme ukusha, ungalokothi ubeke into eshisayo esikhunjeni isikhathi eside.
c-107.actionItem: Ohambweni lwakho olulandelayo, phatha ijeli elwa nokulunywa noma epholisa ukulunywa omiyane.

c-108.title: I-potassium sorbate kulebula iyisivikeli esivimbela isikhunta
c-108.summary: I-potassium sorbate ivimbela isikhunta nemvubelo ekudleni okune-asidi futhi isetshenziswa kushizi, eziphuzweni nasesinkweni. Ithathwa njengephephile ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yemithetho, kodwa abantu abazwelayo bangayihlola kumalebula.
c-108.principle: I-sorbic acid ($\mathrm{C_5H_7COOH}$, $pK_a = 4.76$) ayihlukani kakhulu (undissociated) uma i-pH iphansi, futhi leyo fomu iwela ulwelwesi lwamaseli ukuze yenze umsebenzi wayo.
c-108.example: Ku-pH 4.8 cishe u-50% we-sorbic acid yifomu esebenzayo engahlukene, kodwa ku-pH 6.8 cishe u-1% kuphela oyiyo. Yingakho isebenza kangcono ekudleni okune-asidi.
c-108.actionItem: Namuhla, thola uhlu lwesivikeli (preservative) kumalebula ezithako zokudla okubili ovame ukukudla.

c-109.title: Amabhethri asetshenzisiwe angawomgqomo wokuqoqa, hhayi udoti ojwayelekile
c-109.summary: Amabhethri aqukethe izinsimbi ezifana ne-zinc, i-manganese ne-nickel ezingangena emhlabathini uma elahlwa ngokulahlwa kukadoti. Umgqomo wokuqoqa amabhethri uvumela lezo zinsimbi ukuthi zibuyiselwe zisebenze.
c-109.principle: Ukusabela kweseli ye-alkaline: $\mathrm{Zn + 2MnO_2 + H_2O \to ZnO + 2MnOOH}$. Uma zibuyiselwe, lezi zinsimbi ziba yizinto zokusetshenziswa ezintsha.
c-109.example: Ibhethri elilodwa le-AA linesisindo esingaba ngamagremu angama-23, kanti ngaphezu kuka-20% walokho yizinsimbi ezifana ne-zinc ne-manganese. Ukuqoqa amabhethri ayi-100 (cishe amakhilogremu ayi-2.3) kwenza ukuba ingxenye enkulu yaleyo nsimbi igaywe kabusha.
c-109.actionItem: Namuhla, qoqa amabhethri akho asetshenzisiwe esitsheni esisodwa bese uwahambisa emgqomweni wokuqoqa wendawo.

c-110.title: Ushukela onsundu oqinile uyathamba ngocezu lwesinkwa
c-110.summary: Ushukela onsundu uqina lapho umswakama uphuma kufilimu ye-molasses bese amakristalu enamathelana. Ukuwufaka esitsheni esivalwe ngci nocezu lwesinkwa noma ithawula lephepha elimanzi kubuyisela umswakama futhi kuwenze uthambe.
c-110.principle: Ushukela une-hygroscopic futhi udonsa umhwamuko wamanzi $\mathrm{H_2O(g)}$, ngakho ifilimu ye-molasses ebusweni bawo iphinde ithambe. Kudaleka ukulingana phakathi kwengcindezi yomhwamuko emoyeni nasebusweni bukashukela.
c-110.example: Ukufaka amagremu angu-500 kashukela onsundu oqinile esitsheni esivalwe ngci nocezu olulodwa lwesinkwa ngokuvamile kuwuthambisa phakathi nosuku olulodwa. Uma ushesha, ukuwumboza ngethawula lephepha elimanzi bese uwufaka ku-microwave imizuzwana engu-20 kuyawuxegisa.
c-110.actionItem: Uma unoshukela oqinile namuhla, wuvale esitsheni esingangenisi moya unocezu lwesinkwa.

c-111.title: I-kelp ikhipha i-umami eningi uma icwiliswe isikhathi eside emanzini abandayo
c-111.summary: I-glutamic acid eku-kelp iphuma kancane ngisho nasemanzini abandayo, kanti ukubilisa kakhulu kukhipha amafinyila enza umhluzi ube lufifi futhi uqine. Cwilisa emanzini abandayo imizuzu engu-30 noma ngaphezulu, bese uyikhipha ngaphambi nje kokuba abile.
c-111.principle: I-glutamic acid $\mathrm{HOOC{-}CH_2CH_2{-}CH(NH_2){-}COOH}$ iyancibilika emanzini, kanti ama-polysaccharide anamafinyila afana ne-alginate ancibilika kakhulu ngokubilisa isikhathi eside.
c-111.example: Izingcezu ezimbili ze-kelp ezingu-10 cm ku-1 L wamanzi imizuzu engu-30, ezikhishwa lapho amanzi eqala ukubila (cishe ku-90°C), zinikeza i-umami eningi. I-kelp ekhishiwe ingasetshenziswa kabusha ezitsheni ezitshuziwe.
c-111.actionItem: Lapho wenza umhluzi namhlanje kusihlwa, cwilisa i-kelp emanzini abandayo imizuzu engu-30 ngaphambi kokuyishisa.

c-112.title: Umbala womchamo ubonisa ukuthi uphuza amanzi anele yini
c-112.summary: Umchamo uphuzi ngenxa ye-pigment ebizwa nge-urochrome, futhi uba mnyama lapho uphuza amanzi amancane. Okuphuzi ngokukhanyayo ngokuvamile kusho ukuthi uphuza amanzi anele.
c-112.principle: Ekugxileni $c = \dfrac{n}{V}$, ukuncipha kwamanzi aphuzwayo kunciphisa u-$V$, ngakho inani elifanayo le-urochrome $n$ libukeka liqine kakhulu.
c-112.example: Cishe amalitha angu-1.5 omchamo ngosuku onombala ophuzi okotshani obulula ngokuvamile wenele. Okuphuzi okumnyama njenge-amber kuyisixwayiso sokuba uphuze kakhulu, kodwa amavithamini B noma imithi kungawushintsha umbala.
c-112.actionItem: Namuhla, bheka umbala womchamo wakho kanye bese uphuza ingilazi yamanzi uma umnyama.

c-113.title: Amabanga kaphethiloli ayizilinganiso ze-octane; sebenzisa leyo imoto yakho eyidingayo
c-113.summary: Isilinganiso se-octane sikala ukuthi uphethiloli umelana kahle kangakanani nokungqongqoza, noma ukuzibhebhethekisa ngaphansi kokucindezelwa. Uma ibhukwana lakho lincoma ibanga elithile, ukukhokhela eliphakeme akukuniki nzuzo.
c-113.principle: Inombolo ye-octane iqhathanisa ukumelana nokungqongqoza esikalini lapho i-isooctane ($\mathrm{C_8H_{18}}$) ingu-100 kanti i-heptane ingu-0.
c-113.example: Uma ibhukwana lincoma u-91 (ovamile) bese ufaka u-94 (i-premium), ukhokha imali eningi kakhulu ngelitha ngaphandle kokuthola ukusebenza kahle okwengeziwe. Sebenzisa i-premium kuphela uma injini, njengecindezeleka kakhulu, iyidinga.
c-113.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola i-octane enconyiwe ebhukwaneni lemoto yakho noma kulebula engaphakathi komnyango kaphethiloli.

c-114.title: Uhlu lwezithako zezimonyo luhlelwe ngendlela eqala kwenkulu kakhulu kuye kwencane
c-114.summary: Emalebula ezimonyo, izithako ezingaphezu kuka-1% zibhalwe kusukela kweyiningi kakhulu kuye kwencane kakhulu, kanti lezo ezingaphansi kuka-1% zingabhalwa nganoma iyiphi i-oda. Izithako ezimbalwa zokuqala zakha iningi lomkhiqizo, ngakho isithako esikhangiswe kakhulu esisekugcineni sikhona ngamanani amancane kakhulu.
c-114.principle: Imikhiqizo eminingi ibhala amanzi ($\mathrm{H_2O}$) kuqala. Lapho ukugxila $w = \dfrac{m_{\mathrm{ingredient}}}{m_{\mathrm{total}}} \times 100\%$ kungaphansi kuka-1%, noma iyiphi i-oda ivumelekile.
c-114.example: Uma i-toner ibala amanzi, i-glycerin, bese kuba yi-butylene glycol, lezo zintathu zingenza ngaphezu kuka-90% wayo. Isithako esikhangisiwe esibhalwe ekugcineni ngokuvamile singaphansi kuka-1%.
c-114.actionItem: Namuhla, funda izithako zokuqala ezinhlanu kusimonyo esisodwa osisebenzisayo.

c-115.title: Dlulisa ukudla kwasekhempini ngokushesha endaweni eyingozi engu-4-60°C
c-115.summary: Amagciwane anda ngokushesha phakathi kuka-4 no-60°C cishe, eyaziwa ngokuthi indawo eyingozi. Gcina inyama nezitsha zamaqanda ngaphansi kuka-4°C esipholiseni bese upheka ngokuphelele kuze kufike phakathi nendawo.
c-115.principle: Inani lamagciwane likhula njengo-$N = N_0 \cdot 2^{t/t_d}$. I-E. coli ingaphindaphindeka kabili cishe njalo ngemizuzu engu-20 eduze kuka-37°C.
c-115.example: Ukudla okushiywe ngaphandle ku-30°C phakathi nehlobo amahora amabili kungabona amagciwane anda cishe izikhathi ezingu-$2^{6} = 64$. Pheka inyama ifinyelele ezingeni lokushisa elingaphakathi elingu-75°C noma ngaphezulu okungenani umzuzu owodwa.
c-115.actionItem: Ohambweni lwakho olulandelayo lokukhempa, gcwalisa isipholisi ngeqhwa bese uphatha i-thermometer yokudla.

c-116.title: Ukufaka usawoti emanzini e-pasta akukhuphuli kakhulu izinga lokubila
c-116.summary: Usawoti awenzi amanzi ashise kakhulu. Ukuze wonge igesi, sebenzisa isivalo kanye nelangabi eliphansi kunalokho.
c-116.principle: Izinhlayiya ezincibilikisiwe zikhuphula izinga lokubila (ukwenyuka kwezinga lokubila), kodwa umphumela umncane kakhulu. $\Delta T_b=i\,K_b\,m=2\times0.512\times0.171\approx0.17\ \mathrm{K}$
c-116.example: Ukufaka u-10 g kasawoti ku-1 L wamanzi kukhuphula izinga lokubila cishe ngo-0.17 °C kuphela, ngakho isikhathi sokupheka asishintshi futhi usuke umisa nje i-pasta ngokunambitheka.
c-116.actionItem: Namuhla, faka usawoti emanzini e-noodle ukuze unambitheke kuphela, futhi uma esebilile, vala bese wehlisa ilangabi.

c-117.title: Susa amabala otshani ngotshwala kuqala, bese ulandelisa ngomshini wokuhlanza one-enzyme
c-117.summary: Ibala lotshani lixuba i-chlorophyll enamafutha namaprotheni, ngakho amanzi wodwa ayehluleka. Ukuhlelwa ngendlela efanele kuyalisusa.
c-117.principle: I-chlorophyll incibilika ku-ethanol, kanti i-protease ekusithako sokuhlanza se-enzyme isika amabala amaprotheni abe ama-peptide. Amanzi ashisayo aqinisa amabala amaprotheni. $\text{protein stain}+\mathrm{H_2O}\xrightarrow{\ \text{protease}\ }\text{peptides}$
c-117.example: Ukuthepha i-70% ye-ethanol ebaleni imizuzu engu-5 bese ugeza ku-30-40 °C ngesithako sokuhlanza se-enzyme kususa amabala amaningi otshani.
c-117.actionItem: Namuhla, thepha ibala lotshani nge-ethanol ebulala amagciwane imizuzu engu-5 bese ugeza ku-30-40 °C (hlola kuqala endaweni efihlekile ukuthi umbala awusuki yini).

c-118.title: Yidla isipinashi nolamula ukuze umzimba umunce i-ayoni eningi
c-118.summary: I-ayoni yezitshalo (i-non-haem) ayimuncwa kahle, kodwa uvithamini C uyiguqulela esimweni esimuncekayo. Ama-tannin etiyeni nasekhofini enza okuphambene nalokho.
c-118.principle: I-ayoni ye-non-haem imvamisa iyi-$\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$, kodwa amathumbu amunca i-$\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}$; uvithamini C wehlisa i-ferric ibe yi-ferrous iron futhi ayihlanganise. $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}+\text{ascorbate}\rightarrow\mathrm{Fe^{2+}}+\text{dehydroascorbate}$
c-118.example: Cishe u-100 mg kavithamini C (cishe ulamula owodwa) ekudleni angakhuphula ukumuncwa kwe-ayoni ye-non-haem cishe ngokuphindwe ka-2 kuya ku-3.
c-118.actionItem: Namuhla, khama ulamula esitsheni sesipinashi noma sikabhontshisi, bese uphuza itiye noma ikhofi ngemva kwehora udlile.

c-119.title: Pholisa iziphuzo ngokushesha ngaphandle usebenzisa iqhwa elinosawoti
c-119.summary: Ukuxuba usawoti eqhweni kwehlisa izinga lokushisa ngaphansi kakhulu kuka-0 °C, ngakho iziphuzo ziphola ngemizuzu embalwa. Kuyasiza kakhulu epikinikini.
c-119.principle: Ukwehla kwezinga lokuqina kwenza ukuthi amanzi anosawoti aqine kuphela ngaphansi kuka-0 °C, ngakho iqhwa elincibilikayo lithatha ukushisa endaweni ezungezile bese izinga lokushisa lehla kakhulu (eutectic -21 °C). $\Delta T_f=i\,K_f\,m,\quad K_f=1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$
