c-119.example: Ukuxuba iqhwa nosawoti ngesilinganiso sika-3:1 ngokwesisindo kufinyelela cishe ku--15 kuya ku--20 °C, futhi ithini eliphenyulwa kulo liphola lifinyelele cishe ku-5 °C phakathi nemizuzu embalwa.
c-119.actionItem: Epikinikini yakho elandelayo, xuba izingxenye ezi-3 zeqhwa nengxenye e-1 kasawoti ebhokisini lokupholisa bese uphenya ithini imizuzu engu-3-5 (qaphela ukuthi lingaqandi liqhume).

c-120.title: Inyama ensundu ayonakele ngokuzenzakalelayo
c-120.summary: Umbala wenyama ubonisa isimo se-ayoni ku-myoglobin, okungahambisani ngaso sonke isikhathi nokusha kwayo. Yahlulela ngosuku nangokuhogela futhi.
c-120.principle: I-oxymyoglobin, ehlanganiswe nomoya-mpilo, ibomvu ngokugqamile; lapho i-ayoni yayo i-oxidiyezeka iba yi-metmyoglobin ensundu. Ngaphakathi kwezikhwama ezingenamoya noma ezivalwe ngci kunomoya-mpilo omncane, ngakho inyama ibukeka ibubende ngokumnyama. $\mathrm{Mb}(\mathrm{Fe^{2+}})+\mathrm{O_2}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{MbO_2}$ (ebomvu), $\mathrm{Mb}\rightarrow\mathrm{metMb}(\mathrm{Fe^{3+}})$ (ensundu)
c-120.example: Inyama egayiwe iba bomvu ngokugqamile phakathi kwemizuzu engu-15-30 emoyeni futhi ingase ibe nsundu ngemva kwezinsuku ezithile efrijini, kodwa umbala uwodwa awubona ubufakazi bokonakala.
c-120.actionItem: Lapho uthenga inyama namuhla, hlola usuku lokuphela kwesikhathi, ukupakishwa kwayo, nanoma yisiphi iphunga elimuncu noma ukushelela kwayo, hhayi umbala kuphela.

c-121.title: Yekela u-garlic oqotshiwe uphumule imizuzu engu-10 ngaphambi kokupheka ukuze akhe i-allicin
c-121.summary: Ukusika noma ukuchoboza u-garlic kuvumela i-enzyme i-alliinase ukuba iguqule i-alliin ibe yi-allicin, okuyisisekelo sezinhlanganisela zikagarlic ezilwa namagciwane nezisiza impilo. Ukushisa ngokushesha kumisa i-enzyme ngakho kwakheka i-allicin encane.
c-121.principle: I-alliin $\xrightarrow{\text{alliinase}}$ allicin ($\mathrm{C_6H_{10}OS_2}$). I-enzyme iyaphela amandla ngokushesha ngaphezu kwama-60-70°C.
c-121.example: Imibiko ibonisa ukuthi u-garlic ocolwe kahle oyekelwe waphumula imizuzu engu-10 ugcina izinhlanganisela ezitholakala ku-allicin ngokuphindwe kaningi kunogarliki ophekwe ngokushesha. Izindevu ezilodwa noma ezimbili ngesiphako ngasinye zanele impela.
c-121.actionItem: Uma upheka ngo-garlic namuhla, mqobe bese umyeka aphumule imizuzu engu-10 ngaphambi kokumfaka ekushiseni.

c-122.title: Hlunga bese ufihla uwoyela wokuthosa elangeni ukuze uhlale isikhathi eside
c-122.summary: Uwoyela uyonakala uma ubekwe ekushiseni, ekukhanyeni nasemoyeni we-oxygen, bese uhogela kabi. Ukuwugcina kahle kugwema ukumosha.
c-122.principle: Ama-unsaturated fatty acids ayagqwasa (oxidize) ngokusabela kochungechunge lwama-radicals, akhe ama-peroxide nama-aldehyde; ukushisa kanye nezinsalela zokudla kusheshisa lokhu. $\mathrm{R}\cdot+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROO}\cdot,\ \ \mathrm{ROO}\cdot+\mathrm{RH}\rightarrow\mathrm{ROOH}+\mathrm{R}\cdot$
c-122.example: Sebenzisa uwoyela one-unsaturated ephezulu ezinyangeni ezingaba ngu-3 uvuliwe, futhi uphinde usebenzise uwoyela wokuthosa ohlungiwe izikhathi eziyi-2 kuye kwezi-3 kuphela.
c-122.actionItem: Namuhla, hlunga uwoyela wokuthosa osetshenzisiwe usebenzisa isisefo sekhofi uwuthele ebhodleleni elimnyama bese uwugcina endaweni epholile; ulahle uma unuka njengopende.

c-123.title: Insimbi engagqwali (stainless steel) ingagqwala uma isobho elinosawoti lihlala isikhathi eside kakhulu
c-123.summary: Insimbi engagqwali imelana nokugqwala ngenxa yolwelwesi oluncane lwe-chromium-oxide, kodwa i-chloride ingalubhidliza bese ishiya imigodi emincane namabala okugqwala.
c-123.principle: Ngokuba ne-chromium engaphezu kuka-10.5%, kwakheka ulwelwesi lwe-$\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ oluzilungisayo lapho kukhona i-oxygen, kodwa i-$\mathrm{Cl^-}$ iyalonakalisa endaweni ethile bese ibangela ukugqwala okunemigodi. $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}\ (1\text{-}5\ \mathrm{nm\ film})\ +\ \mathrm{Cl^-}\rightarrow\text{pitting}$
c-123.example: I-Grade 316, ene-molybdenum engaba ngu-2%, imelana nosawoti kangcono kune-304 (cishe i-18% Cr, 8% Ni). Amanzi anosawoti ashiywe amahora amaningi angadala imigodi.
c-123.actionItem: Namuhla, washe ngokushesha noma yiliphi ibhodwe lensimbi engagqwali ebeliphethe isobho noma ukudla okunosawoti bese ulesula lome ngokuphelele.

c-124.title: Ikhofi lantambama lisala emzimbeni ebusuku
c-124.summary: I-caffeine iphuma kancane emzimbeni, ngakho-ke ikhofi laphuzisa lingaphazamisa ubuthongo basebusuku. Ukusheshisa inkomishi yakho yokugcina kuyasiza.
c-124.principle: I-caffeine inesikhathi sokuncipha ngengxenye (half-life) esingaba amahora angu-5 (uhla lwamahora angu-3-7) futhi yehla ngengxenye ehleliwe ngehora, njengenqubo ye-first-order. $C(t)=C_0\left(\tfrac12\right)^{t/t_{1/2}},\quad t_{1/2}\approx5\ \mathrm{h}$
c-124.example: Uma uphuza u-150 mg we-caffeine ngo-3 ntambama, cishe u-50 mg (ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu) usala ngemuva kwamahora angu-8 ngo-11 ebusuku. Isamba sansuku zonke esifinyelela ku-400 mg yisona siphakamiso esivamile.
c-124.actionItem: Namuhla, phuza isiphuzo sakho sokugcina esine-caffeine okungenani amahora angu-8 ngaphambi kokulala bese ushintshela ku-decaf noma itiye lebhali ngemuva kwalokho.

c-125.title: Ezindaweni eziphakeme amanzi abilisa eduze kuka-95 °C, ngakho ukupheka kuthatha isikhathi
c-125.summary: Umfutho womoya uyehlela phansi ngokuphakama kwendawo, ngakho amanzi abila ezingeni lokushisa eliphansi. Yingakho ama-noodle asheshayo nelayisi kungavuthi kahle.
c-125.principle: Umfutho womoya ophansi wehlisa izinga lokubila (cishe ngo-3.3 °C njalo ngo-1,000 m). Ngomthetho wokuthi isivinini siphindaphindeka kabili njalo ngo-10 °C, isikhathi sokupheka siyakhula. $\Delta T_b\approx -3.3\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}\ \text{per}\ 1000\ \mathrm{m};\quad \frac{t'}{t}\approx 2^{\Delta T/10}$
c-125.example: Ku-1,500 m amanzi abila cishe ku-95 °C, ngakho-ke isivinini siba ngu-$2^{-0.5}\approx0.7$ kokuvamile futhi ukupheka kuthatha cishe isikhathi eside ngo-40%.
c-125.actionItem: Uma uqwala izintaba namuhla, hlela isikhathi esiphindwe ngo-1.4 kunesejwayelekile sama-noodle asheshayo bese upheka ilayisi isikhathi eside lisibekelwe.

c-126.title: Ungalokothi ufudumeze ipani elinganamekile lingenalutho ekushiseni okuphezulu
c-126.summary: Ukwembozwa kwe-PTFE (Teflon) kuhlala kuqinile kuze kufike cishe ku-260 °C kodwa kuyonakala ngaphezu kwalokho bese kukhipha intuthu eyingozi. Ukufudumeza ipani elingenalutho ekushiseni okuphezulu yimbangela evame kakhulu emakhaya.
c-126.principle: I-PTFE izinzile ngenxa yezibopho eziqinile kakhulu ze-C-F, kodwa ngaphezu kwama-300 °C iyabhidlika bese ikhipha amagesi e-fluorinated abulalayo ezinyonini ezifuywayo. $-(\mathrm{CF_2\text{-}CF_2})_n-,\quad E_{\mathrm{C\text{-}F}}\approx485\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
c-126.example: Ipani elingenalutho elisemlilweni ophakeme lingadlula u-300 °C phakathi kwemizuzu engu-2 kuye kwengu-5, kanti ukupheka ngamafutha noma ukudla ekushiseni okumaphakathi kuvamise ukuhlala ngaphansi kuka-200 °C.
c-126.actionItem: Namuhla, sebenzisa amapani anganamekile ekushiseni okumaphakathi noma okuphansi anamafutha noma ukudla phakathi, ungalokothi uwafudumeze engenalutho, futhi ugweme izitsha zensimbi.

c-127.title: Ukuphuza uviniga ongahlutshulwanga kuncibilikisa uqweqwe lwamazinyo (enamel)
c-127.summary: I-pH kaviniga ingaba ngu-2.5, engaphansi kakhulu kwe-pH 5.5 lapho uqweqwe lwamazinyo luqala khona ukuncibilika. Uma uwuphuza, wuhlanzele kahle ngamanzi bese uhlanza umlomo ngamanzi ngemuva kwalokho.
c-127.principle: Ukuncibilika koqweqwe lwamazinyo: $\mathrm{Ca_{10}(PO_4)_6(OH)_2 + 14H^+ \to 10Ca^{2+} + 6H_2PO_4^- + 2H_2O}$. Lapho i-$\mathrm{pH} = -\log[\mathrm{H^+}]$ iphansi, kuncibilika ngokushesha okukhulu.
c-127.example: Uviniga one-pH engu-2.5 une-hydrogen ion concentration ephindwe kayinkulungwane kune-pH 5.5. Hlanganisa isipuni esisodwa emanzini okungenani angama-200 mL, uwaphuze nge-straw, bese uxubha ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-30.
c-127.actionItem: Uma uphuza uviniga noma isiphuzo esimuncu namuhla, hlanza umlomo ngamanzi bese ulinda imizuzu engu-30 ngaphambi kokuxubha.

c-128.title: Faka isinkwa efrijini eliqandisayo (freeze), ungasifaki efrijini elivamile
c-128.summary: Isinkwa asiqini ngokoma kodwa kungenxa yokuthi isitashi siphinde sakhe amakristalu (recrystallizes), futhi lokho kwenzeka ngokushesha okukhulu efrijini elivamile.
c-128.principle: I-starch retrogradation, lapho i-amylose ne-amylopectin zihlangana kabusha zibe amakristalu, ishesha kakhulu ku-0-5 °C futhi icishe ime ngokuphelele ngaphansi kuka -18 °C. $\text{amylose/amylopectin recrystallization (retrogradation)},\ \text{fastest at }0\text{-}5\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$
c-128.example: Isinkwa esigcinwe ekushiseni kwegumbi sihlala izinsuku ezingu-2-3 kanti esisesiqandisini esivamile siyonakala ngokushesha, kanti isinkwa esiku -18 °C sihlala cishe izinyanga ezingu-3, futhi ukusifudumeza ngaphezu kuka-60 °C kuncibilikisa amakristalu bese sihlala sithambile.
c-128.actionItem: Namuhla, sika isinkwa esisele ngezicucu, siqandise eziqeshini ezilingene, bese usifudumeza ku-toaster noma ngesitimu lapho usidinga.

c-129.title: Susa amabala katamatisi ezitsheni zepulasitiki ngamafutha nokukhanya kwelanga
c-129.summary: Ibala elibomvu kusoso katamatisi lixubana namafutha bese lingena epulasitikini. Amafutha nokukhanya kwe-UV kusebenza kangcono kunamanzi.
c-129.principle: I-Lycopene iyi-pigment engenayo i-polar encibilika epulasitikini; izibopho zayo eziyi-11 ezihlanganisiwe eziphindwe kabili zimunca ukukhanya futhi zibukeke zibomvu, kanti i-UV izihlephula zibe yizicucu ezingenambala. $\text{lycopene (11 conjugated C=C)}\xrightarrow{h\nu}\text{colourless fragments}$
c-129.example: Gcoba ithonsi lamafutha, uwashe ngensipho yezitsha, bese ushiya isitsha elangeni amahora angu-2 kuya kwangu-3; iningi lebala liyaphela.
c-129.actionItem: Namuhla, gcoba ithonsi lamafutha okupheka ebhokisini lepulasitiki elinebala, liwashe ngensipho, bese ulibeka efasiteleni elinelanga amahora angu-2-3 (izitsha zengilazi ziyakuvimbela lokhu).

c-130.title: Ukwelashwa ngokubuyisela amanzi emzimbeni kusebenzisa usawoti noshukela ndawonye
c-130.summary: Lapho i-glucose ne-sodium kumuncwa ndawonye, amanzi ayalandela. Kubuyisela amanzi emzimbeni kangcono kunamanzi angenalutho.
c-130.principle: I-transporter ye-SGLT1 kumaseli emathumbu ithwala i-glucose eyodwa kanye nama-ion e-sodium amabili, bese amanzi edonselwa ngaphakathi nge-osmosis. $\mathrm{SGLT1}:\ 1\ \text{glucose}+2\ \mathrm{Na^+}\rightarrow\text{water uptake}$
c-130.example: Iresiphi yasekhaya ye-WHO ilitha elingu-1 lamanzi abilisiwe apholiswa anezinkezo eziyisicaba eziyisi-6 (cishe u-25 g) zikashukela kanye nengxenye yesinkezo (cishe u-3 g) kasawoti. Ukuphelelwa ngamanzi okunzima, izingane noma imfiva enkulu kudinga ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha.
c-130.actionItem: Namuhla, beka iphakethe elilodwa noma amabili kasawoti wokubuyisela amanzi emzimbeni (ORS) ebhokisini lakho lemithi.

c-131.title: Ukubaba kwamehlo echibini kudalwa ama-chloramines, hhayi i-chlorine uqobo
c-131.summary: Amehlo abomvu awasho ukuthi ichibi line-chlorine eningi kakhulu; aqhamuka kuma-chloramine akheka lapho i-chlorine ihlangana nomjuluko nomchamo. Ukugeza ngaphambi kokubhukuda yikona kuvikela okungcono kakhulu.
c-131.principle: I-Chlorine iba yi-hypochlorous acid (HOCl) emanzini futhi ibulale amagciwane; nge-nitrogen yohlobo lwe-ammonia yakha ama-chloramine acasulayo. Ku-pH engu-7.5 cishe u-50% yi-HOCl. $\mathrm{Cl_2}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{HOCl}+\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{Cl^-},\quad \mathrm{HOCl}\rightleftharpoons\mathrm{H^+}+\mathrm{OCl^-}\ (\mathrm{p}K_a\approx7.5)$
c-131.example: Amanani anconyiwe echibi yi-pH engu-7.2-7.8 kanye ne-chlorine ekhululekile engu-1-3 ppm. Ukugeza ngensipho iminithi elingu-1 ngaphambi kokubhukuda kunciphisa kakhulu ukungcola kwezinto eziphilayo.
c-131.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokubhukuda namuhla, geza ngensipho iminithi elingu-1, futhi ungachameli echibini.

c-132.title: Bala ubulukhuni bamanzi kusuka kulebula yamanzi amaminerali
c-132.summary: Amanzi asezisezweni ayehluka ngobulukhuni, okushintsha ukuthi ikhofi netiye kunambitheka kanjani nokuthi uthola utwayi olungakanani. Izinombolo zelebula zanele ukuhlukanisa athambile kwawomile.
c-132.principle: Ubulukhuni buveza ama-ion e-calcium kanye ne-magnesium njengesisindo esilinganayo se-calcium carbonate. Cishe u-50-175 mg/L unconywa ekwenzeni ikhofi. $H=2.497\,[\mathrm{Ca}]+4.118\,[\mathrm{Mg}]\ (\mathrm{mg\,L^{-1}}\text{ as }\mathrm{CaCO_3})$
c-132.example: Amanzi ane-80 mg/L ye-calcium kanye ne-26 mg/L ye-magnesium alingana no-$2.497\times80+4.118\times26\approx307$ mg/L, alukhuni kakhulu (ngaphezu kuka-180), futhi azokwenza utwayi egedleleni ngokushesha.
c-132.actionItem: Namuhla, bala ubulukhuni bamanzi asembobeni owaphuzayo usebenzisa izinombolo ze-Ca ne-Mg ezisebhalweni lawo.

c-133.title: Ama-calorie awukushisa kokusha: 4-4-9 kcal ngegremu ngalinye
c-133.summary: Amandla okudla achazwa ukushisa okukhishwayo lapho ukudla kusha. Ungazibalela ngokwakho ama-calorie kusuka kumagremu asebhalweni.
c-133.principle: Ukushisa imvukuzane engu-1 (mol) ye-glucose kukhipha u-2,803 kJ (cishe u-15.6 kJ/g, 3.7 kcal/g). Izici ze-Atwater zingu-4 kcal/g kuma-carbohydrate namaprotheni bese ziba ngu-9 kcal/g kumafutha. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}+6\,\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow6\,\mathrm{CO_2}+6\,\mathrm{H_2O},\ \Delta H=-2803\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}\approx3.7\ \mathrm{kcal\,g^{-1}}$
c-133.example: Ukudla okuncane okuno-50 g we-carbohydrate, 20 g wamafutha kanye no-10 g weprotheni kunikeza $50\times4+20\times9+10\times4=420$ kcal.
c-133.actionItem: Namuhla, sebenzisa ilebula yezakhi zomsoco zokudla okukodwa ukubala i-kcal yayo kusuka kumagremu e-carbs, amafutha namaprotheni.

c-134.title: Ukwomisa izingubo elangeni kuyazixebula futhi
c-134.summary: Ukukhanya kwe-ultraviolet kuhlephula amabala e-pigment asele endwangu, okwenza izingubo ezimhlophe zibukeke zigqamile kakhudlwana. Amabala amancane ayaphela elangeni ngisho ngaphandle kwe-percarbonate.
c-134.principle: I-Photo-oxidation: Ama-photon e-UV aphula izibopho ze-$\pi$ kumabala, asabela nomoya-mpilo ukuze akhe imikhiqizo engenambala. Amandla e-photon $E = h\nu$ kufanele adlule amandla esibopho.
c-134.example: Isikibha esimhlophe esinebala esilengiswe simanzi elangeni eliqondile amahora angu-4 kuya kwangu-6 siwaphelisa ngokusobala amabala alula. Izingubo ezinemibala zingaphela umbala ngalesi simiso, ngakho-ke zomisise ziphendulelwe ngaphakathi.
c-134.actionItem: Namuhla, lengisa ingubo emhlophe enebala imanzi endaweni enelanga ukuze yome.

c-135.title: Cwilisa iminwe enamathele i-superglue emanzini anensipho
c-135.summary: I-Superglue yoma ngokushesha ngenxa yomswakama wesikhumba, kodwa amanzi afudumele anensipho angayithukulula kancane kancane. Ukuyidonsa ngenkani kudabula isikhumba.
c-135.principle: I-Cyanoacrylate yakha amaketango e-polymer ngokushesha lapho umswakama (OH⁻) uyicubula, iqine ngemizuzwana kuya kumzuzu. Amanzi anensipho nokuhlikihla ngobumnene kuyayithambisa futhi kuqede ukunamathela. $n\,\mathrm{CH_2{=}C(CN)COOR}\xrightarrow{\ \mathrm{OH^-}\ (\text{omswakama})\ }\left[\mathrm{CH_2\text{-}C(CN)(COOR)}\right]_n$
c-135.example: Ukucwilisa emanzini afudumele anensipho imizuzu eyi-10-15 nokuyiphendula ngesithupha kukhulula iminwe eminingi. Uma inamathele emehlweni noma ezindebeni, ungahlikihli; thola usizo lwezokwelapha ngokushesha.
c-135.actionItem: Namuhla, vula amawindi uma usebenzisa i-superglue, futhi uma iminwe inamathela, yicwilise emanzini afudumele anensipho imizuzu eyi-15 bese uyiphendula kancane ize ihlukane.

c-136.title: Ukwengeza i-asidi kunciphisa iphunga lenhlanzi
c-136.summary: Isizathu esiyinhloko sephunga lenhlanzi yi-trimethylamine, okuyikhompawundi eyisisekelo (base). Ukufafaza ijusi kalamula noma uviniga kuyayincibilikisa ukuze kuphume iphunga elincane.
c-136.principle: $\mathrm{(CH_3)_3N + H^+ \to (CH_3)_3NH^+}$. I-amine esishintshe yaba yi-ion ayihwamuki, ngakho-ke iphunga liyancipha.
c-136.example: Isipuni setiye (cishe u-5 mL) sejusi kalamula ecezwini lenhlanzi imizuzu eyi-5 linciphisa ngokuphawulekayo iphunga lenhlanzi. Ukuyicwilisa obusini imizuzu engama-20 kusebenza ngomgomo ofanayo, njengoba amaprotheni ebopha amakhemikhali anephunga.
c-136.actionItem: Lapho upheka inhlanzi namuhla, qala ngokuyifafaza ngejusi kalamula noma uviniga.

c-137.title: Umfutho we-oksijini uyehla lapho uphakama futhi lokho kukuqeda umoya
c-137.summary: Ingxenye ye-oksijini emoyeni icishe ibe ngama-21% yonke indawo, kodwa umfutho womoya uyehla ezindaweni eziphakeme, ngakho-ke umfutho we-oksijini uyehla. Ebangeni elingamamitha angama-3000 uthola cishe ama-70% kuphela uma kuqhathaniswa nolwandle.
c-137.principle: Umthetho ka-Dalton: $p_{\mathrm{O_2}} = x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \times P_{\mathrm{total}}$. $x_{\mathrm{O_2}} \approx 0.21$ ihlala ingaguquki ngenkathi $P_{\mathrm{total}}$ yehla.
c-137.example: Ezingeni lolwandle (101 kPa) umfutho we-oksijini ucishe ube ngu-21 kPa, kanti ebangeni elingamamitha angama-3000 (cishe 70 kPa) uba cishe ngu-14.7 kPa. Ukukhuphuka kancane kancane, cishe ngamamitha angama-500 ngosuku, kunciphisa ingozi yokugula ngenxa yokuphakama (altitude sickness).
c-137.actionItem: Uma uhlela uhambo oluya endaweni ephakeme kakhulu, hlela ukukhuphuka kancane kancane.

c-138.title: Lahla amathini avuvukile noma agxotshwe kabi
c-138.summary: Ithini elivuvukile libonisa ukuthi amagciwane angaphakathi akhiqize igesi, mhlawumbe amagciwane ayingozi afana ne-Clostridium botulinum. Ungawavuli amathini avuvukile; alahle kude.
c-138.principle: Igesi yokubilisa yamagciwane: ukusabela okufana nokuthi $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2C_2H_5OH + 2CO_2}$ kukhiqiza i-$\mathrm{CO_2}$ futhi kwenyusa umfutho ngaphakathi ethinini.
c-138.example: Ithini elijwayelekile linomfutho ophansi kakhulu (near vacuum) ngaphakathi, ngakho-ke isivalo salo siyisicaba noma sigobe kancane ngaphakathi. Uma livuvukile, likhipha umsindo wokuvuza noma ligwebu lapho livulwa, ungakudli.
c-138.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola amathini asekhabetheni lakho ukuthi awavuvukile noma awanagcekeza yini.

c-139.title: Amafutha athululelwa kusinki ayaphola, aqine bese evimba amapayipi
c-139.summary: Amafutha ashisayo awuketshezi, kodwa njengoba ephola amafutha agcwele (saturated fats) ayaqina ezindongeni zamapayipi bese ebamba udoti. Sula amafutha ngephepha bese uwaphonsa emgqonyeni kadoti, hhayi kusinki.
c-139.principle: Amafutha agcwele ancibilika cishe ku-30-60°C, kanti amafutha apholayo adlula ekushintsheni kwesimo $\mathrm{uketshezi \to okuqinile}$. Ngama-ion e-calcium aphinde akhe usawoti we-calcium we-fatty acid (amagwebu anamathelayo ensipho).
c-139.example: Ukuthululela u-200 mL wamafutha okuthosa kusinki kungashiya ungqimba oluqinile lwe-1-2 mm ezindongeni zamapayipi, futhi ukukuphinda kungavimba ipayipi. Sula izitsha ezinamafutha ngethawula lephepha ngaphambi kokuzigeza.
c-139.actionItem: Namuhla, sula amapani anamafutha ngethawula lephepha ngaphambi kokuwageza.

c-140.title: Amabhodlela amanzi ashiywe emotweni eshisayo
c-140.summary: Amabhodlela e-PET ashiywe emotweni eshisayo angadedela i-antimony encane nezinye izinhlanganisela zamakhemikhali. Usuku olulodwa noma amabili anobungozi obuphansi, kodwa amanzi ashiywe amasonto amaningi kungcono ukuwagwema.
c-140.principle: Ukungena kwamakhemikhali emanzini kwenyuka nezinga lokushisa: $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ (isibalo se-Arrhenius, i-$T$ enkulu inikeza i-$k$ enkulu)
c-140.example: Ingaphakathi lemoto phakathi nehlobo lingafinyelela ku-60-70 °C, okwenza ukungena kwamakhemikhali kusheshiswe ngokuphindwe kaningi kunezinga lika-20 °C.
c-140.actionItem: Ungawanaki amanzi asebhodleleni le-PET asekupheleni kwesikhathi emotweni yakho; phatha igilasi lensimbi (stainless steel) ohambweni lwakho.

c-141.title: Kungani isiqandisi se-R-32 sibalulekile
c-141.summary: I-R-32 idinga inani elincane kune-R-410A ukuze inikeze amandla okupholisa afanayo, futhi inamathuba okufudumeza umhlaba (GWP) angaba ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu kuphela. Kufanelekile ukukuhlola lokhu lapho uthenga i-air conditioner.
c-141.principle: I-R-32 yi-$\mathrm{CH_2F_2}$; ukushisa okukhulu okucashile $q = h_{\mathrm{g}} - h_{\mathrm{f}}$ kusho ukuthi isiqandisi esincane kufanele sizungeze.
c-141.example: I-GWP icishe ibe ngu-2088 ku-R-410A kanti icishe ibe ngu-675 ku-R-32. Inani eligcwaliswayo liphinde libe lincane ngama-20-30%, okunikeza ukusebenza kahle kakhudlwana.
c-141.actionItem: Uma uthenga noma ulungisa i-AC, funda ilebula bese uphawula uhlobo lwesiqandisi (R-32 noma R-410A).

c-142.title: Kungani isoda liphelelwa amagwebu
c-142.summary: I-carbon dioxide incibilika kangcono kakhulu ngaphansi komfutho nasebandeni, futhi iyaphuma lapho isiphuzo siba fudumele noma umfutho wehla. Ligcine libanda futhi ulibophe ngokushesha.
c-142.principle: Umthetho ka-Henry: $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P_{\mathrm{CO_2}}$, lapho i-$k_{\mathrm{H}}$ yehla njengoba izinga lokushisa likhuphuka.
c-142.example: Umfutho ebhodleleni elivaliwe ucishe ube ngu-3-4 atm, kanti ukuncibilika kwe-$\mathrm{CO_2}$ ku-25 °C kucishe kube yingxenye yalokho okuku-4 °C.
c-142.actionItem: Vala ibhodlela lesoda ngokushesha ngemva kokuthela bese uligcina limile esiqandisini namuhla.

c-143.title: I-baking soda esiqandisini
c-143.summary: I-baking soda ine-base emaphakathi, ngakho-ke iqeda ama-molecule ane-asidi anuka kabi njengama-fatty acids. Amandla ayo mancane, ngakho yishintshe njalo ngemva kwezinyanga ezi-2-3.
c-143.example: Cishe amagremu ayi-100 (ingxenye yenkomishi) esitsheni esivulekile yanele ukunqanda amaphunga amancane esiqandisini esincane.
c-143.actionItem: Beka inkomishi ye-baking soda esitsheni esingashonile eshalofini lesiqandisi bese ubhala usuku lokuyishintsha ezinyangeni ezi-3 ezizayo.

c-144.title: Ubhatata unambitheka kamnandi kakhulu uma ubhakwa kancane ku-70-75°C
c-144.summary: I-beta-amylase kubhatata ihlukanisa isitashi sibe yi-maltose emnandi, isebenza kahle kakhulu cishe ku-70-75°C futhi iyama ngaphezu kuka-90°C. Uma ubhakwa kancane, uchitha isikhathi esiningi kule ndawo emnandi.
c-144.principle: $\mathrm{(C_6H_{10}O_5)_n + n/2\,H_2O \xrightarrow{\beta\text{-amylase}} n/2\,C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}}$. Ukusebenza kwe-enzyme kunezinga lokushisa elifanele.
c-144.example: Ukubhaka ku-150°C noma ngaphansi imizuzu engama-50 noma ngaphezulu kugcina ingaphakathi likububanzi obungu-70-75°C isikhathi eside kakhulu kunemizuzu emi-5 ku-180°C, kukhiqize i-maltose eningi kakhulu. Yingakho ubhatata othosiwe umnandi kangaka.
c-144.actionItem: Lapho ubhaka ubhatata namuhla, wose ngezinga lokushisa eliphansi nangesikhathi eside.

c-145.title: Amaqanda aba thambile cishe ku-62-65°C ngoba amaprotheni ayashintsha ukwakheka
c-145.summary: Amaprotheni amhlophe nawesikhupha seqanda aqina emazingeni okushisa angafani. Ingxenye emhlophe iqala ukuqina cishe ku-62-65°C kanti isikhupha siqina cishe ku-65-70°C, okwehlukanisa iqanda elithambile kweliqine ngokuphelele.
c-145.principle: I-thermal denaturation yembula ukwakheka kwe-tertiary kwamaprotheni ukuze ahlangane ndawonye. I-ovotransferrin ishintsha ukwakheka ngase-62°C kanti i-ovalbumin ngase-80°C.
c-145.example: Imizuzu eyisithupha emanzini abilayo inikeza ingxenye emhlophe eqinile nesikhupha esimanzi, kanti imizuzu eyi-10 noma ngaphezulu inikeza iqanda eliphekwe laqina ngokuphelele. Ngenxa yengozi ye-Salmonella, abantu abadala nabesifazane abakhulelwe kufanele bawadle ephekwe ngokugcwele.
c-145.actionItem: Lapho ubilisa amaqanda namuhla, setha izibali-sikhathi zibe yimizuzu engama-6 nengama-10 bese uqhathanisa imiphumela.

c-146.title: Amavithamini ancibilika emanzini angeqile aphuma ngomchamo
c-146.summary: I-Vitamin C namavithamini e-B ancibilika emanzini, ngakho-ke lokho okweqa isidingo sakho akugcinwa emzimbeni kodwa kukhishwa ngomchamo. Okuningi kwesithasiselo somthamo ophezulu kungase kumane kumosheke.
c-146.principle: Ama-molecule ancibilika emanzini ane-polarity, ancibilika kalula egazini nasemchamweni, futhi ahlolwa yizinso. Ngokuphambene, amavithamini ancibilika emafutheni aqongelela ezicutshini zamafutha.
c-146.example: Isincomo se-vitamin C somuntu omdala cishe singama-100 mg ngosuku, futhi ukuthatha i-1000 mg ngesikhathi esisodwa kwehlisa ukumuncwa kube ngaphansi kwama-50%, kanti okunye okuningi kuyachithwa. Isithelo esisodwa sinikeza cishe ama-50 mg.
c-146.actionItem: Uma uthatha isithasiselo samavithamini namuhla, hlola ukuthi sona kanye nokudla kwakho kuhlala ngaphakathi kwenani elinconyiwe.

c-147.title: Usawoti wasolwandle nosawoti ocolisiwe uhluka ngenani le-NaCl namaminerali
c-147.summary: Usawoti ocolisiwe unamaphesenti angu-99 noma ngaphezulu e-sodium chloride (NaCl), kuyilapho usawoti wasolwandle owenziwe ngokomisa ungaphezu kuka-80-90% we-NaCl exubene ne-magnesium, i-calcium nomswakama. Kunoma iyiphi indlela i-sodium iyafana, ngakho ukudla kancane yikho okubaluleke kakhulu.
c-147.principle: Ingxenye ye-sodium ithi $\dfrac{M_{\mathrm{Na}}}{M_{\mathrm{NaCl}}} = \dfrac{23}{58.5} \approx 0.39$. Eisisindo esifanayo sikasawoti, lapho inani le-NaCl liphezulu, iba ningi ne-sodium.
c-147.example: U-5 g we-NaCl emsulwa uphethe cishe u-1.97 g we-sodium, kanti usawoti wasolwandle one-85% ye-NaCl uphethe cishe u-1.67 g. I-WHO yeluleka ngokungadli usawoti ongaphezu kuka-5 g ngosuku.
c-147.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola inani le-sodium (mg nge-100 g ngalinye) kulebula yezomsoco kasawoti wakho.

c-148.title: Incazelo yezingilazi zamehlo ezishintsha umbala (photochromic lenses)
c-148.summary: I-silver halide ezingilazini ezishintsha umbala ihlukana ibe amachashaza esiliva ngaphansi kwemisebe ye-UV bese iba mnyama, bese iphinde ihlangana lapho ukukhanya kuncipha. Ezimotweni, ingilazi ivimba i-UV ngakho ziba mnyama kancane.
c-148.example: Ekukhanyeni kwelanga, ukudlula kokukhanya kungehla kusuka cishe ku-85% kuya ebangeni lika-20% phakathi nomzuzu bese kubuyela esimweni phakathi kwemizuzu engu-5-15 endlini.
c-148.actionItem: Uma ushayela elangeni, phatha izibuko zelanga ezijwayelekile ezivimba i-UV esikhundleni sokuthembela ezingilazini ezishintsha umbala.

c-149.title: Izimoto zikagesi zisebenzisa amandla kahle kunezimoto zikaphethiloli
c-149.summary: Injini kaphethiloli iguqula kuphela cishe u-20-30% wamandla kaphethiloli abe ukunyakaza bese ichitha amanye njengokushisa. Imoto kagesi iletha cishe u-80-90% wamandla ayo kagesi emasondweni, ngakho idinga amandla amancane ebangeni ngalinye.
c-149.principle: Ilitha elilodwa likaphethiloli liphethe cishe u-$32\ \mathrm{MJ}$ ($\approx 8.9\ \mathrm{kWh}$), futhi ngokusebenza kahle okungu-$\eta = \dfrac{W_{\text{out}}}{E_{\text{in}}}$ okungaba u-25%, umsebenzi owusizo uba cishe u-2.2 kWh.
c-149.example: Imoto ehamba cishe amakhilomitha angu-12 ngelitha likaphethiloli isebenzisa lawo mandla awusizo angu-2.2 kWh ebangeni elingu-12 km, kanti imoto kagesi ihamba u-12 km ngamandla acishe abe ngu-2 kWh (cishe u-6 km nge-kWh ngayinye). Ukubala ukulahleka kwamandla ezikhungweni zikagesi kunciphisa lo mehluko.
c-149.actionItem: Namuhla, hamba ngezinyawo noma usebenzise izithuthi zomphakathi ohambweni olufushane ukuze wonge uphethiloli.

c-150.title: Izinga lokushisa lapho uwoyela wokupheka uqala ukuthunqa intuthu (smoke point)
c-150.summary: Ngaphezu kwezinga layo lokuthunqa, uwoyela ukhipha intuthu kanye ne-acrolein ecasula amehlo nomphimbo. Ukupheka ngokushisa okuphezulu kudinga uwoyela onezinga eliphezulu lokuthunqa intuthu.
c-150.example: Amazinga okuthunqa intuthu acishe abe ngu-190 °C kuwoyela we-olive we-extra-virgin, cishe u-240 °C kuwoyela we-canola, kanti acishe abe ngu-230 °C kuwoyela we-sunflower ocolisiwe.
c-150.actionItem: Sebenzisa uwoyela ocolisiwe onezinga eliphezulu lokuthunqa intuthu lapho uthosa ngokunyakazisa (stir-frying); uma uthunqa intuthu, nciphisa ukushisa bese uvula indawo kungene umoya.

c-151.title: Kungani itiye elineqhwa liba nenkungu
c-151.summary: Lapho itiye elimnyama elinamandla liphola, i-caffeine nama-tannin ayahlangana akhe izinhlayiya bese elenza libe nenkungu. Ukwengeza amanzi ashisayo kuyalicacisa, kanti ukulenza ngamanzi abandayo kuyakugwema lokhu.
c-151.principle: I-caffeine + tannin (theaflavin) $\rightleftharpoons$ inhlanganisela eyinkimbinkimbi: ukuncibilika kwehla emazingeni okushisa aphansi, ngakho kuyazika kuphume esixazululweni.
c-151.example: Itiye elimnyama elenziwe ngo-100 °C bese lipholiswa lifinyelele ku-4 °C liba nenkungu phakathi kwemizuzu embalwa; itiye elibiliswe ngamakhaza (4 °C, amahora angu-8) licace kakhulu.
c-151.actionItem: Yenza itiye elineqhwa lanamuhla ngokufaka isikhwama setiye emanzini abandayo angu-500 mL esiqandisini amahora angu-8.

c-152.title: I-amygdalin esezinhlamvini zamaplamu iyingozi uma iluhlaza
c-152.summary: Amaplamu aluhlaza angavuthiwe kanye nezinhlamvu zawo ziqukethe i-amygdalin, engakhipha i-hydrogen cyanide lapho igayeka. Khipha uhlamvu noma vumela isiraphu yamaplamu ihlale izinyanga eziyisithupha noma ngaphezulu, uyihlunge, futhi ungazidli izinhlamvu.
c-152.principle: $\mathrm{C_{20}H_{27}NO_{11} + 2H_2O \xrightarrow{\text{i-enzyme}} C_6H_5CHO + HCN + 2C_6H_{12}O_6}$. I-hydrogen cyanide yakheka lapho i-enzyme ihlangana nayo.
c-152.example: I-amygdalin esohlamvini olulodwa lweplamu incane kakhulu, kodwa ukuhlafuna izinhlamvu eziningi ezingaphekiwe kungaba yingozi. Hlanganisa amaplamu aluhlaza akhishiwe izinhlamvu noshukela ngesilinganiso sika-1:1, kuveze izinyanga eziyisithupha, bese ususa izithelo.
c-152.actionItem: Uma wenza isiraphu yamaplamu namuhla, ungazidli izinhlamvu bese ubhala ekhalendeni ukuthi kufanele uzisuse nini izithelo.

c-153.title: Amathini okufutha angaqhuma uma eshiywe endaweni eshisayo
c-153.summary: Amathini e-aerosol aqukethe igesi ecindezelwe kanye nento ebangela ukuphuma komlilo evuthayo, ngakho-ke umfutho uyakhuphuka ngokwenyuka kwezinga lokushisa. Uma eshiywe emotweni ehlobo noma eduze nelangabi angaqhuma, ngakho landela umkhawulo wokugcina osebhokisini ongu-50°C noma ngaphansi.
c-153.principle: Umfutho wegesi ulingana nezinga lokushisa: $\dfrac{P_1}{T_1} = \dfrac{P_2}{T_2}$ ($T$ nge-kelvin). Umfutho womhwamuko wento ewuketshezi ebangela ukuphuma ukhuphuka kakhulu ngokwezinga lokushisa.
c-153.example: Ithini eliku-5 atm ku-20°C (293 K) lifinyelela cishe ku-5.7 atm ku-60°C (333 K) ngokubala okulula, futhi liba phezulu kakhulu uma sekwengezwe umfutho womhwamuko wento ebangela ukuphuma. Ingaphakathi lemoto phakathi nehlobo lingadlula ama-60°C.
c-153.actionItem: Namuhla, qoqa imikhiqizo yokufutha ekhaya bese uyiyisa endaweni epholile ekude nokushisa.

c-154.title: Kungani i-jelly ingeke ibumbane nephayinaphu noma i-kiwi eluhlaza
c-154.summary: Ama-enzyme agaya amaprotheni kuphayinaphu eluhlaza kanye ne-kiwi agcoba i-gelatin. Ukuwashisa kanye noma ukusebenzisa izithelo ezisemathinini kumisa lawa ma-enzyme ukuze i-jelly ibumbane.
c-154.principle: I-Bromelain ne-actinidin zihluza izibopho ze-peptide: $\mathrm{R{-}CO{-}NH{-}R' + H_2O \to R{-}COOH + H_2N{-}R'}$. Ama-enzyme ayonakala ngaphezu kwama-$70\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$.
c-154.example: I-100 mL ye-gelatin enophayinaphu oluhlaza ihlala iwuketshezi ngisho nangemva kwamahora, kodwa uphayinaphu oshiswe ngaphezu kwama-80°C umzuzu owodwa, noma uphayinaphu osesitinini, ubumbana ngendlela evamile. Wona lawa ma-enzyme asetshenziselwa ukuthambisa inyama.
c-154.actionItem: Lapho wengeza izithelo ezintsha ku-jelly noma ku-pudding namuhla, faka uphayinaphu noma i-kiwi emanzini abilayo umzuzu owodwa kuqala.

c-155.title: Iphunga lokubola lamathawula anomswakama
c-155.summary: Iphunga lezingubo ezithatha isikhathi eside ukoma lidalwa amafutha ane-asidi afana ne-4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid ekhiqizwa amagciwane e-Moraxella. Ukoma ngokushesha ngaphambi kokuba zande kuyisihluthulelo.
c-155.principle: Ukusebenza kwamagciwane: amafutha esikhumba $\rightarrow$ $\mathrm{C_7H_{12}O_2}$ (4-methyl-3-hexenoic acid) namanye amafutha ane-asidi ahwamukayo
c-155.example: Uma izingubo ezimanzi zihlala zinomswakama amahora angaphezu kwama-5 ngaphakathi endlini, iphunga liyaqala; umshini wokomisa izingubo ku-60 °C noma ngaphezulu wehlisa kakhulu amagciwane.
c-155.actionItem: Yendlala izingubo ngokushesha ngemva kokuziwashela bese usebenzisa ifeni noma isisusa-mswakama ukuze zome phakathi kwamahora ama-5.

c-156.title: Yini ukungcola okupinki okuvela endlini yokugezela
c-156.summary: Ukungcola okupinki akusona isikhunta kodwa ulwelwesi olunombala obomvu olwenziwa amagciwane afana ne-Serratia. Umswakama kanye nensalela yensipho kuyakondla, ngakho-ke ukugcina komile kuyindlela engcono kakhulu yokukuvimbela.
c-156.principle: Ukukhula kwamagciwane $N = N_0\,2^{t/t_d}$ (isikhathi sokuphinda kabili $t_d$ semizuzu engama-30 sinikeza amakhulu ezinkulungwane zezikhathi ngosuku)
c-156.example: Endlini yokugezela efudumele nenomswakama ku-25-35 °C, inani lingakhula cishe ngokuphindwe ka-4,000 njalo ngamahora ayi-6; ukoma kumisa ukukhula.
c-156.actionItem: Ngemva kokugeza, sula izindonga naphansi ngethuluzi lokusula amanzi bese uvula ifeni yokukhipha umoya imizuzu engama-30.

c-157.title: Ukugcina ikhabe elisikiwe
c-157.summary: Ikhabe elisikiwe lilahlekelwa amanzi noshukela engxenyeni esikiwe futhi libiza amagciwane. Mboza ingxenye esikiwe bese uligcina esiqandisini, futhi lidle phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili.
c-157.principle: Ukuhwamuka kuncike endaweni evulekile kanye nezinga lokushisa. Ku-4 °C, ukukhula kwamagciwane kucishe kube ngu-1/20 walokho okuku-25 °C.
c-157.example: Ku-30 °C ikhabe elisikiwe lingaba namagciwane aphindaphindwe ngamashumi ezikhathi ngemva kwamahora ama-2; esiqandisini ku-4 °C lihlala liphephile cishe izinsuku ezi-2.
c-157.actionItem: Gcina ikhabe elisele liyizicucu ezinkulu linamaxolo alo bese ugoqa ingxenye esikiwe ngokuqinile ngaphambi kokulipholisa.

c-158.title: Amabhokisi okudla kwasemini asehlobo aphephe kakhulu uma kunelayisi elineviniga nokudla okuseceleni okupholisiwe
c-158.summary: Ezimeni ezine-asidi (i-pH engaphansi kuka-4.6) amagciwane amaningi abangela ushevu ekudleni ayahluleka ukukhula. Ukwengeza isipuni seviniga elayisini noma ukupakisha ukudla okuseceleni okupholile kwandisa ukuphepha.
c-158.principle: Ngokulingana kwe-asidi ebuthakathaka $\mathrm{CH_3COOH \rightleftharpoons CH_3COO^- + H^+}$, i-$[\mathrm{H^+}]$ ephakeme yehlisa i-pH futhi yehlise ijubane lokukhula kwamagciwane.
c-158.example: Ukwengeza isipuni esi-1 (15 mL) seviniga ezinkomishini ezi-2 zerayisi (cishe 300 g) kuhlisa i-pH yalo ibe cishe ku-5 futhi kubambezela ukukhula kwamagciwane. Vala ibhokisi lokudla kuphela ngemva kokuba ukudla sekupholile ngokuphelele, bese ufaka i-ice pack.
c-158.actionItem: Ebhokisini lokudla lanamuhla, pholisa ukudla ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokulivala bese ufaka i-ice pack.

c-159.title: Kungani amathuluzi egqwala ngezinsuku ezinomswakama
c-159.summary: Insimbi yenza ukugqwala lapho kukhona amanzi nomoya-mpilo (i-oxygen), futhi kushesha kakhulu uma umswakama ungaphezu kuka-60%. Ungqimba oluncane lwamafutha noma okumunca umswakama kuyakwehlisa lokhu.
c-159.example: Lapho umswakama ohlobene ungaphezu kuka-60%, insimbi engavikelekile ingagqwala phakathi kwezinsuku, kodwa ngaphansi kuka-40% cishe akuthuthuki.
c-159.actionItem: Sula amathuluzi ngendwangu enamafutha kancane bese ufaka i-silica gel ebhokisini lamathuluzi.

c-160.title: Ukuphepha kwamabhola ezinambuzane (mothballs)
c-160.summary: Amabhola ezinambuzane asuka ngqo ekubeni okuqinile aye ekubeni igesi (i-sublimation) ukuze axoshe izinambuzane. Umhwamuko wawo uyingozi ukuwuhogela, ngakho ukungena komoya nebanga kunendaba.
c-160.principle: I-Sublimation: $\mathrm{C_{10}H_8(s) \rightarrow C_{10}H_8(g)}$; umfutho womhwamuko uyenyuka ngokukhuphuka kwezinga lokushisa.
c-160.example: Umfutho womhwamuko we-naphthalene ucishe ube ngu-11 Pa ku-25 °C futhi uphindaphindeka cishe izikhathi ezi-4 ku-40 °C. Gwema ukuthi angathinti izingubo.
c-160.actionItem: Yendlala izingubo ezigcinwe namabhola ezinambuzane kuvulandi amahora angu-2-3 ngaphambi kokuzigqoka, futhi ugcine amabhola ezinambuzane kude nezingane.

c-161.title: Ukuhlikihla izandla ensimbini engagqwali kunciphisa iphunga likagalikhi nelenhlanzi
c-161.summary: Izinhlanganisela zesibabule (sulfur) ezivela kugalikhi no-anyanisi kuthiwa ziyaphela uma uhlikihla izandla zakho ensimbini engagqwali (stainless steel). Insipho iyasiza ngokugeza nokwenza i-oxidize kulezi zinhlanganisela zesibabule.
c-161.principle: Izinhlanganisela zesibabule $\mathrm{R{-}SH}$ zinamathela kongqimba lwe-oxide ($\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$) olusebusweni bensimbi bese ziba nencane ingozi yokuhwamuka.
c-161.example: Abantu abaningi bathola ukuthi ukuhlikihla izandla empompini yensimbi engagqwali imizuzwana engu-30 ngemuva kokusika ugalikhi kunciphisa iphunga, nakuba ubufakazi besayensi ngobukhulu balomphumela bungenele. Ijusi kalamula noma uviniga nakho kungasetshenziswa.
c-161.actionItem: Ngemuva kokusika ugalikhi namuhla, hlikihla izandla zakho kusinki yensimbi engagqwali imizuzwana engu-30 bese uzigeza ngensipho.

c-162.title: Kungani isinkwa siba nesikhunta ngokushesha ngenkathi yezimvula
c-162.summary: Isinkwa sinomsebenzi omkhulu wamanzi (water activity), ngakho isikhunta sikhula ngokushesha uma umswakama ungaphezu kuka-70%. Izintambo zaso zingena zijule ngaphakathi, ngakho ukusika kuphela lapho okubonakala khona akuphephile.
c-162.principle: Umsebenzi wamanzi $a_w = \dfrac{p}{p_0}$ (isinkwa cishe singu-0.95; isikhunta sikhula ngaphezu kuka-0.80)
c-162.example: Ngosuku olunomswakama ku-25 °C isinkwa siba nesikhunta ezinsukwini ezingu-3-4, kanti uma siqandisiwe ku--18 °C sihlala amasonto amaningi.
c-162.actionItem: Qandisa izingcezu zesonkwa ongeke uziqede namuhla, zisongwe ngayinye ngayinye, bese uzithosa ziqondene ngqo zivela esiqandisini.

c-163.title: Kungani imvula ine-asidi kancane
c-163.summary: Imvula ine-asidi encane cishe ku-pH 5.6 ngoba i-CO2 esemoyeni iyancibilika kuyo; imvula ene-asidi enamandla ingaphansi kuka-5.6. Ayinabungozi esikhunjeni kuleli zinga kodwa idla kancane kancane insimbi namatshe.
c-163.example: $[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 2.5\times10^{-6}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$ inikeza i-pH $= -\log[\mathrm{H^+}] \approx 5.6$, uma kuqhathaniswa no-7 wamanzi ahlanzekile.
c-163.actionItem: Ngemuva kwemvula, sula amanzi eketangweni lebhayisikili lakho bese ufaka iconsi lamafutha.

c-164.title: Ilayisi elipholile lithola isitashi esimelana nokugayeka, ngakho kuncipha ushukela omuncwayo
c-164.summary: Njengoba ilayisi liphola, esinye isitashi salo siphenduka isitashi esimelana nokugayeka (resistant starch) okunzima ukusigaya. Ngisho nangemva kokulifudumeza kabusha, esinye sisala, okunganciphisa kancane ukukhuphuka kukashukela egazini.
c-164.principle: I-Starch retrogradation iwukwakheka kabusha kwamakristalu e-amylose egayiwe njengoba iphola. I-enzyme ye-amylase iwephula kabi la makristalu.
c-164.example: Ilayisi elifudunyezwe kabusha ngemuva kwamahora angu-12-24 efrijini kubikwa ukuthi linesitashi esimelana nokugayeka ngokuphindwe izikhathi eziningi kunelayisi elisanda kuphekwa, nakuba ukwanda kungamaphesenti ambalwa kuphela esitashini sisonke. Ungalishiyi ilayisi ezingeni lokushisa legumbi; lifake efrijini ngokushesha.
c-164.actionItem: Namuhla, faka ilayisi elisele efrijini kungakapheli ihora elilodwa.

c-165.title: Isithambisi sendwangu kanye nokumunca kwethawula
c-165.summary: Isithambisi sendwangu simboza imicu ngama-surfactant e-cationic, okuyenza ithambe kodwa ingakwazi ukumunca amanzi kahle. Emathawuleni, sisebenzise kancane noma ungasisebenzisi nhlobo.
c-165.principle: I-cationic surfactant $\mathrm{R_2N^+(CH_3)_2}$ inamathela emicwini eneshaji enegethivu $\mathrm{{-}COO^-}$ bese yakha ungqimba oluxosha amanzi.
c-165.example: Isithambisi singanciphisa ukumunca kwethawula cishe ngama-20-30%. Sisebenzise kuphela emthwalweni o-1 kulawo ma-3 wamathawula owawashayo.
c-165.actionItem: Washa amathawula anamuhla ngaphandle kwesithambisi bese uwahlukuluza kahle ngaphambi kokuwomisa.

c-166.title: Ukugaywa kabusha kwethini le-aluminium kusebenzisa amaphesenti angaba ngu-5 kuphela wamandla okwenza elisha
c-166.summary: Ukwenza i-aluminium ngetshe lensimbi kusebenzisa ugesi omningi kakhulu, kodwa ukuyigaya kabusha konga cishe ama-95%. Ukuhlambulula amathini nokuwahlukanisa ngendlela efanele kwandisa le nzuzo.
c-166.principle: Ukuhlukaniswa ngegesi kwe-bauxite: $\mathrm{2Al_2O_3 \to 4Al + 3O_2}$. I-aluminium entsha ithatha cishe u-$14\ \mathrm{kWh}$ ngekhilogremu ngayinye, kuyilapho i-aluminium egayiwe kabusha ithatha cishe u-$0.7\ \mathrm{kWh}$.
c-166.example: Ukugaya kabusha ithini elilodwa le-aluminium (elingaba ngu-14 g) konga cishe u-0.2 kWh. Amathini ayikhulu onga cishe u-20 kWh, okulingana nokusebenzisa i-air conditioner cishe amahora amahlanu.
c-166.actionItem: Namuhla, thulula futhi uhlanze noma yimaphi amathini ophuze kuwo bese uwafaka emgqonyeni wokugaya kabusha we-aluminium.

c-167.title: Ukusika ingxenye yesikhunta ebonakalayo akwenzi ukudla okunesikhunta kuphephe
c-167.summary: Isikhunta sithumela imicu efana nentambo (ama-hyphae) ngaphansi kwalokho okubonayo, kanti ezinye izikhunta zikhiqiza ubuthi. Ekudleni okuthambile njengesinkwa, izithelo kanye nojamu, kuphephe kakhulu ukukulahla konke uma kuvela isikhunta.
c-167.principle: I-Aflatoxin $\mathrm{B_1}$ ($\mathrm{C_{17}H_{12}O_6}$) ayibhidlizwa ukushisa kalula futhi ibhidlika kuphela ngaphezu kwama-degree angaba ngu-$270\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$, ngakho-ke ukubilisa noma ukubhaka akuyikhiphi.
c-167.example: Ekudleni okuqinile njengoshizi oqinile noma izaqathe, imihlahlandlela ithi ukusika okungenani u-2.5 cm eduze kwendawo enesikhunta kuyasebenza, kodwa ukudla okuthambile, okunomswakama njengesinkwa, ujamu kanye ne-tofu kumele kulahlwe ngokuphelele.
c-167.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola isinkwa nojamu efrijini lakho ukuthi akunaso yini isikhunta.

c-168.title: Iphunga lesisi ledolobha yinto engezwa ngamabomu
c-168.summary: Isisi ledolobha (i-methane) ngokwemvelo alinaphunga, ngakho-ke inani elincane lezakhi ze-thioether noma i-mercaptan ezinephunga lamaqanda abolile liyangezwa ukuze liveze ukuvuza. Uma ulihhovula, ungasebenzisi amalangabi noma amashintshi kagesi; qala ngokuvumela umoya ungene.
c-168.principle: I-methane ingaqhuma uma ingama-5-15% emoyeni: $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$. Izithako zokuhogela ezengezwa kusisi elingenaphunga zihlanganisa izakhi ezifana ne-$\mathrm{CH_3SH}$.
c-168.example: Endaweni engu-8 m³, u-0.4-1.2 m³ wesisi se-methane evuzile (5-15%) usezingeni elingaqhuma. Uma uzwa iphunga lesisi, vala ivalvu, vula amawindi, gwema ukuthinta amashintshi ezibani noma awefeni, bese ubika ususe ngaphandle.
c-168.actionItem: Namuhla, funda ukuthi ikuphi ivalvu yakho yesisi futhi ukwenze umkhuba ukuyivala ngemuva kokuyisebenzisa.

c-169.title: Izikhanyisi ezibonakalayo kusihlanzi sezingubo ezimhlophe zenza izingubo ezimhlophe zibukeke zimhlophe kakhulu
c-169.summary: Izikhanyisi ezibonakalayo (optical brighteners) zimunca ukukhanya kwe-ultraviolet bese zikukhipha njengokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, okufihla amabala aphuzi ukuze indwangu ibukeke imhlophe kakhulu. Kungumphumela wokubona nje, hhayi ukususa ukungcola, futhi izingubo ezinemibala azikudingi.
c-169.principle: I-Fluorescence imunca i-UV (cishe engu-350 nm) bese ikhipha ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (cishe okungu-430 nm); amandla e-photon akhishiwe $E = \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$ aphansi kancane.
c-169.example: Isikibha esimhlophe esiwashwe ngezikhanyisi singabukeka sikhanya kakhulu cishe ngama-5-10% elangeni ngoba sikhipha ukukhanya okwengeziwe okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Ezingutsheni ezinemibala, okokuhlanza okuvamile okungenazo kwanele.
c-169.actionItem: Ngosuku lokuwasha, hlola amalebula ezihlanzi izingubo ukuthi anazo yini izikhanyisi ezibonakalayo bese uzisebenzisa ezingutsheni ezimhlophe kuphela.

c-170.title: Ukufaka ifoni emanzi elayisi akusizi ngalutho
c-170.summary: Ilayisi aliwumunci kahle umswakama, ngakho-ke likhipha amanzi efoni ngesilinganiso esicishe sifane nokomisa ngomoya ovamile. Yicime, ungayishaji, futhi uyiyeke yome endaweni enomoya ohelezayo kunalokho.
c-170.principle: Izinga lokoma lilingana nomehluko wengcindezi yomhwamuko. Amandla okumunca omile elayisi abuthaka kakhulu uma eqhathaniswa ne-silica gel, futhi okubalulekile ukuthi ukugqwala kungaqhubeka isikhathi esingakanani ngemva kokushayisana kukagesi (short circuit).
c-170.example: I-Silica gel ingamunca amanzi afika cishe kuma-40% wesisindo sayo, kodwa ilayisi limunca kancane kakhulu kunalokho. Yigcine ivaliwe ifoni amahora angama-24-48 noma ngaphezulu ngaphambi kokuyivula. Uma iwele emanzini anosawoti, xhumana nesikhungo sosizo kuqala.
c-170.actionItem: Uma ifoni yakho iba manzi, gwema ilayisi bese uyicima bese uyishiya endaweni engenisa umoya.

c-171.title: Uma ushile, qala ngokupholisa ngaphansi kwamanzi agelezayo imizuzu engu-20
c-171.summary: Ngokushesha ngemva kokusha, ukusebenzisa amanzi apholile agelezayo (15-25°C) imizuzu engu-10-20 kukhipha ukushisa okusakazekela ekujuleni kwesikhumba futhi kunciphisa umonakalo. Ungasebenzisi iqhwa, umuthi wokuxubha noma inhlama kabhontshisi.
c-171.principle: Ukushisa okuvela entweni eshisayo kudlulela ezicutshini njenge-$q = mc\Delta T$ futhi konakalisa amaprotheni. Amanzi agelezayo asusa ukushisa ngokushesha.
c-171.example: Amanzi aku-60°C angadala ukusha okubi kakhulu ngemizuzwana engu-5. Imizuzu engu-20 yamanzi apholile inciphisa ukujula kokusha nobuhlungu, kanti iqhwa elibanda kakhulu lifinyeza imithambo yegazi futhi lingalimaza izicubu kakhulu.
c-171.actionItem: Khumbula namuhla: uma uzishisa ekhishini, kupholise ngaphansi kwamanzi agelezayo imizuzu engu-20 ngokushesha.

c-172.title: Kwenziwani yizinto ezimunca umoya-mpilo emaphaketheni okudla
c-172.summary: Iphakethe elincane emaphaketheni e-seaweed noma inyama eyomisiwe liqukethe impushana yensimbi esabela nomoya-mpilo futhi iwususe. Umoya-mpilo omncane unciphisa ukubola kwamafutha kanye nesikhunta.
c-172.example: Iphakethe elilodwa (cishe u-2 g wensimbi) limunca cishe ama-mL angu-200 omoya-mpilo, lisuse cishe wonke ama-21% asephaketheni elingu-1 L.
c-172.actionItem: Ungalidli lelo phakethe elincane; liyeke e裡phaketheni kuze kube yilapho ulivula.

c-173.title: Ukuhlola ukusha kweqanda ngokuntanta
c-173.summary: Igobolondo leqanda linezimbobo ezincane kakhulu, ngakho ngokuhamba kwesikhathi amanzi ne-CO2 kuyaphuma bese isikhala somoya sikhula. Iqanda elisha liyacwila kanti elidala liyantanta.
c-173.principle: I-buoyancy $F_{\mathrm{b}} = \rho_{\mathrm{water}}\,V g$; uma isikhala somoya sehlisa ubuningi obumaphakathi bube $\rho < \rho_{\mathrm{water}}$, liyantanta.
c-173.example: Iqanda elisha licishe libe ngu-1.09 g/mL; ngemva kwamasonto angu-3-4 lehla lifike cishe ku-1.02 g/mL bese liqala ukuntanta emanzini avamile.
c-173.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokufahlaza iqanda ongabaza ngalo, lifake endishini yamanzi, bese ulichitha uma lintanta.

c-174.title: Kungani uju lucijela amakristalu
c-174.summary: Lapho i-glucose ejuqudlula lokho amanzi angakwazi ukukubamba, yakha amakristalu. Kujwayelekile lokhu, akukhona ukonakala, futhi ukufudumeza ngobumnene kuyalungisa.
c-174.example: Uju lungaba ngu-31% we-glucose, u-38% we-fructose no-17% wamanzi, futhi lucikizela amakristalu ngokushesha ngaphansi kuka-14 °C; ukuwufaka emanzini afudumele angu-40 °C kuyaluncibilikisa.
c-174.actionItem: Cwilisa imbiza enamakristalu emanzini angaphansi kuka-40 °C esikhundleni sokuyifaka ku-microwave.

c-175.title: Kungani amafutha nezithasiselo ziza ngamabhodlela ansundu
c-175.summary: Ukukhanya, ikakhulukazi i-UV nokukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kubangela i-oxidation emafutheni nasemavithamini bese kuwawonakalisa. Ingilazi ensundu ivimba kakhulu ukukhanya okungaphansi kwama-450 nm.
c-175.principle: I-Photo-oxidation: $\mathrm{RH + O_2} \xrightarrow{h\nu} \mathrm{ROO\cdot}$ (i-oxidation yochungechunge); amandla e-photon $E = hc/\lambda$
c-175.example: Ingilazi ensundu ivimba ngaphezu kuka-90% wokukhanya eduze kuka-400 nm, kanti amafutha asemabhodleleni acacile angonakala phakathi namasonto elangeni.
c-175.actionItem: Gcina amafutha e-sesame kanye ne-perilla ekhabetheni elimnyama, hhayi ewindini elinelanga.

c-176.title: Indlela amaphakethe abandayo asheshayo abandayo ngayo
c-176.summary: Lapho i-ammonium nitrate noma i-urea ephaketheni incibilika emanzini imunca ukushisa bese izinga lokushisa lehla. Cindezela, xhaphaza bese lisebenza ngokushesha.
c-176.example: I-mole eyodwa (80 g) ye-ammonium nitrate imunca u-25.7 kJ lapho incibilika, ipholisa ama-mL angu-100 amanzi cishe ngo-15-20 °C ngaphansi kwezinga lokushisa legumbi.
c-176.actionItem: Pakisha iphakethe elibandayo elisheshayo lapho uyokhempa noma kwezemidlalo, lisonge ngethawula bese uilisebenzisa imizuzu engu-15 kuphela.

c-177.title: Kungani amabhethri e-lithium-ion ezonda ukushisa
c-177.summary: Izinga eliphezulu lokushisa lisheshisa ukonakala kwe-electrolyte nokukhula kwe-SEI, okunciphisa amandla ebhethri unomphela. Ungalinge ushiye ifoni noma i-power bank emotweni phakathi nehlobo.
c-177.principle: Izinga lokuguga $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$: licishe liphindaphindeke ngo-2x ngokukhuphuka ngakunye kuka-10 °C (umthetho wesithupha ka-Arrhenius)
c-177.example: Uma ibhethri lilahlekelwa cishe ngama-20% amandla alo ngonyaka ku-25 °C, lingase lilahlekelwe cishe ngama-35-40% ngesikhathi esifanayo ku-45 °C.
c-177.actionItem: Ehlobo, ungalokothi ushiye izisetshenziswa ezinebhethri emotweni; ziphathe esikhwameni sakho.

c-178.title: Kungani i-kimchi iba muncu ngokushesha ehlobo
c-178.summary: Amagciwane e-lactic acid ku-kimchi anda ngokushesha lapho kufudumele futhi akhiqiza i-lactic acid eyengeziwe. Ngaphansi kuka-10 °C ivuthwa kancane futhi igcina ukunambitheka okuhle isikhathi eside.
c-178.example: Ku-20 °C i-pH yehlela cishe ku-4.2 ezinsukwini ezi-3-4 bese i-kimchi iba muncu, kanti ku-4 °C ishintsha kancane phakathi namasonto.
c-178.actionItem: Khipha kuphela lokho ozokudla ukufake esitsheni esincane bese ugcina okunye engxenyeni ebanda kakhulu yesiqandisi.

c-179.title: Isivikeli-langa sinamafutha, ngakho ukugeza ngamanzi odwa akusisusi
c-179.summary: Izihlungi ze-UV zamafutha okuzivikela elangeni namafutha azo kucishe kungancibiliki emanzini, ngakho amanzi odwa awazisusi. Ukuzincibilikisa ngamafutha okuhlanza noma i-balm bese uqedela ngesihlanzi esinamagwebu kuzisusa kahle.
c-179.principle: Okufanayo kuncibilikisa okufanayo: i-polarity efanayo iyahlangana. Amafutha angewona awe-polar ancibilika ezihlanzeni ezingezona eze-polar, kanti amanzi adinga ama-surfactant micelle ukuze awasuse.
c-179.example: Izivikeli-langa ezingangenwa ngamanzi zenzelwe ukugcina ama-80% noma ngaphezulu ngemva kokungena emanzini. Ukubhucunga ngamafutha okuhlanza imizuzwana engama-30, ukufaka amanzi ukuze kuhlanganiseke bese uyahlanza kuyasebenza kakhulu.
c-179.actionItem: Uma ugcobe isivikeli-langa namuhla, sebenzisa isihlanzi esinamafutha kuqala bese ulandelisa ngesihlanzi esinamagwebu.

c-180.title: Uqweqwe olumhlophe oluphuma ebhethrini elivuzayo luyi-alkaline; gqoka amagilavu uma uluhlanza
c-180.summary: Impushana emhlophe ephuma ebhethrini elidala le-alkaline yi-potassium carbonate, eyakheka lapho i-potassium hydroxide evuzile isabela ne-carbon dioxide esemoyeni. Iyacasula esikhunjeni nasemehlweni, ngakho gqoka amagilavu bese uyesula nge-swab efakwe uviniga noma ijusi kalamula.
c-180.principle: $\mathrm{2KOH + CO_2 \to K_2CO_3 + H_2O}$ kwakha amakristalu amhlophe, kanti i-asidi ebuthakathaka njgoviniga iyakulinganisa: $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + 2CH_3COOH \to 2CH_3COOK + H_2O + CO_2}$.
c-180.example: I-electrolyte evuzile ine-alkaline enamandla ku-pH 13-14 futhi icasula isikhumba esingambhedwanga. Yesule nge-swab enovoniga bese uqedela ngendwangu eyomile. Ukukhipha amabhethri ezintweni ongazisebenzisi njalo kuphephile.
c-180.actionItem: Namuhla, khipha amabhethri kunoma iyiphi i-remote noma ithoyizi ongalisebenzisi isikhathi eside.

c-181.title: Kungani amakhyubhu eqhwa eba nenkungu
c-181.summary: Umoya oncibilikile nokungcola kuphushelwa phakathi nendawo njengoba amanzi eba yiqhwa, kubhajwe njengengxenye emhlophe phakathi. Amanzi abilisiwe apholiswa acaca kakhudlwana kodwa awabi sobala ngokuphelele.
c-181.principle: Ukuncibilika kwegesi $C = k_{\mathrm{H}}\,P$: kwehla kucishe kube yize eqhweni, ngakho amagwebu ayabhajwa
c-181.example: Iqhwa elenziwe ngamanzi abilisiwe apholiswa linamagwebu ambalwa futhi licace ngokubonakalayo; ukubandisa okuvela ohlangothini olulodwa (directional freezing) kunikeza iqhwa elicwebile.
c-181.actionItem: Gcwalisa ithileyi leqhwa ngamanzi abilisiwe apholiswa bese uwafaka efrijini ukuze uthole iziphuzo zanamuhla.

c-182.title: Ukugcina i-hydrogen peroxide
c-182.summary: I-hydrogen peroxide ibolile ibe yi-oxygen namanzi lapho ichayeka ekukhanyeni, ekushiseni noma ezinsimbini. Yigcine endaweni epholile ebhodleleni elinsundu; amabhodlela amadala aphelelwa amandla.
c-182.example: I-hydrogen peroxide engu-3% ingalahlekelwa yingxenye enkulu yamandla ayo ezinyangeni ezingaba ngu-6 ngemva kokuvulwa, futhi ibola ngokushesha ngaphezu kuka-30 °C.
c-182.actionItem: Bhala usuku lokuvula ebhodleleni lakho le-hydrogen peroxide bese uligcina endaweni emnyama nepholile.

c-183.title: Ukuphuza Amanzi Angekho Usawoti Kuphela Ngemuva Kokujuluka Kakhulu Kunganciphisa Usawoti Osegazini
c-183.summary: Ngemuva kokujuluka amahora amaningi, ukuphuza amanzi amaningi angenalutho kunganciphisa izinga likasawoti (sodium) osegazini futhi kubangele ikhanda elibuhlungu noma isicanucanu. Hlanganisa uketshezi nokuthile okunosawoti.
c-183.principle: Umjuluko ususa i-Na$^+$ kanye namanzi. Ukugcwalisa ngamanzi angenalutho kuphela kukhulisa isibalo esingaphansi ku-$C_{\mathrm{Na}}=\frac{n_{\mathrm{Na}}}{V}$, ngakho-ke izinga liyawa futhi amanzi angene kumaseli nge-osmosis. Ibanga elivamile lingaba ngu-135-145 mmol/L.
c-183.example: Ohambweni lokugibela izintaba lwamahora angu-3 ehlobo ungase ulahlekelwe cishe ngamalitha angu-2 omjuluko, cishe amagremu angu-2 e-sodium (cishe amagremu angu-5 kasawoti). Ukuphuza amalitha angu-3 amanzi angenalutho ngesikhathi esisodwa phezu kwalokho kungase kucindezele i-Na$^+$ esegazini ibe ngaphansi kuka-135 mmol/L.
c-183.actionItem: Ngesikhathi sokuvivinya umzimba isikhathi eside noma ukuhamba ngezinyawo namuhla, phatha ukudla okulula okunosawoti (amakinati, amakhekhe anosawoti) noma isiphuzo sezemidlalo esixutshwe namanzi akho, futhi ugweme ukuphuza ngaphezu kuka-500 mL ngesikhathi esisodwa.

c-184.title: I-Bleach Exubaniswe Emanzini Ashisayo Ilahlekelwa Amandla Ayo Okubulala Amagciwane
c-184.summary: Ukuxuba i-bleach emanzini ashisayo kubhidliza isithako esisebenzayo ngokushesha futhi ngokuvamile kwengeza iphunga elibi leklorini. Yixube emanzini abandayo noma anesivivi bese uyisebenzisa ngaso leso sikhathi.
c-184.principle: Uhlobo olusebenzayo lwe-HOCl oluvela ku-sodium hypochlorite (NaOCl) luzwela ukushisa futhi luyabhidlika ngokuthi $2\mathrm{HOCl}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{HCl}+\mathrm{O_2}$. Ukukhuphuka ngakunye kuka-10 °C kuvame ukusheshisa ukubhidlika ngokuphindwe ka-2 noma ngaphezulu.
c-184.example: Isilinganiso esincane se-bleach yasekhaya (cishe engu-4-5% NaOCl) ku-500 mL wamanzi sihlala sisebenza amahora amaningi ku-20 °C, kodwa emanzini ango-60 °C ingxenye enkulu iyaphela phakathi nemizuzu embalwa futhi kuphume intuthu ecasulayo eyengeziwe.
c-184.actionItem: Lapho ubulala amagciwane namuhla, xuba i-bleach emanzini abandayo, yisebenzise ngokushesha, faka umoya ekamelweni, futhi ungayixubi nanini nezihlanzi ezine-asidi.

c-185.title: Shisisa Izimbaza Zasolwandle Nezilwane Ezinegobolondo Zifike ku-85 °C Umuzuzu O-1 Ukuze Unqande i-Vibrio
c-185.summary: Ukupheka izimbaza nezinye izilwane zasolwandle ezinegobolondo kufike ku-85 °C noma ngaphezulu ngaphakathi kakhulu okungenani umzuzu o-1 kunciphisa kakhulu ubungozi be-Vibrio. Izilwane ezingaphekiwe ziyingozi kakhulu kubantu abanamasosha omzimba abuthakathaka.
c-185.principle: Ukushisa kubhidliza amaprotheni e-Vibrio ukuze amangqamuzana ayeke ukusebenza. Izibalo zehla njenge-$N=N_0\,10^{-t/D}$, futhi amazinga okushisa aphezulu afinyeza u-$D$, isikhathi sokuncipha ngokuphindwe ka-10.
c-185.example: I-Vibrio yande ngokushesha emanzini olwandle ango-25-35 °C. Ukupheka imizuzu engu-3-5 ngemva kokuvuleka kwamagobolondo nokugcina ingaphakathi ku-85 °C umzuzu o-1 kwengeza izinga elihle lokuphepha.
c-185.actionItem: Uma udla ukudla kwasolwandle namuhla, khetha okuphekwe ngokugcwele kunezilwane ezingaphekiwe, futhi ugeze imimese namapulangwe okusika athinte ukudla kwasolwandle okungaphekiwe ngokushesha.

c-186.title: Ijusi ye-Layimu noma ka-Lamula Esikhunjeni Nohlangothi Lwelanga Kungabangela Amabhamuza
c-186.summary: Ijusi yezithelo ezisawolintshi eshiywe esikhunjeni elangeni ingabangela ukubomvu okufana nokusha kanye namabhamuza. Uma utholwa ijusi, geza ngensipho futhi ungayi elangeni.
c-186.principle: Ama-furocoumarins emaxolweni nasejusini yezithelo ezisawolintshi amunca i-UVA (320-400 nm) bese ebopha i-DNA namaprotheni esikhumba ekuphenduleni kwe-phototoxic. Amandla e-photon athi $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$, aphezulu kakhulu kubude begagasi obufushane.
c-186.example: Uma ukhama omalimu ephathini yangaphandle futhi ungawagezi izandla ngaphambi kokuhlala amahora angu-1-2 elangeni, amamaki abomvu namabhamuza anesimo sejusi angavela ngemva kwamahora angu-24-72, kanti amabala angathatha izinyanga.
c-186.actionItem: Uma uphatha izithelo ezisawolintshi namuhla, geza izandla zakho ngensipho namanzi ngokushesha, futhi umboze noma yisiphi isikhumba esivelile elangeni uze ugeze.

c-187.title: Uma Ulunywe I-Jellyfish, Hlambulula Ngamanzi Olwandle, Hhayi Amanzi Ahlanzekile
c-187.summary: Ukuhlambulula lapho ulunywe khona i-jellyfish ngamanzi ahlanzekile kungenza izindosi ezisele ziqhume. Hlambulula ngamanzi olwandle bese ususa izingalo zayo usebenzisa ithuluzi, hhayi izandla ezingenalutho.
c-187.principle: Ama-nematocysts e-jellyfish aqhuma ngenxa yezimbangela ze-osmotic namakhemikhali. Amanzi ahlanzekile anengcindezi ephansi kakhulu ye-osmotic kunamanzi olwandle (cishe u-35 g/L kasawoti); ngokusho kwe-$\Pi=iMRT$ amanzi angangena ngamandla emakhasini abangele ukudubula.
c-187.example: Uma ulunywe olwandle, hlambulula ngamanzi olwandle imizuzwana engu-30+, klwebha izingalo zayo ngomphetho wekhadi, futhi uma kukhona ubuhlungu obukhulu ukucwilisa emanzini acishe abe ngu-45 °C imizuzu engaba ngu-20 kuyalulekwa kakhulu. Usizo lokuqala luyahluka ngokwezinhlobo, ngakho shayela abezimo eziphuthumayo uma unenkinga yokuphefumula.
c-187.actionItem: Uma uya olwandle namuhla, hlola izixwayiso ze-jellyfish bese uphatha ibhodlela lokukha amanzi olwandle kanye nekhadi lasebhange lokuklwebha.

c-188.title: Kungani Izimpahla Zokubhukuda Zixega Ngemva Kwasechibini Nokuthi Ungayikhetha Kanjani Efananele
c-188.summary: Izimpahla zokubhukuda ziyaxega ngemva kokuvakashela ichibi izikhathi ezimbalwa ngoba iklorini ibhidliza imicu enwebekayo. Khetha indwangu emelana neklorini bese uyihlambulula ngokushesha ngemva kokuyisebenzisa.
c-188.principle: Amaketango e-Spandex (polyurethane) ayagqwala futhi anqunywe yi-HOCl ebulala amagciwane echibini. Amaketango amafushane asho ukunwebeka okuncane, futhi i-spandex evamile yonakala ngokushesha kakhulu kunezindwangu zokubhukuda ezakhiwe nge-PBT emelana neklorini.
c-188.example: Impahla ejwayelekile ye-nylon/spandex ibonisa ukuxega okusobala ngemva kokusetshenziswa izikhathi ezingu-30-50 echibini, kanti ezenziwe nge-PBT zihlala isikhathi eside ngokuphindwe kaningi. Iklorini esele echibini ngokuvamile ingu-1-3 mg/L.
c-188.actionItem: Ngemva kokubhukuda namuhla, hlambulula impahla yakho yokubhukuda emanzini abandayo ngokushesha, ungayikhami ngokuyisontha, futhi yomise emthunzini.

c-189.title: Kungani I-Ice Cream Ephinde Yaqandiswa Iba Nesihlabathi
c-189.summary: Lapho i-ice cream incibilika iphinde iqandiswa, amakristalu amakhulu e-ice ayenzeka futhi ayenze ibe nesihlabathi. Ngemva kokuncibilika kanye, kungcono ukuyidla kunokuyiqandisa kabusha.
c-189.principle: Amakristalu amancane e-ice anamandla aphezulu angaphandle, ayancibilika, bese amanzi awo eya emakristalwini amakhulu akhulayo (Ostwald ripening). Ukuncibilika kuyakhuphuka njengoba i-radius $r$ incipha: $\ln\frac{S_r}{S_\infty}=\frac{2\gamma V_m}{rRT}$.
c-189.example: I-ice cream eyenziwe kahle inamakristalu eqhwa angaphansi kuka-50 μm futhi ibushelelezi, kodwa ngemva kokuncibilika nokuphinde iqandiswe angakhula adlule ku-100 μm futhi izweke njengenesihlabathi. Ukushintshashintsha kwezinga lokushisa lefriji kubangela umphumela ofanayo.
c-189.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina i-ice cream ngemuva efrijini esikhundleni sokuyibeka emnyango ukuze unciphise ukushintshashintsha kwezinga lokushisa, futhi uvale isivalo ngokushesha ngemva kokuphaka.

c-190.title: Ungalokothi Ushiye Iqhwa Elomile Emotweni Evalekile
c-190.summary: Iqhwa elomile (dry ice) alincibiliki kodwa liphenduka igesi, engakhuphula izinga le-CO$_2$ emotweni evalekile lifinyelele emazingeni ayingozi. Lihambise amafasitela evuliwe noma endaweni enomoya owanele.
c-190.principle: I-CO$_2$ eqinile iyashintsha isuke ekubeni yinto eqinile iye ngqo ekubeni igesi (sublimes): $\mathrm{CO_2(s)}\rightarrow \mathrm{CO_2(g)}$ (ku -78.5 °C). Ikhilogremu elingu-1 lenza cishe amalitha angama-500 egesi, futhi i-CO$_2$ engaphezulu kuka-4% ibangela ikhanda elibuhlungu nesiyezi, kanti amazinga aphezulu ayingozi kakhulu.
c-190.example: Amakhilogremu ama-2 eqhwa elomile akhipha cishe amalitha ayi-1,000 e-CO$_2$. Uma ihwamuka ngokuphelele endaweni yemoto engaba ngamalitha ayi-3,000, izinga lokugxila lingakhuphukela cishe ku-25%, okuyinto eyingozi kakhulu.
c-190.actionItem: Uma uthwele iqhwa elomile namuhla, gcina indawo inomoya ohambayo, liphathe ngamagilavu, futhi ungalokothi ulibeke esitsheni esivalwe sangci.

c-191.title: Ummbila Ulahlekelwa Ubumnandi Bawo Lapho Uhlala Isikhathi Eside Ngemuva Kokuvunwa
c-191.summary: Kusukela ngesikhathi ummbila uvunwa ngaso, ushukela wawo uphenduka isitashi futhi ubumnandi buyaphela. Wupheke ngosuku owuthenga ngalo noma uwufake efrijini ukuze ugcine ubumnandi isikhathi eside.
c-191.principle: Ama-enzyme asenhlamvwini aguqula ushukela onjenge-glucose ube isitashi: $n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}\rightarrow(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n+n\,\mathrm{H_2O}$. Ukusebenza kwama-enzyme kuyehla emakhazeni, ngakho-ke ukuwufaka efrijini kubambezela lolu shintsho.
c-191.example: Ummbila omusha onoshukela oshiywe ekamelweni elijwayelekile usuku lonke ungaguqula cishe u-40% kashukela wawo ube isitashi, kanti lapho usefrijini elingu-0-4 °C lolu hlelo luhamba kancane kakhulu. Ukugcina amakhasi kuwo kunciphisa nokulahleka komswakama.
c-191.actionItem: Uma uthenge ummbila namuhla, wufake efrijini unamakhasi awo kunokuba uwushiye ngaphandle, futhi uwupheke kungakapheli usuku uma ukwazi.

c-192.title: Kungani Ukufaka Utamatisi Efrijini Kubulala Ukunambitheka Kwawo
c-192.summary: Ukupholisa utamatisi ovuthiwe kunciphisa iphunga lawo elimnandi futhi kwenze inyama yawo ibe nensila (mealy). Gcina utamatisi ovuthiwe ezingeni lokushisa elijwayelekile legumbi bese uwudla ezinsukwini ezimbalwa.
c-192.principle: Ngezansi kuka-12 °C utamatisi uba nokulimala okubangelwa amakhaza (chilling injury), okwehlisa umsebenzi wama-enzyme akha amakhemikhali anephunga elimnandi (njenge-cis-3-hexenal) futhi kulimaza nolwelwesi lwamaseli. Izinga le-enzyme lincike emazingeni okushisa nge-$k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-192.example: Izinsuku ezi-3 nje efrijini elingu-5 °C zinganciphisa kakhulu amakhemikhali anephunga elimnandi kutamatisi. Ekamelweni elijwayelekile, utamatisi ovuthiwe ungcono kakhulu uma udliwa ezinsukwini ezingaba ngu-3 kuye kwezi-5.
c-192.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina utamatisi ovuthiwe ubheke phansi ngohlangothi lwesiqu endaweni epholile, futhi uma kade usefrijini, uwukhiphe imizuzu engama-30 ngaphambi kokuwudla.

c-193.title: Indlela Yokuhlenga Imayonezi Ephukile (Ehlukene)
c-193.summary: Ungayilahli imayonezi lapho amafutha neqanda kuye kwahlukana khona. Yishaye kancane kancane ufake isikhupha seqanda elisha ukuze ibuyele esimweni; i-lecithin ekusikhukheni esisha ivuselela ingxube (emulsion).
c-193.principle: Imayonezi iyinhlanganisela yamafutha ahlakazeke emanzini (emulsion), kanti i-lecithin esikhuphaneni seyingisa ukungezwani kwamafutha namanzi $\gamma$ ukuze amaconsi angahlangani abe mancane. Uma amafutha engena ngokushesha kakhulu noma izinga lokushisa lingafanele, amaconsi ayahlangana bese izigaba zihlukana.
c-193.example: Cishe amagremu angama-200 emayonezi ehlukene angenziwa abushelelezi futhi ngokuyishaya ngezinkezo ezincane ufaka isikhupha esi-1 esisha kanye nethisipuni eli-1 lamanzi. Isikhupha esisodwa ngokuvamile singaxuba kuze kufike ku-200 mL wamafutha.
c-193.actionItem: Uma wenza imayonezi namuhla, qala ngokufaka amafutha iconsi ngalinye, bese usheshisa kancane kancane, sebenzisa amaqanda amasha, bese uyifaka efrijini ngemuva kokuyenza.

c-194.title: Imikhiqizo Epholisa Ye-Menthol Ayilehlisi Ngempela Izinga Lokushisa Lomzimba
c-194.summary: Izifutho namashidi apholisayo ane-menthol akwenza uzizwe upholile nje kuphela; awehlisi izinga lokushisa lomzimba ngempela. Amanzi nomthunzi kubaluleke kuqala ukuze uthole impumuzo ekushiseni.
c-194.principle: I-menthol ivuselela i-receptor yamakhaza i-TRPM8 esikhunjeni, ithumele isignali yamakhaza ezinzwayweni zakho. Ukudluliswa kwangempela kokushisa kudinga ushintsho lokushisa, njengakwi-$Q=mc\Delta T$, kanti i-menthol ngokwayo ayikhiphi cishe ukushisa emzimbeni.
c-194.example: Umkhiqizo opholisayo one-menthol engaba ngu-1% uguqula izinga lokushisa lesikhumba cishe ngo-0.5 °C kuphela, kodwa umuzwa opholile uhlala amashumi emizuzu. Emazingeni okushisa aphezulu angaphezu kuka-33 °C, ukuthembela kulo muzwa kuphela kuyingozi.
c-194.actionItem: Ngosuku olushisayo namuhla, unganciki emikhiqizweni epholisayo kuphela; phuza amanzi futhi uphumule emthunzini ukuze wehlise izinga lokushisa lakho ngempela.

c-195.title: Uma Umlomo Ushisa, Phuza Ubisi Kunokuba Uphuze Amanzi
c-195.summary: Lapho ukudla okubabayo kwenza umlomo wakho ushise, amanzi awasizi ngalutho kodwa ubisi noma iyogathi kusebenza kangcono. I-capsaicin inamathela emafutheni nasemaprothenini.
c-195.principle: I-capsaicin ($\mathrm{C_{18}H_{27}NO_3}$) iyi-molecule encibilika emafutheni engancibiliki kahle emanzini. Amafutha obisi ayayincibilikisa kanti iphrotheni ye-casein iyayibopha, kusize ukuyisusa kuma-receptor.
c-195.example: Ngemuva kokudla ama-noodle ababayo, u-200 mL wamanzi uhlanza isikhashana nje, kanti inkomishi yobisi (200 mL, cishe u-7 g wamafutha, cishe u-6 g wephrotheni) idambisa ukushisa ngokusobala kungakapheli imizuzu embalwa.
c-195.actionItem: Lapho udla ukudla okubabayo namuhla, yiba nobisi noma iyogathi engashukela eduze, futhi uma umlomo wakho ushisa, gcina umthamo emlonyeni ngaphambi kokugwinya.

c-196.title: Izingxenye Ezishile Zenyama Eyoswe Ngamalahle Ziqukethe i-Benzo[a]pyrene
c-196.summary: Izingxenye ezimnyama, ezishile zenyama eyoswe phezu kwamalahle avulekile zingaqukatha i-benzo[a]pyrene, into engase ibangele umdlavuza. Sika izingxenye ezishile futhi uvimbele amalangabi ekutheni athinte inyama.
c-196.principle: Lapho amafutha enyama econsela emalahleni futhi esha ngokweqile (pyrolyzes), kwakheka ama-polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (ama-PAH) abese enyuka ngentuthu ukuze amboze inyama. Enye ebalulekile yi-benzo[a]pyrene ($\mathrm{C_{20}H_{12}}$).
c-196.example: Ukugazinga isisu sengulube esinamafutha ngqo phezu kwamalangabi kwenyusa i-benzo[a]pyrene entuthwini nasezingxenyeni ezishile. Ukwesula i-grill njalo nokusebenzisa ifoyili noma ipuleti esikhundleni se-grate kunganciphisa ama-PAH kakhulu.
c-196.actionItem: Uma wosa inyama namuhla, sebenzisa ukushisa okumaphakathi kude namalangabi abangelwa ngamafutha aconsayo, futhi usike noma yiziphi izingxenye ezimnyama ngaphambi kokudla.

c-197.title: Sebenzisa Impushana Ye-Graphite, Hhayi Amafutha, Ekhiyeneni Lesihluthulelo
c-197.summary: Ekhiyeneni elinamathelayo, impushana ye-graphite (uthuli lomthofu wepensela) isebenza kangcono kunamafutha ajwayelekile. Amafutha aheha uthuli futhi enza ukhiye unamathele kakhulu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
c-197.principle: I-Graphite iyinto yokugcoba eqinile enezingqimba zekhabhoni ezishelelanayo. Yehlisa i-friction coefficient $\mu$ ku-$F=\mu N$ futhi, ngenxa yokuthi yomile, ayiqoqi uthuli.
c-197.example: Ukufutha impushana ye-graphite kanye noma kabili embobeni yesihluthulelo kunciphisa ukungqubuzana ukuze isihluthulelo siphenduke kahle. Amafutha ajwayelekile axubana nothuli futhi anganamathela phakathi nezinyanga, avale ukhiye.
c-197.actionItem: Uma isihluthulelo siqine namuhla, futha okokugcoba okuncane kwe-graphite embobeni yokhiye, noma gcoba umthofu wepensela emigubheni yesihluthulelo bese usifaka usikhipha izikhathi ezimbalwa.

c-198.title: Sebenzisa Amafutha Eketango, Hhayi i-WD-40, Eketangweni Lebhayisikili
c-198.summary: I-WD-40 ngokuyinhloko iyisincibilikisi nesihlanzi futhi ayihlali njengento yokugcoba iketango lebhayisikili. Ngemva kokuhlanza, faka amafutha enzelwe amaketango.
c-198.principle: I-WD-40 iyisincibilikisi esihwamukayo esinefilimu yamafutha encane ehwamuka noma egezeka ngokushesha. I-viscosity ephakeme yento yokugcoba igcina ifilimu phakathi kwezindawo ezithintanayo, inciphise ukulahleka kokungqubuzana $P_{\mathrm{loss}}=F_f\,v$.
c-198.example: Iketango elihlanzekile, eligcotshwe kahle lisebenza kahle cishe ngama-98-99%, kanti elomile, elingcolile lingalahlekelwa ngamaphesenti angu-3 noma ngaphezulu. EkugibCountryeni ngamandla angu-150 W, u-3% ucishe ube ngu-4.5 W olahlekile.
c-198.actionItem: Uma iketango lakho likhala namuhla, lesule ngendwangu eyomile, faka iconsi elilodwa lamafutha eketango kusixhumanisi ngasinye, bese wesula asele ngokweqile.

c-199.title: Lapho i-Aluminium Ithinta Insimbi Engagqwali, Eyodwa Igqwala Kuqala
c-199.summary: Lapho izinsimbi ezingafani zithintana kumswakama, leyo esebenza kakhulu igqwala kuqala. Lapho ubophela i-aluminium kunsimbi engagqwali, beka i-washer evikelayo phakathi kwazo.
c-199.principle: Izinsimbi ezimbili ezinamandla kagesi angafani kanye ne-electrolyte zakha iseli elincane, futhi i-aluminium iyancibilika ku-anode: $\mathrm{Al}\rightarrow \mathrm{Al^{3+}}+3e^-$. Amandla ajwayelekile ayehluka kakhulu: cishe -1.66 V nge-Al uma kuqhathaniswa cishe no--0.44 V noma ngaphezulu ngensimbi engagqwali (esesekelwe ku-Fe).
c-199.example: Kuvulandi osogwini lolwandle, ukusebenzisa izikulufo zensimbi engagqwali ngqo kujantshi we-aluminium kungaveza ukugqwala okuyimpushana emhlophe lapho kuthintana khona ezinyangeni kuya onyakeni, ngoba igebe lamandla kagesi likhulu futhi amanzi olwandle iyi-electrolyte enhle.
c-199.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola izindawo lapho izinsimbi ezingafani zithintana khona, nalapho kuqoqana khona amanzi, zihlukanise nge-washer evikelayo noma ngopende.

c-200.title: Ungakufaki Ukudla Ebhaldini Elenziwe Nge-Galvanized
c-200.summary: Ukufaka ukudla okune-asidi (uviniga, izithelo ezifakwe emanzini anosawoti, i-kimchi) ebhaldini le-zinc-galvanized noma eshidini kungakhipha i-zinc futhi kubangele ukuhlanza nobuhlungu besisu. Sebenzisa izitsha ezifanele ukudla.
c-200.principle: Ukumboza kwe-zinc kuncibilika ku-asidi: $\mathrm{Zn}+2\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Zn^{2+}}+\mathrm{H_2}$. Ukudla okune-asidi kune-pH engu-4 noma ngaphansi, ngakho ukusabela kuyashesha.
c-200.example: Endaweni yokukhempa, i-lemonade noma ama-pickle ane-pH ecishe ibe ngu-3 ashiywe ebhaldini eline-galvanized amahora amaningi angathatha amashumi e-mg/L e-zinc, afake engozini yokuhlanza nokucanuzela kwenhliziyo. Isilinganiso sokudla esinconywayo sansuku zonke somuntu omdala cishe singama-8-11 mg kuphela.
c-200.actionItem: Lapho ukhempa noma upheka ngaphandle namuhla, sebenzisa kuphela izitsha ezimakwe ngokuthi ziphephile ekudleni, futhi ugcine amabhakede ane-galvanized ukukha amanzi.

c-201.title: Hlola Izinkomishi Ze-Ceramic Ezivela Kwamanye Amazwe Ngokuvuza Komthofu Ku-Glaze
c-201.summary: Izinkomishi ze-ceramic ezicwebezelayo ezivela kwamanye amazwe zingavuza umthofu usuke ku-glaze ungene eziphuzweni ezine-asidi. Bheka amalebula okuphepha kokudla nemiphumela yokuhlolwa, futhi ungashiyi iziphuzo ezine-asidi kuzo isikhathi eside.
c-201.principle: Izinhlanganisela zomthofu ku-glaze zincibilika ku-asidi: $\mathrm{PbO}+2\mathrm{H^+}\rightarrow \mathrm{Pb^{2+}}+\mathrm{H_2O}$. Ukuvuza kuyenyuka nge-pH ephansi, njengoviniga noma ijusi yezithelo, kanye nokuthintana isikhathi eside.
c-201.example: Ekuhlolweni kokucwilisa ku-4% acetic acid amahora angama-24, umkhawulo wase-Korea wezinkomishi ngu-0.4 mg/L womthofu. Izitsha ze-ceramic zokuhlobisa ezingenambiko wokuhlolwa zingase zeqe lo mkhawulo.
c-201.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola izinkomishi ze-ceramic ezivela kwamanye amazwe ukuthola uphawu lokuphepha kokudla nombiko wokuhlola, futhi ungafaki iziphuzo ezine-asidi njengejusi noma iwayini ezinkomishini zokuhlobisa ezingaqinisekiswanga.

c-202.title: Iziqholo Ezishiywe Emotweni Zishintsha Iphunga Lazo
c-202.summary: Iziqholo ezishiywe emotweni eshisayo zishintsha iphunga futhi zilahlekelwe ubusha bazo. Zigcine endaweni epholile, emnyama.
c-202.principle: Amangqamuzana e-top-note alula ashintsha abe umhwamuko ngokushesha kakhulu njengoba izinga lokushisa likhuphuka. Umfutho womhwamuko ukhula ngokushesha ngokwezinga lokushisa, $\ln P=-\frac{\Delta H_{\mathrm{vap}}}{RT}+C$, futhi ukushisa, ukukhanya kanye nomoya-mpilo kubangela ukugqwala (oxidation) kwezingxenye zesiqholo.
c-202.example: Imoto emile phakathi nehlobo ingadlula ama-60 °C ngaphakathi, ihwamukise isiqholo ngokushesha ngokuphindwe kaningi kunezinqolobane ezingama-20 °C. Ngemva kwamaviki ambalwa, amaphunga e-citrus ayaphela futhi uketshezi lungaba mnyama.
c-202.actionItem: Namuhla, susa isiqholo emotweni noma endlini yokugezela usiyise ekhabetheni elipholile, elimnyama bese uvala ikepisi liqine ngemva kokulisebenzisa.

c-203.title: Amafutha Okugcoba Namakhilimu Ashiywe Emotweni Ehlobo Angahlukana
c-203.summary: Amafutha okugcoba namakhilimu ashiywe emotweni eshisayo angahlukana abe amanzi namafutha futhi ashintshe, kunciphise ukusebenza kwawo. Gcina imithi ezingeni lokushisa elisebhodleleni (ngokuvamile elingama-30 °C noma ngaphansi).
c-203.principle: Ikhilimu iyi-emulsion yamanzi namafutha ezinziswe ngama-emulsifiers. Ukushisa kwehlisa ukusebenza kwe-emulsifier kanye ne-viscosity ukuze amaconsi ahlangane bese izigaba zihlukana. Izilinganiso zokusabela zizwela kakhulu izinga lokushisa, $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-203.example: Imoto emile phakathi nehlobo ingadlula ama-60 °C, ngakho-ke ikhilimu ingacwenga noma ikhiphe amafutha phakathi namahora ambalwa. Uma isihlukene, umkhiqizo ungase ungabuyeli esimweni sawo sokuqala ngisho noma usuxutshwe kabusha.
c-203.actionItem: Uma uphuma namuhla, phatha amafutha okugcoba, i-sunscreen kanye nemithi esikhwameni sakho kunokuba uyishiye emotweni.

c-204.title: Izitofu Zotshwala Zokukhempa: I-Methanol ne-Ethanol Akufani
c-204.summary: Ezitofini zotshwala zokukhempa, i-methanol inobuthi futhi ivutha ngolimi lomlilo olucishe lungabonakali, ngakho-ke i-denatured ethanol iyisinqumo esiphephile. Hlola ukuthi ivutha yini, futhi ucime ilangabi ngaphambi kokufaka uphethiloli.
c-204.principle: I-ethanol ivutha njenge-$\mathrm{C_2H_5OH}+3\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}+3\mathrm{H_2O}$ kanti i-methanol njenge-$2\mathrm{CH_3OH}+3\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{CO_2}+4\mathrm{H_2O}$. Ilangabi le-methanol licishe lingabonakali, futhi umzimba uyigaya ibe yi-formic acid, okwenza ibe nobuthi obukhulu.
c-204.example: I-ethanol ikhipha cishe ama-27 kJ/g lapho isha uma kuqhathaniswa namacishe abe ngama-20 kJ/g e-methanol, ngakho-ke i-ethanol inikeza ukushisa okwengeziwe ngegramu ngalinye. Inani elincane le-methanol eligingiwe lingadala ubumpumputhe noshevu.
c-204.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa isitofu sotshwala namuhla, hlola uhlobo lukaphethiloli, futhi ufake uphethiloli kuphela ngemva kokuba ilangabi selicimile nesitofu sesipholile.

c-205.title: Ungagcini Uphethiloli Womshini Wokugunda Utshani Isikhathi Esingaphezu Kwezinyanga Ezintathu
c-205.summary: Uphethiloli ogcinwe isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezintathu womshini wokugunda utshani noma ijeneretha uyonakala, okwenza kube nzima ukuduma futhi kuvale nama-carburetor. Thenga kuphela lokho okudingayo, noma sebenzisa i-fuel stabilizer kokusele.
c-205.principle: Izingxenye ezilula zikaphethiloli ziyahwamuka futhi ukugqwala (oxidation) kwakha inhlaka enamathelayo evalela amapayipi kaphethiloli. Izinhlanganisela ze-ethanol zimunca amanzi futhi zingahlukana. Ukugqwala kuqhubeka kanje: $\mathrm{RH}+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow$ peroxides neminye imikhiqizo.
c-205.example: Ethangini elivaliwe, uphethiloli ojwayelekile uvame ukuqala ukuba nezinkinga ngemva kwezinyanga ezi-3 kuye kwezi-6 kanti izingxube ze-ethanol ngemva kwenyanga e-1 kuye kwezi-3. Isitsha esigcwele, esipholile sihlala isikhathi eside ngoba umoya omncane uthintana nophethiloli.
c-205.actionItem: Uma ungeke usebenzise umshini wakho wokugunda isikhathi eside, khipha uphethiloli noma faka i-stabilizer namuhla, bese ugcina uphethiloli oseleyo endaweni evalekile, epholile.

c-206.title: Uma Ufaka Uphethiloli Emotweni Yedizili, Ungayidumi Injini
c-206.summary: Uma ufaka uphethiloli ngephutha emotweni yedizili, ungayidumi futhi shayela imoto edonsayo. Ipompo likaphethiloli nama-injector angonakala.
c-206.principle: Izinjini zedizili zisebenzisa ukubhebhetheka ngokucindezela (umoya ocindezelwe ube nokushisa okuphezulu uzithungele ngokwawo uphethiloli), kodwa uphethiloli ojwayelekile awubhebhetheki kalula futhi une-viscosity ephansi, ngakho awugcobi. Izinga lokucindezela ledizili licishe libe ngu-$\varepsilon=15\sim 20$.
c-206.example: Ukuxubana kukaphethiloli kunciphisa ukugcotshwa kwepompo elinomfutho ophakeme futhi kungadala ukuguga kwensimbi, nokwenza ukulungisa kubize izigidi zama-KRW (izinkulungwane zama-USD). Ukukhipha ithangi ngaphandle kokuqala injini ngokuvamile kuvimbela umonakalo.
c-206.actionItem: Lapho ufaka uphethiloli namuhla, hlola umbala wesibambo sepompo nohlobo lukaphethiloli, futhi uma ugcwalise uphethiloli ongewona, ungasivuli ukhiye bese ushayela indawo yokulungisa izimoto.

c-207.title: I-AdBlue Diesel Exhaust Fluid Iyonakala Ekushiseni Kwehlobo
c-207.summary: Uma igcinwe ishiselwa isikhathi eside, i-urea ekuketshezini lokukhipha umoya wedizili iyabhidlika, amandla ayo ayehle, futhi inuke i-ammonia. Yigcine endaweni epholile enomthunzi futhi ungasebenzisi uketshezi oludala.
c-207.principle: Uketshezi (isixazululo se-urea esingu-32.5%) sihlukana sibe yi-ammonia, $\mathrm{(NH_2)_2CO}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow 2\mathrm{NH_3}+\mathrm{CO_2}$, kanti ophikweni lwe-SCR lunciphisa ama-nitrogen oxides, $4\mathrm{NH_3}+4\mathrm{NO}+\mathrm{O_2}\rightarrow 4\mathrm{N_2}+6\mathrm{H_2O}$.
c-207.example: Uma igcinwe ku-25 °C noma ngaphansi ivamise ukuhlala cishe unyaka owodwa, kodwa ngaphezu kwama-30 °C lokho kuncipha kube izinyanga ezimbalwa, futhi ebhuthini yemoto enemfudumalo engu-50 °C ikhwalithi ingehla phakathi kwamaviki. Ukuhlushwa kuyashintsha kusuka kusipimo se-32.5%.
c-207.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina uketshezi lokukhipha umoya endaweni epholile ekude nelanga eliqondile, bese uhlola noma yiliphi ibhodlela elishiywe isikhathi eside ebhuthini ngaphambi kokulisebenzisa.

c-208.title: Ahlulela Amafutha Enjini Nge-Oxidation Nokuphela Kwezithasiselo, Hhayi Ngebanga Elihanjiwe Kuphela
c-208.summary: Isikhathi sokushintsha amafutha enjini sincike esikhathini, ohambweni olufushane kanye nesimo sezulu esishisayo kanye nebanga elihanjiwe. Sebenzisa isikhawu somkhiqizi njengesisekelo bese usinciphisa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.
c-208.principle: Amafutha enjini a-oxidize emazingeni okushisa aphezulu, aqine futhi akhe udaka (sludge), kuyilapho izithasiselo ezifana nezinto zokuhlanza (detergents) nezokuhlakaza (dispersants) ziphela futhi zibambe ama-asidi nensizi ngendlela encane. I-Oxidation ilandela i-$k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, icishe iphinde kabili ngokukhuphuka ngakunye kuka-10 °C.
c-208.example: Uma umkhiqizi encoma amakhilomitha ayi-10,000 noma unyaka ongu-1, ukusetshenziswa okunzima okufana nohambo olufushane kuphela noma ukushayela ekushiseni okukhulu kudinga ukushintshwa cishe ku-5,000-7,500 km noma izinyanga eziyisi-6. Ngisho noma kungamakhilomitha ayi-5,000 ngonyaka, washintshe ngemva konyaka owodwa.
c-208.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola isitika sesevisi noma imanuwali ukuze uthole isikhawu sokushintsha bese usiqhathanisa nosuku lwakho lokugcina lokushintsha amafutha.
