c-209.title: Ingabe Kuyafaneleka Ukugcwalisa Amathayi Nge-Nitrogen?
c-209.summary: Amathayi agcwele i-nitrogen alahlekelwa umfutho kancane kakhulu, kodwa umphumela mncane. Okubaluleke kakhulu ukuhlola umfutho kanye ngenyanga, hhayi uhlobo lwegesi.
c-209.principle: Injoloba ivumela umoya-mpilo (oxygen) ukuba udlule ngokushesha cishe ngokuphindwe ka-3-4 kune-nitrogen. Umoya ungowangaba yi-78% N$_2$ kanye ne-21% O$_2$, ngakho ukugcwalisa nge-nitrogen kunciphisa ukungena kwe-O$_2$ futhi kunciphise ukwehla komfutho. Emthini ogxilile (fixed volume), umfutho ulandela i-$P=\frac{nRT}{V}$, olingana nama-moles kanye nezinga lokushisa.
c-209.example: Amathayi agcwele umoya ajwayele ukulahlekelwa cishe yi-1-2 psi (cishe 7-14 kPa) ngenyanga, kanti i-nitrogen ilahlekelwa kancane kakhulu kunalokho. Ukwehla kuka-10 °C ekushiseni komoya kunciphisa umfutho cishe ngo-1 psi kukho kokubili i-nitrogen nomoya.
c-209.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola umfutho wamathayi lapho amathayi ebanda bese uwubeka esimweni esibhalwe kusitika sohlaka lomnyango.

c-210.title: Ibhokisi Lasemini Elishiywe Emazingeni Okushisa Asekamelweni Ligcina Ubuthi Balo Ngisho Lingaphinde Lifudunyezwe
c-210.summary: Amabhokisi okudla kwasemini noma ama-rice roll ashiywe ngaphandle ehlobo angaphatha ubuthi lapho ukufudumeza kabusha noma ukubilisa ngeke kubususe uma eqala ukonakala. Uma ungabaza, kulahle.
c-210.principle: Ama-Enterotoxin enziwe yi-Staphylococcus aureus ekhula ekushiseni kwasekamelweni amelana nokushisa, futhi amaningi asala ngisho nangemva kwemizuzu engu-30+ ku-100 °C. Amagciwane ayafa kodwa isakhiwo samaprotheni obuthi asicekeleki phansi kalula, ngakho izimpawu zisaqhubeka zivele.
c-210.example: Amagciwane azala ngokushesha ku-20-37 °C futhi angenza ubuthi phakathi kwamahora ambalwa, kanti ukuhlanza nobuhlungu besisu kuqala emahoreni ayi-1-6 ngemva kokudla. Ukudla okushiywe ngaphandle isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora ama-2 (ihora eli-1 ngaphezu kuka-30 °C) ngemva kokupheka kuyingozi.
c-210.actionItem: Namuhla, phatha ukudla kwasemini esikhwameni esipholisayo esinephakethe leqhwa, bese ulahla ukudla okushiywe ekushiseni kwasekamelweni isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora ama-2 ngemva kokupheka.

c-211.title: Ungagezi Izitsha Nge-Detergent Emfuleni Noma Olwandle
c-211.summary: Ukuwasha izitsha nge-detergent emfuleni noma ogwini lolwandle kungcolisa amanzi, kungabulala izinhlanzi futhi kubangele ukwanda kakhulu kwe-algae. Geza kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethiwe zokukhempa.
c-211.principle: Ama-Surfactant ku-detergent alimaza ulwelwesi lwamagill ezilwane zasemanzini, futhi ama-phosphate anezela izakhamzimba ezibangela ukwanda kwe-algae kanye ne-eutrophication. Lapho i-algae ifa, ukubola kwayo kusebenzisa umoya-mpilo futhi kunciphise umoya-mpilo oncibilikile (DO).
c-211.example: Ngisho nethonsi elilodwa le-detergent evamile yezitsha (cishe i-0.05 mL) lingathinta impilo yasemanzini emashumini ezinkulungwane zamalitha amanzi. Lapho umoya-mpilo oncibilikile emfuleni wehla ngaphansi kuka-5 mg/L, izinhlanzi zithola ubunzima bokusinda.
c-211.actionItem: Ngaphandle namuhla, hamba nezinsalela zokudla lapho uhamba futhi uwashele izitsha endaweni ekhethiwe yamanzi angcolile ekhempini.

c-212.title: Omiyane Balandela Umoya Wakho Omaphumela Kanye Nephunga Lesithukuthuku
c-212.summary: Omiyane balandela i-carbon dioxide oyikhipha ngomoya kanye nephunga le-lactic acid esithukuthukwini ukuze bathole lapho bazoluma khona. Ukusula izithukuthuku nokugcoba isivikeli-zinambuzane kunciphisa amathuba okulunywa.
c-212.principle: Izitholi (receptors) ezisezimpondweni zomiyane zilandela ukuhlukahluka kokugxila (concentration gradients), ziya lapho kune-CO$_2$ ephezulu kanye ne-lactic acid ($\mathrm{C_3H_6O_3}$). Umoya ophumayo ungowangaba yi-4% CO$_2$, cishe ngokuphindwe kayi-100 kune-0.04% esemoyeni ojwayelekile.
c-212.example: Umuntu ukhipha cishe ikhilogremu eli-1 le-CO$_2$ ngosuku, futhi ngemva kokuzivocavoca i-lactic acid yezithukuthuku iyenyuka, ngakho omiyane bangakuthola bekude ngamashumi amamitha. Imikhiqizo ene-DEET engu-10-30% ivame ukuvikela amahora ambalwa.
c-212.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuphumela ngaphandle namuhla, sula izithukuthuku, gcoba isivikeli-zinambuzane esikhunjeni esingamboziwe nasezingutsheni, futhi uchithe noma yimaphi amanzi amile.

c-213.title: Iphunga Lendle Ephuma Epayipini Laphansi Liyakhuphuka Lapho Isivikelo Sichitheka Noma Somile
c-213.summary: Uma ipayipi laphansi linuka indle, amanzi avale isivikelo sayo (trap water seal) kungenzeka ukuthi omile. Thela ijagi lamanzi ukuze uphinde ugcwalise isivikelo futhi uvimbele iphunga.
c-213.principle: Amanzi agcinwe ku-U-bend yepayipi (isivikelo) avimba igesi yendle. Lapho ehwamuka, i-hydrogen sulfide ($\mathrm{H_2S}$) eyenziwe amagciwane endle ingakhuphuka. Ukujula kwesivikelo ngokuvamile cishe kungu-50 mm.
c-213.example: Isivikelo sepayipi laphansi lasendlini yangasese engasetshenziswa singoma phakathi namasonto ayi-1-2, sivumele iphunga lidlule. Ukuthela cishe ama-500 mL wamanzi kuyasigcwalisa kabusha, futhi ehlobo ukuhwamuka kuyashesha ngakho loma kaningi.
c-213.actionItem: Namuhla, thela ijagi lamanzi emapayipini angasetshenziswa asendlini yangasese noma kukhonsoli (balcony) ukuze ugcwalise isivikelo, bese uphinda kanye ngenyanga.

c-214.title: Kungani Ama-Air Conditioner Enephunga Elimuncu
c-214.summary: Iphunga elimuncu eliphuma ku-air conditioner lidalwa amagciwane kanye nesikhunta esikhula emanzini ajiyile kanye nasothulini olungaphakathi. Ukumisa ingaphakathi usebenzisa imodi yefeni ngaphambi kokuyicisha kuyasiza.
c-214.principle: Amanzi ajiyela ezingxenyeni ezipholisayo njenge-$\mathrm{H_2O(g)}\rightarrow \mathrm{H_2O(l)}$, bese amagciwane ekhula othulini nasezintweni eziphilayo, akhiqize ama-metabolite ahwamukayo (ama-fatty acid, utshwala, njll.) anephunga elimuncu.
c-214.example: Ukuyicisha ngokushesha ngemva kokupholisa kuletha umswakama wangaphakathi ongaphezu kwama-80%, ngakho amagciwane akhula kalula. Ukusebenzisa imodi yefeni imizuzu eyi-10-30 ngaphambi kokuyicisha komisa ingxenye enkulu yangaphakathi futhi kunciphisa kakhulu iphunga.
c-214.actionItem: Namuhla, sebenzisa i-AC kumodi yefeni imizuzu eyi-15 ngaphambi kokuyicisha, futhi ukhiphe isihlungi ukuze usule uthuli usiyeke some.

c-215.title: Ulwelwe Olumhlophe Kushokoledi Akusona Isikhunta
c-215.summary: Ulwelwe olumhlophe olukushokoledi ngokuvamile akusona isikhunta kodwa yi-fat bloom, ibhotela le-cocoa elincibilikile laphinde laqina. Ukuthungeka kwayo kuba lukhuni kancane kodwa kuphephile ukudliwa.
c-215.principle: Ibhotela le-cocoa linezinhlobo eziningana zamakristalu (ama-polymorph). Uhlobo oluzinzile lwe-V luphenduka uhlobo oluzinzile kakhulu lwe-VI ngokushintsha kwezinga lokushisa bese lukhuphukela phezulu, libonakale limhlophe. Uhlobo lwe-V luncibilika cishe ku-34 °C.
c-215.example: Uma igcinwe ngaphezu kuka-28 °C noma ngokushintshashintsha kwamazinga okushisa okuvamile, i-bloom ingavela ezinsukwini kuya emavikini. Indawo engcono kakhulu yokugcina ushokoledi cishe ingu-15-18 °C kumswakama ohlobene ongu-50% noma ngaphansi.
c-215.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina ushokoledi endaweni epholile ekude nelanga eliqondile, futhi uma uwukhipha efrijini, wushiye kusongwe kuwo ezingeni lokushisa lasekamelweni ukuvimbela ukujiya kwamanzi.

c-216.title: I-Mackerel ne-Tuna Eshiywe Ezingeni Lokushisa Lasekamelweni Yenza I-Histamine
c-216.summary: Izinhlanzi ezinenyama ebomvu njenge-mackerel ne-tuna zingenza i-histamine uma zishiywe ngaphandle, okubangela ukubomvu ebusweni, ikhanda elibuhlungu kanye nezilonda. Ukupheka akuyikhiphi, ngakho gcina izinhlanzi zizintsha futhi zibanda.
c-216.principle: I-bacterial histidine decarboxylase iguqula i-histidine yenhlanzi ibe yi-histamine: $\mathrm{C_6H_9N_3O_2}\rightarrow \mathrm{C_5H_9N_3}+\mathrm{CO_2}$. I-Histamine imelana nokushisa futhi ayibhujiswa kalula ngokupheka.
c-216.example: I-Histamine ingakheka phakathi kwamahora ku-25 °C kodwa kancane kakhulu ku-4 °C. Imikhawulo yokudla ngokuvamile ingu-200 mg/kg noma ngaphansi, futhi ukudla u-100 mg noma ngaphezulu kungabangela izimpawu.
c-216.actionItem: Namuhla, faka izinhlanzi ezinenyama ebomvu efrijini noma uziqandise ngokushesha nje lapho ufika nazo ekhaya, futhi ungazidli izinhlanzi ezishiywe ezingeni lokushisa lasekamelweni isikhathi esingaphezu kwamahora ama-2.

c-217.title: Kungani Amatende Amadala Nezimpahla Zemvula Zinamathela
c-217.summary: Uqwembe olungangenwa amanzi ngaphakathi etendeni elidala noma ibhantshi lemvula liyanamathela futhi lixebuke ngoba i-polyurethane iyonakala (hydrolyzes) kumswakama nokushisa. Ukuligcina lome ngokuphelele kubambezela lokhu.
c-217.principle: Ama-ester bond aqwembeni lwe-polyurethane (PU) asabela ngamanzi futhi aqhekeke, $\mathrm{R{-}COO{-}R'}+\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow \mathrm{R{-}COOH}+\mathrm{R'{-}OH}$, enze amaketanga abe mafushane ukuze uqwembe lunamathele. Izimo ezishisayo neziswakeme ziyakusheshisa.
c-217.example: Amatende anembozo ye-PU ngokuvamile aqala ukubola emva kweminyaka emi-3-5. Uma esongeke emanzi futhi egcinwe ngaphezu kuka-30 °C, anganamathela phakathi nesizini eyodwa.
c-217.actionItem: Namuhla, omisa ngokuphelele amatende nezimpahla zemvula, bese uwagcina engasongwanga endaweni epholile, futhi uma esenamathela, cabanga ngokufaka amasha esikhundleni sokubuyisela uqwembe.

c-218.title: Kungani Ama-Capsule Okuwasha Eba Yizigaxa
c-218.summary: Ama-capsule okuwasha ahlala eyizigaxa uma amanzi ebanda, emancane kakhulu, noma umthwalo ugcwele kakhulu. Faka i-capsule phansi kumshini kuqala, bese ufaka izingubo ngaphezulu.
c-218.principle: Ifilimu ye-PVA (polyvinyl alcohol) ezungeze i-capsule incibilika emanzini, futhi izinga lokuncibilika lincike kakhulu ezingeni lokushisa, libambezeleka emazingeni okushisa aphansi njengakwi-$k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$, ngakho ayincibiliki kahle emanzini abandayo.
c-218.example: Ifilimu ye-PVA incibilika cishe emizuzwini eyi-1-3 emanzini angu-40 °C kodwa ingathatha ngaphezu kwemizuzu eyi-10 emanzini abandayo ku-15 °C noma ngaphansi. Umshini ogcwele impahla ucindezela i-capsule ezingubeni ukuze amanzi angakwazi ukufika kuyo.
c-218.actionItem: Namuhla, ungathinti ama-capsule ngezandla ezimanzi, wafake kumshini kuqala bese izingubo ziza ngaphezu kwawo, futhi usebenzise okokugeza okunguketshezi uma usebenzisa amanzi abandayo.

c-219.title: Izinti Ezikhanyayo Zokukhempa Zikhanya Ngokusebenzisa Ukusabela Kwamakhemikhali
c-219.summary: Uthi olukhanyayo lokukhempa luyakhanya uma ulugoba futhi uketshezi olubili olungaphakathi luxubana ekusabeleni kwamakhemikhali. Lukhanya ngaphandle kukagesi noma ukushisa, lukhanye kakhulu nesikhathi esifushane uma lifudumele, lufiphele futhi luhlale isikhathi eside uma libanda.
c-219.principle: I-Hydrogen peroxide kanye ne-oxalate ester ngaphakathi kweshubhu kuyasabela ukuze kwakheke into enikeza amandla amakhulu, evuselela idayi ekhanyayo ukuze ikhiphe ukukhanya (chemiluminescence). Izinga lincike ekushiseni, $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$.
c-219.example: Uthi olukhanyayo ngokuvamile luhlala amahora ayi-6-12 ku-20 °C, kodwa ku-40 °C lukhanya kakhulu futhi lungaphela emahoreni ayi-1-2, kanti efrijini liyacima bese liyakhanya futhi uma lifudunyezwa. Alikhiphi cishe ukushisa, ngakho ingozi yomlilo iphansi.
c-219.actionItem: Ukuze ukhempe ebusuku noma lapho kucime ugesi namuhla, faka uthi olulodwa noma ezimbili ezikhanyayo esikhwameni sakho, futhi ugcine noma yiluphi uketshezi oluvuzayo kude nesikhumba sakho.

c-220.title: Imibala Yezicishamlilo Ivela Ekukhanyeni Kwamalangabi Ezakhi Zensimbi
c-220.summary: Imibala yezicishamlilo ivela ezakhini zensimbi ezixubene nempushana. I-Strontium inikeza umbala obomvu, ithusi linikeza oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kanti i-barium inikeza oluhlaza okotshani.
c-220.principle: Ukushisa kwelangabi kuthakazelisa ama-electron kuma-athomu ensimbi, futhi lapho ebuyela emuva emazingeni aphansi wamandla akhipha ukukhanya kwamandla $E=h\nu=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$. Isakhi ngasinye sinamazinga ahlukene, ngakho-ke ngasinye sinombala waso.
c-220.example: I-Sr inikeza umbala obomvu cishe ku-650 nm, i-Ba eluhlaza okotshani cishe ku-520 nm, i-Cu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka cishe ku-450 nm kanti i-Na ephuzi cishe ku-589 nm. Umbala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka unzima kakhulu ukwenziwa ngoba izinhlanganisela zethusi zibhidlika kalula ngaphezu kwama-1,200 °C.
c-220.actionItem: Uma ubukele izicishamlilo namuhla, zama ukuqagela insimbi kumbala ngamunye, futhi uqhelelane nemfucumfucu kanye nentuthu.

c-221.title: Ukubulala Amagciwane Emanzini Ngebhodlela Elicwathile Le-PET Nelanga
c-221.summary: Ukugcwalisa ibhodlela elicwathile le-PET ngamanzi acwebile bese ulishiya elangeni amahora angu-6 kuyindlela yesimo esiphuthumayo (SODIS) yokunciphisa amagciwane. Amanzi anenkungu kumele ahluzwe kuqala, futhi akuyona indlela ephelele yokuhlanza amanzi okuphuza.
c-221.principle: I-UVA (320-400 nm) nokushisa kulimaza i-DNA namaprotheni amagciwane bese kuwenza angasebenzi. Umphumela ukhula ngomthamo we-UV $H=I\,t$ (amandla aphindaphindwe ngesikhathi), futhi izinga lokushisa lamanzi elingaphezu kwama-50 °C liyakhuphula kakhulu lokhu.
c-221.example: Ngosuku olunelanga ibhodlela le-PET elicwathile elingu-1-2 L elishiywe amahora angu-6 linciphisa amagciwane amaningi, kanti ngaphansi kwamafu kudingeka izinsuku ezimbili. Ukusebenza kuyehla lapho izinga lokungcola kwamanzi lidlula ama-30 NTU.
c-221.actionItem: Uma ukuzama njengokuhlola kwesimo esiphuthumayo namuhla, sebenzisa kuphela amanzi acwebile bese ubeka ibhodlela elangeni amahora angu-6, kodwa ngokujwayelekile khetha amanzi abilisiwe noma ahlanziwe.

c-222.title: Ipulasitiki Lokugoqa Ukudla Liphuma Nge-PVC Ne-PE, Futhi Awehlukene
c-222.summary: Ipulasitiki lokugoqa ukudla liza nge-PVC ne-PE (polyethylene), futhi ngalinye linemikhawulo ehlukile yokuphepha ekusetshenzisweni kwe-microwave nokuthintana nokudla okunamafutha. Hlola uhlobo lwempahla nezinga lokushisa ephaketheni.
c-222.principle: Ipulasitiki le-PVC liqukethe ama-plasticizer ukuze livumelane nezimo, elingangena ekudleni lapho lithinta ukudla okunamafutha noma lishiswa. Ipulasitiki le-PE alidingi i-plasticizer futhi izinga lalo lokushisa elicela ku-110 °C lihluke kunele-PVC (eminye imikhiqizo ebhalwe amalebula ibala ama-130 °C noma ngaphezulu).
c-222.example: Lapho usebenzisa i-microwave, ukudla okunamafutha kungadlula ama-100 °C ngakho ipulasitiki elikuthintayo lingancibilika noma livumele i-plasticizer ingene. Gcina ibanga elingaba ngu-2-3 cm phakathi kwepulasitiki nokudla.
c-222.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola impahla nezinga lokushisa ngaphambi kokusebenzisa ipulasitiki lokugoqa, futhi ku-microwave ligcine lingathinti ukudla.

c-223.title: Lapho Amafutha Ashisayo Ethinta Isitsha Se-Styrofoam Se-Instant-Noodle
c-223.summary: Ukufaka ukudla okushisayo, okunamafutha esitsheni se-polystyrene (Styrofoam) kungenza sithambe futhi kuphume i-styrene encane. Landela izinga lokushisa elivunyelwe lesitsha.
c-223.principle: I-polystyrene ithamba eduze kwenguquko yayo yengilazi cishe ku-100 °C futhi incibilika kalula emafutheni, ngakho-ke i-monomer ye-styrene ($\mathrm{C_8H_8}$) ingangena ekudleni. Ukungena kuyenyuka ngokwezinga lokushisa nesikhathi sokuthintana.
c-223.example: Umhluzi we-instant-noodle cishe ku-90 °C ungezansi kwendawo yokuthamba ye-polystyrene futhi ngokuvamile wamukelekile, kodwa amafutha okupheka angaphezu kuka-100 °C noma ukudla okunamafutha kakhulu kungancibilikisa isitsha. Sebenzisa izitsha ezilahlwayo kanye kuphela.
c-223.actionItem: Namuhla, susa ukudla okushisayo, okunamafutha esitsheni se-Styrofoam ukufake endishini yengilazi engamelana nokushisa noma yesitsha sobumba.

c-224.title: Izikhwama Zepulasitiki Ezibolayo Aziboli Ekhaya
c-224.summary: Izikhwama eziningi ezibolayo zibhidlika kuphela emazingeni okushisa aphezulu ezikhungweni zokwenza umquba futhi cishe aziboli engadini yasekhaya noma emgqonyeni kadoti. Landela amalebula endawo okulahlwa kwemfucuza.
c-224.principle: I-PLA (polylactic acid) ihlangana namanzi ngendlela ye-hydrolysis, $(\mathrm{C_3H_4O_2})_n+n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\rightarrow n\,\mathrm{C_3H_6O_3}$ (lactic acid). Ukusabela kushesha ngaphezu kwenguquko yengilazi ecishe ibe ngu-58 °C, ngakho kudinga izimo zokwenza umquba zezimboni (cishe ama-58 °C nomswakama).
c-224.example: Emshinini wokwenza umquba wezimboni (58 °C, umswakama), i-PLA ibhidlika ezinsukwini ezingaba ngu-90-180, kodwa ekhaya ngo-20 °C kungathatha iminyaka noma ingaboli nhlobo. Futhi ayiboli kahle olwandle.
c-224.actionItem: Uma uthola isikhwama esinelebula yokubola namuhla, sihlukanise njengodoti ojwayelekile futhi, uma ukwazi, phatha isikhwama sokuthenga esiphinde sisetshenziswe esikhundleni saso.

c-225.title: Kungani Amapayipi Engadi Eqhekezeka Futhi Ebhidlika Elangeni
c-225.summary: Ipayipi lengadi elishiywe ngaphandle liyaqina futhi liqhekezeke phakathi neminyaka ngoba imisebe ye-UV elangeni inqamula amaketango e-polymer. Lapho lingasetshenziswa, lisonge emthunzini.
c-225.principle: Amandla e-UV photon $E=\frac{hc}{\lambda}$ anqamula izibopho ze-C-Cl kanye ne-C-H kuma-polymer afana ne-PVC, akhe ama-radical asabela nomoyampilo bese enqamula amaketango. Amaketango amafushane enza impahla ibe buthaka futhi iphuke kalula.
c-225.example: Ipayipi elinesivikeli se-UV lihlala iminyaka engu-3-5, kanti lelo elishiywe elangeni njalo lingalahlekelwa yi-plasticizer bese liqhekezeka phakathi nonyaka ongu-1-2. Emini phakathi nehlobo, lapho inkomba ye-UV iphezulu kakhulu, yilapho lilimala kakhulu khona.
c-225.actionItem: Ngemuva kokusebenzisa ipayipi namuhla, likhuphe amanzi bese ulisonge emthunzini noma ngaphakathi kwebhokisi lepayipi kude nokukhanya kwelanga.

c-226.title: Kungani Amabhande E-Rubber Namagilavu ​​E-Rubber Ehlukana
c-226.summary: Amabhande namagilavu e-rubber aqhuma ngokungazelelwe futhi anqamuke ngoba i-ozone esemoyeni ihlasela izibopho eziphindwe kabili ze-rubber. I-rubber egcinwe yeluliwe iqhuma ngokushesha okukhulu.
c-226.principle: I-ozone yengeza ezibophweni eziphindwe kabili ze-C=C ze-rubber yemvelo (polyisoprene), $\mathrm{C{=}C}+\mathrm{O_3}\rightarrow$ ozonide, futhi isibopho siyanqamuka. Imifantu igijima ngokuqondile ngokuhambisana nokwelulwa ebusweni be-rubber eyeluliwe.
c-226.example: I-ozone esendaweni ngokuvamile ingu-0.02-0.06 ppm, kodwa ngisho nalokho kungaqhumisa i-rubber eyeluliwe emasontweni kuya ezinyangeni. Ukuyigcina endaweni epholile kwandisa isikhathi sayo sokuphila kakhulu.
c-226.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina amabhande e-rubber namagilavu ​​engaluliwe esikhwameni esivaliwe ekhabetheni elipholile, elimnyama.

c-227.title: Kungani Iziteki Ezimhlophe Ziphenduka Ziphuzi
c-227.summary: Iziteki ezimhlophe ziphenduka ziphuzi ngisho nalapho zigciniwe ngoba i-polyurethane esolweni i-oxidize ngokukhanya nomoya-mpilo kanti ama-antioxidant e-phenolic ayashintsha. Zigcine endaweni epholile, emnyama.
c-227.principle: Izingxenye ezinephunga elimnandi ze-polyurethane ziba ne-oxidize ngaphansi kwe-UV nomoya-mpilo ukuze zenze ama-chromophore aphuzi, kanti ama-antioxidant e-phenolic asabela nama-nitrogen oxide ukuze abe izinhlanganisela zohlobo lwe-quinone ephuzi. I-photo-oxidation iyakhula ngezinga le-UV.
c-227.example: Uma zishiywe ewindini elikhanyayo zingaphenduka ziphuzi ngokuphawulekayo phakathi namasonto kuya ezinyangeni, ngokushesha ngokuphindwe kaningi kunasekhabetheni lezicathulo elimnyama. Okuphuzi kwenzeka engxenyeni encane engaphezulu, i-bleach yomoya-mpilo engakwazi ukukunciphisa kancane.
c-227.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina iziteki ezimhlophe ekhabetheni lezicathulo elimnyama, elinongcwelisa umoya esikhundleni sewindi elinelanga, futhi uzigcine esikhwameni sikakotini esikhundleni sepulasitiki.

c-228.title: Kungani Ujini Omusha Uphuma Umbala Ngesikhathi Uqala Ukuwuwasha
c-228.summary: Ujini omusha uphuma umbala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ekuwashweni kokuqala ngoba udayi we-indigo uhlala kuphela ebusweni bezintambo njengezinhlayiya. Uwawashe ngaphakathi uya ngaphandle, uwodwa, emanzini abandayo okokuqala.
c-228.principle: I-indigo ayincibiliki emanzini: idaywe ngendlela encibilikayo encishisiwe, bese iba ne-oxidize emoyeni ukuze izinhlayiya ezingancibiliki zinamathele ebusweni bezintambo. Ayihlangani ngamakhemikhali nentambo, ngakho ukugubuzelana namanzi kuyayiwasha isuke.
c-228.example: Ibhulukwe elisha lejini (cishe amagremu angu-600) lingakhipha cishe amagremu angu-1-2 kadowayi ekuwashweni kokuqala, liphendule izingubo ezimhlophe zibe luhlaza okwesibhakabhaka uma ziwashwe ndawonye. Emanzini abandayo (30 °C noma ngaphansi) kuphuma udayi omncane.
c-228.actionItem: Namuhla, washa ujini omusha uwodwa uphendulelwe ngaphakathi emanzini abandayo okokuqala, ungawuhlanganisi nezinto ezimhlophe, futhi womise emthunzini.

c-229.title: Usimende omanzi une-alkaline futhi ungashisa isikhumba sakho
c-229.summary: Usimende omanzi nokhonkolo bane-alkaline eqinile, futhi isikhumba esishiywe sithintana nawo singathola ukusha kwamakhemikhali ngaphambi kokuba buhlungu.
c-229.principle: Izinhlanganisela ze-calcium kusimende zihlangana namanzi ukwakha i-$\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$ (i-pH ecishe ibe ngu-12.5), kanti i-alkali igaya amaprotheni namafutha esikhumba. $\mathrm{CaO + H_2O \to Ca(OH)_2}$
c-229.example: Ukuguqa kukhonkolo omanzi amahora angu-1-2 kubangele ukusha okungabi buhlungu kwezinga lesibili ezimweni ezibikwe kakhulu. I-pH engu-12.5 isho cishe ngokuphindwe izikhathi ezingu-300,000 ngaphezulu kwe-$[\mathrm{OH^-}]$ kunamanzi angathathi hlangothi.
c-229.actionItem: Uma usimende uthinta isikhumba, qala ngokushanela impushana eyomile, bese ugeza ngaphansi kwamanzi agelezayo okungenani imizuzu engu-15+; gqoka amagilavu ​​angangeni manzi namabhulukwe amade kunoma yimuphi umsebenzi namuhla.

c-230.title: Qaphela ukushisa negesi evela ezivulini zokudonsa amanzi
c-230.summary: Izivula zokudonsa amanzi ezisekelwe ku-lye ziyafudumala njengoba zincibilika, futhi zikhipha igesi ye-hydrogen uma zithinta i-aluminum.
c-230.principle: I-NaOH ikhipha cishe u-44.5 kJ/mol lapho incibilika, futhi ihlangana ne-aluminum ukwakha i-hydrogen. $2\mathrm{Al} + 2\mathrm{NaOH} + 6\mathrm{H_2O} \to 2\mathrm{Na[Al(OH)_4]} + 3\mathrm{H_2}$
c-230.example: Ukuncibilikisa amagremu angu-100 e-NaOH (2.5 mol) kukhipha cishe u-111 kJ, okwanele ukufudumaza ilitha elilodwa lamanzi cishe ngo-26 °C. Epiphini elincane lingashisa kakhulu endaweni eyodwa bese litsaza.
c-230.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa isivula sokudonsa amanzi namuhla, faka umoya, gqoka izibuko zokuzivikela namagilavu, futhi ungalokothi usihlanganise nezinye izinto zokuhlanza noma usifake ezitsheni ze-aluminum.

c-231.title: I-Epoxy iqina kuphela uma uhlanganisa isilinganiso ngqo
c-231.summary: I-Epoxy iqina ngokugcwele kuphela lapho i-resin nesilukhuni kuhlangana ngesilinganiso esishiwo; kungenjalo ihlala inamathela.
c-231.principle: Amaqembu e-epoxide ahlangana nama-hydrogen asebenzayo e-amine ngamanani alinganayo ukuze akhe inethiwekhi. Isisindo sesilukhuni singu-$m_{\mathrm{hardener}} = \frac{\mathrm{AHEW}}{\mathrm{EEW}} \times m_{\mathrm{resin}}$.
c-231.example: Nge-resin engu-5 mL nesilukhuni esingu-5 mL (1:1), iphutha lesilinganiso elingu-20% noma ngaphezulu livame ukushiya umphumela onamathelayo, othambile. Ukuqina ngokugcwele ngokuvamile kuthatha cishe amahora angu-24.
c-231.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa i-epoxy namuhla, kala ngokwesilinganiso selebula, hlanganisa okungenani imizuzu engu-2 ngenkathi ukhuhla phansi, bese ugcoba ungqimba oluncane.

c-232.title: Ithangi lezinhlanzi lizinzisa lapho i-ammonia iphenduka i-nitrate
c-232.summary: Ithangi elisha liqongelela i-ammonia ne-nitrite kuze kube yilapho amagciwane e-nitrifying ezinzile, okuyinto eyingozi ezinhlanzini.
c-232.principle: Amagciwane e-nitrifying aguqula i-ammonia enobuthi ibe yi-nitrite, bese eyenza i-nitrate enobuthi obuncane. $\mathrm{NH_4^+ + 1.5\,O_2 \to NO_2^- + 2H^+ + H_2O}$, $\mathrm{NO_2^- + 0.5\,O_2 \to NO_3^-}$
c-232.example: Ithangi elisha ngokuvamile lidinga amaviki angu-4-6 ukuze liqedele umjikelezo walo, futhi kuphephe kakhulu ukufaka izinhlanzi kuphela uma i-ammonia ne-nitrite ziku-0 ppm. Gcina i-nitrate ingaphansi kuka-40 ppm ngokushintsha amanzi ngo-20-30% masonto onke.
c-232.actionItem: Hlola i-ammonia, i-nitrite kanye ne-nitrate ngekhithi yokuhlola namuhla, futhi lapho ushintsha amanzi hlambulula izinto zokuhlunga emanzini akhishiwe ethangini, hhayi emanzini ompompi.

c-233.title: Ungalokothi uthele amanzi emlilweni wamafutha; wumboze ngesivalo
c-233.summary: Amanzi atheleka emafutheni avuthayo athumela amafutha avuthayo nesisi kuyo yonke indawo.
c-233.principle: Umlilo udinga uphethiloli, umoya-mpilo kanye nokushisa, ngakho isivalo sivimba umoya-mpilo. Amanzi acwila ngaphansi kwamafutha, aguquke ngokushesha abe yisisi, futhi ande cishe izikhathi ezingu-1,700. $\mathrm{H_2O(l) \to H_2O(g)}$
c-233.example: Inkomishi eyodwa (200 mL) yamanzi ehlangana namafutha angaphezu kuka-300 °C yenza cishe ama-340 L esisi ngokushesha, okungaphonsa amafutha avuthayo phezulu ophahleni.
c-233.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina isivalo esilingana nephani lakho eduze kwesitofu, futhi ukhumbule ukulandelana: cima ukushisa, bese umboza iphani.

c-234.title: Kungani ukusebenzisa i-recirculation kuphela ohambweni olude kukulethela ubuthongo
c-234.summary: Ukusebenzisa imodi ye-recirculation isikhathi eside kwenza i-carbon dioxide iqongelele emotweni, okungadala ukozela nokungagxili kahle.
c-234.principle: Endlini yemoto evalekile, i-CO2 ekhiqizwa ngokuphefumula ayikwazi ukuphuma, ngakho ukugxila kwayo kuyakhuphuka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. $\Delta C \approx \frac{G}{V}\,t$ ($G$: isilinganiso sokukhiqiza, $V$: ivolumu yendlu yemoto)
c-234.example: Umoya wangaphandle une-CO2 elinganiselwa ku-420 ppm, kodwa imoto enabantu abambalwa ekumodi ye-recirculation imizuzu engu-30-60 isike yalinganiswa ngaphezu kuka-2,000 ppm. Ukozela kuvame ukubikwa ngaphezu kuka-1,000 ppm.
c-234.actionItem: Ohambweni lwanamuhla, shintshela kumodi yomoya omusha (fresh-air mode) noma vula kancane ifasitela umzuzu owodwa njalo emva kwemizuzu engu-20-30.

c-235.title: Vumela amanzi okuqala ompompi ekuseni ageleze isikhashana
c-235.summary: Amanzi ahlale emapayipini ubusuku bonke angathatha izakhi zensimbi, ngakho vula umpompi isikhashana ngaphambi kokuwasebenzisa.
c-235.principle: I-copper ne-lead emapayipini nasezintweni zokuxhuma zenza i-oxidize kancane kancane emanzini. $\mathrm{Pb \to Pb^{2+} + 2e^-}$, $\mathrm{Cu \to Cu^{2+} + 2e^-}$ Lapho ehlala isikhathi eside emile, ukugxila kuba phezulu kakhulu.
c-235.example: Ngemva kwamahora angu-6+ emile, vula umpompi imizuzwana engu-30-60 kuze kube yilapho amanzi eba abandayo. Ku-6 L/min, umzuzu owodwa ucishe ube ngu-6 L, ongaya ezitshalweni noma ekuhlanzeni ukuze angamosheki.
c-235.actionItem: Kusasa ekuseni, vula umpompi imizuzwana engu-30-60 ngaphambi kokugcwalisa inkomishi, futhi uqoqe lawo manzi ukuze unisele izitshalo noma uwasebenzisele ukukorobha.

c-236.title: Amanzi ane-alkaline asheshe angathathi hlangothi esiswini sakho
c-236.summary: I-asidi yesisu yenza amanzi ane-alkaline angathathi hlangothi cishe ngokushesha, ngakho awakwazi ukushintsha i-pH yomzimba wakho futhi awavamile ukufaneleka intengo yawo ephezulu.
c-236.principle: Ijusi yesisu icishe ibe ngu-0.01-0.1 M HCl (pH 1.5-3.5), kanti i-$\mathrm{OH^-}$ esemanzini e-alkaline isabela nayo ngokushesha. $\mathrm{HCl + OH^- \to H_2O + Cl^-}$
c-236.example: Ilitha elilodwa lamanzi e-pH 9 line-$\mathrm{OH^-}$ engu-$10^{-5}$ mol kuphela, eyanele ukunciphisa cishe u-1% we-100 mL ye-asidi yesisu ye-pH 2 ($10^{-3}$ mol H+). I-pH yegazi igcinwa ku-7.35-7.45 ngokuphefumula nangezinso.
c-236.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuthenga amanzi ane-alkaline, hlola izimangalo zezempilo ezingasekelwe ubufakazi; namuhla, amanzi ompompi avamile noma ahlungiwe anele ukugcwalisa amanzi emzimbeni.

c-237.title: Ukugcina amabhethri efrijini akukuzuzisi cishe lutho
c-237.summary: Amabhethri e-alkaline anamuhla azikhiphela amandla kancane kakhulu ngisho nasekushiseni kwegumbi, ngakho ukuwafaka efrijini kusiza kancane futhi kubeka engcupheni ukujuluka/ukufingqa kwamanzi.
c-237.principle: Ukuzikhiphela amandla (self-discharge) kuyinqubo yamakhemikhali, ngakho kusheshiswa izinga lokushisa ngokuvumelana nesibalo se-Arrhenius. $k = A\,e^{-E_a/RT}$ Ukubandisa kuyakwehlisa, kodwa amangqamuzana e-alkaline vele ahamba kancane kakhulu.
c-237.example: Amabhethri e-alkaline alahlekelwa cishe ngu-2-3% kuphela ngonyaka ku-20 °C, okunikeza isikhathi sokuhlala seminyaka engu-5-10. Ifriji longa cishe u-1% ngonyaka, futhi amathonsi amanzi ngemva kokuwakhipha angagqwalisa izingxenye zokuxhuma.
c-237.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina amabhethri ekhabetheni elipholile, elomile ehlukaniswe ngohlobo, futhi ungalokothi uhlanganise amangqamuzana amasha namadala entweni eyodwa.

c-238.title: Amalahle okuwasha: amabhrikhethi, amalahle amhlophe namnyama ayahluka
c-238.summary: Izinhlobo zamalahle ziyehluka ngokuthi abasa ngokushesha kangakanani, abangela umusi ongakanani, nokuthi ukushisa kuhlala isikhathi esingakanani, ngakho khetha uhlobo olufanele umsebenzi.
c-238.principle: Lapho izinga le-carbonization liphezulu, izinto ezishabalalayo ziba zincane bese ikhabhoni iba ningi, okunikeza umusi omncane nokusha isikhathi eside. $\mathrm{C + O_2 \to CO_2}$ ($\Delta H \approx -394$ kJ/mol); uma umoya-mpilo umncane kakhulu, $2\mathrm{C + O_2 \to 2CO}$.
c-238.example: Ikhilogremu elilodwa lamalahle linikeza cishe ama-29 MJ (cishe ama-8 kWh). Amalahle amhlophe abhacwe eduze kuka-1,000 °C asha isikhathi eside futhi ahlanzekile kodwa anzima ukubasa; amalahle amnyama abaseka kalula kodwa abhema kakhulu; amabhrikhethi ashiya umlotha omningi ngenxa yezinto zokuhlanganisa.
c-238.actionItem: Uma uthenga amalahle okuwasha namuhla, khetha ngokwenhloso yawo, futhi ungalinge ushise amalahle ngaphakathi etendeni noma endaweni evalekile (ubuthi be-carbon monoxide).

c-239.title: Kungani kufanele udle ama-carbs ngokushesha ngemva kokuzivocavoca
c-239.summary: Ehoreni lokuqala noma amabili ngemva kokuzivocavoca, imisipha ithatha ushukela kangcono kakhulu, ngakho-ke ama-carbohydrate ngaleso sikhathi agcwalisa i-glycogen ngokushesha.
c-239.principle: I-glycogen eqedwe ukuzivocavoca iphinde yakhiwe nge-insulin nezithuthi ze-glucose emisipheni. $(\mathrm{Glucose})_n + \mathrm{Glucose} \to (\mathrm{Glucose})_{n+1}$
c-239.example: Imisipha igcina cishe amagremu angama-400 e-glycogen. Kumuntu ovamile ozivocavocayo, ubhanana (cishe amagremu angama-27 e-carbs) nengilazi yobisi ngemva kokuzivocavoca okunzima kwanele; uma uphumula usuku noma ngaphezulu, isikhathi esiqondile asinandaba kakhulu.
c-239.actionItem: Uma uzivocavoca namuhla, yidla ama-carbs aneprotheni ethile phakathi nehora elilodwa ngemva kwalokho, njengobhanana, isitsha selayisi, noma ubisi.

c-240.title: Umbala ogqamile wama-aprikothi omisiwe uvela kuma-sulfite
c-240.summary: Ama-aprikothi omisiwe awolintshi agqamile avikelwe ekubeni nsundu ngama-sulfite, kanti ansundu ngokuvamile awanawo ama-sulfite, futhi abantu abane-asthma kufanele baqaphele.
c-240.principle: $\mathrm{SO_2}$ incibilika emanzini ukuze yakhe i-bisulfite, evimbela ama-enzyme abangela umbala onsundu kanye ne-oxidation. $\mathrm{SO_2 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons HSO_3^- + H^+}$
c-240.example: Ama-aprikothi omisiwe ane-sulfite angaqukatha amakhulu ambalwa kuya cishe ku-2,000 mg/kg ye-$\mathrm{SO_2}$, kanti amazwe amaningi adinga ilebula kusukela ku-10 mg/kg noma ngaphezulu. Iziguli ze-asthma ezingezwani ne-sulfite zingaba nenkinga yokuphefumula.
c-240.actionItem: Lapho uthenga izithelo ezomile namuhla, funda uhlu lwezithako ukuthola ama-sulfite (sulphur dioxide), bese ukhetha ezinsundu ezingenayo i-sulfite uma ungezwanani nayo.

c-241.title: Usawoti one-sodium ephansi unothe nge-potassium: qaphela uma unesifo sezinso
c-241.summary: Usawoti one-sodium ephansi ushintsha ingxenye ye-sodium nge-potassium, ngakho abantu abanesifo sezinso noma abathatha imithi ethinta i-potassium kufanele baxoxe nodokotela kuqala.
c-241.principle: Ingxenye ye-$\mathrm{NaCl}$ ithathelwa indawo yi-$\mathrm{KCl}$, okunciphisa i-sodium kodwa kwenyusa i-potassium. Ngobukhulu besisindo, i-Na ingu-39.3% we-NaCl kanti i-K ingu-52.4% we-KCl.
c-241.example: Amagremu amahlanu engxube engu-70% ye-sodium / 30% ye-potassium anama-1.4 g e-sodium (ngaphansi ngo-30% kunama-2.0 g ku-5 g kasawoti ojwayelekile) kanye cishe nama-0.79 g e-potassium. Ngokuncipha kokusebenza kwezinso, i-potassium ingaqongelelana futhi ibeke engcupheni yokushaya kwenhliziyo okuyingozi.
c-241.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokuthenga usawoti one-sodium ephansi namuhla, hlola ingxenye ye-KCl kulebula, bese ubuza udokotela wakho kuqala uma unesifo sezinso noma uphuza imithi ehlobene nalokho.

c-242.title: Igolide le-14K nele-18K akulona igolide elimsulwa
c-242.summary: Inombolo ye-karat ibonisa ubungako begolide: i-18K inegolide elingu-75% kanti i-14K cishe ingu-58%, kanti ezinye izinsimbi zenza okunye okusele.
c-242.principle: Ubumsulwa buvezwa ngezingxenye ezingama-24. $\text{ubumsulwa} = \frac{K}{24}$ Ukuhlanganisa nezinye izinsimbi kwenza igolide liqine futhi kushintshe umbala walo, kanti igolide elimsulwa le-24K liyathamba cishe ku-99.9%.
c-242.example: Indandatho ye-18K engamagremu ayi-10 iqukethe amagremu angama-7.5 egolide elimsulwa, kanti eye-14K iqukethe cishe amagremu angama-5.8. Izimpawu zobumsulwa (hallmarks) zivame ukuba ngu-750 ku-18K no-585 ku-14K.
c-242.actionItem: Lapho uthenga igolide namuhla, hlola uphawu lobumsulwa (750, 585, njll.) nesisindo, bese uzibalela ngokwakho okuqukethwe kwegolide elimsulwa.

c-243.title: Ubhontshisi wekhofi ukhipha igesi ngemva kokugazingwa, bese uba ne-oxidize
c-243.summary: Ubhontshisi ukhipha i-carbon dioxide ngokushesha ngemva kokugazingwa bese uba ne-oxidize, ngakho-ke zama ukuwusebenzisa phakathi kwamasonto angaba ngu-1 kuye kwangu-4 kusukela ngosuku owagazingwa ngalo.
c-243.principle: I-$\mathrm{CO_2}$ eyakheke ngesikhathi sokugazinga iphuma kancane kancane, kanti izakhi zephunga namafutha zithintana nomoya-mpilo bese ziphelelwa ubusha bazo. $\mathrm{RH + O_2 \to ROOH}$
c-243.example: Igremu elilodwa likabhontshisi likhipha ama-mL ambalwa e-CO2 ngemva kokugazingwa, kanti ukugaya kwandisa indawo engaphezulu ukuze iphunga linciphe phakathi kwemizuzu kuye emahoreni ambalwa. Ubhontshisi ovuliwe ekushiseni kwegumbi ulahlekelwa ukunambitheka ngokusobala cishe emasontweni ama-2 kuye kwama-4.
c-243.actionItem: Lapho uthenga ubhontshisi namuhla, khetha isikhwama esinosuku lokugazingwa, gaya ngaphambi nje kokuphuza, bese uwugcina endaweni evalelekile, epholile nemnyama (efrijini kunengcuphe yomswakama).

c-244.title: Kungani isambatho esixosha amafutha esikrinini sefoni siphela
c-244.summary: Isambatho sokuvikela izigxivizo zeminwe sefoni sinobubanzi obungama-nanometer ambalwa kuya emashumini kuphela, ngakho-ke siphela kancane kancane ngenxa yokwesula nokuguguleka.
c-244.principle: Ifilimu ye-fluoropolymer yehlisa amandla aphezu kwendawo ukuze amafutha azenzele amaconsi esikhundleni sokubhebhetheka. I-engeli yokuthintana ilandela i-$\cos\theta = \frac{\gamma_{SV} - \gamma_{SL}}{\gamma_{LV}}$, futhi njengoba ifilimu iguga, u-$\theta$ uyehla.
c-244.example: Isambatho siba nobubanzi obungama-nm ambalwa kuya emashumini, okucishe kube yingxenye eyodwa kwezinkulungwane eziyishumi yobubanzi bocingo lonwele (elingaba ngu-80,000 nm). Isihlabathi nezihluthulelo ephaketheni kanye nokuhlanza ngotshwala ngokuphindaphindiwe kuyasigugula ngokusobala phakathi kwezinyanga kuya eminyakeni emi-2.
c-244.actionItem: Kusukela namhlanje, wesule isikrini ngendwangu eyomile ye-microfiber, futhi ugweme ama-wipes anotshwala obuningi noma izindwangu ezinokhahlo.

c-245.title: Khipha izingubo ezisanda kuhlanzwa nge-dry-cleaning epulasitikini bese uzifaka emoyeni
c-245.summary: Izingubo ezisanda kuhlanzwa nge-dry-cleaning zingagcina i-solvent, ngakho-ke khipha ipulasitiki bese ungenisa umoya ngaphambi kokuzigqoka noma ukuzibeka ekhabetheni.
c-245.principle: I-solvent yokuhlanza i-perchloroethylene ibila ku-121 °C futhi ine-vapor pressure engaba ngu-1.9 kPa ku-20 °C, ngakho-ke ihwamuka kancane. $\mathrm{C_2Cl_4(l) \to C_2Cl_4(g)}$ Ipulasitiki livimba lo mhwamuko.
c-245.example: Ukushiya izingubo epulasitikini ngaphakathi ekhabetheni kuvala umhwamuko futhi kwandisa iphunga nokuchayeka kuwo. Ukuzilengisa endaweni enomoya amahora ambalwa kuya osukwini kuvumela iningi lawo ukuba liphume. Abanye abahlanzi basebenzisa ama-hydrocarbon solvent esikhundleni salokho.
c-245.actionItem: Khipha izingubo epulasitikini ngokushesha lapho uziletha ekhaya zivela kumhlanzi, bese uzilengisa amahora ambalwa kuvulandi noma endaweni engenisa umoya.

c-246.title: I-condensing boiler ithola ukushisa kusuka kumhwamuko wamanzi osemoyeni ophumayo
c-246.summary: I-condensing boiler ijikisa umhwamuko wamanzi osemoyeni ophumayo ube uketshezi bese isebenzisa lokho kushisa okufihlekile (latent heat) ekushiseni, esikhundleni sokukulahla.
c-246.principle: Ukushiswa kwegesi yemvelo kwakha amanzi, $\mathrm{CH_4 + 2O_2 \to CO_2 + 2H_2O}$, futhi ukujikisa lowo mhwamuko ube uketshezi kukhipha ukushisa okufihlekile okungaba ngu-2.26 MJ/kg. Ukuze lokhu kutholakale, amanzi abuyayo kumele abe ngaphansi kuka-55 °C.
c-246.example: Ukushisa i-1 m³ yegesi kwakha cishe u-1.6 kg wamanzi, kwenezela cishe u-3.6 MJ (cishe u-10% wokushisa okuphelele). Yingakho ingonga cishe u-10-15% wamandla uma iqhathaniswa ne-boiler evamile.
c-246.actionItem: Uma usebenzisa i-condensing boiler namuhla, yehlisa izinga lokushisa ukuze amanzi abuyayo ahlale engaphansi kuka-55 °C futhi i-condensation isebenze kahle.

c-247.title: Ikhandlela lishisa umhwamuko we-wax, hhayi i-wax encibilikile
c-247.summary: Ilangabi lekhandlela lishisa umhwamuko we-wax odonswa ngentambo yalo (wick), hhayi i-wax ewuketshezi ngokwayo.
c-247.principle: I-wax encibilikile ikhuphuka ngentambo ngesenzo se-capillary action, ihwamuke ngokushisa, bese umhwamuko usabela ne-oxygen. $\mathrm{C_{25}H_{52} + 38\,O_2 \to 25\,CO_2 + 26\,H_2O}$
c-247.example: Ikhandlela elivamile lishisa cishe u-7 g we-wax ngehora futhi likhipha cishe u-80 W wokushisa. Intambo ende kakhulu isha ngokungaphelele futhi yenza intuthu enensizi eningi.
c-247.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokokhela ikhandlela namuhla, gunda intambo ibe cishe ngu-5 mm ukunciphisa insizi, futhi ungalokothi ushiye ikhandlela elivuthayo lingagadiwe.

c-248.title: Ukubilisa i-pasta emanzini amancane kunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwamandla
c-248.summary: I-pasta idinga kuphela cishe i-1 L yamanzi nge-100 g ngayinye, ngakho-ke ukushintsha umkhuba wokubilisa ama-3 L kunciphisa kakhulu ukushisa okudingekayo.
c-248.principle: Ukushisa amanzi kuthatha $Q = mc\Delta T$, futhi isitashi se-pasta simunca amanzi siphinde sithambe kusuka cishe ku-60-70 °C, ngakho-ke ibhodwe elikhulu kakhulu alidingeki.
c-248.example: Ukususa i-1 L yamanzi ku-20 °C kuya ku-100 °C kuthatha cishe u-334 kJ (0.093 kWh), ngakho ukwehlisa kusuka ku-3 L kuya ku-1 L konga cishe u-0.19 kWh isikhathi ngasinye. Ukusebenzisa isivalo konga kakhulu.
c-248.actionItem: Lapho upheka i-pasta namuhla, sebenzisa cishe i-1 L yamanzi kuphela nge-100 g ngayinye, faka isivalo ngenkathi ushisa, bese unyakazisa njalo ukuze inganamatheli.

c-249.title: Ngenisa umoya kuqala lapho iphuka isibani se-fluorescent
c-249.summary: Izibani ze-fluorescent zine-mercury encane, ngakho lapho iphuka, khipha abantu nezilwane ezifuywayo bese ungenisa umoya ngaphambi kokuhlanza.
c-249.principle: I-mercury yinsimbi ehwamuka ngisho nasezingeni lokushisa elivamile legumbi. $\mathrm{Hg(l) \to Hg(g)}$ I-vapor pressure yayo ku-20 °C icishe ibe ngu-0.16 Pa, futhi umhwamuko uyaqoqana egumbini elivaliwe.
c-249.example: Isibani esisodwa se-compact fluorescent (CFL) ngokuvamile siphethe ama-mg ambalwa e-mercury. Ngemva kokuphuka, ngenisa umoya imizuzu engu-5-10+, bese uqoqa izingcezu ngephepha eliqinile ne-tape esikhundleni se-vacuum, bese uzivalela ebhokisini lokuqoqa.
c-249.actionItem: Namuhla, thola noma yimaphi amashubhu e-fluorescent asephelile ekhaya, uwafake ebhokisini lawo lokuqala, bese uthola ukuthi likuphi ibhokisi lokuqoqa izibani eliseduze kakhulu.

c-250.title: Sebenzisa amanzi amancane elayisini elisha elisanda kuvunwa kunaselayisini elidala
c-250.summary: Ilayisi elisha elisanda kuvunwa ligcina umswakama omningi, ngakho-ke sebenzisa cishe u-90% wamanzi akho ajwayelekile kungenjalo ilayisi lizothamba kakhulu lize libe yiphalishi.
c-250.principle: Lapho ilayisi lihlala isikhathi eside, loma kakhulu futhi limunca amanzi amaningi. Amanzi okupheka alinganiselwa ku-$m_{\mathrm{water}} = m_{\mathrm{rice}} \times r$, lapho u-$r$ ecishe abe ngu-1.1 kwilayisi elisha no-1.2 kwelidala.
c-250.example: Ezinkomishini ezi-2 (cishe ama-360 mL) zelayisi ungase usebenzise cishe ama-400 mL amanzi, kodwa ngelayisi elisha sebenzisa cishe ama-360 mL, okuncane cishe ngama-40 mL. Ilayisi elisha linomswakama ongaba ngu-15-16%, kanti elidala ngu-13-14%.
c-250.actionItem: Lapho upheka ilayisi elisha elisanda kuvunwa namuhla, sebenzisa cishe u-90% wamanzi akho ajwayelekile, bese unciphisa kakhulu ngokuzayo uma lithamba kakhulu.

c-251.title: Hlanganisa inhlama yamapanikuku kancane emanzini abandayo ukuze iqweqwele
c-251.summary: Inhlama ye-jeon yohlobo lwase-Korea iba crispy uma ihlanganiswa isikhathi esifushane namanzi abandayo, okunciphisa i-gluten enwebekayo.
c-251.principle: I-Glutenin ne-gliadin kufulawa kwakha inethiwekhi ye-gluten uma kumanzi futhi kunyakaziswa. $\text{glutenin} + \text{gliadin} + \mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\text{mixing}} \text{gluten}$ Amanzi abandayo anciphisa ijubane lale nqubo.
c-251.example: Gqugquzela inkomishi eyi-1 (cishe amagremu ayi-120) kafulawa nenkomishi eyi-1 yamanzi abandayo ngokunyakazisa cishe izikhathi eziyi-10 kuphela; izigaxa ezincane zilungile. Ukufaka isitashi esikhundleni sesilinganiso esingaba ngu-20% kafulawa kunciphisa i-gluten ukuze kube crispy kakhulu.
c-251.actionItem: Uma wenza amapanikuku anongwe kahle namuhla, hlanganisa namanzi abandayo njengeqhwa imizuzwana eyi-10-15 kuphela, futhi ungachithi imizuzu engaphezu kweyi-10 ugoqoza inhlama.

c-252.title: Ama-fiddleheads e-bracken adinga ukufakwa emanzini abilayo nokuwacwilisa ukuze kuncishiswe ubuthi
c-252.summary: I-bracken engaphekiwe iqukethe into ebangela umdlavuza ebizwa nge-ptaquiloside, ngakho-ke yibilise futhi uyicwilise njalo, futhi ugweme ukuyidla njalo.
c-252.principle: I-Ptaquiloside iyancipha futhi iphuke ngokushisa kanye ne-alkali. $\text{ptaquiloside} \xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{OH^-}} \text{pterosin B}$ (ayinawo ubuthi)
c-252.example: Yibilise imizuzu eyi-5-10, bese uyicwilisa emanzini abandayo cishe usuku lonke; ukwengeza cishe amagremu ayi-5 (0.5%) e-baking soda ku-1 L wamanzi kusiza ukuyihlakaza. Lokhu akuqinisekisi ukuthi asikho neze isalela, ngakho ungayidli njalo noma ngamanani amakhulu.
c-252.actionItem: Uma upheka i-bracken namuhla, yibilise kahle, uyicwilise emanzini abandayo, bese ulungisa isidlo ngemva kwalokho kuphela.

c-253.title: Kungani i-taro yenza izandla zakho zilume, nendlela yokukulungisa
c-253.summary: Isikhumba sejusi le-taro liqukethe amakristalu e-calcium oxalate amise okwezinaliti ahlaba futhi alume izandla ezingavikelekile.
c-253.principle: Amakristalu e-calcium oxalate (ama-raphide) abhoboza isikhumba abangele ukulunywa, futhi ancibilika kancane noma aphelelwe amandla ku-asidi noma ekushiseni. $\mathrm{CaC_2O_4 + 2H^+ \rightleftharpoons Ca^{2+} + H_2C_2O_4}$
c-253.example: Amakristalu anobude obungamashumi kuya emakhulwini ama-micrometer (0.02-0.2 mm), acijile ngokwanele ukuba abhoboze ungqimba lwangaphandle lwesikhumba. Ekulumeni, ukugeza ngamanzi afudumele anoviniga omncane kungasiza, futhi ukubilisa kunciphisa kakhulu ukunambitheka okubabayo.
c-253.actionItem: Lapho ulungisa i-taro namuhla, gqoka amagilavu enjoloba bese uyicwecwa ngaphansi kwamanzi agelezayo.

c-254.title: Izinaliti zikaphayini zisiza i-songpyeon ukuba ihlale isikhathi eside njengesivikeli semvelo
c-254.summary: Ama-terpenes ezinalitini zikaphayini ngaphansi kwe-songpyeon anomphumela omncane wokulwa namagciwane, kodwa awasona isilondolozi esigcwele, ngakho-ke indlela yokugcina isabalulekile.
c-254.principle: Ama-terpenes afana ne-alpha-pinene ($\mathrm{C_{10}H_{16}}$) aphazamisa ulwelwesi lwamaseli ebhaktheriya futhi anciphise ukukhula kwawo. Umphumela ubuthaka futhi wandisa isikhathi sokuhlala ngamahora ambalwa kuya osukwini olulodwa kuphela.
c-254.example: I-Songpyeon ivame ukuhlala cishe usuku olulodwa ekamelweni elipholile; efrijini ikhekhe lelayisi liyaziqina (i-retrogradation); uma liqandisiwe ligcineka cishe inyanga e-1. Ukuthembela ezinalitini zikaphayini zodwa emazingeni okushisa asehlobo kungaholela ekonakaleni.
c-254.actionItem: Namuhla, pholisa i-songpyeon esele, bopha ngayinye ngepulasitiki bese uyifaka efrijini, bese uyishisa ngesitimu ngaphambi kokuyidla.

c-255.title: I-Red ginseng iyashiswa ngesitimu, ngakho-ke isakhiwo sayo se-saponin sesishintshile
c-255.summary: I-Red ginseng iyi-ginseng entsha eshisiwe ngesitimu futhi yomiswa, futhi lesi sitimu sisusa ushukela kuma-saponin e-ginseng (ama-ginsenoside), sakhe izinhlanganisela ezitholakala ku-red ginseng kuphela.
c-255.principle: Ukushisa kwesitimu nomswakama kuhlakaza amaketango kashukela kuma-ginsenosides. $\text{Rb}_1 \xrightarrow{\text{steam, H}^+} \text{Rg}_3 + 2\ \text{glucose}$
c-255.example: I-Red ginseng yenziwa ngokufutha i-ginseng entsha ngesitimu cishe ku-95-100 °C amahora amaningi bese iyomiswa, okukhiqiza izinhlanganisela ezinjenge-Rg3, Rg5 kanye ne-Rk1. Izinzuzo zezempilo azikwazi ukuthathwa kalula njengeziqinisekisiwe, futhi inani le-ginsenoside liyahluka ngokomkhiqizo.
c-255.actionItem: Lapho uthenga umkhiqizo we-red ginseng namuhla, qhathanisa iminyaka yempande (njengeneminyaka engu-6) kanye nenani le-ginsenoside elibhalwe kulebula (ingqikithi ye-Rg1+Rb1+Rg3).

c-256.title: Impushana emhlophe esikhumbeni samagilebhisi ayisona isibulala-zinambuzane
c-256.summary: Ungqimba olumhlophe olufana nothuli emagilebhisini iyi-wax yemvelo (bloom) eyenziwa yisithelo ngokwaso, futhi futhi kuwuphawu lokusha kwaso.
c-256.principle: I-Bloom ngamakristalu e-wax e-hydrophobic afana ne-oleanolic acid ($\mathrm{C_{30}H_{48}O_3}$), ungqimba lwemvelo olungangenwa amanzi olunciphisa ukulahleka kwamanzi futhi luvimbele isikhutha nemvula.
c-256.example: Ungqimba lwe-bloom lunobukhulu obungama-micrometer ambalwa kuphela noma ngaphansi futhi luyasuka kalula ngomunwe. I-bloom esakazeke ngokulinganayo ibonisa ukuthi amagilebhisi awazange aphathwe kakhulu kusukela evunwa, okusiza ekuhloleni ukusha kwawo.
c-256.actionItem: Namuhla, hlambulula amagilebhisi ngaphansi kwamanzi agelezayo imizuzwana engama-30 ngaphambi nje kokuwadla, futhi ungawawashi kusengaphambili.

c-257.title: Amaqhafa asekwindla aphenduka abomvu ngoba iqhafa lenza i-pigment entsha
c-257.summary: Amaqhafa aphuzi aveza i-pigment eyayisivele ikhona, kuyilapho amaqhafa abomvu enza i-anthocyanin entsha ekwindla.
c-257.principle: Njengoba izinsuku ziba mfushane futhi zibanda, i-chlorophyll ($\mathrm{C_{55}H_{72}O_5N_4Mg}$) iyaphela amandla, iveze ama-carotenoids aphuzi, futhi njengoba ushukela uqongelelwa, kwenziwa i-anthocyanin entsha, ephendula amaqhafa abomvu.
c-257.example: Ukubomvu kugqama kakhulu ngezinsuku ezinelanga ezakha ushukela kanye nokusa okuhla kuye ku-5-10 °C. Ekwindla enemvula nefudumele, imibala iba lufifi kakhulu.
c-257.actionItem: Uma uhlela uhambo lokubuka amahlamvu namuhla, hlola imephu yesibikezelo samahlamvu amaviki angu-1-2 ngemuva kokuthi ukubanda kwasekuseni kuqale ukuhlala cishe ku-5 °C.

c-258.title: Ungacosha izithelo ze-ginkgo ngezandla ezingenalutho
c-258.summary: Inyama yesithelo se-ginkgo ingabangela ukuqubuka njenge-poison ivy esikhunjeni esingenalutho, futhi iphunga livela ku-butyric acid.
c-258.principle: Ama-ginkgolic acids (alkylphenols) enyameni yesithelo abangela i-contact dermatitis, kanti nephunga elibi livela ku-butyric acid. $\mathrm{CH_3CH_2CH_2COOH}$
c-258.example: Amanzi enyama yesithelo esikhunjeni angaholela ekuqubukeni okubomvu nokulunywa emahoreni ambalwa kuya osukwini olulandelayo. I-butyric acid iwuhlobo olufanayo lwephunga njengebhotela elibolile noma ukuhlanza.
c-258.actionItem: Ohambweni lwanamuhla lasekwindla, ungacosha izithelo ze-ginkgo eziwile, futhi uma kudingeka nakanjani, gqoka amagilavu alahlwayo bese uziphatha ngaphakathi esikhwameni.

c-259.title: Ukubilisa noma ukomisa akubulali ubuthi bamakhowe anobuthi
c-259.summary: Ubuthi bamakhowe anobuthi buhlala bukhona ngisho sekubilisiwe, komisiwe noma kwenziwa ukuhlola kwesipuni sesiliva, ngakho ungalokothi udle amakhowe asendle angahlolwanga uchwepheshe.
c-259.principle: I-amatoxin (alpha-amanitin) yamakhowe e-death cap iyi-cyclic peptide engabhubhi ngokushisa evimba i-RNA polymerase II futhi ilimaze amangqamuzana esibindi nezinso. $\text{amatoxin} + \text{RNA polymerase II} \to \text{inactive complex}$
c-259.example: Isilinganiso esibulalayo singaba ngu-0.1 mg/kg, ngakho-ke ikhowe elilodwa le-death cap (elingaba ngu-50 g) lingabulala umuntu omdala. Izimpawu zivela kuphela ngemuva kwamahora angu-6-24, okwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo sekwephuze kakhulu.
c-259.actionItem: Uma uhlangana namakhowe asendle ohambweni lokuhamba namuhla, ungawacosha, futhi uma uke wadla amanye wabe sewuhlanza noma uhudo, yana egumbini lezimo eziphuthumayo (ER) ngokushesha uphathe nalelo khowe.

c-260.title: Kungani kungafanele ushise amaqhafa asekwindla nodoti
c-260.summary: Ukushisa amaqhafa nodoti ngaphandle akushi ngokuphelele futhi kukhulula uthuli olucolisekileyo namakhemikhali ayingozi, futhi ukushisa ipulasitiki noma i-PVC kungenza ama-dioxin.
c-260.principle: Ukushisa endaweni evulekile ngomoya omncane kuyukusha okungaphelele, okukhipha ama-PAH ne-carbon monoxide. $2\mathrm{C} + \mathrm{O_2} \to 2\mathrm{CO}$ I-PVC $(\mathrm{C_2H_3Cl})_n$ ingakha i-hydrogen chloride nezinhlanganisela zohlobo lwe-dioxin lapho ishiswa.
c-260.example: Cishe amaphesenti angu-57 esisindo se-PVC yi-chlorine, ngakho-ke u-1 kg uphethe cishe u-570 g we-chlorine. Ukushisa izinsalela zezitshalo endaweni evulekile kungakhipha cishe u-5-15 g wezinhlayiya ezincane ngekhilogremu ngayinye.
c-260.actionItem: Namuhla, ungawashisi amaqhafa; enze umquba noma uwabeke ngaphandle ulandela imithetho yendawo yangakini yokuqoqwa kukadoti.

c-261.title: Impuphu emhlophe ephuma kuma-humidifier ingamaminerali amanzi kampompi
c-261.summary: Uthuli olumhlophe oluhlala eduze kwe-ultrasonic humidifier ngamaminerali e-calcium ne-magnesium ancibilike emanzini akho ompompi.
c-261.principle: I-ultrasonic humidifier ifutha amathonsi amancane ngaphandle kokubilisa, ngakho usawoti oncibilikile usala njengezinhlayiya eziqinile lapho amathonsi omile. Ukubilisa kwenza okunye okuqinile kuhlale phansi. $\mathrm{Ca(HCO_3)_2 \to CaCO_3 + CO_2 + H_2O}$
c-261.example: Ngamaminerali acishe abe ngu-80 mg/L emanzini kampompi kanye no-2.4 L ofuthwe ebusuku obungamahora angu-8, cishe u-190 mg wezinhlayiya ungasakazeka emoyeni. Lezi zincane ngokwanele ukuba zifinyelele ezindleleni zokuphefumula.
c-261.actionItem: Namuhla, thulula, hlanza uphinde ugcwalise ithangi le-humidifier nsuku zonke, futhi lapho kungenzeka khona sebenzisa amanzi acwengekile (distilled) noma imodeli eshisayo noma ehwamukisayo.

c-262.title: Kungani izincwadi ezindala ziphenduka zibe phuzi
c-262.summary: Izincwadi ezindala ziba phuzi futhi zibhidlike ngoba ama-asidi ne-lignin ephepheni kuyaphelelwa umoya-mpilo (oxidize) bese kuwohloka.
c-262.principle: I-lignin ephepheni eline-asidi iyaxhaphazeka ngokukhanya nomoya-mpilo bese iphenduka ibe phuzi, futhi i-asidi ihlukanisa i-cellulose ukwenza iphepha libe buthaka. $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\mathrm{H_2O} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H^+}} n\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$
c-262.example: Iphepha elicebe nge-lignin njengephephandaba (cishe u-25% we-lignin) liphenduka libe phuzi ezinyangeni ezimbalwa, kuyilapho izincwadi ezingenayo i-asidi zingahlala amakhulu eminyaka. Umswakama ophezulu kanye nezinga lokushisa kukhulisa isivinini salokhu kusabela.
c-262.actionItem: Namuhla, beka izincwadi ezibalulekile ezindaweni ezikude nokukhanya kwelanga okuqondile endaweni epholile neyomile, futhi ungafaki izingcezu zamaphephandaba phakathi kwamakhasi.

c-263.title: Ukubola okumnyama phansi kotamatisi kuvela ku-calcium
c-263.summary: Ukubola okumnyama ngaphansi kukatamatisi (blossom-end rot) ngokuvamile akubangelwa ukuntuleka kwe-calcium enhlabathini, kodwa kudalwa ukuthi i-calcium ayifiki esithelweni.
c-263.principle: Ama-ion e-calcium ahamba nokugeleza kwamanzi okuqhutshwa ukujuluka kwezitshalo (transpiration), kanti isihloko sesithelo, esingajuluki kakhulu, siyithola ekugcineni. Ukuhamba kancane kusho ukuthola okuncane. $J = C \times \dot{V}$ ($C$: ukugcwala kwe-calcium, $\dot{V}$: ukugeleza kwamanzi)
c-263.example: Ukunisela okungalingani kuphazamisa ukuhamba kwe-calcium futhi kubangele izimpawu; ukunisela njalo cishe ngama-25 mm (i-intshi elingu-1) lamanzi ngeviki yikhona okuvame ukwelulekwa. Ukulawula amanzi kusebenza kangcono kakhulu kunokwengeza i-calcium eningi enhlabathini.
c-263.actionItem: Namuhla, nisela utamatisi ngezikhathi ezihlelekile ngaphambi kokuba umhlabathi wome esikhundleni sokunisela ngokweqile ngesikhathi esingahlelekile, bese wengeza umquba wokumboza (mulch).

c-264.title: Umlotha womlilo wamalahle uyi-potassium yamahhala yengadi, kodwa qaphela
c-264.summary: Umlotha wezinkuni ungumanyolo we-alkaline ohlinzeka nge-potassium ne-calcium, kodwa ulimaza izitshalo ezithanda inhlabathi ene-asidi, kanti umlotha ophuma kumalahle enziwe anamakhemikhali noma ezinkunini ezipendiwe akumele usetshenziswe.
c-264.principle: I-$\mathrm{K_2CO_3}$ esemlotheni incibilika ibe ngama-ion e-potassium nawe-hydroxide, okuphakamisa i-pH yomhlabathi. $\mathrm{K_2CO_3 + H_2O \rightleftharpoons 2K^+ + HCO_3^- + OH^-}$
c-264.example: Umlotha wezinkuni une-pH ephakathi kuka-10 no-13 kanye cishe no-3-10% we-potassium (njenge-K2O). Umkhawulo ovamile ungaphozu kuka-100 g nge-m² ngayinye ngonyaka (izandla ezigcwele ezimbalwa), futhi gwema ukuwusebenzisa kuma-blueberry namazambane.
c-264.actionItem: Uma unomlotha wezinkuni opholile ngokuphelele nohlohlwe kahle namuhla, wuhlole, hlola i-pH yomhlabathi wakho, bese uwuchitha kancane kuphela emibhedeni yomhlabathi ongathathi hlangothi noma one-alkaline.

c-265.title: Uma umquba wakho unuka kabi, engeza ikhabhoni
c-265.summary: Uma umquba unuka i-ammonia noma ukubola, une-nitrogen eningi kakhulu, ngakho-ke hlanganisa izinto ezinekhabhoni njengamaqabunga omile.
c-265.principle: Amagciwane asebenza kangcono lapho isilinganiso sekhabhoni kuya ku-nitrogen cishe singu-30:1. $\mathrm{C/N} = \frac{m_C}{m_N} \approx 30$ I-nitrogen eyeqile iphuma njengephunga le-ammonia nge-$\mathrm{NH_4^+ + OH^- \to NH_3 + H_2O}$.
c-265.example: Izinsalela zokudla zine-C/N ecishe ibe ngu-15-20, amaqabunga omile angama-50-80 kanti uthuli lwokhuni lungaba ngu-400. Ukuxuba izingxenye ezi-2 kuye kwezi-3 zezinto ezinsundu njengamaqabunga omile nengxenye eyodwa yezinsalela zokudla kunciphisa kakhulu iphunga.
c-265.actionItem: Uma umgqomo wakho womquba unuka namuhla, engeza isikhwama samaqabunga omile noma amakhadibhodi aqotshiwe, bese uwuhlanganisa kahle ukuze ungenise umoya.

c-266.title: Ubhontshisi obomvu ongavuthiwe kahle unobuthi be-lectin
c-266.summary: Ubhontshisi obomvu oluhlaza (kidney beans), noma ofudunyezwe kuphela wafinyelela cishe ku-80 °C, ungadala ukuhlanza nohudo ngenxa yama-lectin, ngakho-ke kufanele ubiliswe ngamandla.
c-266.principle: I-lectin kabhontshisi obomvu (phytohaemagglutinin) iyiphrotheni egqabuka kuphela ngokushisa okwanele ku-100 °C. $\text{active lectin} \xrightarrow{100^\circ\mathrm{C},\ \ge 10\ \text{min}} \text{denatured lectin}$ Cishe ku-80 °C, ubuthi bungakhula ngokuphindaphindiwe.
c-266.example: Ubhontshisi obomvu oluhlaza oyizinhlamvu ezi-4-5 kuphela ungadala isicanucanu nokuhlanza kungakapheli amahora angu-1-3, kanti ukupheka emazingeni aphansi ka-80 °C kubikwe ukuthi kwandisa ubuthi cishe izikhathi ezi-5 kunezinhlamvu ezingaphekiwe. Ubhontshisi wasethinini usuvele uphekiwe.
c-266.actionItem: Uma upheka ubhontshisi obomvu owomile namuhla, uwucwilise amahora angu-5+, ulahle lawo manzi, uwubilise ngamandla okungenani imizuzu engu-10, bese uwuyeka ubile kancane.

c-267.title: Ungasiqinisi kakhulu isivalo sejva yesiraphu yamaplamu
c-267.summary: Isiraphu yamaplamu iyabiliswa yilevubu bese ikhipha i-carbon dioxide, ngakho-ke ijva evalwe yaqina ingakha ingcindezi bese iqhuma.
c-267.principle: Ilevubu lihlukanisa ushukela libe utshwala kanye ne-carbon dioxide. $\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6 \to 2\,C_2H_5OH + 2\,CO_2}$
c-267.example: Ukubilisa amagremu ayi-10 kuphela e-glucose (cishe i-0.056 mol) kukhipha cishe amalitha angu-2.7 e-CO2, ngakho ingcindezi ingakhuphuka ngokushesha ejveni engu-3 L. Kwenzeka kakhulu lokhu uma ushukela ungancibilikile noma isimo sezulu sifudumele.
c-267.actionItem: Namuhla, beka isivalo sejva yesiraphu yamaplamu sixegile noma uvale ngendwangu, futhi uma ligwebu, vula isivalo kanye ngosuku ukuze ukhiphe igesi.

c-268.title: Kungani ukugeza amabala e-curry ngensipho kuwaphendula abebomvu
c-268.summary: Umbala ophuzi we-curry (curcumin) uphenduka ube bomvu ezintweni ezine-alkali, ngakho-ke ukuwukhuhla ngensipho ene-alkaline kwenza ibala libe bomvu kakhulu futhi libe mnyama.
c-268.principle: I-Curcumin iyinkomba ye-pH: iphuzi ngaphansi kwezimo ezine-asidi kuya kokungathathi hlangothi futhi iba bomvu ngokusansundu ngenhla kwe-pH engaba ngu-8.6. $\mathrm{HCur \rightleftharpoons H^+ + Cur^-}$ (iphuzi ⇌ ibomvu)
c-268.example: Ingxube yensipho yokugeza inamazinga e-pH aphakathi kuka-9 no-10, okungaphezulu kwalokho kushintsha kombala. Insipho yezitsha engathathi hlangothi (cishe i-pH engu-7) ayiwushintshi umbala, kanti ukwomisa elangeni kwenza i-curcumin ibole ngenxa yokukhanya (photodegrades) ize iphele.
c-268.actionItem: Uma uthola ibala le-curry namuhla, lihlambulule ngamanzi abandayo, ligcobe ngensipho yezitsha engathathi hlangothi, ungalisebenzisi insipho evamile, bese uyaloma elangeni.

c-269.title: Kungani izikhupha zamaqanda abilisiwe ziba nendingilizi eluhlaza
c-269.summary: Indingilizi eluhlaza esikhuphaneni esibiliswe kakhulu iyi-iron sulfide engenangozi, kanti ukubilisa isikhathi esifushane kuyayivimbela.
c-269.principle: I-hydrogen sulfide ephuma kuma-amino acid e-sulfur amhlophe eqandeni isabela ne-iron esikhuphaneni yakhe i-iron sulfide. $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + H_2S \to FeS + 2H^+}$
c-269.example: Iqanda elikhulu livuthwa ngokugcwele cishe emizuzwini eyi-10-12 ngemva kokuba amanzi eqale ukubila, kanti uma kudlula imizuzu eyi-15 indingilizi eluhlaza yakheka kalula. Ukulipholisa emanzini abandayo imizuzu emi-5 ngokushesha kuyasimisa lesi senzo samakhemikhali.
c-269.actionItem: Uma ubilisa amaqanda namuhla, p 何 pheka imizuzu eyi-10-12 kuphela ngemva kokuba amanzi eqale ukubila, bese uwapholisa ngokushesha emanzini abandayo imizuzu emi-5.

c-270.title: Ukugwinya ibhethri lenkinobho kungadala ukusha phakathi kwamahora ama-2
c-270.summary: Ibhethri eliyisicaba eliyindilinga eliwumumo wenkinobho eligwanyiwe lingadala ukusha okukhulu emphinjeni phakathi kwamahora ama-2, ngakho-ke yana egumbini lezimo eziphuthumayo (ER) ngokushesha ngisho noma ungekho nezimpawu.
c-270.principle: Lapho ibhethri lithinta amathe emphinjeni, amandla kagesi ayageleza bese enza i-electrolysis emanzini, ekhiqiza i-hydroxide ohlangothini olunegethivu kanye nokusha okunamandla kwe-alkaline. $2\mathrm{H_2O} + 2e^- \to \mathrm{H_2} + 2\mathrm{OH^-}$
c-270.example: Iseli yebhethri ye-lithium engu-20 mm, 3 V (CR2032) ibhajwa kalula emphinjeni wengane, futhi i-pH yezicubu ingafinyelela ku-12-13. Ukulimala kuqala phakathi kwamahora ama-2, futhi akufanele uhlanzise ingane noma ulinde.
c-270.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ukuthi izingxenye zamabhethri zezilawuli kude (remotes), okhiye bezimoto, namathoyizi ziqiniswe ngezikulufu, futhi ugcine amabhethri ayisipele lapho izingane zingafinyeleli khona.

c-271.title: Nciphisa i-tuna ne-swordfish ibe izikhathi eziyi-1-2 ngeviki ngenxa ye-mercury
c-271.summary: Izinhlanzi ezinkulu ezidla ezinye njenge-tuna ne-swordfish zigxilisa i-methylmercury eningi, ngakho-ke kuhlakaniphile ukuzinciphisa zibe izikhathi eziyi-1-2 ngeviki.
c-271.principle: Amagciwane aguqula i-mercury ibe yi-methylmercury, eqongelelana ngokukhula kohlelo lokudla (food chain). $\mathrm{Hg^{2+} \xrightarrow{\text{microbes}} CH_3Hg^+}$ Isilinganiso samasonto onke esibekezelelekayo se-EFSA singu-1.3 μg ngekhilogremu yesisindo somzimba ngalinye.
c-271.example: Kumuntu ongamakhilogremu angama-60 umkhawulo weviki ngu-78 μg. Ingxenye engu-100 g ye-swordfish ene-1.0 ppm iqukethe cishe i-100 μg futhi ingadlula lo mkhawulo esidlweni esisodwa, kuyilapho u-100 g we-tuna elula ku-0.1 ppm unama-10 μg. Abesifazane abakhulelwe nezingane kufanele baqaphele nakakhulu.
c-271.actionItem: Namuhla, gcina i-tuna, i-swordfish kanye noshaka ku-100 g kuphela ngokudla ngakunye, futhi uhlele ukungadli lezi zinhlanzi ezinkulu ngaphezu kwezikhathi eziyi-1-2 kuleli viki.

c-272.title: Ama-shrimp nama-crab aphenduka abomvu uma ephekwe
c-272.summary: Ama-shrimp nama-crab aphenduka abomvu ngoba ukushisa kushintsha amaprotheni awo futhi kukhulule umbala obomvu obubanjwe ngaphakathi, okuwuphawu oluhle lokuthi aseqediwe ukuphekwa.
c-272.principle: Lapho esaphila, i-astaxanthin iboshelwe kuphrotheni (crustacyanin) futhi ibukeka iluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka-mpunga; ukushisa kuguqula isimo sephrotheni (denatures) bese kukhulula i-astaxanthin ebomvu. $\text{astaxanthin-protein (blue-gray)} \xrightarrow{\Delta} \text{astaxanthin (red)} + \text{denatured protein}$
c-272.example: I-shrimp ivuthwa lapho izinga lokushisa langaphakathi lifinyelela ku-63 °C (145 °F), iphenduka ingabonakali kahle (opaque) futhi ibe phinki, kanti imizuzu emi-2-3 emanzini abilayo yanele. Ukupheka isikhathi eside kwenza inyama ibe lukhuni njengenjoloba.
c-272.actionItem: Uma ubilisa ama-shrimp namuhla, wakhiphe ngokushesha nje lapho ephenduka aphinki angasabonakali futhi egoqana aba njengesimo sohlamvu u-C, ukuze angabi lukhuni.

c-273.title: Uketshezi lwamabhuleki oludala lwenza amabhuleki angasebenzi kahle
c-273.summary: Uketshezi lwamabhuleki lumunca umswakama emoyeni, okwehlisa izinga lalo lokubila, futhi lungabila ngesikhathi kubhulekwa kakhulu njengasezintabeni ezinde zehlayo bese lunciphisa amandla okubhuleka.
c-273.principle: Uketshezi lwamabhuleki olusekelwe ku-glycol lumunca umswakama (hygroscopic), ngakho amanzi ehlisa izinga lalo lokubila bese kwakheka umusi; umusi uyaminyeka futhi awukwazi ukudlulisa amandla okubhuleka. $\ln\frac{P_2}{P_1} = -\frac{\Delta H_{vap}}{R}\left(\frac{1}{T_2} - \frac{1}{T_1}\right)$
c-273.example: Uketshezi lwe-DOT 4 lunezinga lokubila elingomile okungenani elingu-230 °C, kodwa ngamanzi amunciwe lingehlela ku-155 °C, ukwehla okungaba ngu-75 °C. Ngokuvamile lumunca cishe u-2-3% wamanzi ngonyaka, ngakho ukushintshwa njalo eminyakeni emi-2 noma njalo ngamakhilomitha angama-40,000 kuyanconywa.
c-273.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ibhuku lakho lesevisi ukuthola ukuthi uketshezi lwamabhuleki lagcina nini ukushintshwa, futhi uma sekudlule iminyaka engaphezu kwemi-2, bhukha ukuhlolwa koketshezi lwamabhuleki egaraji.

c-274.title: Umbala ophinki we-ham ungenxa yokufakwa kwe-nitrite
c-274.summary: I-ham ihlala iphinki ngemva kokuphekwa ngenxa yombala owenziwe yi-nitrite, futhi kuhlakaniphile ukungadli inyama eningi egayiwe futhi eyenziwe ngamakhemikhali (processed meat).
c-274.principle: Esimweni esine-asidi, i-nitrite iphenduka i-nitric oxide (NO), eboshelana ne-iron yombala wenyama i-myoglobin bese yakha i-nitrosomyoglobin ephinki. $\mathrm{NO + Mb(Fe^{2+}) \to Mb(Fe^{2+})\text{-}NO}$
c-274.example: Umkhawulo we-nitrite esele emikhiqizweni yenyama e-Korea ngu-70 mg/kg noma ngaphansi. I-WHO ihlukanisa inyama egayiwe njenge-Group 1 carcinogen (edala umdlavuza), ilinganisela ukuthi ingozi yomdlavuza wamathumbu amakhulu inyuka ngo-18% ngokudla amagremu angama-50 nsuku zonke.
c-274.actionItem: Faka efrijini noma iyiphi i-ham oyitholayo namuhla, futhi uyidle ngezingxenye ezingaba ngu-50 g kanye nemifino.

c-275.title: Iphuphu Elimhlophe Kuma-Persimmon Omisiwe Lingamakristalu Kashukela, Hhayi Isikhunta
c-275.summary: Uqweqwe olumhlophe oluvela kuma-persimmon omisiwe ngokuvamile lushukela oselube amakristalu (i-glucose ne-fructose), hhayi isikhunta. Amachashaza aluhlaza okotshani noma amnyama anoboya yisikhunta, ngakho-ke alahle lawo.
c-275.principle: Njengoba isithelo soma, amanzi ayaphuma bese ukuminyana kukashukela kukhuphuka. Uma sekudlule izinga lokuncibilika kokugcwala (saturation solubility), ushukela uba amakristalu: $C > C_{\mathrm{sat}}(T)$, lapho u-$C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{sugar}}}{V_{\mathrm{water}}}$ ekhula ngenxa yokuthi isibalo esingaphansi siyancipha.
c-275.example: I-persimmon elisha linamanzi acishe abe ngama-80% kanye noshukela ongaba ngu-15%, kodwa elomile lehla libe ngamanzi acishe abe ngu-25-30% kanye noshukela ongu-60% noma ngaphezulu ngesisindo. Lokho kuminyana yikho okwenza uqweqwe olumhlophe olungaphezulu.
c-275.actionItem: Lapho uthenga ama-persimmon omisiwe namuhla, khetha lawo anoqweqwe olulinganayo, oluqinile, nolomile, futhi ugweme noma yimaphi anamachashaza anoboya aluhlaza okotshani noma izingxenye ezinamathelayo.

c-276.title: Iphunga Lokusha Lapho Uqala Ukukhanyisa Isifudumezi Uthuli Olushayo
c-276.summary: Iphunga lokufukama nelokusha lapho uqala ukukhanyisa isifudumezi (heater) ngemva kwehlobo ngokuvamile luthuli oluhlale kuso olushiswa ngokushisa okukhulu. Ngokuvamile liyaphela emizuzwini embalwa ngokuvula umoya, kodwa uma liqhubeka, lihlolisise.
c-276.principle: Izinto eziphilayo othulini (imicu, amagwebu esikhumba) zibola ngokushisa (pyrolyze), zikhiphe amagesi anuka kabi namalahle. Lokhu kuqala cishe ku-$T \approx 150\text{~}250\,^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, kanti indawo engaphezulu yensimbi yokushisa ishisa kakhulu kunalokho.
c-276.example: Insimbi yesifudumezi sikagesi ivame ukufinyelela ku-300-800°C phezulu, ngakho uthuli lusha kalula. Isifudumezi esingu-1-2 kW singanuka emizuzwini engama-30 yokuqala, kanti ngemva kokuhlanza iphunga liyaphela cishe ngokuphelele.
c-276.actionItem: Ngaphambi kokukhanyisa isifudumezi sakho namuhla, sikhiphe epulakini, sula uthuli lokungena komoya nolwaphansi nge-vacuum, bese uvula ifasitela usivule imizuzu eyi-10. Uma iphunga lokusha liqhubeka noma kuvela intuthu, sicishe bese usihlolisisa.

c-277.title: Ukufaka Usawoti Eklabishini Le-Napa Kuyalibuna Futhi Kwenze Ukunambitheka Kwe-Kimchi Kungene
c-277.summary: Ukufaka iklabishi usawoti kukhipha amanzi nge-osmosis, ngakho liyabuna, limunce izinongo kahle, futhi lihlale liqinile. Iklabishi elingenasawoti owanele lenza i-kimchi engenanambitheko futhi ethambile kakhulu.
c-277.principle: Ulwelwesi lwamaseli luvumela izinto ezithile ukudlula (semipermeable), ngakho lapho ukuminyana kukasawoti kungaphandle kuphezulu, amanzi aphuma kumaseli. Umfutho we-osmosis ngu-$\Pi = iCRT$, kanti i-calcium ihlanganisa i-pectin, igcine izicubu ziqinile.
c-277.example: Ukufaka iklabishi elilodwa le-napa (cishe amakhilogremu angu-2.5) usawoti ongaba ngu-200 g (cishe ama-8%) amahora angu-4-6 kunciphisa isisindo salo ngama-20-25%, kukhiphe amanzi acishe abe ngu-0.5-0.6 kg. Izinga lokugcina likasawoti elingaba ngu-2% lilingene kahle.
c-277.actionItem: Uma wenza i-kimchi namuhla, gumbuqela iklabishi kanye ngenkathi lisemanzini anosawoti, bese ulihlambulula futhi ulikhama lapho isiqu sigoba ngaphandle kokugqabuka.

c-278.title: Ama-Persimmon Ahlabayo Ayayeka Ukuhlaba Lapho Ama-Tannin Ancibilikayo Eba Ngawehluleki Ukuncibilika
c-278.summary: Ukunambitheka okuhlabayo nokomisa komlomo kwe-persimmon kuvela kuma-tannin ancibilika emanzini, futhi kuyaphela lapho engasancibiliki. Ukumisa noma ukwelashwa kokususa ukuhlaba kuncike kulokhu ngqo.
c-278.principle: Ama-tannin ancibilikayo abopha amaprotheni asematheni nasolimini, enze umuzwa wokoma. Njengoba isithelo sivuthwa, soma noma sivalelwe, kwakheka i-acetaldehyde ($\mathrm{CH_3CHO}$) bese ihlanganisa ama-tannin abe yizigaxa ezingancibiliki ezingasancibiliki ematheni.
c-278.example: I-persimmon elihlabayo liqukethe cishe i-1% ye-tannin encibilikayo, eyomisa umlomo wakho, kodwa uma livalelwe cishe ku-20-25°C izinsuku ezingu-3-5 iningi layo alisakwazi ukuncibilika futhi ukunambitheka okuhlabayo cishe kuyaphela.
c-278.actionItem: Uma unama-persimmon ahlabayo namuhla, wavalele esitsheni noma esikhwameni une-aphula noma ubhanana izinsuku ezingu-2-3, noma wacwebe uwanike elangeni ukuze ome. Nambitha ucezu oluncane ngaphambi kokudla ukuze uhlole.

c-279.title: Ijusi Ye-Grapefruit Ingashintsha Indlela Eminye Imithi Esebenza Ngayo
c-279.summary: I-grapefruit ingavimba ukwehlukaniswa kweminye imithi emzimbeni, ikhuphule izinga layo egazini. Uma uphuza noma yimuphi umuthi, buza usokhemisi ukuthi ngabe i-grapefruit iyaphazamisana yini nawo.
c-279.principle: Ama-furanocoumarin e-grapefruit avimbela i-enzyme yokugaya imithi emathunjini i-CYP3A4. Ngokuncipha kokwehlukaniswa komuthi, umuthi omningi uyamuncwa, ngakho i-$AUC=\int_0^\infty C(t)\,dt$ iyenyuka futhi ingozi yemiphumela engemihle iyakhula.
c-279.example: Kwamanye ama-statin, ingilazi eyodwa (cishe engu-250 mL) yejusi ye-grapefruit ingaphindaphinda izinga lomuthi egazini (AUC) izikhathi eziningana, futhi umphumela ungathatha ngaphezu kosuku. Ubukhulu bomphumela buhluka kakhulu phakathi kwemithi.
c-279.actionItem: Namuhla, hlola ipheshana lanoma yimuphi umuthi owuphuzayo noma ubuze usokhemisi ukuthi ngabe i-grapefruit iyinkinga yini, futhi uma kunjalo, gwema ijusi nesithelo esisha. Ungawumisi umuthi ngokwakho.

c-280.title: Kungani Uketshezi Kumele Lube Ezitsheni Ezingama-100 mL Emthwalweni Oya Egumbini Lendiza
c-280.summary: Ezindizeni zamazwe ngamazwe, uketshezi namajeli ezikhwameni eziphathwa ngesandla kumele kube sezitsheni ezingama-100 mL noma ngaphansi, zipakishwe esikhwameni esisodwa esisobala esine-zip. Umthetho uklanyelwe ukugcina noma yisiphi isitsha esisodwa singaphansi kwenani eliyingozi.
c-280.principle: Umthetho ubeka umkhawulo kubukhulu besitsha ngoba iziqhumane ezinguketshezi ziyingozi kuphela uma zingaphezulu kwenani elithile. Isamba esiphathwayo ngu-$V_{\mathrm{total}}=\sum V_i$ lapho i-$V_i \le 100\,\mathrm{mL}$ ngayinye, ngokuvamile ekhawulelwe esikhwameni esisodwa esingu-1 L.
c-280.example: Izitsha eziyishumi ezingama-100 mL esikhwameni esisodwa esingu-1 L zinikeza isamba esiphezulu esingaba ngu-1 L. Ibhodlela elingu-200 mL, ngisho lingaba nengxenye engenalutho, livame ukwenqatshwa ngoba umthamo wesitsha yiwo obalwayo.
c-280.actionItem: Uma ulungiselela uhambo namuhla, thela i-shampoo, i-lotion nomuthi owuketshezi emabhodleleni angama-100 mL noma amancane, uwafake esikhwameni esisodwa esisobala esine-zip, bese usigcina phezulu esikhwameni sakho. Phinda uhlole imithetho yenkampani yezindiza neyezwe ngaphambi kokuhamba.

c-281.title: Choose Fermented Seafood by Aging and Amino-Acid Flavor, Not Just Saltiness
c-281.summary: The savory depth of jeotgal comes from amino acids released as proteins break down during aging. Check that it is not just salty and that the production and aging details are clear.
c-281.principle: Protease enzymes in the fish gut hydrolyze protein into peptides and amino acids: $\text{protein} + n\,\mathrm{H_2O} \to n\,\text{amino acids}$. Glutamic acid in particular gives the savory umami taste.
c-281.example: Salted shrimp usually has a salt level around 20%, and after 3-6 months of aging its amino nitrogen rises and the flavor deepens. At the same salt level, a short-aged product tastes fishy and merely salty.
c-281.actionItem: When buying jeotgal today, check the production date, ingredients and salt level on the label, and if you can taste, pick the one that leaves sweetness and richness after the saltiness.

c-282.title: Check Gas Connections With Soapy Water Bubbles, Not by Smell Alone
c-282.summary: To check a suspected gas leak at a connection, brush on soapy water and watch for bubbles. Never use a flame or lighter to check, as it risks an explosion.
c-282.principle: Leaking gas pushes up the soap film formed by surfactant and makes bubbles. For a bubble, $\Delta P = \frac{4\gamma}{r}$, so even a small leak shows up as a visible bubble.
c-282.example: Brush a mix of about 1 mL dish soap in 100 mL of water onto a stove hose connection, and bubbles that keep growing or forming mean a leak. Natural gas is lighter than air and rises, while LPG is heavier and settles low.
c-282.actionItem: Today, with the gas valve closed, brush soapy water on hose connections and look for bubbles. If bubbles keep growing, shut the valve, ventilate and have a professional inspect it.

c-283.title: Chestnuts Stored Cold Get Sweeter as Starch Turns Into Sugar
c-283.summary: Fresh chestnuts kept in the fridge at 0-4°C for a few weeks turn starch into sugar and taste sweeter. At room temperature they spoil fast, so refrigeration is the thrifty choice.
c-283.principle: In the cold, amylase and other enzymes break starch into maltose and glucose: $(\mathrm{C_6H_{10}O_5})_n + n\,\mathrm{H_2O}\to n\,\mathrm{C_6H_{12}O_6}$. Plants build up sugars to protect against freezing through osmotic protection.
c-283.example: Freshly harvested chestnuts hold about 5-8% sugar, but after 4-8 weeks at 0-2°C the sugar content can rise about 1.5-2 times, giving a clearly sweeter taste. At room temperature, worms and mold appear within about two weeks.
c-283.actionItem: Today, wrap whole chestnuts in paper towels, put them in a zip bag in the fridge (about 1-4°C), and steam or roast them within 1-2 weeks.

c-284.title: Whether Home Canning Is Safe Depends on the pH 4.6 Threshold
c-284.summary: In home canning, you must separate high-acid foods at pH 4.6 or below from low-acid foods above it. Boiling-water heating alone can leave a botulism toxin risk in low-acid foods.
c-284.principle: Botulinum spores can produce toxin in sealed, oxygen-free conditions when pH is above 4.6. Acidity is $\mathrm{pH}=-\log_{10}[\mathrm{H^+}]$, and pH 4.6 corresponds to $[\mathrm{H^+}]\approx 2.5\times10^{-5}\,\mathrm{mol/L}$.
c-284.example: Jam and fruit preserves have a pH around 3-4, so boiling-water processing is relatively safe, but vegetables, meat and beans sit at pH 5-7 and need pressure heating at about 116-121°C. Boiling water cannot exceed 100°C.
c-284.actionItem: If you do home canning today, check whether the ingredient is acidic (fruit or vinegar pickle), and for low-acid foods refrigerate or freeze instead of canning at home. If a lid bulges or there are bubbles or an off smell, do not eat it and throw it away.

c-285.title: Chocolate Can Be Poisonous to Dogs
c-285.summary: The theobromine in chocolate is broken down slowly by dogs and can cause poisoning. The higher the cocoa content, the greater the risk, so if a dog ate some, note the type and amount and call a vet.
c-285.principle: Theobromine ($\mathrm{C_7H_8N_4O_2}$) has a half-life of about 17 hours in dogs versus about 6-10 hours in humans, so it accumulates. Risk is gauged by dose per body weight $D=\frac{m_{\mathrm{theobromine}}}{m_{\mathrm{body}}}$.
c-285.example: Dark chocolate (70% cocoa) holds about 5-8 mg/g of theobromine, so a 10 kg dog eating about 50 g (roughly half a standard bar) takes in about 250-400 mg (about 25-40 mg/kg), a range with risk of severe signs. Milk chocolate has less.
c-285.actionItem: Today, store chocolate and cocoa products high up or in a sealed cupboard where a dog cannot reach. If one ate any, do not wait: note the type, amount and time, and call a vet right away.

c-286.title: Airplane Food Tastes Bland Because of Cabin Pressure and Dryness
c-286.summary: Cabin air is low in pressure and very dry, which dulls smell and taste so food seems bland. That is why airline meals are deliberately seasoned strongly.
c-286.principle: Cabin pressure equals about 2,000-2,400 m of altitude (about 0.75-0.8 atm) and relative humidity is 10-20%. Under low pressure and dryness, smell and taste receptors become much less sensitive, with sweet and salty perception reported to drop about 30%. The pressure ratio is $\frac{P_{\mathrm{cabin}}}{P_0}\approx0.8$.
c-286.example: A food that tastes normal on the ground can seem 20-30% less sweet and salty at cruising altitude, so airline meals use extra salt and spices. A similar reason is given for why tomato juice tastes especially good in flight.
c-286.actionItem: If you fly today, sip water often so your mouth does not dry out, and instead of adding more salt to bland food, choose strongly flavored dishes or a tangy drink.

c-287.title: Choose Baking Flour by Protein Content: Bread, All-Purpose or Cake
c-287.summary: The difference among bread, all-purpose and cake flour is protein content. Bread flour for bread, low-protein cake flour for cakes and cookies gives the right texture.
c-287.principle: Wheat proteins gliadin and glutenin form a gluten network with water: $\text{gliadin}+\text{glutenin}+\mathrm{H_2O}\to\text{gluten}$. The more protein, the tougher and more elastic the network.
c-287.example: Bread flour has about 11-13% protein for chewy loaves and bagels, all-purpose about 9-10% for noodles and pancakes, and cake flour about 7-9% for tender cakes and cookies. A 100 g portion of cake flour has about 8 g of protein.
c-287.actionItem: When buying flour today, read the protein figure on the nutrition label and pick bread, all-purpose or cake flour to match what you plan to bake.

c-288.title: Mixing New and Old Batteries Greatly Raises the Risk of Leaks
c-288.summary: Mixing new and used batteries, or different types, can over-discharge the weak cell and make it leak. Replace all batteries in a device together with the same type and age.
c-288.principle: In series, the same current flows, and when the weak cell's voltage falls to near 0 V, the others drive it in reverse. Hydrogen forms by reactions such as $2\,\mathrm{H_2O}+2e^-\to \mathrm{H_2}+2\,\mathrm{OH^-}$, raising internal pressure and causing leaks.
c-288.example: With three fresh 1.5 V cells in series (4.5 V) and one nearly drained to 0 V, the other two keep pushing about 3 V and force that cell into reverse charging. Leaked potassium hydroxide is strongly alkaline (pH about 14) and corrodes skin and devices.
c-288.actionItem: Today, check the batteries in your remote, clock or toys, and when replacing them, swap all of a device's batteries for the same brand and fresh ones. Do not touch leaked white powder with bare hands.

c-289.title: Boil Bone Broth in One Big Batch and Portion It Out
c-289.summary: Long simmering turns bone collagen into gelatin for a rich broth that sets like jelly when cooled. Boiling one big batch and freezing portions saves gas and time.
c-289.principle: Heating unwinds collagen into gelatin, and on cooling it shifts from sol to gel. The hydrolysis is $\text{collagen}\xrightarrow{\Delta,\ \mathrm{H_2O}}\text{gelatin}$, and it typically sets below about 35°C.
c-289.example: Simmering 1 kg of ox bones in about 6 L of water for 6-8 hours gives roughly 4-5 L of broth. Instead of lighting the stove each time, one boil portioned into fifteen 300 mL servings cuts gas use a lot.
c-289.actionItem: If you make bone broth today, cool it fully, divide it into single-serving bags or containers and freeze them, then thaw and heat only what you need.

c-290.title: White Powder on Potting Soil May Be Mineral Salts, Not Mold
c-290.summary: A white crust on potting soil or the pot rim may be leftover mineral salts from fertilizer or tap water rather than mold. Flushing with plenty of water reduces it.
c-290.principle: When water evaporates from the surface, dissolved salts are left behind and precipitate. Concentration $C=\frac{m_{\mathrm{salt}}}{V_{\mathrm{water}}}$ rises as $V_{\mathrm{water}}$ falls, and past saturation crystals form, such as the hard-water component $\mathrm{CaCO_3}$.
c-290.example: If tap water has hardness of about 100 mg/L (as CaCO3), evaporating 1 L leaves about 100 mg of calcium carbonate. Even 200 mL per week builds a visible white layer on the surface within a few months.
c-290.actionItem: If you see white powder today, scrape off the top 1-2 cm of soil and cover with fresh soil, then slowly water with about the pot's volume so it drains out fully.

c-291.title: Xylitol Gum Is Dangerous if Your Dog Eats It
